point is on the left of the segment's direction (set when made). Horizontal and vertical distances are
signed: `b` minus `a`.

The angle from segment `a`'s direction to `b`'s, counter-clockwise; `reverseA`, `reverseB`: a segment taken
from its end to its start (chosen when made, so the angle measured is the one the user picked).

Convention.description:
Which way a Helmert transformation's rotations turn: EPSG's position
vector convention (9606) or its coordinate frame convention (9607).

CrsBase.description:
A local system's base: a projected system of the registry by its EPSG
code (`srid`), or a transverse Mercator the project defines
(`definition`); exactly one.

CrsDefinition.description:
A coordinate system the project defines (docs/adr/0168 §1): its name
and what it is.

CrsPlane.description:
A local system's coordinates to its base's: base x = a·x + b·y + c,
base y = d·x + e·y + f; a similarity turns counter-clockwise (degrees),
scales, then shifts.

CrsSystem.description: The kind of system a definition is.

CustomDatum.description:
A datum the project defines: its ellipsoid and, when it has one, its
seven parameters to WGS 84 (without them it stands alone).

DatumTransform.description:
The project's choice for a pair of the registry's datums instead of
EPSG's way (docs/adr/0168 §3); the pair's other way is its reverse. It
shifts by seven parameters (`helmert`) or an NTv2 grid (`grid`); exactly
one.

name.description: What the values rest on: “ED50 → TUREF: Bölge 7”.

DeviceTerminal.description: A terminal: its id (lower-case letters, digits and hyphens) and its name (what the tools say).

DimensionArrow.description:
A dimension's arrowheads other than the oblique tick, which is no value but
the field's absence (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: A filled triangle, its tip on the dimension line's end (Dolu ok).
The triangle's two sides (Açık ok).
A filled circle about the end (Nokta).
Nothing at the ends (Yok).

DimensionFit.description:
Where the value goes when it does not fit between the extension lines (AutoCAD's DIMATFIT and DIMTIX): absent,
always between them.

oneOf.description: Beyond the second extension line when the value and the two arrowheads are longer than the line between them.
Always beyond the second extension line, the arrowheads outside.

DimensionOptions.description: A dimension's options (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2): all absent, the dimension as it always was.

breakSize.description: A break's width, times the value's height, over 0; absent: 1 (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK size).

lengthStyle.description:
Feet and inches in an inch or foot unit (AutoCAD's DIMLUNIT, docs/adr/0262 §2); absent: the project's, unless
the dimension names its own unit.

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

DimensionStyleDef.description: A named dimension style (docs/adr/0183 §3): sizes in paper mm.

arrowSize.description: The arrowhead's length, mm; absent: the arrowhead's default times the height.

dimLineColor.description: The line fields as a dimension's (docs/adr/0205 §6); weights in paper mm.

height.description: The value's height on paper, mm.

id.description: One of its kind among the project's dimension styles (a UUIDv7).

name.description: As a text style's.

options.description: The value's fit and writing (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2).

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

DistanceAxis.description: Which way a distance is measured: along the line between its points, or across or along the drawing's axes.

oneOf.description: Along east: `b`'s east minus `a`'s.
Along north: `b`'s north minus `a`'s.

DoorSource.description: The doors' layer and which of its attributes say what.

code.description: Adres kodu (UAVT): a query that is one finds its door.

door.description: Kapı no: the outer door number (“12”, “12/A”).

layer.description: The layer's id. A layer the project no longer has is said when the locator is built.

street.description: Yol: the street's name, with its kind as written (“Atatürk Bulvarı”).

DrawingFont.description:
The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

ElementRef.description: A part of an object by the object's persistent id.

Ellipsoid.description: An ellipsoid: its name, semi-major axis (m) and inverse flattening.

EventLink.description: A link: the events of one layer on the routes of some others.

eventRoute.description: The events' attribute naming their route.

events.description: The event layer's id: the objects it holds are the events (points, or lines and polylines).

from.description: A line event's from and to measure attributes (`line` only, and then both required).

id.description: Letters, digits, `-`, `_`, `.`; 1–64; unique in the project.

measure.description: A point event's measure attribute (`point` only, and then required).

name.description: What the windows show; trimmed, 1–64 characters.

offset.description: The attribute of the offset from the route (m, perpendicular); none: the event is on the route.

routeField.description: The routes' id field: a route is the first object of an id.

routes.description: The route layers' ids (1–16, none twice, none the event layer).

side.description: The side a positive offset lies on; written only when not `right`.

tolerance.description: How far (m) an event may lie from its route's place before a write moves it; none: 0,001.

EventLinkKind.description: What an event object is: a point at a measure, or a line between two.

oneOf.description: A point at one measure (`measure`).
A line or a polyline from one measure to another (`from`, `to`).

EventSide.description: Which side of the route a positive offset lies on.

oneOf.description: The right of the measure's direction.
The left of it.

FeatureFeed.description: Where a layer's objects came from, to take them again (docs/adr/0208 §10).

bbox.description: The area asked, `[x₁, y₁, x₂, y₂]` in the project's system; absent: all.

filter.description: CQL, or ArcGIS's `where`.

key.description: The attribute that matches objects when they are taken again.

name.description: WFS's type, OGC's collection, ArcGIS's layer.

srid.description: The system asked of the service.

FeedKind.description: What a layer's objects were taken from (docs/adr/0208 §10).

oneOf.description: An ArcGIS REST layer's `query`.
A GeoJSON document at an address.

FieldChoice.description:
One value of a field's value list: the code written to the attribute
and the label shown for it.

description.description: What the value means, said beside it in a list (docs/adr/0438 §5): 1–500 characters.

from.description:
The first day the value holds (`YYYY-AA-GG`, docs/adr/0438 §5); before it a new choice does not
offer it, as a retired one.

retired.description:
Kullanımdan kalktı (docs/adr/0418): a record that holds it keeps it and shows it, a new
choice does not offer it, a form does not write it anew. Written only as `true`.

until.description: The last day the value holds (`YYYY-AA-GG`); after it a new choice does not offer it.

FieldDomain.description: A value list of the project: a coded list (`values`) or a range (`min`, `max`), never both.

id.description: Its stable id: what a field links to.

kind.description: The kind of field it fits: a field linking it is of this kind.

max.description: A range's greatest value, in its canonical text; included.

maxExclusive.description: `max` itself left out of the range; written only as `true`.

min.description: A range's least value, in its canonical text; included.

minExclusive.description: `min` itself left out of the range (docs/adr/0438 §4); written only as `true`.

unit.description: The unit a number list's values are in (`m²`; docs/adr/0438 §4), copied to the fields linking it.

values.description: A coded list's values, in their order (labels, retired codes as a field's list has them).

FieldGroup.description: A group of fields whose values go together.

fields.description: Its fields' keys, in its order: 2–8 single-valued listed fields.

name.description: The group's name, once in the layer.

restrictive.description: A combination none of its rows allows is refused (advisory: warned).

rows.description: The combinations allowed.

FormBody.description: A form's content: its items and the draft's revision (each kept change adds one).

clearHidden.description:
A write through the form empties the fields the record hides (docs/adr/0402 §3); written only
as `true`. Without it a hidden field keeps its value.

revision.description: Raised by one with every saved change to the draft: an update names the revision it was made on.

scope.description:
Kapsam (docs/adr/0539): an expression over the layer's fields and the `@` values; a Veri girişi
reads and writes, through this form, only the records it holds true for (`@kullanici`,
`@kullanici_eposta` the person signed in). None: every record of the layer. At most
`MOST_SCOPE_LETTERS` letters.

steps.description:
Adım adım (docs/adr/0437): the tabs are steps, taken in order with Geri and İleri; a step with
an error is not left forward. Only a form of tabs; written only as `true`.

tests.description:
The designer's scenarios (docs/adr/0420): values typed into a record and what the form made of
them, run again whenever the form changes.

translations.description:
The form's words in other languages (docs/adr/0443 §5), by language tag (`en`, `de`, `ar`): its
name and its items' labels and help. Only what is shown changes; the values, codes and rules are
the form's own.

workflow.description:
The records' workflow (docs/adr/0428): their state, the steps between states, the states that
lock a record.

FormCheck.description:
A check of a field: an expression that must be true when the field is shown and filled, and what
the form says when it is not.

on.description:
When it is asked (docs/adr/0438 §2); none: as the value changes. A check asked later is still
asked of every save that reaches it: the moment only says when the form shows it.

warning.description: A soft check: when not true it warns and the record is still written; written only as `true`.

FormComment.description: A reviewer's comment on a form or one of its items (docs/adr/0441 §5).

author.description: Who wrote it and when (as the command was given them).

id.description: 1, 2, …: one more than the form's last.

item.description: The item it is about; none: the form.

FormItem.description: An item of a form: a tab (only at the top), a group, a field or a note.

oneOf.description:
A tab: its items show when it is chosen. Tabs stand at the top only, and then the top holds
nothing but tabs.

visibleWhen.description: The tab is shown while it holds (docs/adr/0426): a record's kind may have tabs of its own.

oneOf.description: A group: a titled box of items, in one or two columns, that a rule may hide.

across.description:
In two columns, filled a row at a time: Tab goes across, then down (docs/adr/0443 §6); else
down the first column, then the second. Written only as `true`.

collapsed.description: It opens closed (its title opens it); written only as `true`.

columns.description: 1 or 2; none: 1.

oneOf.description: A field of the layer.

calculate.description:
The field's value, worked out from the record at every write; the field is read-only. Not
with `default`, `defaultExpr` or `readOnlyWhen`.

checks.description: What the record must satisfy, in order.

choiceFilter.description:
Asked of each of the field's listed values: `@secenek` is its code, `@secenek_etiketi` its
label; a value it is not true for is not offered.

default.description:
The value an empty field shows when the form opens, in the field's canonical text; written
only when the record is saved.

defaultExpr.description:
The value of a new record's empty field: an expression over the record (its plain defaults
in), evaluated in the form's order. Not with `default`.

field.description: The layer field's key ([`LayerField::key`](crate::LayerField::key)): its stable id or its name.

id.description: The item's id, unique in the form.

label.description: The label; none: the field's alias or name.

lookup.description:
The field's values from another layer (docs/adr/0404 §1). Not with the field's own list or
`choiceFilter`.

minSearch.description:
A searched list searches once this many letters are typed (docs/adr/0439 §6); none: from the
first.

mirror.description:
A mirror (docs/adr/0437): the field's value shown again, read-only, where the form needs it; the
field's own item elsewhere writes it. Only its label, help, widget and visibility rule. Written
only as `true`.

overridable.description:
The calculation may be overridden (docs/adr/0417): it fills the field while the field is
empty, the field stays open to typing, and emptying it calculates it again. Only with
`calculate`; written only as `true`.

readOnly.description: Shown, never edited; written only as `true`.

readOnlyWhen.description: Locked when this expression is true.

redact.description:
Kept out of the recorder's examples (docs/adr/0443 §2): the field's values are written as
`‹gizli›` in the Python and replay a call is copied as. Written only as `true`.

required.description:
May not be left empty while shown; written only as `true`. The layer field's own `required`
holds as well.

requiredWhen.description: Required when this expression is true (and the field is shown).

reuseLast.description:
A new record's field opens with the value last written through the form in the session (the
form's interface keeps it); written only as `true`.

suggest.description:
The layer's values of the field offered while typing, the value staying free (docs/adr/0407
§3): text fields without a list; written only as `true`.

unique.description: No two objects of the layer have the same value (empty ones aside); written only as `true`.

visibleWhen.description: Shown only when this expression is true (the record's fields by name).

widget.description: How it is edited; none: the field kind's own.

oneOf.description:
A line of text: a hint for whoever fills the form. A `{…}` in it is an expression put in with
the record's value (docs/adr/0225 §6's templates; docs/adr/0402 §1).

The objects of another layer whose field holds this record's persistent id (docs/adr/0404 §4):
a list in the form, each opened by its own form.

columns.description: The table's columns: the other layer's fields' keys, at most 8; empty: its first four.

field.description: Its field's key that holds this record's id.

layer.description: The other layer's id.

max.description: The most (1–1000): 1 one to one.

min.description:
The fewest related objects (0–1000) the record holds while the item is shown: 1 a child it
must have (docs/adr/0444 §1).

view.description: How the objects are shown (docs/adr/0425): a list of their names, or a table of `columns`.

oneOf.description:
The record's photos and documents (docs/adr/0407 §1): the object's own attachments, added
and removed in the form; their count may be bounded.

accept.description: What counts and is added: every attachment, only photos or only documents and addresses.

max.description: The most (0–100).

min.description: The fewest (0–100) the record holds while the item is shown.

oneOf.description:
The record's place (docs/adr/0433): its shape on a small map, its centre's coordinates and its
area or length; nothing is written.
A divider (docs/adr/0441 §2): a line across the form, its title on it, that a rule may hide.

An action (docs/adr/0441 §6, 0442 §5): a button of a declared kind on the record: a registered
processing tool by its id, the form's calculations again, a workflow step by its label, or the
record shown on the drawing; no address, query or script.

kind.description: What it does; written unless `tool`.

runs.description: Where a `tool` action's tool runs (docs/adr/0442 §6); written unless `auto`.

step.description: A `step` action's workflow step, by its label.

tool.description:
A `tool` action's processing tool id (`attributes.calculate`): letters and digits in dotted
parts.

FormLookup.description: A field's list of values from another layer (docs/adr/0404 §1, docs/adr/0439 §1).

columns.description:
Its layer's fields shown beside a value's label in the list and under the chosen value
(docs/adr/0439 §2), in order; at most [`MOST_LOOKUP_COLUMNS`].

copy.description:
The chosen object's fields copied into the record's when the value is chosen (docs/adr/0439
§3): a copy, kept when the source changes.

duplicates.description: What a code held by more than one of the list's objects is (docs/adr/0439 §4).

filter.description: Asked of each of the list's objects (its fields by name, the project's `@` values).

key.description: Its field's key whose value is written; `$uid`: the object's persistent id (a reference).

label.description: Its field's key shown; none: the key's.

layer.description: The list's layer id.

limit.description:
How many values a page of the list holds (docs/adr/0439 §1): a form's state carries the
first ones and the count of the rest; searching reaches them all. None: every value.

matches.description: The list's object is offered when its field equals the record's (a chain: il, ilçe, mahalle).

sort.description: The list's order (docs/adr/0439 §1): by a field of its layer; none: the labels' natural order.

spatial.description: Only the list's objects standing so to the record's geometry are offered (docs/adr/0439 §5).

stamp.description:
A text field of the record that is told where the copy came from (docs/adr/0439 §3): the
layer, the code, the copied values' fingerprint and the day.

FormRelease.description: A frozen copy of a form's body: what data entry and the write profile use.

digest.description: The first 32 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the body's canonical JSON ([`body_digest`]).

fields.description:
The layer's fields the body binds as they were at publishing ([`bound_fields_digest`]): a
release whose fields changed since is said (docs/adr/0444 §2). None: published before it was kept.

note.description: What changed, as the publisher wrote it.

version.description: 1, 2, …: one more than the release before.

FormTest.description:
A scenario of a form (docs/adr/0420): a record's typed values and what the form showed, required,
locked, wrote and said for them.

name.description: Unique in the form; trimmed, 1–64 characters.

new.description: A new record: the form's defaults fill it. Written only as `true`.

values.description: The values typed, by the layer fields' keys, onto an empty record.

attrs.description: The record after the form: its attributes by the fields' names.

issues.description: What the form said: each issue's code, `@` and its item when it has one (`form_required@not`).

shown.description: The items shown, required and read-only, by their ids in the form's order.

FormTranslation.description: A form's words in one language (docs/adr/0443 §5).

name.description: The form's name; none: its own.

oneOf.description: One line of text.
Several lines of text.
A number: integer or decimal fields.
A date (YYYY-AA-GG).
A check box: yes or no fields.
A switch: yes or no fields.
A drop-down list: fields with a value list.
Radio buttons: fields with a value list.
A segmented choice: fields with a short value list.
A slider between the field's least and most (docs/adr/0406 §2): number fields with both.
A colour, `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA` (docs/adr/0407 §2): text fields.
A check box for each listed value (docs/adr/0408 §2): multiple fields, and only they.
A list searched by typing (docs/adr/0431): single-valued fields with a long value list.
The codes held as chips, one added from a list (docs/adr/0431): multiple fields with a value list.

A tree of the list (docs/adr/0437): its labels' “Üst / Alt” parts as branches; single-valued
fields with a value list. The codes are the list's.

FormWorkflow.description:
A form's workflow (İş akışı, docs/adr/0428): a listed field holds each record's state; a step
(`cad.forms.transition`) takes a record from one state to another, the form valid when the step
says so and a reason written when it names one; a locked state's record is read-only until a step
takes it out.

drafts.description:
The draft states (docs/adr/0432): a record in one may be kept incomplete, the form's own
requirements warn; the layer's and the subtype's still refuse.

field.description: The state field's key: a single-valued field with a value list.

initial.description: The state a new record starts in: a code of its list.

locked.description: The states whose records are read-only.

log.description:
A text field's key each step appends a line to (docs/adr/0429): the moment, the person, the step,
the states and the reason; read-only in the form.

steps.description: The steps, in their order (the editor's buttons).

GeographicDefinition.description: Latitude and longitude on a datum.

customDatum.description: the project's own (exactly one of the two).

datum.description: The registry's datum by name; or

GeoidModel.description: A geoid model by its name and, when the grid file is at hand, the SHA-256 of its bytes (lower-case hex).

GridChoice.description:
An NTv2 grid the project's datum choice names: its SHA-256 (the
device's grid library keeps it by that), the file's name and size, the
accuracy the project gives it.

size.description: The file's size in bytes (at most the core's 256 MiB).

HatchPatternDef.description: A project's own hatch pattern (docs/adr/0331 §1): a PAT file's or a user's, its families as written.

name.description: One of its kind among the project's, letters' case aside; no comma.

source.description: The file it came from (`kentos.pat`).

HatchPatternUnit.description: What a project pattern's numbers are in (docs/adr/0331 §1): a PAT file says no unit.

oneOf.description: Millimetres on paper (acadiso.pat's, the library's).
Inches on paper (acad.pat's).
The drawing's own lengths, in the project's unit.
Heights above the horizontal datum's ellipsoid (a GNSS receiver's): they move with the datum's shift.

Heights above a geoid or a mean sea level (levelling's): a horizontal datum's shift leaves them; between them
and ellipsoidal heights stands a geoid model.

Not said: what a call says to mean that a side's heights are not known, and what `cad.settings.set` takes to
forget the project's. A project never keeps it (its settings leave `heights` out instead).

HeightReference.description:
What a drawing's elevations rest on: their kind, and for orthometric heights the vertical system (one of
[`VERTICAL_SYSTEMS`] by its EPSG code) and the geoid model. An ellipsoidal height names neither: its ellipsoid is
the horizontal system's.

Helmert.description:
Seven parameters: translations (m), rotations (″) in their convention,
the scale difference (ppm), and the accuracy (m) when it is given.

InfoCard.description: What the Bilgi tool shows of a layer's objects (docs/adr/0225 §5).

actions.description: Whether the layer's actions show (absent: they do).

attachments.description: Whether the object's attachments show (absent: they do).

fields.description: The attributes shown, in order; empty: all the object has.

text.description: Lines under the attributes, a template.

title.description: The card's title, a template; absent: the object's kind and label.

ItemWords.description:
An item's words in a language: its label (a tab's, group's, field's, list's or action's title, a
note's text) and its help line.

choices.description: A listed field's values' labels by their codes; the codes written are the list's own.

placeholder.description: A field's text shown in it while empty.

JoinKeep.description: Which records of the layer a view shows.

oneOf.description: Every record, the ones without a match with empty cells (a left join).
Only the records with a match (an inner join).

JoinView.description: A join view: the layer's records by `key` with the `with` layer's by `withKey`.

fields.description: The joined layer's fields the view shows, in order (keys); none: all of them.

id.description: Letters, digits, `-`, `_`, `.`; 1–64; unique in the project.

key.description: The main layer's key: a field's key, or `$uid`.

layer.description: The main layer's id: one row (or more) a record of it.

name.description: What the table's layer list shows; trimmed, 1–64 characters.

with.description: The joined layer's id (the main one itself for a tree).

withKey.description: The joined layer's key: a field's key, or `$uid`.

JunctionLayer.description: A junction layer: its points' role and, optionally, which of them it takes and which are closed.

closed.description: An expression: the junctions it holds for (a closed valve) are passed by no analysis.

oneOf.description: Bağlantı: splits the edges it lies on.
Kaynak: where the supply comes from (Yalıtım's beslemesiz kalan).
Vana: where Yalıtım stops.

always.description: Always; absent, only when the label does not fit.

LabelAlign.description: How a label's lines line up.

fill.description: Hex or a theme name (`paper`: the drawing area's colour, a mask); absent, not filled.

padding.description: CSS px round the letters; absent, 2.

LabelCallout.description: The line from a label placed away from its object to the object.

color.description: Absent, the label's.

minLength.description: A shorter one is not drawn, CSS px; absent, 6.

LabelClass.description:
One class of a rule-based labelling: its name, the condition its objects
meet and its labels' style.

name.description: One of its kind on the layer; a pin names it.

when.description: İfadeyle seç's language; absent, every object.

LabelHalo.description: The halo round a label's letters.

color.description: Hex or a theme name; absent, the drawing area's colour.

LabelObstacle.description: A layer's objects as obstacles to every label.

kind.description: An area's inside (absent) or its outline.

weight.description: 1 to 10: a label of a lower priority cannot cover them; another may, at a cost.

LabelOverlap.description: Whether a label may cover another (QGIS's three).

oneOf.description: Never: a label with no free place is not drawn.
When no free place is left, at its best one.
Always at its best place.

LabelPin.description:
A label moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (an object's
`labelPins`, docs/adr/0212 §3.7).

at.description: Where the label's middle is from the object's anchor, metres; absent, the engine places it.

class.description: The class's name; absent, the object's first label.

rotation.description: Degrees counter-clockwise from east; only with `at`.

LabelPosition.description:
A line label's side of its line; on an area's outline `above` is inside
and `below` outside.

oneOf.description: Above, else below.

LabelShadow.description: A label's shadow: the label again under it, moved.

color.description: Absent, black.

oneOf.description: A rectangle with round corners.

at.description: The letters a line may end at; absent, the space.

chars.description: The most letters a line holds (a longer word stays whole).

LabelStyle.description: How entity labels on a layer are drawn; sizes in CSS px.

align.description: How a label's lines line up; absent, centred.

area.description: Where an area's label goes; absent, by `placement`.

callout.description: The line to the object from a label placed away from it.

color.description: The letters' colour (hex or a theme name): instead of `ink`.

curved.description: An outline's label (perimeter, boundary) letter by letter.

distance.description: CSS px between a label and its object; absent, 2.

duplicates.description: CSS px within which the same text is labelled once.

halo.description: The halo round the letters; absent, 1.5 px of the drawing area's colour.

inside.description: An area's label only where it fits inside.

line.description: Where a line's label goes; absent, by `placement`.

maxAngle.description: Degrees two neighbouring letters of a curved label may turn; absent, 25.

mergeLines.description: Lines meeting end to end with the same text labelled once.

outside.description: An area's label that fits nowhere inside, outside with a callout.

overlap.description: Whether it may cover another label; absent, never.

point.description: Where a point's label goes; absent, by `placement`.

position.description: A line label's side of its line (on an outline, `above` inside).

priority.description: 0 to 10; absent, 5: higher first.

repeat.description: CSS px between a line's repeated labels.

shrink.description: The smallest size a label is made when it does not fit, a factor 0.5–1.

text.description: The text as an expression (İfadeyle seç's language, docs/adr/0212 §2): instead of the template.

LabelWord.description: One word of an abbreviation dictionary.

oneOf.description: One label: the style's `label`, else its kind's default.
The classes, in order: each whose condition holds labels an object.
None (its objects may still be obstacles).

LayerAction.description:
An action of a layer's objects (docs/adr/0225 §4): its name and the
address or file it opens, a template.

name.description: The name in the menus and on the card.

target.description: An `http`, `https` or `mailto` address or a file's path, a template.

LayerCompose.description:
How a layer is composed into the drawing (Katman çizimi, docs/adr/0226 §3,
§4); absent, as it always was: opaque, normal, no mask.

LayerField.description: A field of a layer (docs/adr/0199 §1): its name is the attribute's key.

alias.description: The name the table and the form show.

default.description: The value a new object takes, in its canonical text.

domain.description:
The project's value list it links (docs/adr/0430): its `values` (or `min` and `max`) are that
list's copy, written anew whenever the list changes. None: its own.

id.description:
The field's stable id (docs/adr/0401 §2): what a form binds to. None: its name is its id; a
rename writes the old name here so a binding holds. Unique among the layer's fields' keys.

max.description: A number's greatest value, in its canonical text; included.

maxExclusive.description: `max` is not itself in the range; only with `max`; written only as `true`.

merge.description:
What the field's value becomes when objects are merged into one (Alan birleştir, Birleştir,
Parçaları birleştir; docs/adr/0419). None: the first object's.

min.description: A number's least value, in its canonical text; included.

minExclusive.description: `min` is not itself in the range (docs/adr/0438 §4); only with `min`; written only as `true`.

multiple.description:
A text field holds several values (docs/adr/0408 §1, 0409 §1): a listed one its codes in the
list's order, an unlisted one its values in their order (objects' persistent ids for a
many-to-many reference), joined with `; `; written only as `true`.

required.description: An object may not leave it empty; written only as `true`.

scale.description: A decimal's most fraction digits (0–15).

split.description:
What the field's value becomes in the pieces when its object is split (Alan böl, Parçala,
Kır, Parçalara ayır; docs/adr/0419). None: each piece keeps it.

unique.description:
No two objects of the layer hold the same value (empty ones aside; docs/adr/0438 §3): every
write is refused `not_unique` that would; written only as `true`.

unit.description:
The unit a number is in, shown after it (`m²`, `kg`; 1–16 characters; docs/adr/0438 §4); the value
stays the number.

values.description: The values a text or a number takes, when only some.

oneOf.description: A date and a time of day, local (docs/adr/0412 §1): `YYYY-AA-GGTSS:DD:SS`.
A time of day (docs/adr/0412 §1): `SS:DD:SS`.

LayerFilter.description:
A layer's filter (docs/adr/0211 §2): an object passes when the condition
holds for it and, when there is a list, the list names it.

expression.description:
The condition (İfadeyle seç's language, docs/adr/0100): an object
passes when it is true.

objects.description:
Only these objects, by their persistent ids (Seçimden süzgeç); an id
the drawing does not hold is not wrong.

LayerGeometry.description:
What a layer holds (docs/adr/0622 §5): GIS's layer type, a layer of points, lines, areas or annotation; absent,
any kind (Karışık, a CAD layer). A typed layer takes only the objects of its kind: a write that would put another
kind on it is refused (`layer_geometry_mismatch`) and the tools that draw another kind are off while it is active.

LayerLabels.description: How a layer is labelled (`LayerStyle.labels`, docs/adr/0212 §2).

classes.description: The rules' classes, in order; only with `rules`.

LayerMask.description: The mask a layer's labels and markers cut into other layers (docs/adr/0226 §3).

labels.description: Its placed labels' boxes.

size.description: How far the shapes grow, paper mm (0–10); their corners round as far.

targets.description: The layers it cuts into, by their ids.

LayerNode.description: A node of the layer tree: a group or a layer.

actions.description:
The addresses and files its objects open (docs/adr/0225 §4). Only a
layer holding objects has them, never a group or a layer drawn from a
service.

card.description:
What the Bilgi tool shows of its objects (docs/adr/0225 §5); absent:
the default card. Only on a layer holding objects.

contingents.description:
Değer bileşimleri (docs/adr/0423): the groups of fields whose values go together. Only a
layer holding objects has them.

feed.description:
Where the layer's objects were taken from, to take them again
(docs/adr/0208 §10). Only a layer has it, never a group.

fields.description:
A layer's fields (docs/adr/0199 §1): the schema of its objects'
attributes, in the order the table and the form show them; empty, no
schema (and nothing written). Only a layer has them, never a group.

filter.description:
The layer's filter (docs/adr/0211 §2): only the objects that pass it
are shown, picked and given to its tools. Only a layer has it, never a
group or a layer drawn from a service.

frozen.description:
Dondur (AutoCAD's freeze, DXF's 70 bit 1; docs/adr/0311 §1): absent,
thawed; `true`, frozen: neither drawn, picked, snapped to nor counted
in the drawing's extent, and Hepsini göster leaves it frozen; the
active layer is never frozen. A group's covers what it holds. Only
`true` is written.

geometry.description:
What the layer holds (docs/adr/0622 §5): points, lines, areas or annotation; absent, any kind. Only a layer
has it, never a group.

replaces.description: A scenario's layer: the base layer it stands for (docs/adr/0210 §9).

rules.description:
Kayıt kuralları (docs/adr/0438 §1): the constraints every write of the layer's records keeps.
Only a layer holding objects has them.

scenario.description: A group made a scenario (docs/adr/0210 §9). Only a group has it.

service.description:
A layer drawn from a map service (docs/adr/0208 §2): it holds no
objects. Only a layer has it, never a group.

snap.description:
A layer's own snapping (docs/adr/0163 §4): off, or only some kinds;
absent, the general kinds. Only a layer has it, never a group.

sourceCrs.description: The system its objects came from (docs/adr/0583 §1); absent: not known. Only a layer has it, never a group.

subtypes.description:
Alt türler (docs/adr/0422): the field that sorts the records and what each kind narrows.
Only a layer holding objects has them.

tableStyles.description:
Koşullu biçim (docs/adr/0413 §1): how the attribute table paints its rows and cells by
conditions; empty, plainly. Only a layer holding objects has them.

time.description:
A temporal layer's time setting (docs/adr/0210 §2): which attributes
hold its objects' start and end. Only a layer has it, never a group.

LayerRule.description: A record rule of a layer.

fields.description:
The fields' keys a form shows it on and a refusal points at, in order; none: the first field it
reads.

id.description: Its id, once in the layer: what a form or a refusal names it by (1–64 characters).

message.description: What a write breaking it is told (1–500 characters).

name.description: Its name as the interface shows it (1–64 characters).

rule.description:
The expression that must hold (the record's fields by name, `$alan` and the project's `@`
values).

warning.description: A soft rule: broken, it warns and the write goes in; written only as `true`.

LayerSnap.description:
A layer's own snapping (docs/adr/0163 §4): `{ "off": true }`, no
snapping to its objects; or `{ "kinds": [...] }`, only these kinds (as
far as the general kinds take them). Exactly one of the two, and a list
that is not empty: the readers refuse anything else ([`LayerSnap::problem`]).

off.description: No snapping to the layer's objects; written only as `true`.

LayerSourceCrs.description: The system a layer's objects came from.

area.description: Where the system is meant for, in the registry's words.

axisOrder.description: `en`, `ne` or `latlon`: EPSG's order of its axes (the drawing's are always east, north).

srid.description: Its EPSG code, when the registry knows it.

unit.description: `metre` or `degree`.

LayerState.description:
A named layer state (docs/adr/0177 §4; QGIS's map themes, AutoCAD's
layer states): the tree's nodes as they were when it was saved, their
visibility and, when it was saved with them, their locks and the layers'
styles. The project keeps them (`ProjectSettings::layer_states`).

id.description: One of its kind among the project's states.

name.description:
Its name as the menu lists it: not empty, one of its kind (as written,
spaces at its ends aside).

nodes.description: The nodes, in the tree's order when it was saved.

LayerStateNode.description: A node of a layer state: a layer's or a group's id and what was kept of it.

frozen.description:
Its own freeze and printing (docs/adr/0311 §3): every state saved
since schema 55 keeps both; absent in an older state, applying it
leaves them as they are.

locked.description: Its own lock, when the state keeps locks.

node.description: The node's id; a node the tree no longer has is passed over.

path.description:
The node's names from the top of the tree (“Kadastro / Parsel”), only
in a file of exported states (docs/adr/0311 §3): importing finds the
node by it in another drawing. A project's own states never keep it.

style.description: A layer's style, when the state keeps styles; a group has none.

LayerStyle.description: A layer's look. `renderer` (the style engine, docs/STYLE.md) is opaque JSON in v1.

color.description: Hex colour or a theme token (fg, fg-dim, ink, paper).

labels.description:
How the layer is labelled (docs/adr/0212 §2): rule-based classes,
none, its objects as obstacles; absent, by `label` (one label).

linePattern.description: A project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1; `pattern` is a hatch's); absent: `line_type`.

lineType.description: Its built-in line type; with a `pattern`, the one nearest to it (what a reader without patterns draws).

lineWeight.description: Plot line weight in mm.

LayerSubtypes.description: A layer's subtypes: the field that sorts the records (its key) and the subtypes, in their order.

field.description: The subtype field's key (its id, else its name): a field with a value list, one value each.

LayerTime.description:
A layer's time setting (docs/adr/0210 §2): its objects' start (or
moment) and end are the values of these attributes.

cumulative.description: Birikimli: an object shows from its start on, whatever its end; written only as `true`.

end.description: The attribute holding the end; absent, the objects are moments.

key.description: The attribute naming an object across its versions (Zamanı karşılaştır's key).

recordedEnd.description: The attribute holding when the version was superseded (its system time's end); empty: still current.

recordedStart.description:
The attribute holding when the object's version was recorded (its system time's start, docs/adr/0537):
what was known on a day is the versions recorded by then and not yet superseded. `.kcad` schema 90.

start.description: The attribute holding the start (an instant layer's moment).

LeaderArrow.description:
A leader's arrowhead other than the filled triangle (Dolu üçgen,
AutoCAD's Closed filled), which is no value but the field's absence: a
leader has one spelling (docs/adr/0146 §1). The first three are the
first leaders'; the others AutoCAD's arrowheads (docs/adr/0205 §7, `.kcad`
schema 30).

oneOf.description: Açık ok: the filled triangle's two sides (Open).
Dolu nokta: a filled dot (Dot).
Yok: no arrowhead, the line ends at the tip (None).
Boş üçgen: the triangle's outline (Closed blank).
İnce açık ok: two sides 15° off the line (Open 30).
Dik açık ok: two sides square to each other (Open 90, Right angle).
Küçük nokta (Dot small).
Boş nokta: a ring (Dot blank).
Eğik çizgi: a tick across the tip (Oblique).
Mimari çentik: a heavy tick (Architectural tick).
Dolu kare (Box filled).
Boş kare (Box blank).
Dayanak üçgeni: a filled triangle standing on the tip (Datum triangle filled).

LeaderStyleDef.description:
A named leader style (docs/adr/0326 §4): its arrowhead, the arrowhead's length in the note's height, the note's
height on paper (mm) and its mask.

arrowSize.description: Times the note's height; absent: 1.

height.description: The note's height on paper, mm.

id.description: One of its kind among the project's leader styles (a UUIDv7).

name.description: As a text style's.

LengthStyle.description:
How lengths are written (docs/adr/0262 §2); none (no setting) is decimal
in the drawing's unit. The three are an inch or foot drawing's.

oneOf.description: Decimal in the drawing's unit: no setting, here for a command to say so.
Straight, along the line.
Letter by letter, following the line.
Level, on the line.
A contour's height: curved on the line, its top uphill.

name.description: One of its kind among the project's, letters' case aside.

source.description: The file it came from (`kentos.lin`, a DXF's name).

LineageOperation.description: How the object came from its parents.

oneOf.description: A piece of one object split (Böl, Kır, Parçalara ayır).
The object the others were merged into (Birleştir, Parçaları birleştir).

LineageRecord.description: One object's parents in one step.

child.description: The object made or kept by the step.

parents.description: The objects it came from, in the step's order; never itself.

step.description: The undo step's name (“Böl”, “Birleştir”); 1–200 characters.

LocalDefinition.description: A local system: its base and the plane transform from it to the base.

LookupCopy.description: A field of the chosen object copied into a field of the record.

from.description: The list's field's key.

LookupDuplicates.description: What a code held by more than one of the list's objects is (docs/adr/0439 §4).

oneOf.description: The first object's is taken and a record holding it is warned (`form_lookup_duplicate`).
The first object's is taken, as chosen.
A record may not hold it (`form_lookup_duplicate`, an error).

LookupMatch.description: A field of the list's layer that must equal a field of the record.

field.description: The list's field's key.

fold.description:
Compared without regard to case, Turkish letters folded (`İ` and `i`, `I` and `ı`), ends
trimmed (docs/adr/0439 §4); written only as `true`. Numbers are compared by their values.

LookupRelation.description: How a list's object stands to the record's geometry.

oneOf.description: The object holds the record (a building's parcel).
The record holds the object.
They have a point in common (within the tolerance).
The nearest object (within the tolerance, when given); ties by the list's order.

LookupSort.description: A list's order by a field of its layer.

descending.description: The greatest first; written only as `true`.

field.description: The field's key: numbers by value, dates as written, text in natural order; empty ones last.

LookupSpatial.description: The objects of the list a record's geometry takes (docs/adr/0439 §5).

tolerance.description: How far apart still counts, in the drawing's unit; none: 0 (nearest: any distance).

MergePolicy.description: A field's value in the object merged from several (docs/adr/0419).

oneOf.description: The first object's value.
Empty.
The values' sum, exact to the field's last digit: integers and decimals with fraction digits.
The least value (numbers).
The greatest value (numbers).

NamedUcs.description: A named UCS of the project.

name.description: Trimmed, 1–64 characters, no control characters; unique.

NamedView.description:
A named view of the project: its middle, the world size it shows (width
along the screen's x, height along its y) and its twist: the angle of the
screen's x axis from the world's x (east), counter-clockwise, in radians,
in [0, 2π). A view with twist 0 shows the north up.

center.description: The world point in the middle of the area.

height.description: The world height the area shows, along the screen's y.

id.description: Its stable id, which a view mark points at (docs/adr/0345 §2); empty: the one its name gives (`view_key`).

name.description: Trimmed, 1–64 characters, no control characters; unique.

twist.description: The screen's x axis from east, counter-clockwise; 0 shows the north up.

width.description: The world width the area shows, along the screen's x.

NetworkClosures.description:
The edge fields of a closure's first and last day (docs/adr/0567 §2): `YYYY-MM-DD`, both days in; an empty first
day closes from always, an empty last day until ever. Its weekdays and hours (docs/adr/0568): an edge closed on
the days its weekday field names (`Pzt-Cum`, `Cmt, Paz`, `1-5`; empty: every day) and, when its hours field holds
any, only in those hours (`22:00-06:00`, `07:00-09:00, 17:00-19:00`; empty: the whole day). An edge whose four
values are all empty is not closed.

days.description: The edge field of the weekdays an edge is closed on (docs/adr/0568 §1).

hours.description: The edge field of the hours an edge is closed in (docs/adr/0568 §1).

oneOf.description: Uçlarda: at their ends, and an end on another edge splits it there.
Köşelerde: at every vertex too.

field.description: The attribute it reads: a speed in km/h, or the whole edge's cost.

periods.description:
A speed cost's time profile (docs/adr/0521 §4): its periods in the day's order; the rest of the day the
edges' own speeds. Read when a question gives a time.

speed.description: A speed cost's speed (km/h) where the field gives none it can read.

unit.description: A field cost's unit (“TL”, “dk”); a speed cost's is minutes and names none.

oneOf.description: Süre, minutes: the length over the speed.
The field's value for the whole edge, shared by its pieces by their lengths.

closed.description: An expression: the edges it holds for are out of service, travelled by nothing.

closures.description:
Tarihli kapanmalar (docs/adr/0567 §2): the edge fields of the first and the last day an edge is closed; a
question with a date passes none closed that day. None: no edge is closed by date.

costs.description: The costs besides the length, in the order the tools offer them.

edges.description: The line layers whose lines, paths and arcs are the edges, in this order.

id.description: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens; one of its kind in the project.

junctions.description: The point layers whose points are junctions, sources or valves.

levels.description:
Seviyeler (docs/adr/0521 §3): which ends and insides of the edges connect, by their level fields; none: every
one at one level.

name.description: Trimmed; one of its kind in the project.

profiles.description:
Araç profilleri (docs/adr/0567 §1): what a vehicle may travel (its weight, height, width against the edges'
limits; the edges its kind may not) and how fast; a question names one. None: every vehicle the same.

subnetworks.description:
Alt ağlar (docs/adr/0557 §2): the parts the sources feed, found by `cad.subnetworks.find` and written into an
attribute by `cad.subnetworks.update`. None: the network has no subnetworks.

terminals.description:
Terminaller (docs/adr/0557 §1): the ends of a device (a valve's in and out, a transformer's two sides) and which
of them connect through it; a trace goes through a device only along those paths. None: a device is a point.

tolerance.description: Metres, within [`NETWORK_TOLERANCES`].

turns.description: Dönüşler (docs/adr/0521 §2): forbidden turns, U-turns and turn delays; none: every turn free.

oneOf.description: Every edge both ways.
Every edge the way it is drawn (pipes drawn with the flow).

By an attribute's value: `forward` the way the edge is drawn only, `backward` against it only, `closed`
neither; any other value, and none, both ways.

NetworkKind.description: Yol ağı or Şebeke: what the tools offer first; the graph is the same.

NetworkLayer.description: An edge layer and, optionally, which of its objects are edges.

filter.description: An expression: only the objects it holds for; absent: all of them.

layer.description: The layer's id. A layer the project no longer has is said when the network is built.

NetworkLevels.description:
The level fields (docs/adr/0521 §3): an edge's level at its start, at its end and, when given, inside it (else
its ends' when they are one, none when they differ); a junction point's from `start` (empty: every level).

NetworkPeriod.description:
A period of a speed cost's day (docs/adr/0521 §4): from `from` to `to` (minutes of the day), the edges go at their
speed times `factor`, or at the speed `field` gives (km/h; 0 closed, empty or unreadable the edge's own speed).

NetworkProfile.description:
A vehicle profile (docs/adr/0567 §1): its name, its limits (an edge is closed to it where the edge's field is
below its value), what forbids an edge to it (a field's values), its top speed and whether it goes against one-way
edges (a pedestrian).

bothWays.description: Whether the vehicle goes both ways on one-way edges (closed edges stay closed).

name.description: Trimmed, at most 40 characters; one of its kind in the network, Turkish case aside.

topSpeed.description: The highest speed (km/h) the vehicle goes on any edge: a speed cost's edges slower; none: the edges' own.

NetworkSubnetworks.description:
A network's subnetworks (docs/adr/0557 §2): its sources are the subnetwork controllers; a subnetwork is what a
controller reaches (not past another controller, a closed junction or a closed edge).

attribute.description:
The attribute `cad.subnetworks.update` writes on every object of the network: its subnetworks' names, joined
with `; ` where it is in more than one; taken away where it is in none.

keepCurrent.description:
Güncel tut (docs/adr/0562 §3): a write that touches the network's layers also rewrites the attribute, in its
own step; when it cannot, the command says `subnetwork_dirty`.

name.description: The controller's attribute holding its subnetwork's name; none: its label, else its `Ad`, else `Kaynak <no>`.

NetworkTerminals.description:
The terminals of a network's devices (docs/adr/0557 §1): the edge fields naming the terminal an edge's start and
its end are attached to, and the devices.

devices.description: The devices: 1–16, each a junction layer of the network.

end.description: The same for its end.

start.description: The edge attribute whose value (a terminal's id or name) is the terminal its start is attached to.

NetworkTurns.description:
A network's turns (docs/adr/0521 §2): where a way may turn back, what a turn at a crossing of three or more
pieces costs by its angle (seconds, added to the speed costs), and the turn layers' lines, each a turn from the
edge at its start to the edge at its end through their common node: forbidden, or its own delay.

back.description: A U-turn, wherever it is made, seconds.

straight.description: Going straight on (within 30° of the way one came), seconds.

oneOf.description: Her yerde: at every node.
Yalnız çıkmazlarda: where one piece ends (a dead end).
Hiçbir yerde.

ObstacleKind.description: What of an obstacle area a label avoids.

oneOf.description: Its inside: a label covering any of it.
Its outline: a label crossing an edge.

ParameterKind.description: What a parameter's value is: a length in the drawing's unit, an angle in the project's angle unit, or a number.

ParkedPin.description: The pins of a row outside the part (docs/adr/0578 §3).

key.description: The key's value of the row when the link has a key and the row had a value.

pins.description: The pins, as the object held them.

uid.description: The object's lasting id (the row's).

PatternElement.description:
An element of a pattern: a dash (a positive length), a gap (negative), a dot (0), or a text or a shape (0: it
takes no length of its own).

PatternLine.description:
One family of a pattern's lines (docs/adr/0186 §1), in the pattern's
units, before the pattern turns: lines at `angle` (degrees) through
`origin`, each the next `offset` on (`[along, across]` the line), drawn
as `dashes` say (plus drawn, minus a gap, 0 a dot; none: whole).

PatternShape.description: A shape of a shape file in a pattern (`[CIRC1,ltypeshp.shx]`).

file.description: The SHX file it is in, as written.

rotation.description: R (along the line), A (absolute) or U (along the line, kept readable): degrees.

scale.description: S: its height (a text) or its scale (a shape), in the pattern's unit.

rotation.description: R (along the line), A (absolute) or U (along the line, kept readable): degrees.

scale.description: S: its height (a text) or its scale (a shape), in the pattern's unit.

style.description: The text style it names, as written.

PatternUnit.description: Where a pattern's lengths are measured.

oneOf.description: Millimetres on paper: the same on every sheet, the drawing's scale over 1000 metres in it (KentOS's own types).
The drawing's own lengths, in the project's unit (a LIN file's).

PhaseView.description: Which phases the drawing shows and how (docs/adr/0346 §2): Tümü, Mevcut durum, Yıkım planı, Yeni durum.

oneOf.description: Around it, QGIS's cartographic order (top right first).
On it.

size.description: Diameter in CSS px.

ProfileForbid.description: What forbids an edge to a profile: the edge field's values (Turkish case aside).

ProfileLimit.description:
A profile's limit: the vehicle's value (tonnes, metres …) against the edge field's: closed where the field reads
a number below it; an empty field, no limit.

comments.description: The reviewers' comments on the form, oldest first (docs/adr/0441 §5).

enforce.description:
The latest release's rules hold for every attribute write on the layer (the write profile);
written only as `true`, and only with a release.

id.description: Stable, unique in the project: letters, digits, `-`, `_` and `.`; 1–64 characters.

layer.description: The layer the form edits: a layer's id (not a group's).

name.description: What the lists show; trimmed, 1–64 characters.

releases.description: The frozen releases, oldest first; data entry uses the last.

withdrawn.description:
Yayından kaldırıldı (docs/adr/0445 §1): no record is written through it; a window open on it keeps
what was typed. Written only as `true`, and only with a release.

ProjectRelation.description:
A relation of the project (docs/adr/0405 §1): the child layer's field holds the parent object's
persistent id.

field.description: The child field's key that holds the parent's persistent id.

id.description: Letters, digits, `-`, `_`, `.`; 1–64; unique in the project.

parent.description: The parent layer's id.

ProjectSettings.description: Project settings (`ProjectSettingsData`): saved with the drawing, the same for everyone who opens it.

addressLocators.description: The project's address data (docs/adr/0229 §2), in the order they were made.

annotation.description:
The project's annotation heights on paper (docs/adr/0205 §1); absent:
every kind's default.

arch.description: The project's levels and the detail its walls are drawn at (docs/adr/0339 §3); absent: no level, by the scale.

autoSelect.description:
Otomatik seçim (docs/adr/0622 §5): on, a click and a box select any shown layer's objects (with the list of
the ones under the click); off, only the active layer's, as a GIS edits one layer at a time. Absent: off in a
CBS project, on otherwise ([`ProjectSettings::auto_select`]).

connections.description: The project's service connections without their secrets (docs/adr/0208 §2).

coordinateEpoch.description:
The coordinates' epoch (decimal year, docs/adr/0519 §1): when a dynamic system's coordinates hold; absent: not
said. Only a project with a coordinate system has one.

customCrs.description:
The project's own coordinate system when it is a definition
(docs/adr/0168 §1); `srid` is then 0.

datumTransforms.description: The project's datum choices (docs/adr/0168 §3); none: EPSG's ways.

domains.description: The project's value lists, in the order they were made (docs/adr/0430).

drawingFont.description: Absent in files written before drawing typefaces (read as Barlow).

drawingUnit.description:
A local project's unit (docs/adr/0165 §2); absent: metres. Only a
project without a coordinate system (SRID 0) has another.

forms.description: The project's forms, in the order they were made (docs/adr/0401).

hatchPatterns.description: The project's own hatch patterns (docs/adr/0331 §1): a PAT file's or a user's, offered beside the library's.

heights.description:
What the drawing's elevations are (docs/adr/0519 §1): ellipsoidal or orthometric heights, the vertical system
and the geoid model; absent: not said, and no command takes them for either.

joinViews.description: The project's join views (docs/adr/0527), in the table's order.

layerStates.description: The project's named layer states (docs/adr/0177 §4), in the menu's order.

lengthStyle.description:
How lengths are written (docs/adr/0262 §2): none, decimal; the others
only in an inch or foot drawing.

lineTypeScale.description:
The project's line type scale (AutoCAD's LTSCALE, docs/adr/0313 §3): every pattern's lengths times it, above 0;
absent: 1.

lineTypes.description: The project's line types with patterns (docs/adr/0313 §1).

lineage.description:
What the split and merged objects came from (docs/adr/0598), in the order the steps made them; kept in the undo
history (`Op::Lineage`).

linearEvents.description: The project's links of event layers to their routes (docs/adr/0569), in the list's order.

mapSrid.description:
The map's system (docs/adr/0583 §3): the view drawn in it, the objects staying in the project's; absent:
the project's own. Changing it changes no coordinate.

namedUcs.description: The project's named UCSs, in the order they were kept.

namedViews.description: The project's named views, in the order they were kept (docs/adr/0285 §1).

secondCustomCrs.description: The second system when it is a definition (instead of `second_srid`).

secondSrid.description:
The project's second coordinate system (docs/adr/0167 §1): its
coordinates are shown beside the project's own; absent: none. Never
the project's own system, never a local project's.

sourceBases.description:
The bound layers' bases (docs/adr/0538 §1): each object's hashes when a layer and its table last matched, so a
reconcile tells each side's changes apart. A link has at most one; a layer of more than `MAX_BASE_ROWS`
objects has none.

sources.description: The layers bound to a table of a file, each with the file's revision when it last matched (docs/adr/0503).

survey.description:
The project's survey constants and tolerances (docs/adr/0169 §3);
absent: k = [`REFRACTION`] and no tolerance.

textStyles.description: The project's named text styles (docs/adr/0183 §2), in the order they were made.

topology.description: The project's topology rules, tolerance and exceptions (docs/adr/0202 §1).

ucs.description:
The drawing's user coordinate system (docs/adr/0261 §1); none: the
world. How points are typed and shown, never where they are.

variables.description: The project's own `@` variables (docs/adr/0214 §2.3), in the settings window's order.

wallStyles.description: The project's named wall styles (docs/adr/0339 §2), in the order they were made.

workspace.description:
The project's type; none while it is not asked (files written before
types). The former Hibrit mode reads as written and means the same
(see [`ProjectSettings::project_type`]).

xrefPaths.description:
The folders external references' sources are looked for in, in order (docs/adr/0349 §1): absolute, or relative
to the project file's folder with `/` between their parts.

ProjectSheets.description: The sheet book of a project and its pictures' bytes.

book.description: The sheet core's book (`kentos.sheet/1`): an object, opaque here.

pictures.description: The bytes of the book's pictures; none when it has none.

ProjectStorage.description:
Where a cloud project keeps its content (TODOS.md §12.1, CLOUD-21).
File projects (binary `.kcad` revisions) and references to an outside
PostGIS come as their own kinds.

oneOf.description:
Object by object in the server's PostGIS database (managed): every
save is one transaction and the others see it at once.

As a file: a sequence of immutable, verified `.kcad` v2 revisions in
the server's object store (docs/adr/0031); each save is a new
revision, based on the one it replaces.

ProjectStyles.description: The project's own style library (opaque items in v1, see `style`).

ProjectType.description: What kind of work a project is (TODOS.md CLOUD-02). A label only (see the module notes).

oneOf.description: General CAD work; also every project made before types existed.
GIS work.
A land readjustment under article 18 of the Zoning Law (18 uygulaması).
A zoning plan (imar planı).
Dividing and merging parcels (ifraz and tevhit).
Road design.
Architecture.

label.description: What the settings window shows beside it (“İş numarası”).

name.description: Without the `@`: a letter or `_`, then letters, digits and `_` (`is_no`).

value.description: None yet: written as no value (an empty `@ad`), as the file keeps it.

RelatedView.description: How a related item shows its objects (docs/adr/0425).

oneOf.description: Their names, one a line.
A table of the item's columns, the numbers totalled under them.
A card for each child: its columns' labels and values, as its form names them (docs/adr/0440 §6).

A bar for each value of its first column, as long as the children holding it are many
(docs/adr/0441 §3).

RelationDelete.description: What happens to a relation's child records when their parent is deleted (docs/adr/0405 §1).

oneOf.description: The link stays as it is: a reference to a deleted object.
The child's field is emptied.
The children are deleted with their parent (a composition).
A parent with children is not deleted (`relation_restricted`).

ScenarioInfo.description:
A group made a scenario (docs/adr/0210 §9): its layers are an alternative
kept apart from the field state (Mevcut durum).

ServiceConnection.description:
A connection of the project (docs/adr/0208 §2): what proof requests to
its origin carry, without the secrets.

origin.description: `https://host[:port]`: proof goes to this origin only.

oneOf.description: Tiles by an address template, Web Mercator (TMS with `yFlip`).
OGC API Tiles' map tiles.
An ArcGIS REST MapServer or ImageServer: its cached tiles, else `export`.
Google's Map Tiles API, 2D tiles.
Vector tiles (MVT) by a MapLibre style, a TileJSON or a template.

ServiceLayer.description: A layer drawn from a service (docs/adr/0208 §2).

bbox.description:
The service's extent, WGS 84 degrees (west, south, east, north), as
its capabilities give it: what “Servisin kapsamına yakınlaştır” shows.

connection.description: The project's connection whose proof goes with the requests.

dynamic.description: WMS and `export`: one picture of the view instead of tiles.

format.description: The image's media type (`image/png`, …).

grid.description: WMTS's, OGC's and a cached ArcGIS service's matrices.

layers.description: WMS's layer names; WMTS's one layer; ArcGIS's layers shown.

preset.description: The ready basemap it came from.

srid.description: The system asked: WMS's `CRS`, ArcGIS's `imageSR`; a grid's own.

style.description: WMS's and WMTS's style; Google's map type.

template.description: WMTS REST's and OGC's tile template.

tileSize.description: XYZ's and the vector tiles' tile side, pixels; absent 256.

url.description:
XYZ: the template; WMS, WMTS, ArcGIS: the service's address; OGC
API Tiles: the tile set's; vector: the style's, the TileJSON's or the
template; Google: empty.

yFlip.description: TMS: rows counted from the bottom.

ServiceParam.description: A parameter sent with every request (`TIME`, `CQL_FILTER`, …): never a secret.

SheetPicture.description: A picture's bytes under the SHA-256 the book names it by.

bytes.description: The file's bytes; base64 (RFC 4648, with padding) in JSON.

SourceBase.description:
A bound layer's base (docs/adr/0538 §1): each object's hashes when the layer and its table last matched, so a
later reconcile tells what the layer changed from what the table did, object by object. The layer's hash is that of
the object's kind, geometry and attributes (the first 8 bytes of the SHA-256 of their canonical JSON, the
essence `layer_digest` hashes); the table's that of the object its row reads as. The two differ only where a row
does not read back bit for bit as the object written (a coordinate system moved through). A base belongs to the
link's `revision` and `digest` it was taken at: with others it is stale and not used.

fields.description:
What each row's object held besides its hashes (docs/adr/0553 §1), one record per row in the same order, in
base64: the hashes of its kind and geometry on each side, of each attribute (name and value) and of its
vertices. Without it two sides' changes to one object cannot be told apart field by field (a conflict as a
whole, docs/adr/0538), nor related changes found. Written only when it fits [`MAX_FIELD_BASE_BYTES`].

revision.description: The file's SHA-256 and the layer's digest it was taken at.

rows.description: The rows, `BASE_ROW` bytes each in the lasting ids' byte order, in base64 (RFC 4648, with padding).

source.description: The link's id (`kaynak-N`).

oneOf.description: A PostGIS table (docs/adr/0505): `path` is the database's address without a password.

SourceLink.description: A layer bound to a table of a file.

digest.description:
The layer's digest when it last matched the file (64 hex digits: the SHA-256 of its objects' kinds, geometries
and attributes by lasting id, `kentos_native_application::sources::layer_digest`): a reload compares with it to
tell the layer's own edits from the file's.

extent.description:
The area the working copy holds (minimum east, north, maximum east, north, in the project's system; docs/adr/0510):
only the table's rows whose box meets it are read, and a write leaves the rows outside as they are. None: the
whole table.

id.description: Its own id, `kaynak-N`.

key.description:
The attribute that names a row the same whatever its place in the table (docs/adr/0533 §1): its value is unique
among the rows and not empty. A reload follows a label pin to the row of the same value when the table was
written again with other row ids, and says the pins whose row is gone. None: a row is its row id, the rule
of every bound layer before.

layer.description: The drawing's layer that is its working copy.

parked.description:
The label pins of objects that left the part (docs/adr/0578 §3): the object's row is in the table but outside
`extent` (it was moved out, or the part was narrowed), so the layer holds no object for its pins. They are kept
here with the row's lasting id and its key's value, not drawn, and go back to the object when the row comes
into the part again; a row gone from the table takes its parked pins with it.

path.description: The file, an absolute path.

relative.description:
The file's path from the project file's folder, `/` between its parts (docs/adr/0506): written on saving when
the file lies on the same disk, so a project moved with its data (or packed with Paketle) finds it again; read
only when `path` is not there and the file it names has the same content. A database has none.

revision.description: The SHA-256 (64 hex digits) of the file when the layer last matched it: what a write or a reload compares with.

srid.description: The EPSG code the table declares, none for an undefined system.

table.description: The table in it.

writable.description: Whether the table can be written: a feature or attribute table of a file KentOS may write.

SpaceMethod.description: What a space's rings stand for (docs/adr/0342 §1): the walls' inner faces, their centre lines or their outer faces.

SplitPolicy.description: A field's value in the pieces of a split object (docs/adr/0419).

oneOf.description: Each piece keeps the value.
The pieces' values are emptied.
The pieces take the field's default (none: empty).

The value is shared by the pieces' areas (lines: lengths), the total kept to the field's last
digit: integers and decimals with fraction digits.

StackMode.description: When a label is cut into lines.

oneOf.description: Only when it does not fit on one line.

StreetSource.description: The streets' layer and which of its attributes say what.

name.description: Yol adı.

oneOf.description: A point object's position: part 0 its own, `k` its `k`th extra point (docs/adr/0174).
A line's, arc's or elliptical arc's start.
Its end.
A circle's, arc's or ellipse's centre.

A path's vertex: part 0 the object's own path, `k` its `k`th extra part; ring 0 the outer ring, `h` its
`h`th hole; the vertex's index in the ring.
The middle of a line (all zero) or of a path's edge from vertex `index` to the next.

A point along an edge or a curve (docs/adr/0263 §1): a line's (all zero) or a path's edge from vertex `index`
to the next, at the fraction `t` of its chord or of its arc's sweep; an arc's (`a0 + t·sweep`), a circle's
(`t·2π` from east) or an ellipse's (`t0 + t·sweep`) curve (all zero). `t` within 0 and 1.

SubnetworkReach.description: Which way a subnetwork reaches from its controller (docs/adr/0557 §2).

oneOf.description: Akış aşağı: the way the edges' directions lead.
Bağlı: along every connection, any way.

Subtype.description: One subtype: a code of the subtype field's list, its label, and what it narrows.

label.description: What it is called; empty: the subtype field's label of its code.

SubtypeField.description: What a subtype changes on one field; a field it does not name keeps the layer's rules.

default.description: The value a new record of this subtype starts with, in its field's canonical text.

field.description: The field's key.

required.description: A record of this subtype has a value (in addition to the field's own rule).

values.description: The codes of its value list this subtype offers (a field with a value list); none: all of them.

SurveySettings.description:
The project's survey constants and tolerances (docs/adr/0169 §3): the
refraction coefficient k of trigonometric heights, and the greatest
differences a field book's two faces are checked against; the mean
ellipsoidal height of the ground values and whether the survey windows
reduce lengths to the grid (docs/adr/0171); the a priori standard
deviations of a network adjustment (docs/adr/0203 §1). Angles are in
radians, lengths in metres. An absent tolerance is not checked; the
differences are still shown.

faceHz.description: The two faces' horizontal reading difference.

faceSlope.description: The two faces' slope distance difference.

groundHeight.description:
The project's mean ellipsoidal height (m), within [−500, 9000]: the
ground values of Mesafe ölç and Alan hesapla (docs/adr/0171 §2;
schema 16). Points' elevations are not used: whether orthometric or
ellipsoidal is not known.

sigmaCentering.description: Each end's centering, the instrument's and the target's, m (schema 28).

sigmaDirection.description:
A direction's a priori standard deviation, radians (docs/adr/0203 §1;
schema 28); absent: [`SIGMA_DEFAULTS`]'s.

sigmaPpm.description: A distance's part per million of its length (schema 28).

twoWay.description:
A traverse leg's horizontal distance measured from its two ends
(schema 15).

TableStyle.description: One rule of a layer's table (docs/adr/0413 §1).

color.description: The text's colour, `#RRGGBB`.

condition.description: When it holds: an expression over the record (`Kat > 3 ve Durum = 'kotu'`).

field.description: The field whose cell it paints, by name; absent: the whole row.

TerminalConfig.description:
A configuration of a device (docs/adr/0562 §2): the terminals and paths of the points whose `by` attribute holds
`value` (caseless).

TerminalDevice.description:
A device: every point of the junction layer `layer` has these terminals. An edge attached to one of its terminals
goes on through the device only to a terminal on a path with it; an edge that names none (or one the device does
not have) passes to every terminal and the trace is said to be unverified.

by.description:
The attribute of the device's points that names their configuration (docs/adr/0562 §2): a point whose value is
a configuration's has that configuration's terminals and paths; one with none, or an unknown value, has the
device's own (an unknown value is said). None: every point has the device's own.

configs.description: The configurations besides the device's own: 1–16 when `by` is named, none otherwise.

layer.description: A junction layer of the network (its id).

paths.description: 1–16 paths: each the ids of two or more terminals connected to one another through the device.

fontFile.description: The typeface file a DXF named for it, written back as it came.

height.description: The texts' height on paper, mm; absent: the tool's height.

id.description: One of its kind among the project's text styles (a UUIDv7).

name.description:
Its name: trimmed, one of its kind whatever its letters' case, never
`STANDARD_STYLE`.

oblique.description: As a text's (`TextFace::oblique`).

widthFactor.description: As a text's; absent: 1.

TileGrid.description: A service's tile grid as read: its system and its matrices, coarsest first.

TileMatrix.description:
One matrix of a tile grid (docs/adr/0208 §3): its pixel's size in the
grid system's units, its top left corner as east and north (longitude
and latitude), whatever order the service wrote them in, its tiles' and
its own size in tiles.

TmDefinition.description:
A transverse Mercator grid: its origin's latitude (0 when left out),
central meridian, scale and false origin.

customDatum.description: the project's own (exactly one of the two).

datum.description: The registry's datum by name; or

oneOf.description: ` ±upper`.
` +upper -lower`.
The largest and the smallest value instead of the number: `max/min`.

TopologyException.description:
A finding marked as left on purpose: its rule, its objects' persistent
ids in the finding's order, and its place.

digest.description:
The objects' geometry when it was marked (docs/adr/0589 §3): 16 lowercase hexadecimal digits. The geometry
changed since, the exception lapses and its finding is open again; absent (marked before schema 99): kept while
the rule, the objects and the place are the same.

objects.description: At least one.

rule.description: The rule's id.

TopologyRule.description: A rule: its kind on a layer and, between layers, another layer.

id.description: One of its kind among the project's rules; exceptions name it.

layer.description:
The layer's id (a layer, not a group). A rule whose layer the project
no longer has stays and is not checked.

other.description: The other layer's id, for a rule between layers only.

value.description:
The value of a kind that takes one: a length in metres, an angle in
radians; absent: the kind's default.

oneOf.description: Çakışmamalı: the layer's areas do not overlap.
Boşluk olmamalı: no gap is closed in among the layer's areas.
İnce alan olmamalı: no part of an area is thinner than the value.
Yinelenmemeli: no edge of a line lies on another line, no point on another point.
Sarkan uç olmamalı: every line end meets the layer's line work.
Kısa kenar olmamalı: no edge is shorter than the value.
Küçük açı olmamalı: no corner is sharper than the value.
Geçerli olmalı: ADR 0201 §6's problems.
Ortak sınırda köşe eksik olmamalı: an area's vertex on a neighbour's edge is the neighbour's too.
… ile çakışmamalı: the layer's areas do not overlap the other's.
… içinde kalmalı: the layer's objects stay within the other's areas.
Sınırı … sınırlarında olmalı: the layer's areas' boundaries lie on the other's line work.
… çizgilerinin ucunda olmalı: the layer's points are at the other's line ends.

rules.description: The rules, in the order they are checked and listed.

tolerance.description: Metres, within [`TOPOLOGY_TOLERANCES`]; absent: [`TOPOLOGY_TOLERANCE`].

TurnLayer.description:
A turn layer: its lines are turns; `field`'s number is a turn's delay (seconds), its empty value a forbidden turn;
without a field every turn of the layer is forbidden.

Ucs.description:
A user coordinate system: its origin in the world and the angle of its x
axis from the world's x (east), counter-clockwise, in radians, in
[0, 2π). Its y axis is square to x, counter-clockwise; it neither scales
nor mirrors. The world's is origin (0, 0), angle 0, kept as no setting.

angle.description: Its x axis from east, counter-clockwise.

origin.description: Its origin in the world.

oneOf.description: ISO text (YYYY-AA-GG).

VariableValue.description: A variable's value: none yet, true/false, a number or text.

Vec2.description: A point in world units: x = east (Y, sağa), y = north (X, yukarı).

WallCaps.description: Whether an open wall's ends are closed by a line across it.

WallComponent.description: One layer of a wall's body, from its left face towards its right (`CAD-ARCH-04`): plaster, brick, insulation.

edge.description: The lines along its sides; absent: the wall's.

A named wall style (`CAD-ARCH-04`): the components a wall is built of, its ends, its schematic fill and the width a

A project's type (`app/workspaces.ts`, docs/adr/0165): CAD or CBS, each
with its own scene, axes and ribbon; every command still runs in both.
`plan3d` and `disaster` are announced ("Yakında") and cannot be chosen yet;
a file naming them shows as CBS. There is no hybrid type any more.

A part of a multi-part area past its first (docs/adr/0143): its outer
