symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

widths.description:
A polyline's widths: the start and the end of the edge from each
vertex, as many as `pts` (the last is the closing edge's, `[0, 0]`
on an open polyline), in the drawing's length, not the paper's line
weight (docs/adr/0258 §2). Absent: none, the line is drawn with its
line weight. One part only.

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

zs.description:
Each vertex's elevation, m, as many as `pts`; `null` for a vertex
without one (not 0); absent when no vertex has one (docs/adr/0142).

PatternElement.description:
An element of a pattern: a dash (a positive length), a gap (negative), a dot (0), or a text or a shape (0: it
takes no length of its own).

PatternLine.description:
One family of a pattern's lines (docs/adr/0186 §1), in the pattern's
units, before the pattern turns: lines at `angle` (degrees) through
`origin`, each the next `offset` on (`[along, across]` the line), drawn
as `dashes` say (plus drawn, minus a gap, 0 a dot; none: whole).

PatternShape.description: A shape of a shape file in a pattern (`[CIRC1,ltypeshp.shx]`).

file.description: The SHX file it is in, as written.

rotation.description: R (along the line), A (absolute) or U (along the line, kept readable): degrees.

scale.description: S: its height (a text) or its scale (a shape), in the pattern's unit.

ProjectAccessView.description:
The caller's access to a project: the highest of ownership, a grant and the
organisation's policy, and exactly what it allows. Buttons follow it; the
server checks every request itself.

comments.description: The reviewers' comments on the form, oldest first (docs/adr/0441 §5).

parent.description: The parent layer's id.

CBS project, on otherwise ([`ProjectSettings::auto_select`]).

connections.description: The project's service connections without their secrets (docs/adr/0208 §2).

coordinateEpoch.description:

said. Only a project with a coordinate system has one.

customCrs.description:

SourceBase.description:
A bound layer's base (docs/adr/0538 §1): each object's hashes when the layer and its table last matched, so a
later reconcile tells what the layer changed from what the table did, object by object. The layer's hash is that of
the object's kind, geometry and attributes (the first 8 bytes of the SHA-256 of their canonical JSON, the
essence `layer_digest` hashes); the table's that of the object its row reads as. The two differ only where a row
does not read back bit for bit as the object written (a coordinate system moved through). A base belongs to the
link's `revision` and `digest` it was taken at: with others it is stale and not used.

What each row's object held besides its hashes (docs/adr/0553 §1), one record per row in the same order, in
base64: the hashes of its kind and geometry on each side, of each attribute (name and value) and of its
vertices. Without it two sides' changes to one object cannot be told apart field by field (a conflict as a
whole, docs/adr/0538), nor related changes found. Written only when it fits [`MAX_FIELD_BASE_BYTES`].

revision.description: The file's SHA-256 and the layer's digest it was taken at.

tell the layer's own edits from the file's.

extent.description:
The area the working copy holds (minimum east, north, maximum east, north, in the project's system; docs/adr/0510):

written again with other row ids, and says the pins whose row is gone. None: a row is its row id, the rule
of every bound layer before.

here with the row's lasting id and its key's value, not drawn, and go back to the object when the row comes
into the part again; a row gone from the table takes its parked pins with it.

A device: every point of the junction layer `layer` has these terminals. An edge attached to one of its terminals

not have) passes to every terminal and the trace is said to be unverified.

oneOf.description: Çakışmamalı: the layer's areas do not overlap.
Boşluk olmamalı: no gap is closed in among the layer's areas.
İnce alan olmamalı: no part of an area is thinner than the value.
Yinelenmemeli: no edge of a line lies on another line, no point on another point.
Sarkan uç olmamalı: every line end meets the layer's line work.
Kısa kenar olmamalı: no edge is shorter than the value.
Küçük açı olmamalı: no corner is sharper than the value.
Geçerli olmalı: ADR 0201 §6's problems.
Ortak sınırda köşe eksik olmamalı: an area's vertex on a neighbour's edge is the neighbour's too.
… ile çakışmamalı: the layer's areas do not overlap the other's.
… içinde kalmalı: the layer's objects stay within the other's areas.
Sınırı … sınırlarında olmalı: the layer's areas' boundaries lie on the other's line work.
… çizgilerinin ucunda olmalı: the layer's points are at the other's line ends.

VisibilityState.description: One of a visibility parameter's states: its name and the objects (local ids) it hides.

WallCaps.description: Whether an open wall's ends are closed by a line across it.

WallComponent.description: One layer of a wall's body, from its left face towards its right (`CAD-ARCH-04`): plaster, brick, insulation.

detail.description: The least detail it is drawn at as its own (its lines and hatch); below, it is part of the body.

edge.description: The lines along its sides; absent: the wall's.

priority.description:
Its strength where walls meet (docs/adr/0340 §1), 1 to 9, the smaller the stronger: a joining wall's component
passes the host's weaker ones and stops at the first as strong. Absent: 3 (between a core's 1 and a finish's 5).

thickness.description: Its thickness, metres; absent: what the wall's width leaves of the others (one component at most).

WallDetail.description:
How much of a wall is drawn (`CAD-ARCH-12`), the least first: `Schematic` its outline and its style's fill,
`Standard` the components shown at construction scales, `Detailed` every component.

WallEntity.description:
A wall (`CAD-ARCH-01`, `02`): its path, the base line it was drawn along, with arcs as a polyline's bulges (one per
vertex, as the document keeps a polyline's: an open wall's last is 0); its width; where its body lies across the
justification line (the path moved `offset` to its left); the components it is built of, from its left face; its
ends; its height above its level; its architectural information. Its faces, ends, component lines and hatches are
drawn from these (`geom::wall` of the shared core), at the detail the drawing's scale asks.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

cleanup.description:
Its components are cleaned up by their priorities where another wall tees into or crosses it; false: the
walls meet at their faces only.

closed.description: Its path's last vertex joins its first: a ring of wall.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

components.description: Its body's layers from its left face; none: one plain body.

fill.description: The body's solid fill when drawn schematically (`#RRGGBB`); absent: none.

height.description: Its height above its level's floor, metres; absent: the level's height.

joins.description: How its ends join (docs/adr/0340 §1); absent: both by the rule.

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

offset.description: The base line offset: the justification line is the path moved this far to its left (negative: right).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

style.description: The project's wall style it was made with, by its id; its components are the style's.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

WallJoin.description:
How one end of a wall joins another (docs/adr/0340 §1, `CAD-ARCH-07`): by the rule; not at all (its end line
drawn); at a corner mitred; butting the other (it stops at the other's face); running through it (the other butts).

WallJoins.description: A wall's start's and end's join.

WallJustify.description:
Where the wall's body lies across its path (AutoCAD Architecture's justification): `Left`, the path is the wall's
left face and the body to its right; `Center`, the path is its middle; `Right`, the path is its right face.

WallStyleDef.description:
A named wall style (`CAD-ARCH-04`): the components a wall is built of, its ends, its schematic fill and the width a
new wall takes when one component takes the rest.

id.description: One of its kind among the project's wall styles; KentOS's own are named (`kentos-…`), the user's UUIDv7.

width.description: A new wall's width, metres, when one component takes the rest; the components' sum when none does.

frame.description: Whether its boundary is drawn (AutoCAD's WIPEOUTFRAME, per mask).

from.description: The states it is taken from; empty: any state.

label.description: The button's words, unique in the workflow: “Gönder”, “Onayla”, “Geri gönder”.

reason.description: A text field's key the step writes its reason to; it must be given.

valid.description: The record must be valid by the form (no error) to take it.

Workspace.description:
A project's type (`app/workspaces.ts`, docs/adr/0165): CAD or CBS, each
with its own scene, axes and ribbon; every command still runs in both.
`plan3d` and `disaster` are announced ("Yakında") and cannot be chosen yet;
a file naming them shows as CBS. There is no hybrid type any more.

XrefKind.description:
How a reference goes on: `attach` (Ekle) is seen in a drawing that references this one too, `overlay` (Bindir) only
here.

XrefSource.description: Where an external reference's content comes from (docs/adr/0348 §1).

digest.description: The SHA-256 of the file's content as loaded, lowercase hex.

group.description: The layer group its layers are under, by id.

objects.description:
The source's objects' persistent ids, one for each of the definition's objects in its order: a reload finds
each object again by it and moves the references to its pieces (a definition's objects are numbered by their
order in a file).

page.description: A PDF underlay's page, from 1 (docs/adr/0351 §2): the source is a PDF file and this page its content.

parent.description: The reference that brought it, for one nested in another.

path.description: The source drawing's absolute path, as attached or last found.

relative.description: Its path from the drawing's folder, `/` between its parts, written when the drawing is saved.

underlay.description: A PDF underlay's look; absent: as its PDF draws, plotted.

unloaded.description: Its content let go (Boşalt): its inserts stay and draw nothing.

output.description: `GET /v1/tenants/{tenant}/projects/{project}`: what opening needs before the objects.

access.description: What the caller may do in it.

arrays.description: A database project's associative arrays (docs/adr/0300); an older server's answer without them has none.

blocks.description:
A database project's block definitions with their versions
(docs/adr/0144 §5), in the order they were made. An older server's
answer without them has none.

constraints.description:
A database project's constraints and parameters (docs/adr/0336 §3); an older server's answer without them has
none.

eventCursor.description: Event cursor at the moment this was read: subscribe after it to miss nothing.

sheets.description:
A database project's sheet book and its pictures (docs/adr/0251); an
older server's answer without it has none.

state.description: Active or archived (an archived project opens read-only; one in the trash does not open).

storage.description:
How it keeps its content: a file project opens from its newest
revision (`GET …/files`), not from `…/features` (docs/adr/0031). An
older server's answer without it is a database project.

output.title: ProjectInfo

commands.title: Kapalı alan oluştur
commands.summary: Açık çizimde verilen katmana köşeleri, isteğe bağlı yay değerleri ve delikleriyle bir kapalı alan ekler; tek geri alma adımıdır. Katman girdide açıkça verilir: kilitli katmana yazılmaz, gizli katmana uyarıyla yazılır. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur. Yerel çizim izin istemez; bulut projesine değişiklik project.changes ile gider.

AreaRules.description:
The rules a new area is written by (docs/adr/0162, 0622 §9), the tools' Çakışma and Topoloji made explicit: the
command reads no session state.

- `avoid`: the layers whose shown areas it must not overlap (Çakışma: its own layer, or the chosen ones); what
  overlaps them is cut away and the rest written as one object, its parts and holes as they are; one wholly
  covered is refused (`area_covered`), one cut warned of (`area_clipped`). Empty: Serbest.
- `topology`: joined with the shown lines, paths and areas it touches corner by corner, within 1 µm: its corners
  on their edges go to them, theirs on its edges to it, the neighbours in the same undo step (`corners_joined`);
  a locked layer's neighbour takes none (`neighbours_locked`). `points`: points too (Noktalar da).

RingGeometry.description: A closed ring in vertex + bulge form (a polygon hole).

zs.description:
Each vertex's elevation, m, as many as `pts`; `null` for a vertex
without one (not 0); absent when no vertex has one (docs/adr/0142).

Vec2.description: A point in world units: x = east (Y, sağa), y = north (X, yukarı).

frame.description: Whether its boundary is drawn (AutoCAD's WIPEOUTFRAME, per mask).

input.description:
Input of `cad.polygon.create` v1: one closed area on a named layer, written
as one undo step. Everything the command depends on is here (TODOS.md
CMD-07): the closed-area tool fills `layerId` from the active layer and
`color` from the current colour; the command reads neither.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `too_few_corners`,
`not_finite`, `bulge_count` (the outer ring, then each hole),
`invalid_line_weight` (not from 0 to 100 mm), `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict` (status `conflict`),
`layer_not_found`, `not_a_layer`, `layer_locked`; on the desktop also
`slots_exhausted`; with `rules`, an avoided layer's `layer_not_found` and `not_a_layer` (path `rules.avoid[i]`)
and `area_covered`. Warning: `layer_hidden` (it is written all the same); with `rules`, `area_clipped`,
`corners_joined`, `neighbours_locked`.
Geometric validity (self-intersection, zero area, a hole outside the
ring) is not checked, as the drawing tools and the file reader do not.

attrs.description: GIS attributes, text in v1. Absent: none.

bulges.description:
One bulge per edge, the closing edge (last corner → first) last:
tan(θ/4) of the edge's included angle, positive counter-clockwise, 0
straight. Absent: every edge is straight.

color.description: Colour override (`EntityBase.color`). Absent: the layer's colour (katmana göre).

expectedRevision.description:
The document revision the input was prepared against, as decimal text
(from a plan, or the document). When given and the document is no
longer at it, nothing is written and the answer is `conflict`.

holes.description: Holes: closed rings of at least 3 corners, each with one bulge per edge when it has bulges.

label.description: The text shown beside it (`EntityBase.label`). Absent: none.

layerId.description: The layer it goes on: a layer's id (`LayerNode.id`), not a group's.

lineType.description:
Its own line type (docs/adr/0260 §2): what the tools give a new object
from the current line type. Absent: its layer's (katmana göre).

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper mm (`EntityBase.line_weight`, 0 the
thinnest, at most 100; docs/adr/0139): what the tools give a new
object from the current weight. Absent: the layer's (katmana göre).

pts.description:
Corners of the outer ring in order: x east (Y), y north (X), in the
project's units (m), float64. At least 3; the first is not repeated.

rules.description:
Çakışma and Topoloji (docs/adr/0162, 0622 §9): what the new area must not overlap and whether it shares
corners with its neighbours. Absent: written as given.

symbol.description:
Its own symbol, a library item's id (`EntityBase.symbol`), drawn
instead of its layer's style: an object template's (docs/adr/0176).
The id is not looked up: the libraries are the host's. Absent: the
layer's style.

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (Maske, AutoCAD's WIPEOUT; docs/adr/0310 §1): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it, its frame drawn or not. Absent: an ordinary area.

document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

DatasetDim.description:
One of a dataset's slice dimensions (docs/adr/0243 §6): its name, the
index shown, its values (coordinates; moments in milliseconds since 1970
when `time`) and units.

time.description: The values are a CF time axis's moments.

DimensionArrow.description:
A dimension's arrowheads other than the oblique tick, which is no value but
the field's absence (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: A filled triangle, its tip on the dimension line's end (Dolu ok).
The triangle's two sides (Açık ok).
A filled circle about the end (Nokta).
Nothing at the ends (Yok).

DimensionBreak.description:
A gap in one of a dimension's lines where another object crosses it (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK), at the fraction `t` of
the line; its width the options' `breakSize`.

DimensionEntity.description:
Fields every object has. `id` is the object's local id inside a v1 file.
v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

angle.description: Linear: measured direction in degrees (0 = ΔY, 90 = ΔX).

annotative.description:
Its scales: drawn at the paper height it was given at every scale it takes part in, hidden
at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

arrowSize.description:
The arrowhead's (or tick's) length; absent: `DEFAULT_TICK` for ticks,
`DEFAULT_ARROW` for the others.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

breaks.description: The gaps in its lines where other objects cross them (docs/adr/0321 §1).

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

c.description:
Angular: the vertex. Arc length: the arc's centre. Jogged: the centre
the line starts from (docs/adr/0147).

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

decimals.description:
A length's, a coordinate's or a slope's decimals; absent: the
project's length decimals (a slope's 2). Angles keep the project's.

dimLineColor.description:
The dimension line's and its arrowheads' colour, `#RRGGBB`; absent:
the object's (docs/adr/0205 §6).

dimLineType.description: The dimension line's type; absent: continuous.

dimLineWeight.description: The dimension line's weight, paper mm as an object's; absent: a hairline.

dimStyle.description: The project's dimension style it follows, by its id; absent: Standart.

extBeyond.description: How far the extension lines pass the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_BEYOND`.

extColor.description: The extension lines' colour; absent: the object's.

extLineType.description: The extension lines' type; absent: continuous.

extOffset.description: The extension lines' gap from the measured points; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_OFFSET`.

extWeight.description: The extension lines' weight, paper mm; absent: a hairline.

font.description: The value's typeface; absent: the project's.

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

mask.description:
The value is drawn over the drawing's background (docs/adr/0147, as a
text's mask, docs/adr/0145).

options.description: Where the value goes when it does not fit and how it is written (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

overrides.description:
The fields set apart from its style by hand (docs/adr/0322 §5), by name (`DIMENSION_OVERRIDES`): they keep
their value when the style changes. Empty: each field follows while it holds the style's old value.

prefix.description: Written before the value (and its kind's own prefix).

refs.description: The objects its points follow (docs/adr/0249): an associative dimension; none, free points.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

textColor.description: The value's colour; absent: the object's.

textGap.description: The value's baseline over the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_TEXT_GAP`.

textPlace.description: Where the value stands; absent: over the line.

textShift.description: Its value moved from its place (docs/adr/0321 §1).

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

unit.description: The unit lengths and coordinates are written in; absent: the project's.

wipeout.description:

what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

za.description: Slope: the two points' elevations, metres (docs/adr/0147).

DimensionFit.description:
Where the value goes when it does not fit between the extension lines (AutoCAD's DIMATFIT and DIMTIX): absent,
always between them.

oneOf.description: Beyond the second extension line when the value and the two arrowheads are longer than the line between them.
Always beyond the second extension line, the arrowheads outside.

DimensionOptions.description: A dimension's options (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2): all absent, the dimension as it always was.

breakSize.description: A break's width, times the value's height, over 0; absent: 1 (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK size).

lengthStyle.description:
Feet and inches in an inch or foot unit (AutoCAD's DIMLUNIT, docs/adr/0262 §2); absent: the project's, unless
the dimension names its own unit.

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

DrawingFont.description:
The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

EllipseEntity.description: DXF ELLIPSE: centre, major axis vector, minor/major ratio, parameters t0 → t1.

check.description: A check point: kept out of the fit; its error says how good the fit is where no control point is.

off.description: Left out (Kullan off): neither fits nor checks; its residual is still shown.

target.description: Its east and north (a geographic system's longitude and latitude, degrees).

to `t1` (radians): counter-clockwise when `t1` is past `t0`, clockwise when before it; a whole ellipse
`t1 = t0 ± 2π`.
A NURBS curve run whole, from its first knot to its last.

what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

The factor along the definition's y axis when it is not `scale` (docs/adr/0315 §3), positive and finite;

A label moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (an object's
`labelPins`, docs/adr/0212 §3.7).

at.description: Where the label's middle is from the object's anchor, metres; absent, the engine places it.

class.description: The class's name; absent, the object's first label.

LeaderArm.description: A leader's arm after its first (docs/adr/0326 §1).

pts.description: At least one: its tip first, then its bends; it ends at the leader's last vertex.

tip.description: The place on an object its tip follows; absent: a free tip.

LeaderArrow.description:
A leader's arrowhead other than the filled triangle (Dolu üçgen,
AutoCAD's Closed filled), which is no value but the field's absence: a
leader has one spelling (docs/adr/0146 §1). The first three are the
first leaders'; the others AutoCAD's arrowheads (docs/adr/0205 §7, `.kcad`
schema 30).

oneOf.description: Açık ok: the filled triangle's two sides (Open).
Dolu nokta: a filled dot (Dot).
Yok: no arrowhead, the line ends at the tip (None).
Boş üçgen: the triangle's outline (Closed blank).
İnce açık ok: two sides 15° off the line (Open 30).
Dik açık ok: two sides square to each other (Open 90, Right angle).
Küçük nokta (Dot small).
Boş nokta: a ring (Dot blank).
Eğik çizgi: a tick across the tip (Oblique).
Mimari çentik: a heavy tick (Architectural tick).
Dolu kare (Box filled).
Boş kare (Box blank).
Dayanak üçgeni: a filled triangle standing on the tip (Datum triangle filled).

LeaderEntity.description:
A leader (docs/adr/0146): an arrowhead at its first vertex, a line
through its vertices and, with a note, a landing from its last vertex
along the note's direction and the note past the landing's end; one
object. The arrowhead and the landing are measured by the note's height.

annotative.description:
Its scales: drawn at the paper height it was given at every scale it takes part in, hidden
at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

arms.description:
Its other arms (docs/adr/0326 §1): each from its own tip through its bends to the leader's last vertex, where
the landing starts; the arrowhead, the note and the look the first arm's.

arrow.description: The arrowhead; absent: a filled arrow.

arrowSize.description:
The arrowhead's length, times the note's height (docs/adr/0205 §7);
absent: 1. From `MIN_LEADER_ARROW` to `MAX_LEADER_ARROW`.

commands.summary: Açık çizimde verilen katmana iki uç noktası arasında düz bir çizgi ekler; tek geri alma adımıdır. Çizgi aracı zincirin her parçası için bu komutu bir kez çalıştırır: her parça ayrı nesne ve ayrı adımdır. Katman girdide açıkça verilir: kilitli katmana yazılmaz, gizli katmana uyarıyla yazılır. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur. Yerel çizim izin istemez; bulut projesine değişiklik project.changes ile gider.

input.description:
Input of `cad.line.create` v1: one straight line from `a` to `b` on a
named layer, written as one undo step. The line tool calls it once per
segment of its chain, so each segment stays its own object and its own
undo step (docs/adr/0027). Everything the command depends on is here
(TODOS.md CMD-07): the tool fills `layerId` from the active layer and
`color` from the current colour; the command reads neither.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `not_finite` (`a`,
then `b`, x before y), `invalid_line_weight` (not from 0 to 100 mm), `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict` (status
`conflict`), `layer_not_found`, `not_a_layer`, `layer_locked`; on the
desktop also `slots_exhausted`. Warning: `layer_hidden` (it is written
all the same). A line whose ends coincide is not refused: geometric
validity is not checked, as for `cad.polygon.create`.

attrs.description: GIS attributes, text in v1. Absent: none.

(from a plan, or the document). When given and the document is no
longer at it, nothing is written and the answer is `conflict`.

layerId.description: The layer it goes on: a layer's id (`LayerNode.id`), not a group's.

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).

input.description:
Input of `cad.polyline.create` v1: one open polyline on a named layer,
written as one undo step. Everything the command depends on is here
(TODOS.md CMD-07): the polyline tool fills `layerId` from the active
layer and `color` from the current colour; the command reads neither.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `too_few_points`,
`not_finite` (points, x before y), `bulge_count`, `not_finite` (bulges),
`invalid_polyline` (widths not one pair per edge; docs/adr/0258),
`not_finite` and `invalid_polyline` (each edge's widths, NaN or ±∞, then
below 0), `invalid_line_weight` (not from 0 to 100 mm),
`invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict` (status `conflict`),
`layer_not_found`, `not_a_layer`, `layer_locked`; on the desktop also
`slots_exhausted`. Warning: `layer_hidden` (it is written all the same).
Geometric validity (a path crossing itself, zero-length edges) is not
checked, as for `cad.polygon.create`.

bulges.description:

point back to its first), so one fewer than the points, or as many on
a closed line: tan(θ/4) of the edge's included angle, positive
counter-clockwise, 0 straight. Absent: every edge is straight. The
document keeps one value per point, as DXF does: an open polyline is
stored with a 0 after these, for the closing edge it does not have.

closed.description:
A closed line, not an area (docs/adr/0258 §1): its last point joins
its first by one edge more. Absent: open.

color.description: Colour override (`EntityBase.color`). Absent: the layer's colour (katmana göre).

symbol.description:

its line weight.

DimensionFit.description:
Where the value goes when it does not fit between the extension lines (AutoCAD's DIMATFIT and DIMTIX): absent,
always between them.

oneOf.description: Beyond the second extension line when the value and the two arrowheads are longer than the line between them.
Always beyond the second extension line, the arrowheads outside.

DimensionOptions.description: A dimension's options (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2): all absent, the dimension as it always was.

breakSize.description: A break's width, times the value's height, over 0; absent: 1 (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK size).

lengthStyle.description:

the dimension names its own unit.

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

DrawingFont.description:
The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

oneOf.description: Açık ok: the filled triangle's two sides (Open).
Dolu nokta: a filled dot (Dot).

WallEntity.description:
A wall (`CAD-ARCH-01`, `02`): its path, the base line it was drawn along, with arcs as a polyline's bulges (one per
vertex, as the document keeps a polyline's: an open wall's last is 0); its width; where its body lies across the
justification line (the path moved `offset` to its left); the components it is built of, from its left face; its
ends; its height above its level; its architectural information. Its faces, ends, component lines and hatches are
drawn from these (`geom::wall` of the shared core), at the detail the drawing's scale asks.

closed.description: Its path's last vertex joins its first: a ring of wall.

commands.title: Nesneleri sil
commands.summary: Açık çizimden kalıcı kimlikleriyle verilen nesneleri siler; tek geri alma adımıdır, geri alma onları aynı kimlikleriyle yerlerine getirir. Silinecekler girdide açıkça verilir, seçim okunmaz: Sil aracı ve Delete tuşu seçimi ya da tıklanan nesneyi buraya yazar. Kilitli katmandaki nesneler silinmez: başkaları varsa uyarıyla yerinde kalır, hepsi kilitliyse hiçbir şey silinmez. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey silinmez, sonuç conflict olur. Yerel çizim izin istemez; bulut projesine değişiklik project.changes ile gider.

input.description:
Input of `cad.entities.delete` v1: the objects to delete, named by their
persistent ids (docs/adr/0014), deleted as one undo step (“Sil”). What
the interface knows implicitly, the selection, is here (TODOS.md CMD-07):
the erase tool (Sil, Delete) fills `uids` from the selection, or with the
object it picks; the command reads no selection, so the same call deletes
the same objects whatever is selected.

Objects on a locked layer (by themselves or through a group above them)
stay, as the erase tool always left them (docs/adr/0029): with others to
delete they are named in the output's `locked` with a `layer_locked`
warning; when every one is locked nothing is deleted and the answer is
`layer_locked`. A repeated id counts once.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `no_entities`,
`invalid_uid` (each id in order), `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict`
(status `conflict`), `entity_not_found` (each id in order), `layer_locked`.

expectedRevision.description:
The document revision the input was prepared against, as decimal text
(from a plan, or the document). When given and the document is no
longer at it, nothing is deleted and the answer is `conflict`.

uids.description: The objects' persistent ids (lowercase UUID text with hyphens), at least one.

input.title: EntitiesDelete

RelationFollowed.description: What a relation did to a deleted parent's children (docs/adr/0440 §1).

unlinked.description: Children whose link was emptied or lost the parent's id from its list.

output.description: Output of `cad.entities.delete` v1: what was deleted and what stayed.

attachments.description: The attachments the deleted objects (their followed children too) held (docs/adr/0440 §1).

followed.description:
What the project's relations did to the deleted objects' children (docs/adr/0440 §1), in the
relations' order.

locked.description: The ids left in place because their layer is locked, in the input's order.

removed.description:
The ids deleted, in the input's order (a repeated one once). Undo
brings them back with the same ids, in their places.

revision.description:
The document's revision after the delete, as decimal text. Inside an
open transaction or group the delete joins it, and the revision
changes when that ends.

unlinked.description: Children whose link was emptied or lost the parent's id from its list.

commands.title: Nokta oluştur
commands.summary: Açık çizimde verilen katmana bir nokta nesnesi ekler; isteğe bağlı kotu ve yanında görünen yazısıyla. Tek geri alma adımıdır. Nokta aracı her nokta için bu komutu bir kez çalıştırır. Katman girdide açıkça verilir: kilitli katmana yazılmaz, gizli katmana uyarıyla yazılır. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur. Yerel çizim izin istemez; bulut projesine değişiklik project.changes ile gider.

input.description:
Input of `cad.point.create` v1: one point object on a named layer, written
as one undo step. The point tool calls it once per point it places.
Everything the command depends on is here (TODOS.md CMD-07): the tool fills
`layerId` from the active layer (or its own layer, as the spot elevation
tool does) and `color` from the current colour; the command reads neither.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `not_finite` (`p`,
x before y, then `z`), `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict` (status
`conflict`), `layer_not_found`, `not_a_layer`, `layer_locked`; on the
desktop also `slots_exhausted`. Warning: `layer_hidden` (it is written
all the same).

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).

Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

commands.summary: Açık çizimde verilen katmana merkezi ve yarıçapıyla bir daire ekler; tek geri alma adımıdır. Daire aracı yöntemlerinin (merkez ve yarıçap ya da çap, iki nokta, üç nokta, iki nesneye teğet ve yarıçap, üç nesneye teğet) dairesini ortak geometri çekirdeğiyle bulur ve bu komutla yazar. Yarıçap sıfırdan büyük olmalıdır. Katman girdide açıkça verilir: kilitli katmana yazılmaz, gizli katmana uyarıyla yazılır. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur. Yerel çizim izin istemez; bulut projesine değişiklik project.changes ile gider.

input.description:
Input of `cad.circle.create` v1: one circle by its centre and radius on a
named layer, written as one undo step. The circle tool computes the circle
of each of its methods (centre and radius or diameter, two points, three
points, tangent-tangent-radius, three tangents) through the shared core
and gives it here. Everything the command depends on is here (TODOS.md
CMD-07): the tool fills `layerId` from the active layer and `color` from
the current colour; the command reads neither.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `not_finite` (`c`,
x before y, then `r`), `invalid_radius` (not above zero),
`invalid_line_weight` (not from 0 to 100 mm), `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict` (status `conflict`),
`layer_not_found`, `not_a_layer`, `layer_locked`; on the desktop also
`slots_exhausted`. Warning: `layer_hidden` (it is written all the same).

the dimension names its own unit.

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

DrawingFont.description:
The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

EllipseEntity.description: DXF ELLIPSE: centre, major axis vector, minor/major ratio, parameters t0 → t1.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

Entity.description: Any drawing object, tagged by `kind` as in the TypeScript model.

oneOf.description: A general NURBS curve: degree, control points, weights and knots (docs/adr/0259).
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144).
An arrow with a note (docs/adr/0146).
Rows and columns of cells (docs/adr/0184).
A picture (docs/adr/0192).
An orthophoto, a scanned sheet or an elevation model (docs/adr/0204).
A point cloud: LAS, LAZ, COPC or text files (docs/adr/0207).
A wall (docs/adr/0339): its path, width, justification and components; its faces drawn from them.

A door, a window or a bare opening in a wall (docs/adr/0341): its wall's id, its place along it and its
jambs' points.
A grid (docs/adr/0343): its line, label and bubbles.
A column (docs/adr/0343): its centre, outline and the grids it stands on.
A stair (docs/adr/0343): its walking line and its risers, treads and landings.
A ramp (docs/adr/0343): its centre line, width, rise and landings.
A tag (docs/adr/0344): its object, its words and frame.
A view mark (docs/adr/0345): a section, elevation or detail mark pointing at a view.

A record without a geometry (docs/adr/0410): a table's row, with the base's attributes,
attachments and label; not drawn, picked or snapped to.

FieldBroken.description: Why a field's value cannot be read.

oneOf.description: The object is gone.
The object has no such value (an open object's area, a line's text).
The attribute or the variable named is not there.
Texts whose fields read each other in a ring.

FieldFormat.description: How a field writes a number.

comma.description: A decimal comma (`24,35`) instead of a point.

decimals.description: Absent: the project's length or area decimals.

unit.description: Absent: the drawing unit for a length or a place, the project's area unit for an area.

FieldSource.description: Where a field's value comes from.

oneOf.description: An object, by its persistent id.

name.description: The attribute's name, with `attribute`.

oneOf.description: The project.

name.description: The variable's name, with `variable`; the block's, with `blockCount`.

FieldUnit.description: The unit a field writes a number in.

GeorefMethod.description: A transform from the source's pixels to the drawing (docs/adr/0204 §6).

GeorefOutput.description: A resampled raster's grid: north-up, its corner on a multiple of its pixel (docs/adr/0204 §6).

digest.description: The written file's SHA-256 when it was written.

GeorefPoint.description:
A control or check point: a pixel of the source (column, row; pixel corners, 0, 0 the upper left corner of the
upper left pixel, as GDAL's GCPs) and where it is (`target`, in the record's `srid`).

check.description: A check point: kept out of the fit; its error says how good the fit is where no control point is.

name.description: What the user calls it (a mark on the sheet, a survey point's name).

off.description: Left out (Kullan off): neither fits nor checks; its residual is still shown.

target.description: Its east and north (a geographic system's longitude and latitude, degrees).

GeorefSource.description: The raster the points' pixels are of: what it read and its size.

asset.description: The project library's raster it was (embedded).

digest.description: Its bytes' SHA-256 (64 lowercase hex digits) when they were read: the revision the points belong to.

file.description: The file it was (linked), as kept.

url.description: The address it was read from.

GradientShape.description: How a gradient runs over its hatch (docs/adr/0186 §3).

oneOf.description: From one side of the hatch to the other along `angle`.
The second colour along the middle, the first at both sides.
The second colour in the middle, the first at the farthest corner.

HatchAssoc.description:
The objects a hatch follows (docs/adr/0186 §6, 0328 §3): a hatch made inside a closed object follows the

bounds.description: The objects whose line work closes its face (docs/adr/0328 §3).

gap.description: A face's tie: the gaps its line work was closed across, metres (docs/adr/0329 §3); absent: none.

HatchCurve.description: A boundary edge that is no line or circular arc (docs/adr/0328 §1).

oneOf.description:
An ellipse's arc: centre `c`, major semi-axis `major` (from `c`), minor to major `ratio`, from parameter `t0`
to `t1` (radians): counter-clockwise when `t1` is past `t0`, clockwise when before it; a whole ellipse
`t1 = t0 ± 2π`.
A NURBS curve run whole, from its first knot to its last.

HatchEntity.description:
Fields every object has. `id` is the object's local id inside a v1 file.
v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

annotative.description:
Its scales (docs/adr/0331 §3): an annotative hatch's pattern is drawn at each scale it takes part in as large
on paper as at its own; absent: one pattern for every scale.

assoc.description: The objects its region follows (docs/adr/0186 §6); none: it stays as drawn.

HatchLoop.description:
One closed loop of a hatch's boundary as its source holds it (docs/adr/0328 §1): edge `i` runs from `pts[i]` to

points. A loop of one point is one closed curve.

Degrees, counter-clockwise from east: the lines' (lines, cross), the

gradient.description: A gradient's shape and second colour.

origin.description:

spacing.description: Metres between the lines (lines, cross); 1 and unread for the others.

InsertEntity.description:
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144): its definition drawn
moved from the definition's base point to `p`, mirrored in the
definition's x axis when `mirror`, then scaled and turned about `p`. The
transform is a similarity, shapes keeping their kind, unless the insert
has a y factor of its own (docs/adr/0315 §3): then an affine, a circle
becoming the exact ellipse of its image. The insert's own attributes
carry the values of the definition's attribute definitions.

at.description: Where the label's middle is from the object's anchor, metres; absent, the engine places it.

class.description: The class's name; absent, the object's first label.

LeaderArm.description: A leader's arm after its first (docs/adr/0326 §1).

pts.description: At least one: its tip first, then its bends; it ends at the leader's last vertex.

tip.description: The place on an object its tip follows; absent: a free tip.

LeaderArrow.description:
A leader's arrowhead other than the filled triangle (Dolu üçgen,
AutoCAD's Closed filled), which is no value but the field's absence: a
leader has one spelling (docs/adr/0146 §1). The first three are the
first leaders'; the others AutoCAD's arrowheads (docs/adr/0205 §7, `.kcad`
schema 30).

oneOf.description: Açık ok: the filled triangle's two sides (Open).
Dolu nokta: a filled dot (Dot).
Yok: no arrowhead, the line ends at the tip (None).
Boş üçgen: the triangle's outline (Closed blank).
İnce açık ok: two sides 15° off the line (Open 30).
Dik açık ok: two sides square to each other (Open 90, Right angle).
Küçük nokta (Dot small).
Boş nokta: a ring (Dot blank).
Eğik çizgi: a tick across the tip (Oblique).
Mimari çentik: a heavy tick (Architectural tick).
Dolu kare (Box filled).
Boş kare (Box blank).
Dayanak üçgeni: a filled triangle standing on the tip (Datum triangle filled).

LeaderEntity.description:
A leader (docs/adr/0146): an arrowhead at its first vertex, a line
through its vertices and, with a note, a landing from its last vertex
along the note's direction and the note past the landing's end; one
object. The arrowhead and the landing are measured by the note's height.

annotative.description:

at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

arms.description:

the landing starts; the arrowhead, the note and the look the first arm's.

arrow.description: The arrowhead; absent: a filled arrow.

arrowSize.description:

drawn from these (`geom::wall` of the shared core), at the detail the drawing's scale asks.

commands.summary: Açık çizimde verilen katmana merkezi, yarıçapı ve saat yönünün tersine başlangıç ile bitiş açısıyla (radyan) bir yay ekler; tek geri alma adımıdır. Yay aracı yöntemlerinin (üç nokta; başlangıç, merkez ve bitiş, açı ya da kiriş; başlangıç, bitiş ve merkez, açı, yön ya da yarıçap; önce merkez; son nesneye teğet devam) yayını ortak geometri çekirdeğiyle bulur ve bu komutla yazar. Yarıçap sıfırdan büyük olmalıdır; açılar verildiği gibi saklanır, eşit açılar tam turdur. Katman girdide açıkça verilir: kilitli katmana yazılmaz, gizli katmana uyarıyla yazılır. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur. Yerel çizim izin istemez; bulut projesine değişiklik project.changes ile gider.

input.description:
Input of `cad.arc.create` v1: one circular arc on a named layer, as the
document stores it (centre, radius, and the angles it runs between counter-
clockwise), written as one undo step. The arc tool computes the arc of each
of its methods (three points; start, centre and end, angle or chord; start,
end and centre, angle, direction or radius; centre first; continuing the
last object) through the shared core and gives it here. Everything the
command depends on is here (TODOS.md CMD-07): the tool fills `layerId`
from the active layer and `color` from the current colour.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `not_finite` (`c`,
x before y, then `r`, `a0`, `a1`), `invalid_radius` (not above zero),
`invalid_line_weight` (not from 0 to 100 mm), `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict` (status `conflict`),
`layer_not_found`, `not_a_layer`, `layer_locked`; on the desktop also
`slots_exhausted`. Warning: `layer_hidden` (it is written all the same).
The angles are stored as given: equal angles are a full turn, as the
document reads them; no angle is refused for its size.

angle, not a surveying bearing).

commands.summary: Kalıcı kimlikleriyle verilen nesneleri taşır, bir merkez etrafında döndürür, bir merkeze göre ölçekler, iki noktalı bir eksene göre aynalar ya da kaynak noktalarını hedef noktalarına hizalar; yerinde ya da kopya olarak, tek geri alma adımında. Hizalamada birinci kaynak noktası birinci hedefe gider; ikinci çift verilirse nesneler kaynak doğrultusu hedef doğrultusuna oturacak kadar döner, scale ile boyları da eşitlenir. Taşı, Kopyala, Döndür, Ölçekle, Aynala ve Hizala araçları seçimi kimlik listesi olarak verip bu komutla yazar; adım aracın adını taşır. Dönüşüm geometri çekirdeğindedir: her nesne türü (yay, daire, elips, eğri, yazı, ölçü, tarama) aynı kuralla döner; yaylar saat yönünün tersine kalır. Aynanın text alanı yazıların ne olacağıdır (AutoCAD'in MIRRTEXT'i): readable (varsayılan) yazıyı aynadaki yerinde okunur, baş aşağı olmadan, hizası o yeri dolduracak biçimde yazar; mirrored yazıyı çizimle döndürür; yazıların metni ve bloğun öznitelik değerleri hiç değişmez, bloğun kendi yazıları her zaman okunurdur. Yerinde değişen nesne yuvasını, kalıcı kimliğini ve öbür alanlarını korur; kopya bütün alanları alır, yeni bir kalıcı kimlik alır. Kilitli katmandaki nesne ne değişir ne kopyalanır: öbürleri uyarıyla yazılır, hepsi kilitliyse hiçbir şey yazılmaz. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur. Yerel çizim izin istemez; bulut projesine değişiklik project.changes ile gider.

MirrorText.description:
What a mirror does to the texts (docs/adr/0292; AutoCAD's MIRRTEXT): texts, multi-line texts, texts along a
curve, leaders' notes and tables.

oneOf.description:
Okunur (MIRRTEXT = 0): in its mirrored place, reading upright; its alignment turned so that it fills that
place.

Aynalı (MIRRTEXT = 1 without reversed letters): it turns with the drawing, its baseline's image read
backwards; upside down when that points west.

RubberLink.description: A link of Kauçuk levha: a point of the drawing and where it is to go.

Transform.description:
One transform of the plane: a similarity as the modify tools ask for it
(docs/adr/0037, 0047), Vektör oturtma's similarity, affine or projective
transform in centred form (docs/adr/0156 §6), or Kauçuk levha's links
(docs/adr/0158). Coordinates are x east (Y), y north (X), in the
project's units (m), float64.

oneOf.description: Move (taşı) by a displacement: `dx` east, `dy` north.
Rotate (döndür) about `center` by `angle` radians, counter-clockwise.
Scale (ölçekle) about `center` by `factor`, above zero.

Mirror (aynala) across the line through `a` and `b`, two different points. `text` is what becomes of the
texts (docs/adr/0292, AutoCAD's MIRRTEXT): readable (the default) or mirrored. A text's words and a block's
attribute values never change; a block's own texts and attributes always read upright.

Align (hizala, AutoCAD's ALIGN): `source` goes onto `target`. With a
second pair (`source2` and `target2`, given together) the objects
also turn about `source` so that the direction from `source` to
`source2` lies along the one from `target` to `target2`, and with
`scale` they are scaled about it so that the one length becomes the
other. The second pair's points must lie apart from the first's;
`scale` means nothing without a second pair.

Oturt (docs/adr/0156): a similarity between centred frames, `from`
the source centre, `to` the target's: x′ = to.x + a·x̄ − b·ȳ,
y′ = to.y + b·x̄ + a·ȳ, x̄ = x − from.x, ȳ = y − from.y. Every kind
moves as the modify tools move it.

Oturt: an affine transform between centred frames, `m` = [a, b, c, d]:
x′ = to.x + a·x̄ + c·ȳ, y′ = to.y + b·x̄ + d·ȳ. Not a similarity: a
circle, an arc or an ellipse becomes the ellipse of its image (an
object may change its kind), a path's arc segments straight vertices
within 0.1 mm; texts, notes, blocks, dimensions and hatch patterns
keep their shape at their anchor (docs/adr/0156 §4, §5).

Oturt: a projective transform between centred frames, `h` = [a1, a2,
a3, b1, b2, b3, c1, c2]: w = c1·x̄ + c2·ȳ + 1, x′ = to.x + (a1·x̄ +
a2·ȳ + a3)/w, y′ = to.y + (b1·x̄ + b2·ȳ + b3)/w. Lines stay straight;
curves become straight vertices within 0.1 mm; a point where w is
1e-9 or less lies beyond the horizon.

Kauçuk levha (docs/adr/0158): the thin plate spline of the links'
displacements, through every link exactly (a link whose `to` is its
`from` holds its point), following their affine trend far from them.
Only vertices move: straight edges stay straight, an arc segment keeps
its bulge; a circle, an arc and an ellipse move by the nearest
similarity at their centre; texts, notes, blocks, dimensions and hatch
patterns keep their shape at their anchor. 3 to 1000 links, their
sources apart and not all on one line.

Hizala ve dağıt (docs/adr/0194): each object moves on its own along
one axis. The six alignments put its box's west side (`left`),
middle (`center`) or east side (`right`) on the easting `at`, its
north side (`top`), middle (`middle`) or south side (`bottom`) on
the northing `at`; the two spreads (`horizontal`, `vertical`) keep
the first and the last box by their middles and space the others
at equal gaps between them, `at` not given. A box is the object's
extent as the drawing measures it (an insert with its block's
pieces, a text in the drawing's typeface).

Vec2.description: A point in world units: x = east (Y, sağa), y = north (X, yukarı).

input.description:
Input of `cad.entities.transform` v1: objects named by their persistent
ids (docs/adr/0014) moved by one transform as one undo step, in place or
as copies. The modify tools make the selection explicit here (TODOS.md
CMD-07): they give the selected objects' ids; the command reads no
selection, layer or view.

In place, each object keeps its slot, its persistent id and every other
field; only its geometry changes. As copies, each new object takes every
field of its original (layer, colour, attributes, label, symbol) and a new
persistent id; the originals stay. The undo step is the tool's name:
“Taşı” (a move), “Kopyala” (a move as copies), “Döndür”, “Ölçekle”,
“Aynala”, “Hizala”; of an arrangement the mode's name (“Sola hizala”,
“Ortala”, “Sağa hizala”, “Üste hizala”, “Ortaya hizala”, “Alta hizala”,
“Yatay dağıt”, “Dikey dağıt”).

Objects on a locked layer (by itself or a group above it) stay where they
are and are not copied: with others to transform they are named in the
output's `locked` with a `layer_locked` warning; when every one is locked
nothing is written and the answer is `layer_locked`. A repeated id counts
once.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `no_entities`,
`invalid_uid` (each id in order), `not_finite` (the transform's numbers,
in their order), `invalid_factor` (a scale not above zero),
`invalid_axis` (a mirror axis without a direction), `invalid_align` (an
alignment's second pair given by half, or its source or target points
within a nanometre of the first's), `invalid_transform` (an affine or
projective transform whose linear part squashes the plane: its
determinant under 1e-12 of its columns' lengths' product; an
arrangement's `at` missing for an alignment or given for a spread),
`invalid_links` (Kauçuk levha's links: fewer than 3 or more than 1000,
two from one point, all their sources on one line, or equations with no
single solution; path `transform.links`),
`invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict` (status `conflict`),
`entity_not_found` (each id in order), `layer_locked`, `too_few_objects`
(a spread with fewer than three objects off locked layers), `beyond_horizon`
(a point of an object beyond a projective transform's horizon), then
`not_finite` again (path `transform`) when the transform would carry a
coordinate past the largest float64; on the desktop also
`slots_exhausted` for copies.

The undo step of the similarity, affine and projective transforms is
“Oturt”, of the rubber sheet “Kauçuk levha”. When the transform is not a
similarity the output warns with `warp_curves` (objects whose curves
became straight vertices) and `warp_shapes` (texts, notes, blocks,
dimensions and hatch patterns that kept their shape), each with its
count; a rubber sheet with `rubber_bends` (objects whose kept edges or
curves lie over 0.1 mm from their true image, and the largest, mm).

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).

Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.
