oneOf.description: Kesit: a cut line with a bubble at each end, looking to one side.
Görünüş: a bubble looking one way.
Detay: a circle around the detail and a bubble on a leader.

ViewMarkLabel.description: The bubble's words, which the document writes from the target.

bottom.description: The bottom half: the target's number.

top.description: The top half: the mark's number.

ViewTarget.description: What a mark points at: a named view (`view`, its id), or a map frame on a sheet (`sheet` and `item`, their ids).

WallCaps.description: Whether an open wall's ends are closed by a line across it.

WallComponent.description: One layer of a wall's body, from its left face towards its right (`CAD-ARCH-04`): plaster, brick, insulation.

detail.description: The least detail it is drawn at as its own (its lines and hatch); below, it is part of the body.

edge.description: The lines along its sides; absent: the wall's.

priority.description:
Its strength where walls meet (docs/adr/0340 §1), 1 to 9, the smaller the stronger: a joining wall's component
passes the host's weaker ones and stops at the first as strong. Absent: 3 (between a core's 1 and a finish's 5).

thickness.description: Its thickness, metres; absent: what the wall's width leaves of the others (one component at most).

WallDetail.description:
How much of a wall is drawn (`CAD-ARCH-12`), the least first: `Schematic` its outline and its style's fill,
`Standard` the components shown at construction scales, `Detailed` every component.

WallEntity.description:
A wall (`CAD-ARCH-01`, `02`): its path, the base line it was drawn along, with arcs as a polyline's bulges (one per
vertex, as the document keeps a polyline's: an open wall's last is 0); its width; where its body lies across the
justification line (the path moved `offset` to its left); the components it is built of, from its left face; its
ends; its height above its level; its architectural information. Its faces, ends, component lines and hatches are
drawn from these (`geom::wall` of the shared core), at the detail the drawing's scale asks.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

cleanup.description:
Its components are cleaned up by their priorities where another wall tees into or crosses it; false: the
walls meet at their faces only.

closed.description: Its path's last vertex joins its first: a ring of wall.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

components.description: Its body's layers from its left face; none: one plain body.

fill.description: The body's solid fill when drawn schematically (`#RRGGBB`); absent: none.

height.description: Its height above its level's floor, metres; absent: the level's height.

joins.description: How its ends join (docs/adr/0340 §1); absent: both by the rule.

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

offset.description: The base line offset: the justification line is the path moved this far to its left (negative: right).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

style.description: The project's wall style it was made with, by its id; its components are the style's.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

WallJoin.description:
How one end of a wall joins another (docs/adr/0340 §1, `CAD-ARCH-07`): by the rule; not at all (its end line
drawn); at a corner mitred; butting the other (it stops at the other's face); running through it (the other butts).

WallJoins.description: A wall's start's and end's join.

WallJustify.description:
Where the wall's body lies across its path (AutoCAD Architecture's justification): `Left`, the path is the wall's
left face and the body to its right; `Center`, the path is its middle; `Right`, the path is its right face.

frame.description: Whether its boundary is drawn (AutoCAD's WIPEOUTFRAME, per mask).

plan.description: What `cad.entities.transform` would write (plan mode); nothing is written.

entities.description:
Each of them as execute would write it, in the same order: in place
with its own slot (`id`); a copy with `id` 0, as its slot is given
when it is written.

locked.description: The ids it would leave alone because their layer is locked.

revision.description:
The document revision the plan was made against. Give it as
`expectedRevision` to write exactly this plan, or nothing.

sources.description: The ids of the objects execute would transform or copy, in the input's order.

plan.title: EntitiesTransformPlan

targets.note: Nokta bulutunun yeri dosyalarınındır.

examples.title: İki nesneyi 12,5 m doğuya, 7,25 m güneye taşıma
Bir nesnenin bir nokta etrafında 90° döndürülmüş kopyası; yalnız planlandığı sürümde yazılır
Bir yapıyı yolun kenarına hizalama: köşesi hedef noktaya, cephesi yol doğrultusuna

commands.title: Nesneleri düzenle
commands.summary: Kalıcı kimlikleriyle verilen nesnelere yeni geometri verir, onları parçalarla değiştirir, onlardan yeni nesneler yapar ya da onları siler; hepsi tek geri alma adımında, işlemin adıyla. Ötele, Buda, Uzat, Köşe yuvarla, Pah, Kır, Birleştir, Patlat, Uzat-kısalt, Köşe ekle/sil ve Esnet araçları geometriyi ortak geometri çekirdeğiyle bulur, önizlemede gösterdiklerini bu komutla yazar; Öznitelikler panelinin geometri satırları ve yerinde yazı düzenleyicisi de properties işlemiyle (adımı Değiştir), alan araçları da (Alan birleştir, kesiştir, çıkar, böl, Alana çevir, Çizgiye çevir) kendi adlarıyla bu komutla yazar. Seçili nesnenin tutamacı sürüklenince grip işlemiyle (adımı Tutamaçla düzenle), tutamacın menüsü Ortasına köşe ekle ve Köşeyi sil için vertexAdd ve vertexRemove, Düz kenar yap ve Yaya dönüştür için straightEdge ve arcEdge işlemleriyle yazar. Parçala, Yönü çevir, Sadeleştir ve Çizimi temizle split, reverse, simplify ve cleanup işlemleriyle, Tüm köşeleri yuvarla ve Tüm köşelere pah fillet ve chamfer işlemleriyle yazar. update nesnenin geometrisini değiştirir, öbür alanları kalır; replace nesneyi yerinde ve kimliğiyle başka bir nesne yapar, katmanı ve rengi kalır, öznitelikleri ve etiketi keepData ile kalır; add bir nesneden yeni nesne yapar, katmanını, rengini ve kalınlığını alır; add'e verilen katman, renk, kalınlık, öznitelik ve etiket yeni nesnenin kendisinindir (Patlat bir bloğun nesnelerini kendi katman, renk ve verileriyle böyle çıkarır); remove nesneyi siler. Bir nesne tek bir değişiklikle değişir. Yazının metni boş olamaz; kapalı alanın halkası en az 3 köşelidir, kenarlarından biri yaysa 2. Kilitli katmandaki nesne değişmez, ondan nesne yapılmaz: böyle bir nesne verilirse hiçbir şey yazılmaz. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur. Yerel çizim izin istemez; bulut projesine değişiklik project.changes ile gider.

AltUnits.description: An alternate unit written after the value in brackets (AutoCAD's DIMALT): `2.500 [2500]`.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the project's length decimals.

at.description: The scale (1:at) its own geometry is drawn at.

scales.description: The other scales it takes part in, ascending, each with what it sets apart.

AnnotativeScale.description:
One of an object's other scales and what it sets apart from the object's
own values; a field not given is the object's own (`textShift` scaled with
the height).

offset.description: A dimension's line offset.

point.description: A text's point; a leader's landing start (its last point: the points after the arrow's tip move with it).

rotation.description: A text's or a leader's note's direction, degrees counter-clockwise from east.

scale.description: 1:scale.

textShift.description: A dimension's value moved from its place (0 and 0: in its place).

ArchDiscipline.description: The discipline an architectural object belongs to.

ArchInfo.description:
What every architectural object carries beside its geometry (`CAD-ARCH-03`): its level (by the project level's
id), phase, construction status and discipline; absent fields are not said.

ArchPhase.description: An architectural object's phase (renovation): what is there, what goes, what is new.

ArchStatus.description: Where an architectural object is in its construction.

AreaPart.description:
A part of a multi-part area past its first (docs/adr/0143): its outer
ring in vertex + bulge form, its holes and its vertices' elevations, as
the area's own fields hold the first part's. A multi-part polyline's
part is the same, open and without holes (docs/adr/0174).

ms.description:
A polyline's part's measures, as the polyline's own `ms`
(docs/adr/0224 §1); an area's part has none.

zs.description: Each vertex's elevation, as the area's own `zs` (docs/adr/0142).

BreakLine.description: Which of a dimension's lines a break is on.

oneOf.description: The dimension line, from its first end (0) to its second (1).
The first extension line, from the measured point (0) to its far end (1).
The second.

CellField.description: A cell bound to a source (docs/adr/0327 §3): its words are the value last written, `####` when broken.

CellFormula.description: A cell's formula (docs/adr/0327 §2): its words begin with `=`; the cell's words are its result.

CellRange.description: A merged range: `rows` × `cols` cells from row `row`, column `col`.

CellStyle.description:
A style over a range of cells (docs/adr/0327 §1); what it leaves absent the cells take from the styles before it,
then from the table.

color.description: Its words' colour, `#rrggbb`.

decimals.description: The decimals a formula's or a field's number is written with.

fill.description: Its background, `#rrggbb`.

oneOf.description: The file's colours.
ASPRS's classes, each its colour.
Heights through a ramp.
Intensity in grey.
Single, first, intermediate and last returns in four colours.
The object's colour.

asset.description:
The project library's asset its bytes are (embedded); exactly one of
`asset`, `file` and `url` is given.

bounds.description: `[x₁, y₁, z₁, x₂, y₂, z₂]`, as its header says.

count.description: Its points, as its header says.

file.description: The file (linked): absolute, or relative to the drawing's folder.

url.description: An HTTP or HTTPS address read by ranges.

ComponentEdge.description: The lines along a component's sides: its own colour, line weight and line type; absent fields the wall's.

lineWeight.description: Paper mm, 0 to 100.

ComponentHatch.description:
A component's hatch: a pattern of the library or the project by its name (`SOLID` a solid fill), as large on paper
as at 1:1 times `scale` at every drawing scale, turned `angle` degrees along the wall's path, in its own colour.

scale.description: Times the pattern's paper size, above 0.

DatasetDim.description:
One of a dataset's slice dimensions (docs/adr/0243 §6): its name, the
index shown, its values (coordinates; moments in milliseconds since 1970
when `time`) and units.

time.description: The values are a CF time axis's moments.

DimensionArrow.description:
A dimension's arrowheads other than the oblique tick, which is no value but
the field's absence (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: A filled triangle, its tip on the dimension line's end (Dolu ok).
The triangle's two sides (Açık ok).
A filled circle about the end (Nokta).
Nothing at the ends (Yok).

DimensionBreak.description:
A gap in one of a dimension's lines where another object crosses it (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK), at the fraction `t` of
the line; its width the options' `breakSize`.

DimensionFit.description:
Where the value goes when it does not fit between the extension lines (AutoCAD's DIMATFIT and DIMTIX): absent,
always between them.

oneOf.description: Beyond the second extension line when the value and the two arrowheads are longer than the line between them.
Always beyond the second extension line, the arrowheads outside.

DimensionOptions.description: A dimension's options (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2): all absent, the dimension as it always was.

breakSize.description: A break's width, times the value's height, over 0; absent: 1 (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK size).

lengthStyle.description:
Feet and inches in an inch or foot unit (AutoCAD's DIMLUNIT, docs/adr/0262 §2); absent: the project's, unless
the dimension names its own unit.

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

DrawingFont.description:
The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

EditOperation.description: The modify tool an edit comes from; it names the undo step.

oneOf.description: Ötele: a parallel copy.
Buda: the part between two boundaries goes.
Uzat: an end grows to a boundary.
Köşe yuvarla: a corner rounded by an arc.
Pah: a corner cut by a line.
Kır: the part between two points goes, or the object splits at one.
Birleştir: chains of objects meeting end to end become one each.
Patlat: an object comes apart into simple ones.
Uzat-kısalt: a new total length, changed at one end.
Eğriyi düzenle (docs/adr/0303): a polyline or a NURBS curve edited in place by `cad.curves.edit`.
Özellik kopyala's kind properties (docs/adr/0304): a text's face, a dimension's look, a hatch's pattern.
Köşe ekle: a vertex added on an edge.
Köşe sil: a vertex removed.
Esnet: the vertices in a window move, the rest stay.

Öznitelikler: a value typed into a geometry row (a point's Y and X; a
text's content, height and angle; a dimension's offset, text height
and text; a hatch's pattern, angle and spacing), or a text or a
dimension's text edited in place. The step is “Değiştir”.
Alan birleştir: the areas go, their union comes from the first.
Alan kesiştir: the areas' overlap, a new area (the areas go with it when erased).
Alan çıkar: areas with others cut out of them; the pieces left come from each.
Alan böl: areas split along a line; the first piece is the area itself.
Alana çevir: closed objects become areas in their places; the regions line work closes are new areas.
Çizgiye çevir: an area's outer ring becomes a closed polyline in its place; its holes are new polylines.

Tutamaçla düzenle: a selected object's grip moved (a vertex, an end,
a centre, a radius, an edge's middle), the object updated in its place.

Düz kenar yap: an arc edge of a polyline or an area made straight
(its bulge 0), from the grip menu of the edge's middle.

Yaya dönüştür: a straight edge of a polyline or an area made an arc,
from the grip menu of the edge's middle.

Parçala (docs/adr/0140): objects cut into separate pieces where they
cross, into equal parts or by length; the first piece keeps the
object's place and id, every piece its data.
Yönü çevir: an object drawn the other way round, its outline the same.
Sadeleştir: a path's vertices within a tolerance of its outline dropped.

Çizimi temizle: objects repeated on their layer and empty ones
deleted, vertices repeated in a row dropped.

Kot ver (docs/adr/0142): objects' vertices given elevations as the
geometry's `zs` says: the same value, the old ones raised, or none.

Parçaları birleştir (docs/adr/0143): areas become one multi-part area
in the first one's place, overlapping ones merged into one part.

Parçalara ayır (docs/adr/0143): a multi-part area becomes an area a
part; the first part keeps its place, the others are new, with its data.

Okunur yap (docs/adr/0145): texts that read upside down turned half
round, each box where it was.

Bul ve değiştir (docs/adr/0145 §6): texts given new words, the step
named after the window; otherwise as `Properties`.

Topolojik temizlik (docs/adr/0148): line work and area outlines put
right within a tolerance, objects updated in place, each geometry with
its elevations as the cleanup carried them.

Kenar eşle (docs/adr/0159): the line ends of two sheets put together
across their common edge, objects updated in place (Parça ekle makes
a line a polyline), each geometry with its elevations as the core's
`ops::edgematch` gave them.

Biçim değiştir (docs/adr/0173 §2–§3): an area cut or grown, or a
path's stretch redrawn, by a sketched line; the object updated in
place (a line becomes a polyline).

Sürdür (docs/adr/0173 §4): a line or a polyline continued from one
of its ends, updated in place.
Delik ekle (docs/adr/0173 §5): a hole added to an area.
Deliği sil: a hole of an area removed.
Deliği doldur: a new area filling a hole, made from the area.

Yazı stilleri's Kaydet (docs/adr/0183 §1): the texts of the styles
changed take their new faces, widths and heights, those of a style
deleted lose their link; objects updated in place.
Ölçü stilleri's Kaydet, as `TextStyle` for dimensions.

Tabloyu düzenle's Kaydet (docs/adr/0184 §4): a table's cells, rows,
columns, merges and look written in place.
Tabloyu güncelle (docs/adr/0184 §5): tables written again from their source.

Resmi kırp (docs/adr/0192 §5): a picture's clip boundary set or
taken away, the picture updated in place.

Eğriye oturt (docs/adr/0196 §4): texts made to stand on a curve, each
updated in place with its new point, turn and curve.

Doğrultuya döndür (docs/adr/0196 §4): straight texts turned to an
edge's direction, each about its own point.
Düzleştir (docs/adr/0196 §4): texts along a curve made straight.
Kavşak temizle (docs/adr/0198 §3): road areas joined kind by kind, their inner corners rounded.
Refüj kapat (docs/adr/0198 §4): two lines closed into a median, an area.
Topoloji düzelt (docs/adr/0202 §4): a topology finding fixed, its objects updated in place or deleted.
Yatay ağ dengelemesi (docs/adr/0203 §8): points moved to their adjusted places, vertices on them with them.
Kot ağı dengelemesi (docs/adr/0203 §8): points given their adjusted heights, vertices on them too.
Raster stili (docs/adr/0204 §4): rasters' looks and opacities written in place.

Raster oturt (docs/adr/0204 §6): a raster's affine set from control points, or the raster
put in place of its resampled file, updated in place.
Nokta bulutu stili (docs/adr/0207 §5): clouds' looks and opacities written in place.

Yazı yüksekliklerini uydur (docs/adr/0205 §3): after the plot scale or
an annotation height changed, the texts, leaders, dimensions and
tables still at the old height given the new one
(`follow_annotation_scale`).

Kenar genişliği (docs/adr/0288): a polyline edge's start and end widths
set, from `cad.entities.vertex`'s `width`.

EntityEdit.description:
One change of an edit. The objects are named by their persistent ids
(docs/adr/0014).

oneOf.description:
The object takes a new geometry and keeps everything else: its slot,
persistent id, layer, colour, attributes, label and symbol (an end
extended, a corner rounded, a vertex added).

The object becomes another in its place: the new geometry in its slot,
with its persistent id, layer and colour; its attributes, label and
attachments only with `keepData`; not its symbol (the part a trim
leaves, the first part of a break, a chain joined into its first
object).

keepData.description: True: the attributes, the label and the attachments carry over (docs/adr/0225 §1).

oneOf.description:
A new object made from `from`: its layer, colour and line weight; its
attributes, label and attachments only with `keepData` (an offset
copy, a piece of a break or an explode, a fillet's arc). A field given here is the new
object's own instead: a block's object exploded keeps its layer,
colour, line weight, attributes and label (docs/adr/0144).

attrs.description: Its attributes, whatever `keepData` says.

color.description: Its own colour (`EntityBase.color`).

keepData.description: True: the attributes, the label and the attachments carry over (docs/adr/0225 §1).

label.description: Its label, whatever `keepData` says.

layerId.description: The layer it goes on: a layer's id (`LayerNode.id`), not a group's.

lineWeight.description: Its own line weight, paper mm, 0 to 100 (`EntityBase.line_weight`).

oneOf.description: The object is deleted.

EntityGeometry.description:
A drawing object's geometry alone: its kind and the fields that place and
shape it, without the fields every object has (layer, colour, attributes,
label, symbol). Coordinates are x east (Y), y north (X), in the project's
units (m), float64; angles in radians unless said otherwise.

parts.description:
A multi-point object's points past its first, each with its
elevation (docs/adr/0174). The geometry is the whole object:
absent, it has one point, so an edit of a multi-point object
writes every point.

ms.description:
The ends' measures (M) as written (docs/adr/0224 §2), as `zs`;
absent: each takes one from the objects the edit names.

zs.description:
The vertices' elevations as written (docs/adr/0142): its two ends, `null` for one without; all `null`: none. Absent:
each vertex takes one from the objects the edit names.

oneOf.description:
A path: vertices and DXF bulges (tan(θ/4), CCW positive), the one at
vertex i bending the edge to vertex i + 1; open unless `closed`.

closed.description:
A closed line, not an area (docs/adr/0258 §1): its last vertex
joins its first by the edge the last of `bulges` bends. Absent:
open. One part only.

ms.description:
The vertices' measures (M) as written (docs/adr/0224 §2), as
`zs`; a part's come with it (`AreaPart.ms`). Absent: each vertex
takes one from the objects the edit names.

parts.description:
A multi-part polyline's parts past its first, each its vertices,
arcs and elevations, without holes (docs/adr/0174). The geometry
is the whole polyline: absent, it has one part, so an edit of a
multi-part polyline writes every part.

widths.description:
The edges' widths as written (docs/adr/0258 §2): a start and an
end for each vertex's edge, in the drawing's length (the last
`[0, 0]` on an open line); all 0: none. Absent: each edge takes
its widths from the objects the edit names, where it runs along
one of their edges, as elevations do. One part only.

zs.description:
The vertices' elevations as written (docs/adr/0142): as many as
the vertices, `null` for one without; all `null`: none. Absent:
each vertex takes one from the objects the edit names.

oneOf.description: A closed area: its ring and, when it has any, its holes.

parts.description:
A multi-part area's parts past its first, each its ring, arcs,
holes and elevations (docs/adr/0143). The geometry is the whole
area: absent, it has one part, so an edit of a multi-part area
writes every part.

zs.description:
The vertices' elevations as written (docs/adr/0142): as many as
the vertices, `null` for one without; all `null`: none. The holes' come with them (`RingGeometry.zs`). Absent:
each vertex takes one from the objects the edit names.

oneOf.description: Counter-clockwise from `a0` to `a1`.
Centre, major axis vector, minor/major ratio, parameters `t0` → `t1`.
A general NURBS curve (docs/adr/0259): its source numbers as `NurbsEntity` holds them.
A construction line through `p` along the unit direction `dir`.
A ray from `p` along the unit direction `dir`.
Text at `p`; `height` in metres, `rotation` in degrees counter-clockwise from east.

align.description: Where `p` is on the text; absent: the left of its baseline (docs/adr/0145).

annotative.description:
Its scales (docs/adr/0323 §4); absent: an object updated keeps its own (only
`cad.annotations.scales` takes them away), a new one has none.

boxWidth.description: A multi-line text's box width, metres (docs/adr/0182 §1); absent: no box.

font.description: Its typeface; absent: the project's, in the look of docs/adr/0055.

layout.description:
Its indents, tab stops and columns (docs/adr/0324 §1); absent: an object updated keeps its own, a new one
has none; an empty layout (`{}`) takes it away.

lineSpacing.description: Its line spacing, times 5/3 of the height; absent: 1. From 0.25 to 4.

mask.description: Its box filled with the drawing area's colour before it is drawn.

oblique.description:
How far its letters lean, degrees, positive with their tops to the
right; within ±`MAX_OBLIQUE`, never 0 (upright is the field's absence).

overrides.description: The fields set apart from its style by hand (docs/adr/0322 §5), by name (`TEXT_OVERRIDES`), as a dimension's.

path.description: The curve its letters stand on, in its own frame (docs/adr/0196 §1); absent: straight.

runs.description: Its letters' formats (`TextRun`), in order, not overlapping; absent: none.

textStyle.description: The project's text style it follows, by its id; absent: Standart.

widthFactor.description: The letters' width times this, the height kept; absent: 1. Over 0, at most 100.

oneOf.description:
A dimension from `a` to `b` (an angular one's vertex is `c`), its line
`offset` metres away, its text `height` metres high; `text` replaces
the measured value, `angle` is a linear one's measured direction in
degrees counter-clockwise from east (0 = ΔY, 90 = ΔX). What the fields
mean for the styles of docs/adr/0147 (an ordinate's `angle`, an arc
length's and a jogged one's `c`, a slope's `za` and `zb`) is that ADR's
table.

annotative.description:
Its scales (docs/adr/0323 §4); absent: an object updated keeps its own (only
`cad.annotations.scales` takes them away), a new one has none.

arrowSize.description:
The arrowhead's (or tick's) length; absent: `DEFAULT_TICK` for ticks,
`DEFAULT_ARROW` for the others.

breaks.description: The gaps in its lines (docs/adr/0321 §1).

decimals.description:
A length's, a coordinate's or a slope's decimals; absent: the
project's length decimals (a slope's 2). Angles keep the project's.

dimLineColor.description:
The dimension line's and its arrowheads' colour, `#RRGGBB`; absent:
the object's (docs/adr/0205 §6).

dimLineType.description: The dimension line's type; absent: continuous.

dimLineWeight.description: The dimension line's weight, paper mm as an object's; absent: a hairline.

dimStyle.description: The project's dimension style it follows, by its id; absent: Standart.

extBeyond.description: How far the extension lines pass the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_BEYOND`.

extColor.description: The extension lines' colour; absent: the object's.

extLineType.description: The extension lines' type; absent: continuous.

extOffset.description: The extension lines' gap from the measured points; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_OFFSET`.

extWeight.description: The extension lines' weight, paper mm; absent: a hairline.

font.description: The value's typeface; absent: the project's.

mask.description: The value over the drawing's background (docs/adr/0147).

options.description: Where the value goes when it does not fit and how it is written (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2).

overrides.description:
The fields set apart from its style by hand (docs/adr/0322 §5), by name (`DIMENSION_OVERRIDES`): they keep
their value when the style changes. Empty: each field follows while it holds the style's old value.

prefix.description: Written before the value (and its kind's own prefix).

refs.description: The objects its points follow (docs/adr/0249): an associative dimension; none, free points.

textColor.description: The value's colour; absent: the object's.

textGap.description: The value's baseline over the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_TEXT_GAP`.

textPlace.description: Where the value stands; absent: over the line.

textShift.description: Its value moved from its place (docs/adr/0321 §1).

unit.description: The unit lengths and coordinates are written in; absent: the project's.

za.description: A slope's two elevations, metres (docs/adr/0147).

oneOf.description: A hatched area: its ring, its holes when it has any, and its pattern.

annotative.description: Its scales (docs/adr/0331 §3): an annotative hatch's pattern as large on paper at each.

assoc.description: The objects its region follows (docs/adr/0186 §6).

boundary.description:
Its boundary exact (docs/adr/0328 §1): the outer loop, then the holes'; `ring` and `holes` are then
drawn from it and may be left empty.

oneOf.description:
A block placed (docs/adr/0144): the definition's base point goes to
`p`, its objects are mirrored in the definition's x axis when
`mirror`, scaled by `scale` (above 0) and turned by `rotation`
(radians, counter-clockwise) about `p`. The block is the drawing's. `yScale` is its own y factor when it is
not `scale` (docs/adr/0315 §3).

A leader (docs/adr/0146): an arrowhead at `pts[0]`, a line through
`pts` and, with a note, a landing from the last vertex and the note
past it; `height` (metres, over 0) measures the note, the arrowhead
and the landing, `rotation` (degrees counter-clockwise from east)
turns the note and the landing.

annotative.description:
Its scales (docs/adr/0323 §4); absent: an object updated keeps its own (only
`cad.annotations.scales` takes them away), a new one has none.

arms.description:
Its other arms' points, each its tip first (docs/adr/0326 §1); absent: an object updated keeps its own, a new
one has none; an arm kept keeps what its tip follows.

arrow.description: The arrowhead; absent: a filled arrow.

arrowSize.description:
The arrowhead's length, times the note's height (docs/adr/0205
§7); absent: 1. From `MIN_LEADER_ARROW` to `MAX_LEADER_ARROW`.

mask.description: The note's box filled with the drawing area's colour before it is drawn.

pts.description: At least two: the arrow's tip first.

text.description: The note, one line; absent: the arrow alone. Never empty.

oneOf.description:
A table (docs/adr/0184 §1): rows and columns of one-line cells
hanging from `p`, its top left corner, turned by `rotation` (degrees
counter-clockwise from east); `height` (metres, over 0) its cells'
text height; `rows` and `columns` its rows' heights and columns'
widths (metres, over 0); `cells` the words, row by row.

aligns.description: Each column's alignment; absent: all left.

font.description: Its typeface; absent: the project's, in the look of docs/adr/0055.

frame.description: Its frame's width, metres (Kalın çerçeve); absent: a line.

grid.description: Which lines are drawn; absent: all.

header.description: The first row is its heading.

merges.description: Merged ranges, their words in their top left cells.

oblique.description:
How far its letters lean, degrees, positive with their tops to the
right; within ±`MAX_OBLIQUE`, never 0 (upright is the field's absence).

overrides.description: The fields set apart from its style by hand (docs/adr/0322 §5), by name (`TEXT_OVERRIDES`), as a dimension's.

source.description: Where its rows came from; absent: written by hand.

styles.description: Its cells' styles, formulas and fields (docs/adr/0327); absent in an edit: the table's kept.

textStyle.description: The project's text style it follows, by its id; absent: Standart.

oneOf.description:
A picture (docs/adr/0192 §1): its lower left corner `p`, its width
and height (metres, over 0), turned by `rotation` (radians,
counter-clockwise) about `p` and mirrored in its own x axis when
`mirror`; its bytes the project library's asset `asset` or the file
`file`, exactly one; clipped to `clip` in its own fractions; drawn at
`opacity`.

A raster (docs/adr/0204 §2): its pixels placed by `affine`, its size,
bands and samples, its file (`asset` embedded, `file` linked or `url`
read by ranges, exactly one), the file's system, its look and opacity.

A point cloud (docs/adr/0207 §3): its files (each embedded, linked or
an address), their points and bounds, the system, its look and opacity.

A wall (docs/adr/0339 §1): its path (the base line, bulges one per vertex), width, justification, base line
offset, components from its left face, ends, schematic fill, height and architectural information.

FieldBroken.description: Why a field's value cannot be read.

oneOf.description: The object is gone.
The object has no such value (an open object's area, a line's text).
The attribute or the variable named is not there.
Texts whose fields read each other in a ring.

FieldFormat.description: How a field writes a number.

comma.description: A decimal comma (`24,35`) instead of a point.

decimals.description: Absent: the project's length or area decimals.

unit.description: Absent: the drawing unit for a length or a place, the project's area unit for an area.

FieldSource.description: Where a field's value comes from.

oneOf.description: An object, by its persistent id.

name.description: The attribute's name, with `attribute`.

oneOf.description: The project.

name.description: The variable's name, with `variable`; the block's, with `blockCount`.

FieldUnit.description: The unit a field writes a number in.

GeorefMethod.description: A transform from the source's pixels to the drawing (docs/adr/0204 §6).

GeorefOutput.description: A resampled raster's grid: north-up, its corner on a multiple of its pixel (docs/adr/0204 §6).

digest.description: The written file's SHA-256 when it was written.

GeorefPoint.description:
A control or check point: a pixel of the source (column, row; pixel corners, 0, 0 the upper left corner of the
upper left pixel, as GDAL's GCPs) and where it is (`target`, in the record's `srid`).

check.description: A check point: kept out of the fit; its error says how good the fit is where no control point is.

name.description: What the user calls it (a mark on the sheet, a survey point's name).

off.description: Left out (Kullan off): neither fits nor checks; its residual is still shown.

target.description: Its east and north (a geographic system's longitude and latitude, degrees).

GeorefSource.description: The raster the points' pixels are of: what it read and its size.

asset.description: The project library's raster it was (embedded).

digest.description: Its bytes' SHA-256 (64 lowercase hex digits) when they were read: the revision the points belong to.

file.description: The file it was (linked), as kept.

url.description: The address it was read from.

GradientShape.description: How a gradient runs over its hatch (docs/adr/0186 §3).

oneOf.description: From one side of the hatch to the other along `angle`.
The second colour along the middle, the first at both sides.
The second colour in the middle, the first at the farthest corner.

HatchAssoc.description:
The objects a hatch follows (docs/adr/0186 §6, 0328 §3): a hatch made inside a closed object follows the
object (`outer`), its islands, the texts and inserts left open; a hatch made in the face line work closes
(`bounds`: the objects whose line work bounds it, its islands' too) follows that line work; the point clicked
inside picks the region's part or face. Exactly one of `outer` and `bounds` is given.

bounds.description: The objects whose line work closes its face (docs/adr/0328 §3).

gap.description: A face's tie: the gaps its line work was closed across, metres (docs/adr/0329 §3); absent: none.

HatchCurve.description: A boundary edge that is no line or circular arc (docs/adr/0328 §1).

oneOf.description:
An ellipse's arc: centre `c`, major semi-axis `major` (from `c`), minor to major `ratio`, from parameter `t0`
to `t1` (radians): counter-clockwise when `t1` is past `t0`, clockwise when before it; a whole ellipse
`t1 = t0 ± 2π`.
A NURBS curve run whole, from its first knot to its last.

HatchGradient.description: A gradient: its shape, whether it runs the other way, its second colour.

HatchLoop.description:
One closed loop of a hatch's boundary as its source holds it (docs/adr/0328 §1): edge `i` runs from `pts[i]` to
the next point (the last to the first); it is straight, a circular arc of `bulges[i]` (tan(θ/4), counter-clockwise
positive, as a polygon's), or the curve `curves[i]` (an ellipse's arc or a NURBS curve), whose ends are those
points. A loop of one point is one closed curve.

angle.description:
Degrees, counter-clockwise from east: the lines' (lines, cross), the
pattern's turn (pattern), the gradient's direction (gradient).

gradient.description: A gradient's shape and second colour.

name.description: A pattern's name (`ANSI31`).

origin.description:
Where its lines are anchored in the world (docs/adr/0331 §2; AutoCAD's HPORIGIN): every family goes through
it as the definition says instead of through the world's origin. Absent: the world's origin.

scale.description: A pattern's metres per unit of its definition.

spacing.description: Metres between the lines (lines, cross); 1 and unread for the others.

oneOf.description: User-defined lines at `angle`, `spacing` apart.
User-defined lines and the same turned 90°.
A pattern of line families (`name`, `scale`, `lines`).
A gradient from the hatch's colour to `gradient.color2`.

ImageFields.description:
What places and shows a picture: the image object's own fields, and its
geometry in the commands (`EntityGeometry::Image`).

asset.description:
The project library's PNG or JPEG asset its bytes are (embedded);
exactly one of `asset` and `file` is given.

file.description: The file it shows (linked): absolute, or relative to the drawing's folder.

height.description: Along its left edge, metres, over 0.

mirror.description: The picture mirrored in its own x axis (Aynala), before the turn.

rotation.description: Radians, counter-clockwise from east, about `p`.

width.description: Along its bottom edge, metres, over 0.

LeaderArrow.description:
A leader's arrowhead other than the filled triangle (Dolu üçgen,
AutoCAD's Closed filled), which is no value but the field's absence: a
leader has one spelling (docs/adr/0146 §1). The first three are the
first leaders'; the others AutoCAD's arrowheads (docs/adr/0205 §7, `.kcad`
schema 30).

oneOf.description: Açık ok: the filled triangle's two sides (Open).
Dolu nokta: a filled dot (Dot).
Yok: no arrowhead, the line ends at the tip (None).
Boş üçgen: the triangle's outline (Closed blank).
İnce açık ok: two sides 15° off the line (Open 30).
Dik açık ok: two sides square to each other (Open 90, Right angle).
Küçük nokta (Dot small).
Boş nokta: a ring (Dot blank).
Eğik çizgi: a tick across the tip (Oblique).
Mimari çentik: a heavy tick (Architectural tick).
Dolu kare (Box filled).
Boş kare (Box blank).
Dayanak üçgeni: a filled triangle standing on the tip (Datum triangle filled).

LengthStyle.description:
How lengths are written (docs/adr/0262 §2); none (no setting) is decimal
in the drawing's unit. The three are an inch or foot drawing's.

oneOf.description: Decimal in the drawing's unit: no setting, here for a command to say so.

ObjectValue.description: An object's value a field writes.

oneOf.description: A closed object's area, its holes taken off.
A closed object's perimeter.
A line's, an arc's, a path's or a curve's length.
Its layer's name.
Its label.
The attribute named: a block insert's attribute value, else the object's attribute.
A text's letters (a cross reference).
Its east and north: a point's place, a text's, a block's or a table's insertion point, else where its label goes.
Kapı.
Pencere.
Boşluk: a gap in the wall and nothing in it.

ParagraphLayout.description:
A multi-line text's indents, tab stops and columns (docs/adr/0324 §1), in its height (MTEXT's `\p` codes):
every paragraph's first line starts `leftIndent + indent` heights from the box's left, its other lines
`leftIndent`; a tab goes to the next stop past where it is, a stop every `DEFAULT_TAB` heights after the last
given; columns take the lines in turn, each `columns.height` metres tall.

columns.description: Static columns; a text in columns has a box.

indent.description: A paragraph's first line from the others', heights; below 0 a hanging indent (a list's). Absent: 0.

leftIndent.description: Every line but a paragraph's first from the box's left, heights. Absent: 0.

tabs.description: The tab stops from the box's left, heights, ascending, each over 0.

PatternLine.description:
One family of a pattern's lines (docs/adr/0186 §1), in the pattern's
units, before the pattern turns: lines at `angle` (degrees) through
`origin`, each the next `offset` on (`[along, across]` the line), drawn
as `dashes` say (plus drawn, minus a gap, 0 a dot; none: whole).

PointCloudFields.description:
What places and shows a cloud: the object's own fields, and its geometry
in the commands (`EntityGeometry::PointCloud`).

bounds.description: The members' bounds together.

count.description: The members' points together.

srid.description: The files' system; 0: they named none and the user took the project's.

min.description: The ramp's least and most value (heights in metres, or intensities).

ramp.description: One of the rasters' ramps (`RASTER_RAMPS`); absent: Arazi.

rgb8.description: Colours with 8 significant bits (a file that writes 0–255 in its 16-bit fields).

PointPart.description:
A point of a multi-point object past its first (docs/adr/0174): its
place and elevation, as the point's own fields hold the first's.

PointSizeUnit.description: The unit of a point's size.

oneOf.description: Pixels on the screen (independent of the device's pixels).
Metres on the ground (at least a pixel).

ProjectValue.description: The project's value a field writes.

oneOf.description: The project's name.
The drawing's scale, `1:500`.
The drawing unit, `m`.
The coordinate system, `EPSG:5254`, or `Yerel`.
The project's variable named (docs/adr/0214 §4).
How many inserts of the block named the drawing holds (docs/adr/0327 §3).

RasterDataset.description:
A NetCDF variable a raster shows (docs/adr/0243 §6): a CF grid's or a
UGRID mesh's dataset, one slice of its other dimensions.

dims.description: Its slice dimensions in the file's order.

followTime.description: The step shown follows the time slider (docs/adr/0243 §7).

mesh.description: The mesh topology it lies on (a UGRID file); absent: a CF grid.

variable.description: The variable's name in the file (a vector's x component).

vector.description: A vector's y component: its magnitude is shown.

RasterFields.description:
What places and shows a raster: the raster object's own fields, and its
geometry in the commands (`EntityGeometry::Raster`).

affine.description:
`[x₀, a, b, y₀, c, d]`: column i and row j (pixel corners, 0, 0 the
upper left) lie at x = x₀ + a·i + b·j, y = y₀ + c·i + d·j (GDAL's
geotransform order). Invertible.

asset.description:
The project library's asset its file is (embedded); exactly one of
`asset` and `file` is given.

dataset.description: A NetCDF file's variable and slice it shows (docs/adr/0243 §6).

file.description: The file it shows (linked): absolute, or relative to the drawing's folder.

georef.description: How it was georeferenced (Raster oturt, docs/adr/0518): the points, the source and, resampled, the output grid.

srid.description: The file's coordinate system; 0: the file named none and the user took the project's.

url.description: An HTTP or HTTPS address read by ranges (a COG; docs/adr/0207 §1).

RasterGeoref.description: How a raster was georeferenced (docs/adr/0518 §1): enough to do it again.

checkRmse.description: The check points' root mean square error and largest error (the project's length unit).

crs.description:
The targets' system as a definition when it is no registered EPSG system (docs/adr/0594 §1): a project's own, a
`.points` file's `#CRS:` line, a provider's; KentOS's WKT of it, the targets carried from it to the project's.

m0.description: The control points' m0 (the project's length unit); none for the thin plate or without redundancy.

output.description: The output grid, for a resampled raster (projective, polynomials, thin plate).

points.description: The control, check and left-out points, as given.

srid.description: The targets' coordinate system (EPSG) when it is not the project's; they were carried to the project's.

oneOf.description: Three bands as red, green and blue, a fourth as alpha.
One band in grey.
One band through the file's palette.
One band through a colour ramp.
One band (heights) as a shaded relief.
The ramp darkened by the shaded relief.

RasterResampling.description: How a pixel between samples is shown.

RasterStretch.description: How values are brought to colours (docs/adr/0204 §4).

oneOf.description: As they are (8 bit).
The band's least to its most.
Its 2nd to its 98th percentile.
The style's `min` to `max`.

altitude.description: Its height above the horizon, degrees (0–90).

azimuth.description: Gölgeli kabartma's light: degrees from north, clockwise (0–360).

bands.description: The bands drawn, from 1: three or four for `rgb`, one otherwise.

edges.description: A mesh's edges drawn over it in this colour (`#RRGGBB`; docs/adr/0243 §5).

min.description: `manual`'s least and most value.

nodata.description: The value shown as nothing, in place of the file's.

RingGeometry.description: A closed ring in vertex + bulge form (a polygon hole).

zs.description:
Each vertex's elevation, m, as many as `pts`; `null` for a vertex
without one (not 0); absent when no vertex has one (docs/adr/0142).

ScheduleField.description: What one column of a schedule reads.

oneOf.description: The attribute the column's `attr` names.

ScheduleFilter.description: Which objects a schedule lists: those of every list given.

levels.description: Their levels' ids (an opening's its wall's).

ScheduleSort.description: A sort key: a column by its index, in order or reversed.

SourceOverrides.description: What Tabloyu güncelle does with a cell changed by hand since its file was last read (docs/adr/0327 §5).

oneOf.description: Kept while the file's cell there stays as it was.
The file's words written over it.
A point object's position: part 0 its own, `k` its `k`th extra point (docs/adr/0174).
A line's, arc's or elliptical arc's start.
Its end.
A circle's, arc's or ellipse's centre.

A path's vertex: part 0 the object's own path, `k` its `k`th extra part; ring 0 the outer ring, `h` its
`h`th hole; the vertex's index in the ring.
The middle of a line (all zero) or of a path's edge from vertex `index` to the next.

A point along an edge or a curve (docs/adr/0263 §1): a line's (all zero) or a path's edge from vertex `index`
to the next, at the fraction `t` of its chord or of its arc's sweep; an arc's (`a0 + t·sweep`), a circle's
(`t·2π` from east) or an ellipse's (`t0 + t·sweep`) curve (all zero). `t` within 0 and 1.

SubRef.description: A place on an object by the object's persistent id: what a dimension's point follows.

broken.description:
Why it no longer follows its object ([`SUBREF_BROKEN`]); none while it does. The point keeps its last
coordinates.

path.description:
When `uid` is an insert, the piece inside it the place is on (docs/adr/0263 §3): each number the object's
place in that level's definition, every one but the last an insert; empty (not written) for the object itself.

TableAlign.description: A column's alignment; its cells sit in the middle of their rows.

TableGrid.description: Which of a table's lines are drawn, when not all.

oneOf.description: Its outline alone.
Its outline and the lines between its rows.
None: the words alone.

TableSource.description: Where a table's rows came from (docs/adr/0184 §5).

oneOf.description: Koordinat çizelgesi: the points and vertices of these objects.
Alan çizelgesi: these areas, their area and perimeter.
Öznitelik tablosu: these objects' attributes.

A CSV or Excel file by its name (and sheet). Linked (docs/adr/0327 §5): its path (absolute, or from the
drawing's folder), the SHA-256 of the bytes last read, the cells they gave (the embedded copy: what a cell
changed by hand differs from) and what is done with such a cell; unlinked, it is chosen again to update.

Blok çizelgesi (docs/adr/0327 §4): the inserts of the blocks named (none named: every block placed) counted,
by the attribute `by` when given; written again by the document at every step.

Kapı ve pencere, mahal, kolon ya da duvar çizelgesi (docs/adr/0344 §3): the objects of `of` that the filter
takes, a row each (alike ones one row when grouped), in the columns' order, sorted, with a total; written again
by the document at every step, which writes `members` too: each data row's objects by their persistent ids.

TextAlign.description:
Which point of a text its `p` is (docs/adr/0145 §1): horizontally its
left, centre or right; vertically on its baseline, at its bottom (0.2 of
its height under the baseline), its middle (half its height over it) or
its top (its height over it). The left of the baseline, where a text
always stood, is no value but the field's absence: a text has one
spelling.

TextColumns.description:
A multi-line text's static columns (docs/adr/0324 §1): `count` columns of the box's width, `gap` heights
apart, each `height` metres tall; lines past the last column's height go on down in it.

gap.description: The space between two columns, heights.

height.description: A column's height, metres.

TextPath.description:
The curve a text's letters stand on (docs/adr/0196 §1). Its vertices are
in the text's own frame: `p` its start, x along the text's `rotation`, y
square to it on the left, metres. The first vertex is `p` itself and is
not written; `pts` are the ones after it. The frame carries the curve with
the text when it moves, turns or scales.

input.description:
Input of `cad.entities.edit` v1: changes to objects named by their
persistent ids, written as one undo step named after `operation`. The
modify tools give the objects they picked and the geometry the shared
core computed (TODOS.md CMD-07); the command reads no selection, layer or
view.

The changes are made in their order, against the document as it was
before them: an `add` may come from an object the same edit replaces or
deletes. An object is changed (`update`, `replace`, `remove`) by one
change at most.

An object on a locked layer (by itself or a group above it) is not
changed, and nothing is made from it: when one is named, nothing is
written and the answer is `layer_locked`. The pieces of a split object
belong together, so an edit is written whole or not at all.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `no_changes`,
`invalid_uid` (each change's id in order), then each change in order: its
geometry's `too_few_points` (a polyline), `too_few_corners` (a closed
area's ring or hole with fewer than 3 corners, or 2 whose two edges are
both straight, a bulge absent or 0; a hatch's ring or hole with fewer
than 3), `empty_text` (a text whose text is empty or only white space,
Unicode's `White_Space`), `invalid_elevations`, `not_finite`,
`invalid_radius`, `invalid_scale` (an insert's), and an `add`'s own
`invalid_line_weight`;
then `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict` (status `conflict`),
`entity_not_found` (each id in order), `repeated_entity` (an object
changed twice), `layer_locked`; an `add`'s own layer: `layer_not_found`,
`not_a_layer`, `layer_locked`; `unknown_block` (each insert's block, in
order); on the desktop also `slots_exhausted`.

expectedRevision.description:
The document revision the input was prepared against, as decimal text
(from a plan, or the document). When given and the document is no
longer at it, nothing is written and the answer is `conflict`.

operation.description:
The modify tool the edit comes from; it names the undo step: Ötele,
Buda, Uzat, Köşe yuvarla, Pah, Kır, Birleştir, Patlat, Uzat-kısalt,
Köşe ekle, Köşe sil, Esnet; Değiştir for Öznitelikler; Alan birleştir,
Alan kesiştir, Alan çıkar, Alan böl, Alana çevir, Çizgiye çevir,
Parçaları birleştir, Parçalara ayır; Tutamaçla düzenle, Düz kenar
yap, Yaya dönüştür for the grips.

commands.title: Nesneleri diziye kopyala
commands.summary: Kalıcı kimlikleriyle verilen nesnelerin kopyalarını satır ve sütunlara ya da bir merkezin çevresine dizer; bütün kopyalar tek geri alma adımındadır. Dizi: satır × sütun yer (2 ile 10 000 arası), sütunlar dx, satırlar dy aralıkla; birden çok yeri olan yönün aralığı sıfır olamaz. Kutupsal dizi: merkezin çevresinde adet kadar öğe (2 ile 1000 arası, asıllar dahil), fill derecelik açıya; 360 tam turu eşit böler, eksi saat yönündedir. rotate ile kopyalar merkez etrafında döner, yoksa yönünü koruyup kopyalanan nesnelerin kutusunun ortasıyla yer değiştirir. Yol boyunca dizi: kalıcı kimliğiyle verilen yol (çizgi, yay, daire ya da çoklu çizgi) boyunca adet kadar yer (2 ile 10 000 arası, asıllar yolun başında); spacing verilirse yerler yolun başından o aralıkla, verilmezse yolun başından sonuna (kapalı yolda çevresine) eşit dağılır; align ile kopyalar yolun doğrultusuyla döner. Yol okunur, değişmez. Kopyala'nın Dizi'si (line): yer değiştirme (dx, dy) boyunca adet kadar yer (2 ile 10 000 arası, asıllar ilk yerde), k'ıncı kopya k yer değiştirme ötede; fit ile son kopya yer değiştirmenin ucunda, öbürleri onu eşit paylaşır; adım Kopyala. Dizi, Kutupsal dizi ve Yol boyunca dizi araçları seçimi kimlik listesi olarak verip bu komutla yazar; adım aracın adını taşır. Yerleşim geometri çekirdeğindedir: her nesne türü aynı kuralla kopyalanır. Kopya aslının bütün alanlarını ve yeni bir kalıcı kimlik alır. Kilitli katmandaki nesnenin kopyası yapılmaz: öbürleri uyarıyla yazılır, hepsi kilitliyse hiçbir şey yazılmaz. associative ile (ilişkili dizi, docs/adr/0300) nesneler “Dizi n” bloğu olur ve her yere bloğun bir yerleştirmesi konur; dizi çizimde kalır (çıktının array'i) ve cad.arrays.edit ile düzenlenir. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur. Yerel çizim izin istemez; bulut projesine değişiklik project.changes ile gider.

ArrayLayout.description:
How the copies are laid out. The originals take the first place and stay
where they are. Coordinates are x east (Y), y north (X), in the
project's units (m), float64.

oneOf.description:
Dizi: `rows` × `cols` places, 2 to 10 000 of them; the copy `j`
columns and `i` rows from the originals moves `j·dx` east and `i·dy`
north. The copies are made row after row, each row column after
column. A direction with more than one place needs a spacing.

Kutupsal dizi: `count` items around `center`, 2 to 1000, the
originals among them, over `fill` degrees (counter-clockwise; minus
clockwise; 360 a full turn). A full turn shares the circle out; a
partial fill puts the last copy on its end. With `rotate` each copy
turns about the centre; without, it keeps its direction and moves as
the middle of the copied objects' box goes round.

Kopyala's Dizi (docs/adr/0291; AutoCAD COPY's Array): `count` places along the displacement (`dx`,
`dy`), 2 to 10 000, the originals at the first: the copy `k` moves `k·(dx, dy)`; with `fit` the last one
moves the whole displacement and the others share it, the copy `k` moving `k·(dx, dy) / (count − 1)`.

Yol boyunca dizi (docs/adr/0140): `count` places, 2 to 10 000, along
the object `path` names by its persistent id (a line, an arc, a
circle or a polyline), the originals at the first, the path's start.
The places are `spacing` metres apart along the path from its start,
or without a spacing spread evenly from its start to its end (round a
closed path, its end being its start). The copy at a place moves by
the path's point there less its start; with `align` it first turns
about the start by the path's direction there less its direction at
the start. The path is read, never changed.

Vec2.description: A point in world units: x = east (Y, sağa), y = north (X, yukarı).

input.description:
Input of `cad.entities.array` v1: copies of objects named by their
persistent ids (docs/adr/0014) laid out by `layout`, as one undo step.
The array tools make the selection explicit here (TODOS.md CMD-07): they
give the selected objects' ids; the command reads no selection, layer or
view.

Each copy takes every field of its original (layer, colour, attributes,
label, symbol) and a new persistent id; the originals stay. The copies
are written place after place, each place the objects in the input's
order. The undo step is the tool's name: “Dizi”, “Kutupsal dizi”,
“Yol boyunca dizi” or, for a line of copies, “Kopyala”.

Objects on a locked layer (by itself or a group above it) are not
copied: with others they are named in the output's `locked` with a
`layer_locked` warning; when every one is locked nothing is written and
the answer is `layer_locked`. A polar array's copies that do not turn are
placed by the middle of the box of the objects that are copied. A
repeated id counts once.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `no_entities`,
`invalid_uid` (each id in order, then a path array's path at
`layout.path`), `not_finite` (the layout's numbers, in their order),
`invalid_count` (rows and columns, or the count, out of their range),
`invalid_spacing` (a grid direction with more than one place and no
spacing; a line's displacement of no length; a path array's spacing not
above zero), `invalid_fill` (a polar
fill of zero or past a full turn), `invalid_revision`,
`revision_conflict` (status `conflict`), `entity_not_found` (each id in
order, then the path at `layout.path`), `invalid_path` (a path that is
not a line, an arc, a circle or a polyline, or has no length),
`invalid_spacing` again (a path array's places past the end of an open
path, or round to the start of a closed one), `layer_locked`, then
`not_finite` again (path `layout`) when a copy would lie past the
largest float64; on the desktop also `slots_exhausted`.

With `associative` (docs/adr/0300) the objects become a block, “Dizi n”
(its base point the middle of their box), and every place, theirs the
first, gets an insert of it: the items of one associative array the
document keeps (`AssocArray`). The objects are removed; editing the block
changes every item. A path array then follows its path. Refused with
`block_refused` when the objects cannot be a block.

associative.description: One associative array of a block's inserts instead of independent copies.

expectedRevision.description:
The document revision the input was prepared against, as decimal text
(from a plan, or the document). When given and the document is no
longer at it, nothing is written and the answer is `conflict`.

curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

DrawingFont.description:
The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

EllipseEntity.description: DXF ELLIPSE: centre, major axis vector, minor/major ratio, parameters t0 → t1.

check.description: A check point: kept out of the fit; its error says how good the fit is where no control point is.

off.description: Left out (Kullan off): neither fits nor checks; its residual is still shown.

to `t1` (radians): counter-clockwise when `t1` is past `t0`, clockwise when before it; a whole ellipse

A NURBS curve run whole, from its first knot to its last.

HatchLoop.description:

points. A loop of one point is one closed curve.

InsertEntity.description:
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144): its definition drawn
moved from the definition's base point to `p`, mirrored in the
definition's x axis when `mirror`, then scaled and turned about `p`. The
transform is a similarity, shapes keeping their kind, unless the insert
has a y factor of its own (docs/adr/0315 §3): then an affine, a circle
becoming the exact ellipse of its image. The insert's own attributes
carry the values of the definition's attribute definitions.

A leader's arrowhead other than the filled triangle (Dolu üçgen,
AutoCAD's Closed filled), which is no value but the field's absence: a

oneOf.description: Açık ok: the filled triangle's two sides (Open).
Dolu nokta: a filled dot (Dot).
Yok: no arrowhead, the line ends at the tip (None).
Boş üçgen: the triangle's outline (Closed blank).
İnce açık ok: two sides 15° off the line (Open 30).
Dik açık ok: two sides square to each other (Open 90, Right angle).
Küçük nokta (Dot small).
Boş nokta: a ring (Dot blank).
Eğik çizgi: a tick across the tip (Oblique).
Mimari çentik: a heavy tick (Architectural tick).
Dolu kare (Box filled).
Boş kare (Box blank).
Dayanak üçgeni: a filled triangle standing on the tip (Datum triangle filled).

commands.summary: Kimliğiyle verilen ilişkili diziyi (cad.entities.array'in associative'i) düzenler (AutoCAD'in ARRAYEDIT'i); tek geri alma adımı “Diziyi düzenle”. Öğeler yerleşimin sırasıyla 0'dan numaralanır (ızgarada satır satır: satır r, sütun c r × sütun + c). edit layout: yeni satır, sütun, adet, aralık, açı ya da yol; her öğe yeniden yerleşir. Öğe numarasını (iki ızgarada satırını ve sütununu) korur; elle silinen silinmiş, elle değişen (kept) yerinde kalır; yeni yerlere yerleştirme eklenir, kalkan yerlerin yerleştirmeleri silinir. edit placement: ilk yerin p, scale, rotation ve mirror'ı; silinmemiş ve değişmemiş öğeler izler. edit replace: items öğeleri block adlı bloğu yerleştirir ve korunur. edit remove: items öğelerinin yerleştirmeleri silinir, öğeler boş kalır. edit reset: items (yoksa hepsi) yerleşimin verdiği gibi olur: silinen geri gelir, değişen dizinin bloğuyla yerine döner. Dizinin katmanı ve dokunulan her yerleştirme kilitsiz olmalı: hepsi ya da hiçbiri. Çıktı ve plan cad.entities.edit'inkidir. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

ArrayEdit.description: What changes in the array (AutoCAD ARRAYEDIT's properties, Replace, Reset; an item's erase).

oneOf.description:
The rows, columns, count, spacing, fill or path: every item is laid out again. An item keeps its number
(a grid's its row and column); a removed one stays removed, a kept one where it is; the places that are new
get inserts, the ones that are gone take their inserts away. The kind may change too.

The first place: where the block's base point goes, its scale and turn, mirrored or not; the items that
are neither removed nor kept follow. Absent fields stay.
These items insert the block named `block` instead (Değiştir): each is kept from then on.
These items' inserts are deleted; the items stay removed until reset.

These items (none: every item) as the layout makes them: a removed one comes back, a kept one goes to its
place with the array's block (Sıfırla).

ArrayLayout.description:
How the copies are laid out. The originals take the first place and stay
where they are. Coordinates are x east (Y), y north (X), in the
project's units (m), float64.

oneOf.description:
Dizi: `rows` × `cols` places, 2 to 10 000 of them; the copy `j`
columns and `i` rows from the originals moves `j·dx` east and `i·dy`
north. The copies are made row after row, each row column after
column. A direction with more than one place needs a spacing.

Kutupsal dizi: `count` items around `center`, 2 to 1000, the
originals among them, over `fill` degrees (counter-clockwise; minus
clockwise; 360 a full turn). A full turn shares the circle out; a
partial fill puts the last copy on its end. With `rotate` each copy
turns about the centre; without, it keeps its direction and moves as
the middle of the copied objects' box goes round.

Kopyala's Dizi (docs/adr/0291; AutoCAD COPY's Array): `count` places along the displacement (`dx`,
`dy`), 2 to 10 000, the originals at the first: the copy `k` moves `k·(dx, dy)`; with `fit` the last one
moves the whole displacement and the others share it, the copy `k` moving `k·(dx, dy) / (count − 1)`.

Yol boyunca dizi (docs/adr/0140): `count` places, 2 to 10 000, along
the object `path` names by its persistent id (a line, an arc, a
circle or a polyline), the originals at the first, the path's start.
The places are `spacing` metres apart along the path from its start,
or without a spacing spread evenly from its start to its end (round a
closed path, its end being its start). The copy at a place moves by
the path's point there less its start; with `align` it first turns
about the start by the path's direction there less its direction at
the start. The path is read, never changed.

Vec2.description: A point in world units: x = east (Y, sağa), y = north (X, yukarı).

input.description:
Input of `cad.arrays.edit` v1: the associative array `array` edited by `edit`, as one undo step “Diziyi
düzenle”. The array's layer and every insert the edit touches must be unlocked: all or nothing. The answer is
`cad.entities.edit`'s: the item inserts changed, created and removed.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `invalid_uid` (the array's id), the edit's own numbers
(`not_finite`, `invalid_count`, `invalid_spacing`, `invalid_fill`, `invalid_uid` for a path; `invalid_scale`;
`invalid_item` for an empty or repeated list), `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict` (status `conflict`),
`array_not_found`, `invalid_item` (a number past the places), `layer_locked`, `item_removed` (Değiştir or
Sil on a removed item), `unknown_block`, a path layout's `entity_not_found`, `invalid_path` and
`invalid_spacing`, `not_finite` (places past the largest float64), `slots_exhausted`.

expectedRevision.description:
The document revision the input was prepared against, as decimal text. When given and the document is no
longer at it, nothing is written and the answer is `conflict`.

curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

DrawingFont.description:
The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

EllipseEntity.description: DXF ELLIPSE: centre, major axis vector, minor/major ratio, parameters t0 → t1.

check.description: A check point: kept out of the fit; its error says how good the fit is where no control point is.

off.description: Left out (Kullan off): neither fits nor checks; its residual is still shown.

to `t1` (radians): counter-clockwise when `t1` is past `t0`, clockwise when before it; a whole ellipse

A NURBS curve run whole, from its first knot to its last.

HatchLoop.description:

points. A loop of one point is one closed curve.

InsertEntity.description:
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144): its definition drawn
moved from the definition's base point to `p`, mirrored in the
definition's x axis when `mirror`, then scaled and turned about `p`. The
transform is a similarity, shapes keeping their kind, unless the insert
has a y factor of its own (docs/adr/0315 §3): then an affine, a circle
becoming the exact ellipse of its image. The insert's own attributes
carry the values of the definition's attribute definitions.

A leader's arrowhead other than the filled triangle (Dolu üçgen,
AutoCAD's Closed filled), which is no value but the field's absence: a

oneOf.description: Açık ok: the filled triangle's two sides (Open).
Dolu nokta: a filled dot (Dot).
Yok: no arrowhead, the line ends at the tip (None).
Boş üçgen: the triangle's outline (Closed blank).
İnce açık ok: two sides 15° off the line (Open 30).
Dik açık ok: two sides square to each other (Open 90, Right angle).
Küçük nokta (Dot small).
Boş nokta: a ring (Dot blank).
Eğik çizgi: a tick across the tip (Oblique).
Mimari çentik: a heavy tick (Architectural tick).
Dolu kare (Box filled).
Boş kare (Box blank).
Dayanak üçgeni: a filled triangle standing on the tip (Datum triangle filled).

commands.title: Kısıtlar
commands.summary: Çizimin geometrik ve ölçü kısıtlarını (AutoCAD'in GEOMCONSTRAINT ve DIMCONSTRAINT'i) ekler, kaldırır, sürücü ya da başvuru yapar, öbür çözümüne çevirir ya da çizimi yeniden çözer; kısıtlar ve çözümün oynattığı nesneler tek geri alma adımı “Kısıtlar”. edit add: kısıtlar sırasıyla eklenir; kural ve parçaları (nesnenin kalıcı kimliği ve parçası: nokta yeri, düz kenar ya da daire). Yön (teğetin yanı, kenara uzaklığın yanı, açının 180°'den küçük olanı, yatay ve düşey uzaklığın küçükten büyüğe) sense: given demedikçe çizimden okunur. Ölçü kısıtının parameter'ı boşsa bir sonraki boş ad (d1, ang1, rad1, dia1); value bir ifadedir (çizim biriminde, açı projenin açı biriminde; 3.5, 120cm, d1 / 2), yoksa çizimin ölçtüğü; reference yalnız ölçer. Ötekileri tekrarlayan kısıt eklenmez (constraint_redundant). edit remove: kimlikleriyle kısıtlar kalkar, ölçünün parametresi başka parametre okumuyorsa onunla. edit mode: ölçüler sürücü ya da başvuru olur. edit flip: kısıtın öbür çözümü. edit solve: çizim kısıtlarıyla yeniden çözülür. Kilitli katmandaki nesne kımıldamaz. Çelişkide (constraint_conflict, çelişenler uids'te), tekil kısıtta ya da çözüm bulunamadığında hiçbir şey yazılmaz. Bir şekli ters çeviren çözüm (shape_flipped) allowFlip olmadan yazılmaz. Çıktı eklenen ve kaldırılan kısıtları, oynayan nesneleri ve çözücünün teşhisini (durum, serbestlik, fazla, çelişen, tekil, kopuk kısıtlar, serbest nesneler) verir. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

input.description:
Input of `cad.constraints.edit` v1: one undo step “Kısıtlar”: the constraints and every object the solve moves.
Objects on locked layers do not move. The edit is all or nothing: refused, nothing is written.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `no_constraints` (an empty list), `invalid_uid`,
`invalid_constraint` (parts that do not fit the rule, a reference rule not a dimension), `invalid_parameter`
(a name not valid), `parameter_expression` (a value that does not read, or given to a reference),
`invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict` (status `conflict`), `entity_not_found`, `element_not_found` (a part the
object does not have), `constraint_not_found`, `parameter_in_use` (a parameter another dimension has),
`parameter_kind` (a parameter of another kind), the parameters' values (`parameter_expression`,
`parameter_missing`: a name no parameter has, `parameter_cycle`, `parameter_range`: out of its range, or a radius
or diameter not above nought), `invalid_constraint` (the set's rules), `layer_locked` (a constraint whose objects
are all locked does not hold), `constraint_conflict` (`uids`: the constraints that cannot hold with the others),
`constraint_singular`, `not_converged`, `constraint_redundant` (`uids`: the constraints added that repeat),
`shape_flipped` (`uids`: the objects that would turn inside out).

allowFlip.description: Writes even when a shape would turn inside out (the user chose that solution).

expectedRevision.description:
The document revision the input was prepared against, as decimal text. When given and the document is no
longer at it, nothing is written and the answer is `conflict`.

hold.description:
Objects (persistent ids) this solve does not move, as AutoCAD keeps the object picked first and moves the
second; they are not held afterwards.
