commands.title: Parametreler
commands.summary: Çizimin parametrelerini (AutoCAD'in parametre yöneticisi) adlarıyla değiştirir ve çizimi yeni değerlerle çözer; parametreler ve çözümün oynattığı nesneler tek geri alma adımı “Parametreler”. edits sırasıyla: add kullanıcı parametresi (ad, tür length, angle ya da number, ifade, isteğe bağlı min, max, açıklama); set ifade, sınırlar (clear kaldırır) ve açıklama, verilmeyenler kalır; rename yeni ad, onu okuyan ifadeler ve ölçü kısıtı izler; remove başka parametrenin okumadığı kullanıcı parametresi. Değerler parametrenin biriminde: uzunluk çizim biriminde, açı projenin açı biriminde. Yalnız ölçen ölçünün parametresine ifade verilmez (parameter_measured). Döngü, aralık dışı değer, çelişki, tekillik ve ters dönme cad.constraints.edit'teki gibi reddedilir, hiçbir şey yazılmaz. Çıktı her parametrenin değerini, oynayan nesneleri ve çözücünün teşhisini verir.

input.description:
Input of `cad.parameters.edit` v1: one undo step “Parametreler”: the parameters and every object the solve moves.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `invalid_parameter` (a name not valid),
`parameter_expression` (an expression that does not read), `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict` (status
`conflict`), `parameter_not_found`, `parameter_exists` (a name in use), `parameter_kind` (a kind its dimension does
not take), `parameter_measured` (an expression for a dimension that only measures), `parameter_read` (a parameter
another reads, or a dimension's, taken away), then the parameters' values (`parameter_missing`,
`parameter_cycle`, `parameter_range`) and the solve's (`layer_locked`, `constraint_conflict`,
`constraint_singular`, `not_converged`, `shape_flipped`), as `cad.constraints.edit` answers.

follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

c.description:
Angular: the vertex. Arc length: the arc's centre. Jogged: the centre
the line starts from (docs/adr/0147).

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

decimals.description:
A length's, a coordinate's or a slope's decimals; absent: the
project's length decimals (a slope's 2). Angles keep the project's.

dimLineColor.description:
The dimension line's and its arrowheads' colour, `#RRGGBB`; absent:
the object's (docs/adr/0205 §6).

dimLineType.description: The dimension line's type; absent: continuous.

dimLineWeight.description: The dimension line's weight, paper mm as an object's; absent: a hairline.

dimStyle.description: The project's dimension style it follows, by its id; absent: Standart.

extBeyond.description: How far the extension lines pass the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_BEYOND`.

extColor.description: The extension lines' colour; absent: the object's.

extLineType.description: The extension lines' type; absent: continuous.

extOffset.description: The extension lines' gap from the measured points; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_OFFSET`.

extWeight.description: The extension lines' weight, paper mm; absent: a hairline.

font.description: The value's typeface; absent: the project's.

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

mask.description:
The value is drawn over the drawing's background (docs/adr/0147, as a
text's mask, docs/adr/0145).

options.description: Where the value goes when it does not fit and how it is written (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

overrides.description:
The fields set apart from its style by hand (docs/adr/0322 §5), by name (`DIMENSION_OVERRIDES`): they keep
their value when the style changes. Empty: each field follows while it holds the style's old value.

prefix.description: Written before the value (and its kind's own prefix).

refs.description: The objects its points follow (docs/adr/0249): an associative dimension; none, free points.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

textColor.description: The value's colour; absent: the object's.

textGap.description: The value's baseline over the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_TEXT_GAP`.

textPlace.description: Where the value stands; absent: over the line.

textShift.description: Its value moved from its place (docs/adr/0321 §1).

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

unit.description: The unit lengths and coordinates are written in; absent: the project's.

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

za.description: Slope: the two points' elevations, metres (docs/adr/0147).

DimensionFit.description:
Where the value goes when it does not fit between the extension lines (AutoCAD's DIMATFIT and DIMTIX): absent,
always between them.

oneOf.description: Beyond the second extension line when the value and the two arrowheads are longer than the line between them.
Always beyond the second extension line, the arrowheads outside.

DimensionOptions.description: A dimension's options (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2): all absent, the dimension as it always was.

breakSize.description: A break's width, times the value's height, over 0; absent: 1 (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK size).

lengthStyle.description:
Feet and inches in an inch or foot unit (AutoCAD's DIMLUNIT, docs/adr/0262 §2); absent: the project's, unless
the dimension names its own unit.

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

DrawingFont.description:
The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

EllipseEntity.description: DXF ELLIPSE: centre, major axis vector, minor/major ratio, parameters t0 → t1.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

Entity.description: Any drawing object, tagged by `kind` as in the TypeScript model.

oneOf.description: A general NURBS curve: degree, control points, weights and knots (docs/adr/0259).
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144).
An arrow with a note (docs/adr/0146).
Rows and columns of cells (docs/adr/0184).
A picture (docs/adr/0192).
An orthophoto, a scanned sheet or an elevation model (docs/adr/0204).
A point cloud: LAS, LAZ, COPC or text files (docs/adr/0207).
A wall (docs/adr/0339): its path, width, justification and components; its faces drawn from them.

A door, a window or a bare opening in a wall (docs/adr/0341): its wall's id, its place along it and its
jambs' points.
A grid (docs/adr/0343): its line, label and bubbles.
A column (docs/adr/0343): its centre, outline and the grids it stands on.
A stair (docs/adr/0343): its walking line and its risers, treads and landings.
A ramp (docs/adr/0343): its centre line, width, rise and landings.
A tag (docs/adr/0344): its object, its words and frame.
A view mark (docs/adr/0345): a section, elevation or detail mark pointing at a view.

A record without a geometry (docs/adr/0410): a table's row, with the base's attributes,
attachments and label; not drawn, picked or snapped to.

FieldBroken.description: Why a field's value cannot be read.

oneOf.description: The object is gone.
The object has no such value (an open object's area, a line's text).
The attribute or the variable named is not there.
Texts whose fields read each other in a ring.

FieldFormat.description: How a field writes a number.

comma.description: A decimal comma (`24,35`) instead of a point.

decimals.description: Absent: the project's length or area decimals.

unit.description: Absent: the drawing unit for a length or a place, the project's area unit for an area.

FieldSource.description: Where a field's value comes from.

oneOf.description: An object, by its persistent id.

name.description: The attribute's name, with `attribute`.

oneOf.description: The project.

name.description: The variable's name, with `variable`; the block's, with `blockCount`.

FieldUnit.description: The unit a field writes a number in.

GeorefMethod.description: A transform from the source's pixels to the drawing (docs/adr/0204 §6).

GeorefOutput.description: A resampled raster's grid: north-up, its corner on a multiple of its pixel (docs/adr/0204 §6).

digest.description: The written file's SHA-256 when it was written.

GeorefPoint.description:
A control or check point: a pixel of the source (column, row; pixel corners, 0, 0 the upper left corner of the
upper left pixel, as GDAL's GCPs) and where it is (`target`, in the record's `srid`).

check.description: A check point: kept out of the fit; its error says how good the fit is where no control point is.

name.description: What the user calls it (a mark on the sheet, a survey point's name).

off.description: Left out (Kullan off): neither fits nor checks; its residual is still shown.

target.description: Its east and north (a geographic system's longitude and latitude, degrees).

GeorefSource.description: The raster the points' pixels are of: what it read and its size.

asset.description: The project library's raster it was (embedded).

digest.description: Its bytes' SHA-256 (64 lowercase hex digits) when they were read: the revision the points belong to.

file.description: The file it was (linked), as kept.

url.description: The address it was read from.

GradientShape.description: How a gradient runs over its hatch (docs/adr/0186 §3).

oneOf.description: From one side of the hatch to the other along `angle`.
The second colour along the middle, the first at both sides.
The second colour in the middle, the first at the farthest corner.

GridBubbles.description: Which ends of a grid carry a bubble.

bulges.description: One bulge per point (the first the arc's; absent: straight).

HatchAssoc.description:
The objects a hatch follows (docs/adr/0186 §6, 0328 §3): a hatch made inside a closed object follows the
object (`outer`), its islands, the texts and inserts left open; a hatch made in the face line work closes
(`bounds`: the objects whose line work bounds it, its islands' too) follows that line work; the point clicked
inside picks the region's part or face. Exactly one of `outer` and `bounds` is given.

bounds.description: The objects whose line work closes its face (docs/adr/0328 §3).

gap.description: A face's tie: the gaps its line work was closed across, metres (docs/adr/0329 §3); absent: none.

HatchCurve.description: A boundary edge that is no line or circular arc (docs/adr/0328 §1).

oneOf.description:
An ellipse's arc: centre `c`, major semi-axis `major` (from `c`), minor to major `ratio`, from parameter `t0`
to `t1` (radians): counter-clockwise when `t1` is past `t0`, clockwise when before it; a whole ellipse
`t1 = t0 ± 2π`.
A NURBS curve run whole, from its first knot to its last.

HatchEntity.description:
Fields every object has. `id` is the object's local id inside a v1 file.
v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

annotative.description:
Its scales (docs/adr/0331 §3): an annotative hatch's pattern is drawn at each scale it takes part in as large
on paper as at its own; absent: one pattern for every scale.

assoc.description: The objects its region follows (docs/adr/0186 §6); none: it stays as drawn.

ellipses' arcs and NURBS curves exact; `ring` and `holes` are drawn from it (arcs and curves as chords). None:
the ring and holes are all it has.

HatchLoop.description:
One closed loop of a hatch's boundary as its source holds it (docs/adr/0328 §1): edge `i` runs from `pts[i]` to
the next point (the last to the first); it is straight, a circular arc of `bulges[i]` (tan(θ/4), counter-clockwise
positive, as a polygon's), or the curve `curves[i]` (an ellipse's arc or a NURBS curve), whose ends are those
points. A loop of one point is one closed curve.

angle.description:
Degrees, counter-clockwise from east: the lines' (lines, cross), the
pattern's turn (pattern), the gradient's direction (gradient).

gradient.description: A gradient's shape and second colour.

name.description: A pattern's name (`ANSI31`).

origin.description:
Where its lines are anchored in the world (docs/adr/0331 §2; AutoCAD's HPORIGIN): every family goes through
it as the definition says instead of through the world's origin. Absent: the world's origin.

scale.description: A pattern's metres per unit of its definition.

spacing.description: Metres between the lines (lines, cross); 1 and unread for the others.

oneOf.description: User-defined lines at `angle`, `spacing` apart.
User-defined lines and the same turned 90°.

inverted.description: The content outside the boundary is drawn, the inside left out.

InsertEntity.description:
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144): its definition drawn
moved from the definition's base point to `p`, mirrored in the
definition's x axis when `mirror`, then scaled and turned about `p`. The
transform is a similarity, shapes keeping their kind, unless the insert
has a y factor of its own (docs/adr/0315 §3): then an affine, a circle
becoming the exact ellipse of its image. The insert's own attributes
carry the values of the definition's attribute definitions.

A label moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (an object's
`labelPins`, docs/adr/0212 §3.7).

at.description: Where the label's middle is from the object's anchor, metres; absent, the engine places it.

class.description: The class's name; absent, the object's first label.

rotation.description: Degrees counter-clockwise from east; only with `at`.

LeaderArm.description: A leader's arm after its first (docs/adr/0326 §1).

pts.description: At least one: its tip first, then its bends; it ends at the leader's last vertex.

tip.description: The place on an object its tip follows; absent: a free tip.

LeaderArrow.description:
A leader's arrowhead other than the filled triangle (Dolu üçgen,
AutoCAD's Closed filled), which is no value but the field's absence: a
leader has one spelling (docs/adr/0146 §1). The first three are the
first leaders'; the others AutoCAD's arrowheads (docs/adr/0205 §7, `.kcad`
schema 30).

oneOf.description: Açık ok: the filled triangle's two sides (Open).
Dolu nokta: a filled dot (Dot).
Yok: no arrowhead, the line ends at the tip (None).

A constraint lost its meaning on the way (a segment of no length, a circle of no radius: `singular`).
The solver did not reach a solution in its steps.

commands.title: Nesneleri patlat
commands.summary: Kalıcı kimlikleriyle verilen nesneleri bir düzey parçalar (AutoCAD'in EXPLODE'u); tek geri alma adımı “Patlat”. Çoklu çizgi ve alan kenarlarına (çizgi ve yay; delikler ve parçalar da), daire, yay, elips, eliptik yay, eğri ve NURBS eğrisi köşeleri üstünde olan bir çoklu çizgiye (daire ve tam elips kapalı), ölçü çizgilerine, oklarına ve yazısına, desenli tarama çizgilerine, kılavuz çizgisine, okuna ve notuna, tablo çizgilerine ve yazılarına, bloğun yerleştirmesi tanımın nesnelerine açılır. Parça nesnenin katmanını, rengini ve kalınlığını alır; bloğun nesnesi çizimde varsa kendi katmanını, rengini, kalınlığını, özniteliklerini ve etiketini (yoksa yerleştirmeninkini) alır. İlişkili dizinin (cad.entities.array'in associative'i) bir öğesi bütün diziyi patlatır: her öğe açılır, dizi aynı adımda kalkar. Eğrinin nokta sıklığı density'dir: count (eşit bölüm sayısı), step (bölümün en büyük uzunluğu) ya da deviation (kirişlerin eğriden en büyük uzaklığı); verilmezse daire, yay ve elipste kirişler eğriye 0,01 m'den, eğri ve NURBS'te 0,1 mm'den yakın. Bölümler eğri boyunca eşit uzunluktadır; bir eğri en çok 100 000 köşe olur, ötesi invalid_density. Patlamayan nesne (çizgi, nokta, yazı, dolu tarama …) ve kilitli katmandaki nesne uyarıyla atlanır; hiçbiri patlamazsa not_explodable, hepsi kilitliyse layer_locked. Çıktı ve plan cad.entities.edit'inkidir. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

ExplodeDensity.description:
How dense an exploded curve's vertices are (docs/adr/0308): its pieces equal in length along it, as many as
asked, none longer than a length, or as few as keep every chord within a distance of the curve.

oneOf.description:
This many equal pieces: an open curve `segments + 1` vertices, a closed one (a circle, an ellipse, a closed
curve) `segments`, at least 3.
Equal pieces none longer than `length`, metres.
Equal pieces whose chords lie within `tolerance` of the curve, metres.

input.description:
Input of `cad.entities.explode` v1: the objects `uids` exploded one level, as one undo step “Patlat”. Each object
is replaced by its pieces: a piece keeps the object's layer, look and data, a block's object its own layer when
the drawing has it, colour, line weight, data and label (the insert's when it has none). An object on a locked
layer is left out with a warning (`layer_locked`); one that does not explode (a line, a point, a text, a solid
hatch …) too (`not_explodable`), with the first one's words. A curve becomes a polyline (docs/adr/0308).

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `no_entities`, `invalid_uid`, `invalid_density` (a
count below 1 or above [`MAX_EXPLODE_VERTICES`], a length or a tolerance not above zero or not finite),
`invalid_revision`,
`revision_conflict` (status `conflict`), `entity_not_found`, `layer_locked` (every object locked),
`not_explodable` (none explodes), `slots_exhausted`.

density.description:
How dense an exploded curve's vertices are; absent: a circle's, an arc's and an ellipse's chords within
[`EXPLODE_DEVIATION`], a spline's and a NURBS curve's within 0.1 mm (docs/adr/0308).

expectedRevision.description:
The document revision the input was prepared against, as decimal text. When given and the document is no
longer at it, nothing is written and the answer is `conflict`.

uids.description: The objects' persistent ids (lowercase UUID text with hyphens), at least one.

commands.title: Eğriyi düzenle
commands.summary: Kalıcı kimliğiyle verilen çoklu çizgiyi ya da NURBS eğrisini değişecek olanla düzenler (AutoCAD'in PEDIT'i ve SPLINEDIT'i); tek geri alma adımı “Eğriyi düzenle”, nesne katmanını, görünüşünü ve verisini korur. Çoklu çizgide close (Kapat), open (Aç: kapanış kenarının bükümü ve genişliği gider), decurve (Düzleştir: yaylar düz olur) ve toSpline (Eğriye çevir: köşelerden geçen ya da köşeleri denetim noktası olan NURBS eğrisi, derece yoksa 3). Geçiş noktalı NURBS eğrisinde addFit, moveFit, removeFit ve tangents (uç teğetleri): eğri noktalardan yeniden kurulur, açık eğri teğetlerini korur. Her NURBS eğrisinde moveControl ve weight (kapalı eğride sarılan kopya da; geçiş noktaları gider), removeControl, insertKnot (açık eğride, aralığın içinde, derece kereden az olan yere; eğri değişmez), close ve open, toPolyline (her kiriş eğriye tolerance'tan yakın çoklu çizgi). Retler: not_a_curve (tür ya da düzenleme uymuyor), multi_part, no_fit_points, invalid_index, invalid_knot, invalid_weight, invalid_tolerance, too_few_points, coincident_points, invalid_nurbs. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

CurveEdit.description:
What changes (AutoCAD PEDIT's Close, Open, Decurve, Spline; SPLINEDIT's Close, Open, Fit data, Edit vertex,
Refine, convert to Polyline).

oneOf.description:
Kapat: a polyline's last vertex joins its first (its closing edge's bulge and widths as stored); a NURBS
curve closes smoothly: one with fit points drawn again through them, closed, one by control points with its
first `degree` control points wrapped (periodic). Its end tangents go.

Aç: a closed polyline's closing edge goes; a closed NURBS curve opens: one with fit points drawn again
through them, open, one by control points clamped on its own control points (the wrapped copies dropped).
Düzleştir: every arc edge of a polyline straight.

Eğriye çevir: a polyline becomes a NURBS curve of `degree` (absent: 3; lowered to fit the points): by its
vertices as control points, or with `through` through them (its fit points). Arc edges are taken by their
vertices.
A fit point added before `index` (its count: after the last); the curve drawn again through them.
The fit point `index` moved to `at`; the curve drawn again.
The fit point `index` removed; the curve drawn again.

An open curve's start and end tangent directions through its fit points (absent: free); the curve drawn
again leaving and arriving along them.
The control point `index` moved to `at`. The fit points go (the curve is its control points now).
The control point `index` weighs `weight` (above 0). The fit points go.
The control point `index` removed; the knots made uniform again (an open curve clamped). The fit points go.

A knot inserted at the parameter `at`, inside the curve's domain: one more control point, the curve itself
unchanged (Refine). The fit points go.

Çoklu çizgiye çevir: a NURBS curve becomes a polyline whose every chord stays within `tolerance` of it (its
ends exact), closed when the curve is.

Vec2.description: A point in world units: x = east (Y, sağa), y = north (X, yukarı).

input.description:
Input of `cad.curves.edit` v1: the polyline or NURBS curve `uid` edited by `edit`, as one undo step “Eğriyi
düzenle”. The object keeps its layer, look and data; its kind changes with Eğriye çevir and Çoklu çizgiye
çevir. The answer is `cad.entities.edit`'s.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `invalid_uid`, `not_finite` (a point, weight, knot or
tolerance), `invalid_weight` (not above 0), `invalid_tolerance` (not above 0), `invalid_revision`,
`revision_conflict` (status `conflict`), `entity_not_found`, `layer_locked`, `not_a_curve` (the edit is not
for this kind, or the curve is already so), `multi_part`, `no_fit_points` (a fit edit on a curve without
them), `invalid_index`, `invalid_knot` (outside the domain or a full knot), `coincident_points` and
`invalid_nurbs` (the curve the edit makes), `too_few_points`.

expectedRevision.description:
The document revision the input was prepared against, as decimal text. When given and the document is no
longer at it, nothing is written and the answer is `conflict`.

uid.description: The object's persistent id (lowercase UUID text with hyphens).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

gap.description: The space between two columns, heights.

height.description: A column's height, metres.

TextEntity.description:
Fields every object has. `id` is the object's local id inside a v1 file.
v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

align.description: Where `p` is on the text; absent: the left of the baseline (docs/adr/0145).

annotative.description:
Its scales: drawn at the paper height it was given at every scale it takes part in, hidden
at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

attachments.description:

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

boxWidth.description:
Metres, finite and over 0: the lines wrap word by word to this width.
Absent: they end only at line breaks.

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that

fields.description: Ranges of its letters bound to a source (docs/adr/0325 §1), in order, not overlapping; absent: none.

font.description: Its typeface; absent: the project's, in the look of docs/adr/0055.

labelOf.description:

follows the object as its label at `label_scale`; absent: a text of

labelPins.description:

§3.7), one a class at most.

labelScale.description: The scale's denominator (1:N) the linked label is written at; finite, over 0.

layout.description:

`DEFAULT_TAB` heights, one column.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineSpacing.description:

group 44); absent: 1. From `MIN_LINE_SPACING` to `MAX_LINE_SPACING`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineWeight.description:

mask.description:
The text's box is filled with the drawing area's colour before the

oblique.description:

overrides.description: The fields set apart from its style by hand (docs/adr/0322 §5), by name (`TEXT_OVERRIDES`), as a dimension's.

rotation.description: Degrees, counter-clockwise from east.

runs.description:

UTF-16 units), in order, not overlapping, each with a format; a run
with no format is not written, and touching runs of one format are one.

commands.title: Özellik kopyala
commands.summary: Kalıcı kimliğiyle verilen kaynak nesnenin seçilen özelliklerini öbür nesnelere verir (AutoCAD'in MATCHPROP'u); tek geri alma adımı “Özellik kopyala”. Özellikler (properties; verilmezse hepsi): layer, color, lineType, lineTypeScale, lineWeight (yalnız çizgiyle çizilenler arasında), transparency, symbol; text (yazının yüzü, yüksekliği ve genişlik çarpanı, yazılara), dimension (ölçünün görünüşü, değer yüksekliği ve zemini, ölçülere), hatch (taramanın deseni, taramalara; bölgeleri kalır), leader (kılavuzun oku, ok boyu, not yüksekliği ve zemini, kılavuzlara). Kaynakta olmayan değer (katmanın rengi, sembol yok) hedeftekini kaldırır. Kaynak hedeflerin arasındaysa atlanır, kilitli katmandaki hedef uyarıyla atlanır; katmana taşıma cad.entities.set'in kurallarıyla (kilitli, gizli, alanlar). Retler: invalid_uid, no_entities, no_properties, entity_not_found, layer_locked. Çıktı ve plan cad.entities.edit'inkidir. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

MatchProperty.description: A property Özellik kopyala gives (AutoCAD's MATCHPROP settings).

A text's face (its style, font, bold, italic, slant), height and width factor, to texts.
A dimension's look (its style, arrowheads, sizes, value's writing), value height and background, to dimensions.
A hatch's pattern (its name, scale, angle, lines or gradient), to hatches; their regions stay.
A leader's arrowhead, its size, the note's height and background, to leaders.

input.description:
Input of `cad.entities.match` v1: the `properties` of the object `source` given to the objects `uids`, as one
undo step “Özellik kopyala”. A property the source has none of (its layer's colour, no symbol) clears the
target's own. A line weight goes only between objects drawn with lines; the kind's properties (`text`,
`dimension`, `hatch`, `leader`) only to objects of the source's kind; the rest to every object. The source among
the targets is left out. An object on a locked layer is left out with a warning (`layer_locked`).

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `invalid_uid` (the source, then the targets), `no_entities`,
`no_properties` (an empty list), `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict` (status `conflict`), `entity_not_found`
(the source, then the targets), `no_entities` (the source alone), `layer_locked` (every target locked, then the
source's layer when the layer is given). Warning: `layer_hidden` (objects moved to a hidden layer).

expectedRevision.description:
The document revision the input was prepared against, as decimal text. When given and the document is no
longer at it, nothing is written and the answer is `conflict`.

properties.description: The properties given, each once; absent: every one (`MatchProperty::ALL`).

source.description: The object whose properties are given: its persistent id.

uids.description: The objects that take them: their persistent ids, at least one.

created.description: The new objects' persistent ids, in the order of their `add`s.

removed.description: The objects deleted, in the input's order.

revision.description:
The document's revision after the write, as decimal text. Inside an
open transaction or group the write joins it, and the revision
changes when that ends.

matched ends), `offset` past each end.

commands.summary: Toleransla boş ve yinelenen nesneleri siler, aynı doğrudaki çizgileri birleştirir, yolların gereksiz köşelerini atar (AutoCAD'in OVERKILL'i); tek geri alma adımı “Çizimi temizle”. Kapsam uids ya da verilmezse görünen ve kilitsiz katmanlardaki bütün nesneler. tolerance (metre, 0 ile 10; verilmezse 0,000001) içinde: boş nesne (çizgi, yol ve yay tolerans kadar kısa, daire tolerans kadar küçük, sözsüz yazı) gider; aynı türden, noktaları tolerans içinde, öbür alanları, ignore dışındaki kendi özellikleri ve verisi (öznitelik, etiket, ekler) eşit nesne yinelenendir ve gider, ilki kalır. overlaps (varsayılan açık) aynı doğrudaki üst üste binen çizgileri ilkine katar, endToEnd uç uca olanları da; kotlu ya da ölçülü çizgi katılmaz. straightVertices (varsayılan açık) yolun komşularının arasındaki doğrudaki köşelerini, her zaman yinelenen köşelerini atar; kendi kotu ya da ölçüsü olan, genişliğin değiştiği köşe kalır. Rapor sayıları ve kaybı verir (gidenin kalandan en uzak noktası). Retler: invalid_uid, no_entities, not_finite, invalid_tolerance, entity_not_found, layer_locked. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

CleanupIgnore.description: A property two objects may differ in and still be the same (AutoCAD's OVERKILL “Ignore object property”).

input.description:
Input of `cad.entities.cleanup` v1, one undo step “Çizimi temizle”. Within `tolerance` metres:

- an empty object goes: a line, a path or an arc no longer than it, a circle no wider, a text without words;
- a duplicate goes, the first stays: one of the same kind whose points (a point, a line's ends either way, a path's
  vertices in order, reversed or, closed, from any start, its arcs alike; a circle's centre and radius; an arc's
  centre, radius and ends) lie within it, its other fields equal, its own properties equal but the ones in
  `ignore`, and its data (attributes, label, attachments) equal;
- with `overlaps`, lines of one such group that lie on one line and overlap go into the first (with `endToEnd`
  also lines meeting end to end): it reaches the farthest ends; lines with an elevation or a measure stay;
- a path's vertices that add nothing go: a repeat, and with `straightVertices` one on the straight line between its
  neighbours; a vertex with its own elevation or measure, or where the widths change, stays.

The scope is `uids`, or with none every object on a visible, unlocked layer; a named object on a locked layer is
left out with a warning. Refusals: `invalid_uid`, `invalid_tolerance`, `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict`
(status `conflict`), `entity_not_found`, `layer_locked` (every named object locked).

endToEnd.description: Lines on one line that meet end to end merge too; absent: false.

expectedRevision.description:
The document revision the input was prepared against, as decimal text. When given and the document is no

overlaps.description: Lines on one line that overlap merge; absent: true.

straightVertices.description: A path's vertices on the straight line between their neighbours go; absent: true.

tolerance.description: How far points may lie apart and be one, metres, 0 to 10; absent: `CLEANUP_TOLERANCE`.

uids.description: The objects looked at: their persistent ids. Absent: every object on a visible, unlocked layer.

loss.description: The farthest a point that went lies from what stays, metres: what the tolerance cost.

as at 1:1 times `scale` at every drawing scale, turned `angle` degrees along the wall's path, in its own colour.

scale.description: Times the pattern's paper size, above 0.

ConstructionEntity.description: Construction line or ray: base point and unit direction.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

DatasetDim.description:
One of a dataset's slice dimensions (docs/adr/0243 §6): its name, the
index shown, its values (coordinates; moments in milliseconds since 1970
when `time`) and units.

time.description: The values are a CF time axis's moments.

DimensionArrow.description:
A dimension's arrowheads other than the oblique tick, which is no value but
the field's absence (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: A filled triangle, its tip on the dimension line's end (Dolu ok).
The triangle's two sides (Açık ok).
A filled circle about the end (Nokta).
Nothing at the ends (Yok).

DimensionBreak.description:
A gap in one of a dimension's lines where another object crosses it (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK), at the fraction `t` of
the line; its width the options' `breakSize`.

DimensionEntity.description:
Fields every object has. `id` is the object's local id inside a v1 file.
v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

angle.description: Linear: measured direction in degrees (0 = ΔY, 90 = ΔX).

annotative.description:
Its scales: drawn at the paper height it was given at every scale it takes part in, hidden
at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

arrowSize.description:
The arrowhead's (or tick's) length; absent: `DEFAULT_TICK` for ticks,
`DEFAULT_ARROW` for the others.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

breaks.description: The gaps in its lines where other objects cross them (docs/adr/0321 §1).

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

c.description:
Angular: the vertex. Arc length: the arc's centre. Jogged: the centre
the line starts from (docs/adr/0147).

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

decimals.description:
A length's, a coordinate's or a slope's decimals; absent: the
project's length decimals (a slope's 2). Angles keep the project's.

dimLineColor.description:
The dimension line's and its arrowheads' colour, `#RRGGBB`; absent:
the object's (docs/adr/0205 §6).

dimLineType.description: The dimension line's type; absent: continuous.

dimLineWeight.description: The dimension line's weight, paper mm as an object's; absent: a hairline.

dimStyle.description: The project's dimension style it follows, by its id; absent: Standart.

extBeyond.description: How far the extension lines pass the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_BEYOND`.

extColor.description: The extension lines' colour; absent: the object's.

extLineType.description: The extension lines' type; absent: continuous.

extOffset.description: The extension lines' gap from the measured points; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_OFFSET`.

extWeight.description: The extension lines' weight, paper mm; absent: a hairline.

font.description: The value's typeface; absent: the project's.

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

mask.description:
The value is drawn over the drawing's background (docs/adr/0147, as a
text's mask, docs/adr/0145).

options.description: Where the value goes when it does not fit and how it is written (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

overrides.description:
The fields set apart from its style by hand (docs/adr/0322 §5), by name (`DIMENSION_OVERRIDES`): they keep
their value when the style changes. Empty: each field follows while it holds the style's old value.

prefix.description: Written before the value (and its kind's own prefix).

refs.description: The objects its points follow (docs/adr/0249): an associative dimension; none, free points.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

textColor.description: The value's colour; absent: the object's.

textGap.description: The value's baseline over the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_TEXT_GAP`.

textPlace.description: Where the value stands; absent: over the line.

textShift.description: Its value moved from its place (docs/adr/0321 §1).

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

unit.description: The unit lengths and coordinates are written in; absent: the project's.

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

za.description: Slope: the two points' elevations, metres (docs/adr/0147).

DimensionFit.description:
Where the value goes when it does not fit between the extension lines (AutoCAD's DIMATFIT and DIMTIX): absent,
always between them.

oneOf.description: Beyond the second extension line when the value and the two arrowheads are longer than the line between them.
Always beyond the second extension line, the arrowheads outside.

DimensionOptions.description: A dimension's options (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2): all absent, the dimension as it always was.

breakSize.description: A break's width, times the value's height, over 0; absent: 1 (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK size).

lengthStyle.description:
Feet and inches in an inch or foot unit (AutoCAD's DIMLUNIT, docs/adr/0262 §2); absent: the project's, unless
the dimension names its own unit.

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

DrawingFont.description:
The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

EllipseEntity.description: DXF ELLIPSE: centre, major axis vector, minor/major ratio, parameters t0 → t1.

Entity.description: Any drawing object, tagged by `kind` as in the TypeScript model.

oneOf.description: A general NURBS curve: degree, control points, weights and knots (docs/adr/0259).
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144).
An arrow with a note (docs/adr/0146).
Rows and columns of cells (docs/adr/0184).
A picture (docs/adr/0192).
An orthophoto, a scanned sheet or an elevation model (docs/adr/0204).
A point cloud: LAS, LAZ, COPC or text files (docs/adr/0207).
A wall (docs/adr/0339): its path, width, justification and components; its faces drawn from them.

A door, a window or a bare opening in a wall (docs/adr/0341): its wall's id, its place along it and its
jambs' points.
A grid (docs/adr/0343): its line, label and bubbles.
A column (docs/adr/0343): its centre, outline and the grids it stands on.
A stair (docs/adr/0343): its walking line and its risers, treads and landings.
A ramp (docs/adr/0343): its centre line, width, rise and landings.
A tag (docs/adr/0344): its object, its words and frame.
A view mark (docs/adr/0345): a section, elevation or detail mark pointing at a view.

A record without a geometry (docs/adr/0410): a table's row, with the base's attributes,
attachments and label; not drawn, picked or snapped to.

FieldBroken.description: Why a field's value cannot be read.

oneOf.description: The object is gone.
The object has no such value (an open object's area, a line's text).
The attribute or the variable named is not there.
Texts whose fields read each other in a ring.

FieldFormat.description: How a field writes a number.

comma.description: A decimal comma (`24,35`) instead of a point.

decimals.description: Absent: the project's length or area decimals.

unit.description: Absent: the drawing unit for a length or a place, the project's area unit for an area.

FieldSource.description: Where a field's value comes from.

oneOf.description: An object, by its persistent id.

name.description: The attribute's name, with `attribute`.

oneOf.description: The project.

name.description: The variable's name, with `variable`; the block's, with `blockCount`.

FieldUnit.description: The unit a field writes a number in.

GeorefMethod.description: A transform from the source's pixels to the drawing (docs/adr/0204 §6).

GeorefOutput.description: A resampled raster's grid: north-up, its corner on a multiple of its pixel (docs/adr/0204 §6).

digest.description: The written file's SHA-256 when it was written.

GeorefPoint.description:
A control or check point: a pixel of the source (column, row; pixel corners, 0, 0 the upper left corner of the
upper left pixel, as GDAL's GCPs) and where it is (`target`, in the record's `srid`).

check.description: A check point: kept out of the fit; its error says how good the fit is where no control point is.

name.description: What the user calls it (a mark on the sheet, a survey point's name).

off.description: Left out (Kullan off): neither fits nor checks; its residual is still shown.

target.description: Its east and north (a geographic system's longitude and latitude, degrees).

GeorefSource.description: The raster the points' pixels are of: what it read and its size.

asset.description: The project library's raster it was (embedded).

digest.description: Its bytes' SHA-256 (64 lowercase hex digits) when they were read: the revision the points belong to.

file.description: The file it was (linked), as kept.

url.description: The address it was read from.

GradientShape.description: How a gradient runs over its hatch (docs/adr/0186 §3).

oneOf.description: From one side of the hatch to the other along `angle`.
The second colour along the middle, the first at both sides.
The second colour in the middle, the first at the farthest corner.

GridBubbles.description: Which ends of a grid carry a bubble.

HatchAssoc.description:
The objects a hatch follows (docs/adr/0186 §6, 0328 §3): a hatch made inside a closed object follows the
object (`outer`), its islands, the texts and inserts left open; a hatch made in the face line work closes
(`bounds`: the objects whose line work bounds it, its islands' too) follows that line work; the point clicked
inside picks the region's part or face. Exactly one of `outer` and `bounds` is given.

bounds.description: The objects whose line work closes its face (docs/adr/0328 §3).

gap.description: A face's tie: the gaps its line work was closed across, metres (docs/adr/0329 §3); absent: none.

HatchCurve.description: A boundary edge that is no line or circular arc (docs/adr/0328 §1).

oneOf.description:
An ellipse's arc: centre `c`, major semi-axis `major` (from `c`), minor to major `ratio`, from parameter `t0`
to `t1` (radians): counter-clockwise when `t1` is past `t0`, clockwise when before it; a whole ellipse
`t1 = t0 ± 2π`.
A NURBS curve run whole, from its first knot to its last.

annotative.description:
Its scales (docs/adr/0331 §3): an annotative hatch's pattern is drawn at each scale it takes part in as large

assoc.description: The objects its region follows (docs/adr/0186 §6); none: it stays as drawn.

the ring and holes are all it has.

HatchLoop.description:
One closed loop of a hatch's boundary as its source holds it (docs/adr/0328 §1): edge `i` runs from `pts[i]` to
the next point (the last to the first); it is straight, a circular arc of `bulges[i]` (tan(θ/4), counter-clockwise
positive, as a polygon's), or the curve `curves[i]` (an ellipse's arc or a NURBS curve), whose ends are those
points. A loop of one point is one closed curve.

angle.description:
Degrees, counter-clockwise from east: the lines' (lines, cross), the
pattern's turn (pattern), the gradient's direction (gradient).

gradient.description: A gradient's shape and second colour.

name.description: A pattern's name (`ANSI31`).

origin.description:
Where its lines are anchored in the world (docs/adr/0331 §2; AutoCAD's HPORIGIN): every family goes through
it as the definition says instead of through the world's origin. Absent: the world's origin.

spacing.description: Metres between the lines (lines, cross); 1 and unread for the others.

inverted.description: The content outside the boundary is drawn, the inside left out.

InsertEntity.description:
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144): its definition drawn
moved from the definition's base point to `p`, mirrored in the
definition's x axis when `mirror`, then scaled and turned about `p`. The
transform is a similarity, shapes keeping their kind, unless the insert
has a y factor of its own (docs/adr/0315 §3): then an affine, a circle
becoming the exact ellipse of its image. The insert's own attributes
carry the values of the definition's attribute definitions.

runs.description:
The letters' formats: ranges of the text's Unicode scalar values (not
UTF-16 units), in order, not overlapping, each with a format; a run
with no format is not written, and touching runs of one format are one.
Absent: none.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

textStyle.description: The project's text style it follows, by its id; absent: Standart.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

widthFactor.description:
The letters' width times this, the height kept (Netcad's “sıkışma”,
DXF's group 41); absent: 1. Finite, over 0, at most `MAX_WIDTH_FACTOR`.

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

TextField.description: A range of a text's letters bound to a source (docs/adr/0325 §1).

broken.description: Why its value cannot be read; its letters are then `####`. Absent: it reads.

format.description: How a number is written; absent: the project's decimals and unit.

start.description:
Its first letter and the one past its last, counting Unicode scalar values (as a run's); its letters are the
value last written.

TextPath.description:
The curve a text's letters stand on (docs/adr/0196 §1). Its vertices are
in the text's own frame: `p` its start, x along the text's `rotation`, y
square to it on the left, metres. The first vertex is `p` itself and is
not written; `pts` are the ones after it. The frame carries the curve with
the text when it moves, turns or scales.

bulges.description:
Edge i's bulge, from vertex i to vertex i + 1 (vertex 0 is `p`):
DXF's tan(θ/4), counter-clockwise positive; as many as `pts`. Absent:
every edge straight.

pts.description: The vertices after `p`, at least one.

TextRun.description: A range of a text's letters and their format (docs/adr/0182 §1).

color.description: Its own colour, as an object's (`#E5484D`, or a theme name); absent: the text's.

script.description: Raised or lowered, at 0.6 of the height; absent: on the line.

start.description: Its first letter and the one past its last, counting Unicode scalar values.

TextScript.description: A run raised over the line (superscript) or lowered under it (subscript).

oneOf.description:
A stacked fraction (docs/adr/0324 §1): the run's letters before its first `/`, `#` or `^` raised over
those after it; `/` a horizontal bar, `#` a slanted one beside them, `^` none (a tolerance).

TextShift.description:
The value moved from its place (AutoCAD's text moved, DIMTMOVE 2): metres along the value's own direction and
across it (left positive).

oneOf.description: ` ±upper`.
` +upper -lower`.
The largest and the smallest value instead of the number: `max/min`.

angle.description: An elevation's looking direction, degrees from east, counter-clockwise; absent: 90 (north).

WallComponent.description: One layer of a wall's body, from its left face towards its right (`CAD-ARCH-04`): plaster, brick, insulation.

detail.description: The least detail it is drawn at as its own (its lines and hatch); below, it is part of the body.

edge.description: The lines along its sides; absent: the wall's.

`Standard` the components shown at construction scales, `Detailed` every component.

WallEntity.description:
A wall (`CAD-ARCH-01`, `02`): its path, the base line it was drawn along, with arcs as a polyline's bulges (one per
vertex, as the document keeps a polyline's: an open wall's last is 0); its width; where its body lies across the
justification line (the path moved `offset` to its left); the components it is built of, from its left face; its
ends; its height above its level; its architectural information. Its faces, ends, component lines and hatches are
drawn from these (`geom::wall` of the shared core), at the detail the drawing's scale asks.

Kopya (Clip) nesneleri çizimdeki sıralarıyla, kaynaktaki kimliklerini, bulundukları katmanları gruplarıyla ve görünüşleriyle, yerleştirdikleri blokları (iç içe olanlar da), adını andıkları yazı ve ölçü stillerini, çizdikleri kitaplık öğelerini, kaynağın birimini ve taban noktasını taşır. Links between the copied objects stay in the copy; links to others drop.

`entity_not_found`.

Inside only: level, then along the long side, then fitted (Maplex's land parcels).

A part of a multi-part area past its first (docs/adr/0143): its outer
ring in vertex + bulge form, its holes and its vertices' elevations, as
the area's own fields hold the first part's. A multi-part polyline's
part is the same, open and without holes (docs/adr/0174).

(docs/adr/0224 §1); an area's part has none.

`asset`, `file` and `url`) and an optional note.

file.description:

note.description: A note shown with it (lines allowed).

attribute `tag`, else `value`, written at `p` in the definition's
coordinates, moved with the insert.

align.description: Where `p` is on the text, as a text's (docs/adr/0145).

boxWidth.description: A multiline attribute's box width, metres in the definition's size.

constant.description: Its value is the definition's `value` in every insert; an insert holds none of its own (bit 2).

field.description:
A field (docs/adr/0317 §1): a template whose `{ifade}` parts are filled for each insert (its attributes, its
place, the project's `@` values); the commands that place, sync and update fields write it as the value.

height.description: Metres, in the definition's size.

invisible.description: Not drawn: its value is kept, listed and scheduled (DXF 70 bit 1).

movable.description: An insert may move its text (`attributePlaces`); off: locked where the definition puts it (bit 16 set).

multiline.description: Its value may hold line breaks, each a line; wrapped to `boxWidth` when given (an MTEXT attribute).

preset.description: Blok ekle takes its default without asking (bit 8).

prompt.description: What Blok ekle asks for it.

rotation.description: Degrees, counter-clockwise from east, as a text's.

value.description: The default value.

verify.description: Blok ekle asks for it twice, the two the same (bit 4).

separable blending modes, and addition).

oneOf.description:
The objects move by the parameter's change (a linear's along its line, a polar's and a point's by the moved
point).
The objects' points inside the box move by the parameter's change; the rest stay.
The objects scale about the parameter's `from` by its value over its default.

Copies of the objects every `spacing` along a linear parameter's line: one for each further `spacing` its
value holds past its default (the definition shows what the default holds).
The objects turn about an angle parameter's centre by its change.
The objects mirror about a flip parameter's line while it is on.

tags.description: Words it is found by, each once, Turkish case folded.

version.description:
How many times its definition has changed since it was made: 1 when made; each change of its objects, base,
attributes or unit adds one.

BlockDefinition.description:
A block definition (docs/adr/0144): objects drawn once, placed many
times. Its objects' ids are local to it, once each and kept by every edit
of it, so a reference to a piece follows it (docs/adr/0315 §1). An object
on the block's layer (`""`, the DXF's layer 0) is drawn on its insert's
layer; one on a layer of its own shows only while that layer does
(docs/adr/0315 §2). A part of its look it has is its own, a `byLayer` part
its layer's (its insert's layer on the block's layer), any other part its
insert's (BYBLOCK).

attributes.description: The texts an insert shows from its attributes (ATTDEF).

base.description: The point placed at an insert's `p`, in the definition's coordinates.

card.description: Its library card (docs/adr/0317 §4): category, tags and version.

dynamic.description: Its parameters and actions (docs/adr/0318): one definition at many sizes and looks.

units.description:
The unit it was drawn in (docs/adr/0315 §4): a unit, its geometry being metres as the drawing's (an insert
keeps its size anywhere); `unitless`, its numbers being drawing units (an insert is scaled by the drawing's
unit). Absent: a real-size block of an unknown unit.

xref.description: An external reference's source (docs/adr/0348 §1): its objects are that drawing's as last loaded.

`to` moved anywhere: its value a point, its rule on the distance from `from`.

matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

file.description: The file it shows (linked): absolute, or relative to the drawing's folder.

height.description: Along its left edge, metres, over 0.

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

mirror.description: The picture mirrored in its own x axis (Aynala), before the turn.

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

rotation.description: Radians, counter-clockwise from east, about `p`.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

width.description: Along its bottom edge, metres, over 0.

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

InfoCard.description: What the Bilgi tool shows of a layer's objects (docs/adr/0225 §5).

actions.description: Whether the layer's actions show (absent: they do).

attachments.description: Whether the object's attachments show (absent: they do).

fields.description: The attributes shown, in order; empty: all the object has.

text.description: Lines under the attributes, a template.

title.description: The card's title, a template; absent: the object's kind and label.

boundary.description:
Its corners in the definition's coordinates (relative to nothing: the definition's own), at least three, the
ring closing by itself; no edge crosses another.

inverted.description: The content outside the boundary is drawn, the inside left out.

InsertEntity.description:
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144): its definition drawn
moved from the definition's base point to `p`, mirrored in the
definition's x axis when `mirror`, then scaled and turned about `p`. The
transform is a similarity, shapes keeping their kind, unless the insert
has a y factor of its own (docs/adr/0315 §3): then an affine, a circle
becoming the exact ellipse of its image. The insert's own attributes
carry the values of the definition's attribute definitions.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attributePlaces.description:
Where this insert shows a movable attribute (docs/adr/0317 §1): its tag's text at this point of the
definition's coordinates rather than the definition's. Only a movable attribute's tag; absent: every text where
the definition puts it.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

clipping.description:
Its clipping boundary (docs/adr/0351 §1): only the part of its content inside (or outside) the boundary is
drawn, picked and snapped to.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

linePattern.description:
