`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

mirror.description: Mirrored in the definition's x axis, before the turn.

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

p.description: Where the definition's base point goes.

parameters.description:
Its dynamic block's parameter values that differ from their defaults (docs/adr/0318 §3), by parameter name;
a lookup's is not kept (its row's values are).

rotation.description: Radians, counter-clockwise from east.

scale.description: Positive and finite; 1 is the definition's size. With `yScale`, the factor along the definition's x axis.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

yScale.description:
The factor along the definition's y axis when it is not `scale` (docs/adr/0315 §3), positive and finite;
absent: `scale`. A negative factor of a DXF is a mirror and a turn here.

always.description: Always; absent, only when the label does not fit.

LabelAlign.description: How a label's lines line up.

fill.description: Hex or a theme name (`paper`: the drawing area's colour, a mask); absent, not filled.

padding.description: CSS px round the letters; absent, 2.

LabelCallout.description: The line from a label placed away from its object to the object.

color.description: Absent, the label's.

minLength.description: A shorter one is not drawn, CSS px; absent, 6.

LabelClass.description:
One class of a rule-based labelling: its name, the condition its objects
meet and its labels' style.

name.description: One of its kind on the layer; a pin names it.

when.description: İfadeyle seç's language; absent, every object.

LabelHalo.description: The halo round a label's letters.

color.description: Hex or a theme name; absent, the drawing area's colour.

LabelObstacle.description: A layer's objects as obstacles to every label.

kind.description: An area's inside (absent) or its outline.

weight.description: 1 to 10: a label of a lower priority cannot cover them; another may, at a cost.

LabelOverlap.description: Whether a label may cover another (QGIS's three).

oneOf.description: Never: a label with no free place is not drawn.
When no free place is left, at its best one.
Always at its best place.

LabelPin.description:
A label moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (an object's
`labelPins`, docs/adr/0212 §3.7).

at.description: Where the label's middle is from the object's anchor, metres; absent, the engine places it.

class.description: The class's name; absent, the object's first label.

rotation.description: Degrees counter-clockwise from east; only with `at`.

LabelPosition.description:
A line label's side of its line; on an area's outline `above` is inside
and `below` outside.

oneOf.description: Above, else below.

LabelShadow.description: A label's shadow: the label again under it, moved.

color.description: Absent, black.

oneOf.description: A rectangle with round corners.

at.description: The letters a line may end at; absent, the space.

chars.description: The most letters a line holds (a longer word stays whole).

LabelStyle.description: How entity labels on a layer are drawn; sizes in CSS px.

align.description: How a label's lines line up; absent, centred.

area.description: Where an area's label goes; absent, by `placement`.

callout.description: The line to the object from a label placed away from it.

color.description: The letters' colour (hex or a theme name): instead of `ink`.

curved.description: An outline's label (perimeter, boundary) letter by letter.

distance.description: CSS px between a label and its object; absent, 2.

duplicates.description: CSS px within which the same text is labelled once.

halo.description: The halo round the letters; absent, 1.5 px of the drawing area's colour.

inside.description: An area's label only where it fits inside.

line.description: Where a line's label goes; absent, by `placement`.

maxAngle.description: Degrees two neighbouring letters of a curved label may turn; absent, 25.

mergeLines.description: Lines meeting end to end with the same text labelled once.

outside.description: An area's label that fits nowhere inside, outside with a callout.

overlap.description: Whether it may cover another label; absent, never.

point.description: Where a point's label goes; absent, by `placement`.

position.description: A line label's side of its line (on an outline, `above` inside).

priority.description: 0 to 10; absent, 5: higher first.

repeat.description: CSS px between a line's repeated labels.

shrink.description: The smallest size a label is made when it does not fit, a factor 0.5–1.

text.description: The text as an expression (İfadeyle seç's language, docs/adr/0212 §2): instead of the template.

LabelWord.description: One word of an abbreviation dictionary.

oneOf.description: One label: the style's `label`, else its kind's default.
The classes, in order: each whose condition holds labels an object.
None (its objects may still be obstacles).

LayerAction.description:
An action of a layer's objects (docs/adr/0225 §4): its name and the
address or file it opens, a template.

name.description: The name in the menus and on the card.

target.description: An `http`, `https` or `mailto` address or a file's path, a template.

LayerCompose.description:
How a layer is composed into the drawing (Katman çizimi, docs/adr/0226 §3,
§4); absent, as it always was: opaque, normal, no mask.

LayerField.description: A field of a layer (docs/adr/0199 §1): its name is the attribute's key.

alias.description: The name the table and the form show.

default.description: The value a new object takes, in its canonical text.

domain.description:
The project's value list it links (docs/adr/0430): its `values` (or `min` and `max`) are that
list's copy, written anew whenever the list changes. None: its own.

id.description:
The field's stable id (docs/adr/0401 §2): what a form binds to. None: its name is its id; a
rename writes the old name here so a binding holds. Unique among the layer's fields' keys.

max.description: A number's greatest value, in its canonical text; included.

maxExclusive.description: `max` is not itself in the range; only with `max`; written only as `true`.

merge.description:
What the field's value becomes when objects are merged into one (Alan birleştir, Birleştir,
Parçaları birleştir; docs/adr/0419). None: the first object's.

min.description: A number's least value, in its canonical text; included.

minExclusive.description: `min` is not itself in the range (docs/adr/0438 §4); only with `min`; written only as `true`.

multiple.description:
A text field holds several values (docs/adr/0408 §1, 0409 §1): a listed one its codes in the
list's order, an unlisted one its values in their order (objects' persistent ids for a
many-to-many reference), joined with `; `; written only as `true`.

required.description: An object may not leave it empty; written only as `true`.

scale.description: A decimal's most fraction digits (0–15).

split.description:
What the field's value becomes in the pieces when its object is split (Alan böl, Parçala,
Kır, Parçalara ayır; docs/adr/0419). None: each piece keeps it.

unique.description:
No two objects of the layer hold the same value (empty ones aside; docs/adr/0438 §3): every
write is refused `not_unique` that would; written only as `true`.

unit.description:
The unit a number is in, shown after it (`m²`, `kg`; 1–16 characters; docs/adr/0438 §4); the value
stays the number.

values.description: The values a text or a number takes, when only some.

oneOf.description: A date and a time of day, local (docs/adr/0412 §1): `YYYY-AA-GGTSS:DD:SS`.
A time of day (docs/adr/0412 §1): `SS:DD:SS`.

LayerFilter.description:
A layer's filter (docs/adr/0211 §2): an object passes when the condition
holds for it and, when there is a list, the list names it.

expression.description:
The condition (İfadeyle seç's language, docs/adr/0100): an object
passes when it is true.

objects.description:
Only these objects, by their persistent ids (Seçimden süzgeç); an id
the drawing does not hold is not wrong.

LayerGeometry.description:
What a layer holds (docs/adr/0622 §5): GIS's layer type, a layer of points, lines, areas or annotation; absent,
any kind (Karışık, a CAD layer). A typed layer takes only the objects of its kind: a write that would put another
kind on it is refused (`layer_geometry_mismatch`) and the tools that draw another kind are off while it is active.

LayerLabels.description: How a layer is labelled (`LayerStyle.labels`, docs/adr/0212 §2).

classes.description: The rules' classes, in order; only with `rules`.

LayerMask.description: The mask a layer's labels and markers cut into other layers (docs/adr/0226 §3).

labels.description: Its placed labels' boxes.

size.description: How far the shapes grow, paper mm (0–10); their corners round as far.

targets.description: The layers it cuts into, by their ids.

LayerNode.description: A node of the layer tree: a group or a layer.

actions.description:
The addresses and files its objects open (docs/adr/0225 §4). Only a
layer holding objects has them, never a group or a layer drawn from a
service.

card.description:
What the Bilgi tool shows of its objects (docs/adr/0225 §5); absent:
the default card. Only on a layer holding objects.

contingents.description:
Değer bileşimleri (docs/adr/0423): the groups of fields whose values go together. Only a
layer holding objects has them.

feed.description:
Where the layer's objects were taken from, to take them again
(docs/adr/0208 §10). Only a layer has it, never a group.

fields.description:
A layer's fields (docs/adr/0199 §1): the schema of its objects'
attributes, in the order the table and the form show them; empty, no
schema (and nothing written). Only a layer has them, never a group.

filter.description:
The layer's filter (docs/adr/0211 §2): only the objects that pass it
are shown, picked and given to its tools. Only a layer has it, never a
group or a layer drawn from a service.

frozen.description:
Dondur (AutoCAD's freeze, DXF's 70 bit 1; docs/adr/0311 §1): absent,
thawed; `true`, frozen: neither drawn, picked, snapped to nor counted
in the drawing's extent, and Hepsini göster leaves it frozen; the
active layer is never frozen. A group's covers what it holds. Only
`true` is written.

geometry.description:
What the layer holds (docs/adr/0622 §5): points, lines, areas or annotation; absent, any kind. Only a layer
has it, never a group.

replaces.description: A scenario's layer: the base layer it stands for (docs/adr/0210 §9).

rules.description:
Kayıt kuralları (docs/adr/0438 §1): the constraints every write of the layer's records keeps.
Only a layer holding objects has them.

scenario.description: A group made a scenario (docs/adr/0210 §9). Only a group has it.

service.description:
A layer drawn from a map service (docs/adr/0208 §2): it holds no
objects. Only a layer has it, never a group.

snap.description:
A layer's own snapping (docs/adr/0163 §4): off, or only some kinds;
absent, the general kinds. Only a layer has it, never a group.

sourceCrs.description: The system its objects came from (docs/adr/0583 §1); absent: not known. Only a layer has it, never a group.

subtypes.description:
Alt türler (docs/adr/0422): the field that sorts the records and what each kind narrows.
Only a layer holding objects has them.

tableStyles.description:
Koşullu biçim (docs/adr/0413 §1): how the attribute table paints its rows and cells by
conditions; empty, plainly. Only a layer holding objects has them.

time.description:
A temporal layer's time setting (docs/adr/0210 §2): which attributes
hold its objects' start and end. Only a layer has it, never a group.

LayerRule.description: A record rule of a layer.

fields.description:
The fields' keys a form shows it on and a refusal points at, in order; none: the first field it
reads.

id.description: Its id, once in the layer: what a form or a refusal names it by (1–64 characters).

message.description: What a write breaking it is told (1–500 characters).

name.description: Its name as the interface shows it (1–64 characters).

rule.description:
The expression that must hold (the record's fields by name, `$alan` and the project's `@`
values).

warning.description: A soft rule: broken, it warns and the write goes in; written only as `true`.

LayerSnap.description:
A layer's own snapping (docs/adr/0163 §4): `{ "off": true }`, no
snapping to its objects; or `{ "kinds": [...] }`, only these kinds (as
far as the general kinds take them). Exactly one of the two, and a list
that is not empty: the readers refuse anything else ([`LayerSnap::problem`]).

off.description: No snapping to the layer's objects; written only as `true`.

LayerSourceCrs.description: The system a layer's objects came from.

area.description: Where the system is meant for, in the registry's words.

axisOrder.description: `en`, `ne` or `latlon`: EPSG's order of its axes (the drawing's are always east, north).

srid.description: Its EPSG code, when the registry knows it.

unit.description: `metre` or `degree`.

LayerStyle.description: A layer's look. `renderer` (the style engine, docs/STYLE.md) is opaque JSON in v1.

color.description: Hex colour or a theme token (fg, fg-dim, ink, paper).

labels.description:
How the layer is labelled (docs/adr/0212 §2): rule-based classes,
none, its objects as obstacles; absent, by `label` (one label).

linePattern.description: A project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1; `pattern` is a hatch's); absent: `line_type`.

lineType.description: Its built-in line type; with a `pattern`, the one nearest to it (what a reader without patterns draws).

lineWeight.description: Plot line weight in mm.

LayerSubtypes.description: A layer's subtypes: the field that sorts the records (its key) and the subtypes, in their order.

field.description: The subtype field's key (its id, else its name): a field with a value list, one value each.

LayerTime.description:
A layer's time setting (docs/adr/0210 §2): its objects' start (or
moment) and end are the values of these attributes.

cumulative.description: Birikimli: an object shows from its start on, whatever its end; written only as `true`.

end.description: The attribute holding the end; absent, the objects are moments.

key.description: The attribute naming an object across its versions (Zamanı karşılaştır's key).

recordedEnd.description: The attribute holding when the version was superseded (its system time's end); empty: still current.

recordedStart.description:
The attribute holding when the object's version was recorded (its system time's start, docs/adr/0537):
what was known on a day is the versions recorded by then and not yet superseded. `.kcad` schema 90.

start.description: The attribute holding the start (an instant layer's moment).

LeaderArm.description: A leader's arm after its first (docs/adr/0326 §1).

pts.description: At least one: its tip first, then its bends; it ends at the leader's last vertex.

tip.description: The place on an object its tip follows; absent: a free tip.

LeaderArrow.description:
A leader's arrowhead other than the filled triangle (Dolu üçgen,
AutoCAD's Closed filled), which is no value but the field's absence: a
leader has one spelling (docs/adr/0146 §1). The first three are the
first leaders'; the others AutoCAD's arrowheads (docs/adr/0205 §7, `.kcad`
schema 30).

oneOf.description: Açık ok: the filled triangle's two sides (Open).
Dolu nokta: a filled dot (Dot).
Yok: no arrowhead, the line ends at the tip (None).
Boş üçgen: the triangle's outline (Closed blank).
İnce açık ok: two sides 15° off the line (Open 30).
Dik açık ok: two sides square to each other (Open 90, Right angle).
Küçük nokta (Dot small).
Boş nokta: a ring (Dot blank).
Eğik çizgi: a tick across the tip (Oblique).
Mimari çentik: a heavy tick (Architectural tick).
Dolu kare (Box filled).
Boş kare (Box blank).
Dayanak üçgeni: a filled triangle standing on the tip (Datum triangle filled).

LeaderEntity.description:
A leader (docs/adr/0146): an arrowhead at its first vertex, a line
through its vertices and, with a note, a landing from its last vertex
along the note's direction and the note past the landing's end; one
object. The arrowhead and the landing are measured by the note's height.

annotative.description:
Its scales: drawn at the paper height it was given at every scale it takes part in, hidden
at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

arms.description:
Its other arms (docs/adr/0326 §1): each from its own tip through its bends to the leader's last vertex, where
the landing starts; the arrowhead, the note and the look the first arm's.

arrow.description: The arrowhead; absent: a filled arrow.

arrowSize.description:
The arrowhead's length, times the note's height (docs/adr/0205 §7);
absent: 1. From `MIN_LEADER_ARROW` to `MAX_LEADER_ARROW`.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

blocks.description:
Its content blocks (docs/adr/0326 §2): inserts standing in a row at its landing's end, by persistent id; a
leader with blocks has no note.

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

height.description:
The note's height, metres, finite and over 0; the arrowhead and the
landing are measured by it.

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

leaderStyle.description: The leader style it follows (docs/adr/0326 §4), by its id.

Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

mask.description:
The note's box is filled with the drawing area's colour before the
note is drawn, as a text's mask (docs/adr/0145).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

pts.description: At least two: the arrow's tip first, where the landing starts last.

rotation.description: The note's and the landing's direction, degrees counter-clockwise from east.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

text.description:
The note, one line; absent: the arrow alone, no landing and no note.
Never empty: no note is the field's absence.

tip.description: The place on an object its first arm's tip follows (docs/adr/0326 §3); absent: a free tip.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

How lengths are written (docs/adr/0262 §2); none (no setting) is decimal
in the drawing's unit. The three are an inch or foot drawing's.

oneOf.description: Decimal in the drawing's unit: no setting, here for a command to say so.

Fields every object has. `id` is the object's local id inside a v1 file.
v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in

ma.description:

none (docs/adr/0224 §1).

za.description: The start's elevation, m; absent = none (docs/adr/0142).

zb.description: The end's elevation, m; absent = none.

oneOf.description: Straight, along the line.

Level, on the line.

LookPart.description: A part of an object's look whose source can be its layer.

NurbsEntity.description:
Fields every object has. `id` is the object's local id inside a v1 file.
v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

top.description: The top half: the mark's number.

ViewTarget.description: What a mark points at: a named view (`view`, its id), or a map frame on a sheet (`sheet` and `item`, their ids).

VisibilityState.description: One of a visibility parameter's states: its name and the objects (local ids) it hides.

WallCaps.description: Whether an open wall's ends are closed by a line across it.

WallComponent.description: One layer of a wall's body, from its left face towards its right (`CAD-ARCH-04`): plaster, brick, insulation.

detail.description: The least detail it is drawn at as its own (its lines and hatch); below, it is part of the body.

edge.description: The lines along its sides; absent: the wall's.

priority.description:
Its strength where walls meet (docs/adr/0340 §1), 1 to 9, the smaller the stronger: a joining wall's component
passes the host's weaker ones and stops at the first as strong. Absent: 3 (between a core's 1 and a finish's 5).

thickness.description: Its thickness, metres; absent: what the wall's width leaves of the others (one component at most).

WallDetail.description:
How much of a wall is drawn (`CAD-ARCH-12`), the least first: `Schematic` its outline and its style's fill,
`Standard` the components shown at construction scales, `Detailed` every component.

WallEntity.description:
A wall (`CAD-ARCH-01`, `02`): its path, the base line it was drawn along, with arcs as a polyline's bulges (one per
vertex, as the document keeps a polyline's: an open wall's last is 0); its width; where its body lies across the
justification line (the path moved `offset` to its left); the components it is built of, from its left face; its
ends; its height above its level; its architectural information. Its faces, ends, component lines and hatches are
drawn from these (`geom::wall` of the shared core), at the detail the drawing's scale asks.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

cleanup.description:
Its components are cleaned up by their priorities where another wall tees into or crosses it; false: the
walls meet at their faces only.

closed.description: Its path's last vertex joins its first: a ring of wall.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

components.description: Its body's layers from its left face; none: one plain body.

fill.description: The body's solid fill when drawn schematically (`#RRGGBB`); absent: none.

height.description: Its height above its level's floor, metres; absent: the level's height.

joins.description: How its ends join (docs/adr/0340 §1); absent: both by the rule.

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

offset.description: The base line offset: the justification line is the path moved this far to its left (negative: right).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

style.description: The project's wall style it was made with, by its id; its components are the style's.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

WallJoin.description:
How one end of a wall joins another (docs/adr/0340 §1, `CAD-ARCH-07`): by the rule; not at all (its end line
drawn); at a corner mitred; butting the other (it stops at the other's face); running through it (the other butts).

WallJoins.description: A wall's start's and end's join.

WallJustify.description:
Where the wall's body lies across its path (AutoCAD Architecture's justification): `Left`, the path is the wall's
left face and the body to its right; `Center`, the path is its middle; `Right`, the path is its right face.

frame.description: Whether its boundary is drawn (AutoCAD's WIPEOUTFRAME, per mask).

XrefKind.description:
How a reference goes on: `attach` (Ekle) is seen in a drawing that references this one too, `overlay` (Bindir) only
here.

XrefSource.description: Where an external reference's content comes from (docs/adr/0348 §1).

digest.description: The SHA-256 of the file's content as loaded, lowercase hex.

group.description: The layer group its layers are under, by id.

objects.description:
The source's objects' persistent ids, one for each of the definition's objects in its order: a reload finds
each object again by it and moves the references to its pieces (a definition's objects are numbered by their
order in a file).

page.description: A PDF underlay's page, from 1 (docs/adr/0351 §2): the source is a PDF file and this page its content.

parent.description: The reference that brought it, for one nested in another.

path.description: The source drawing's absolute path, as attached or last found.

relative.description: Its path from the drawing's folder, `/` between its parts, written when the drawing is saved.

underlay.description: A PDF underlay's look; absent: as its PDF draws, plotted.

unloaded.description: Its content let go (Boşalt): its inserts stay and draw nothing.

output.description: A copy of objects with all they use (docs/adr/0309 §1).

base.description: Where the objects are placed from: the copy's base point.

blocks.description: The block definitions the objects place, and those these place.

dimensionStyles.description: The dimension styles the objects name.

layers.description: The layer tree the objects are on: their layers and the groups above them, with the source's looks.

library.description:
The library items (symbols, their images) the objects and their layers draw with; absent when they draw
with none.

objects.description:
The objects, numbered 1, 2 … in the drawing's order (so their drawing order is kept), whatever order they
were given in.

textStyles.description: The text styles the objects name.

uids.description: Each object's persistent id where it was copied, in the order of `objects`: what links between them name.

unit.description:
The source drawing's unit (absent: metres). Lengths are metres in every drawing, so a paste keeps the
objects' sizes in another unit (docs/adr/0309 §2).

output.title: Clip

AltUnits.description: An alternate unit written after the value in brackets (AutoCAD's DIMALT): `2.500 [2500]`.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the project's length decimals.

at.description: The scale (1:at) its own geometry is drawn at.

scales.description: The other scales it takes part in, ascending, each with what it sets apart.

AnnotativeScale.description:
One of an object's other scales and what it sets apart from the object's
own values; a field not given is the object's own (`textShift` scaled with
the height).

offset.description: A dimension's line offset.

point.description: A text's point; a leader's landing start (its last point: the points after the arrow's tip move with it).

rotation.description: A text's or a leader's note's direction, degrees counter-clockwise from east.

scale.description: 1:scale.

textShift.description: A dimension's value moved from its place (0 and 0: in its place).

§1); none on a block's objects.

wipeout.description:

ArchDiscipline.description: The discipline an architectural object belongs to.

ArchInfo.description:
What every architectural object carries beside its geometry (`CAD-ARCH-03`): its level (by the project level's
id), phase, construction status and discipline; absent fields are not said.

ArchPhase.description: An architectural object's phase (renovation): what is there, what goes, what is new.

ArchStatus.description: Where an architectural object is in its construction.

oneOf.description: Level, inside, away from the edges.
Level when it fits, else along the area's long side.
Along its outline.
Along its outline, inside, repeated (Maplex's boundary labels).
Inside only: level, then along the long side, then fitted (Maplex's land parcels).
By its box's top left corner (a sheet's frame).

AreaPart.description:
A part of a multi-part area past its first (docs/adr/0143): its outer
ring in vertex + bulge form, its holes and its vertices' elevations, as
the area's own fields hold the first part's. A multi-part polyline's
part is the same, open and without holes (docs/adr/0174).

ms.description:
A polyline's part's measures, as the polyline's own `ms`
(docs/adr/0224 §1); an area's part has none.

zs.description: Each vertex's elevation, as the area's own `zs` (docs/adr/0142).

Attachment.description:
One of an object's attachments: its name, its source (exactly one of
`asset`, `file` and `url`) and an optional note.

asset.description: Embedded: the project library's PNG or JPEG asset its bytes are.

file.description:
Linked: a file's path, relative to the drawing's folder when it is
relative.

name.description: The name shown (the file's name by default).

note.description: A note shown with it (lines allowed).

url.description: A web address (`http` or `https`).

AttributeDefinition.description:
One attribute an insert shows as text (docs/adr/0144 §7): the insert's
attribute `tag`, else `value`, written at `p` in the definition's
coordinates, moved with the insert.

align.description: Where `p` is on the text, as a text's (docs/adr/0145).

boxWidth.description: A multiline attribute's box width, metres in the definition's size.

constant.description: Its value is the definition's `value` in every insert; an insert holds none of its own (bit 2).

field.description:
A field (docs/adr/0317 §1): a template whose `{ifade}` parts are filled for each insert (its attributes, its
place, the project's `@` values); the commands that place, sync and update fields write it as the value.

height.description: Metres, in the definition's size.

invisible.description: Not drawn: its value is kept, listed and scheduled (DXF 70 bit 1).

movable.description: An insert may move its text (`attributePlaces`); off: locked where the definition puts it (bit 16 set).

multiline.description: Its value may hold line breaks, each a line; wrapped to `boxWidth` when given (an MTEXT attribute).

preset.description: Blok ekle takes its default without asking (bit 8).

prompt.description: What Blok ekle asks for it.

rotation.description: Degrees, counter-clockwise from east, as a text's.

value.description: The default value.

verify.description: Blok ekle asks for it twice, the two the same (bit 4).

widthFactor.description: The letters' width times this, as a text's (docs/adr/0145).

BlendMode.description:
How a layer's picture meets what is under it (docs/adr/0226 §4: the W3C's
separable blending modes, and addition).

BlockAction.description: An action (docs/adr/0318 §2): the objects (local ids) a parameter's change moves.

oneOf.description:
The objects move by the parameter's change (a linear's along its line, a polar's and a point's by the moved
point).
The objects' points inside the box move by the parameter's change; the rest stay.
The objects scale about the parameter's `from` by its value over its default.

Copies of the objects every `spacing` along a linear parameter's line: one for each further `spacing` its
value holds past its default (the definition shows what the default holds).
The objects turn about an angle parameter's centre by its change.
The objects mirror about a flip parameter's line while it is on.

BlockCard.description:
A block's library card (docs/adr/0317 §4): what the Bloklar panel's cards and search show beside its name, its
description, its size and its attributes.

category.description: A path of categories by `/` (`Mimari/Kapılar`); absent: none.

tags.description: Words it is found by, each once, Turkish case folded.

version.description:
How many times its definition has changed since it was made: 1 when made; each change of its objects, base,
attributes or unit adds one.

BlockDefinition.description:
A block definition (docs/adr/0144): objects drawn once, placed many
times. Its objects' ids are local to it, once each and kept by every edit
of it, so a reference to a piece follows it (docs/adr/0315 §1). An object
on the block's layer (`""`, the DXF's layer 0) is drawn on its insert's
layer; one on a layer of its own shows only while that layer does
(docs/adr/0315 §2). A part of its look it has is its own, a `byLayer` part
its layer's (its insert's layer on the block's layer), any other part its
insert's (BYBLOCK).

attributes.description: The texts an insert shows from its attributes (ATTDEF).

base.description: The point placed at an insert's `p`, in the definition's coordinates.

card.description: Its library card (docs/adr/0317 §4): category, tags and version.

dynamic.description: Its parameters and actions (docs/adr/0318): one definition at many sizes and looks.

name.description: Unique in the drawing, Turkish case folded.

units.description:
The unit it was drawn in (docs/adr/0315 §4): a unit, its geometry being metres as the drawing's (an insert
keeps its size anywhere); `unitless`, its numbers being drawing units (an insert is scaled by the drawing's
unit). Absent: a real-size block of an unknown unit.

xref.description: An external reference's source (docs/adr/0348 §1): its objects are that drawing's as last loaded.

BlockParameter.description: A parameter (docs/adr/0318 §1). Its points are the definition's coordinates.

oneOf.description: A length along `from`→`to`: its default the distance between them; a change moves `to` along the line.
`to` moved anywhere: its value a point, its rule on the distance from `from`.
An angle about `center`, radians counter-clockwise from east; its default `base`.
A point: its default `at`.
A mirror about the line `a`→`b`, off by default.
The objects shown: its first state by default.
Rows of values set together, chosen by label; it has no value of its own to keep.

BlockUnits.description: The unit a block was drawn in (docs/adr/0315 §4).

oneOf.description: Its numbers are the drawing's units: a 1 is a millimetre in a millimetre drawing, a metre in a metre one.

BreakLine.description: Which of a dimension's lines a break is on.

oneOf.description: The dimension line, from its first end (0) to its second (1).
The first extension line, from the measured point (0) to its far end (1).
The second.
Level, then upright.

Cell.description: A cell of a combination: a code of its field's list, any value (empty too), or empty.

CellField.description: A cell bound to a source (docs/adr/0327 §3): its words are the value last written, `####` when broken.

CellFormula.description: A cell's formula (docs/adr/0327 §2): its words begin with `=`; the cell's words are its result.

CellRange.description: A merged range: `rows` × `cols` cells from row `row`, column `col`.

CellStyle.description:
A style over a range of cells (docs/adr/0327 §1); what it leaves absent the cells take from the styles before it,
then from the table.

color.description: Its words' colour, `#rrggbb`.

decimals.description: The decimals a formula's or a field's number is written with.

fill.description: Its background, `#rrggbb`.

CircleEntity.description:
Fields every object has. `id` is the object's local id inside a v1 file.
v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

time.description: The values are a CF time axis's moments.

DimensionArrow.description:
A dimension's arrowheads other than the oblique tick, which is no value but
the field's absence (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: A filled triangle, its tip on the dimension line's end (Dolu ok).
The triangle's two sides (Açık ok).
A filled circle about the end (Nokta).
Nothing at the ends (Yok).

DimensionBreak.description:
A gap in one of a dimension's lines where another object crosses it (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK), at the fraction `t` of
the line; its width the options' `breakSize`.

angle.description: Linear: measured direction in degrees (0 = ΔY, 90 = ΔX).

annotative.description:
Its scales: drawn at the paper height it was given at every scale it takes part in, hidden
at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

arrowSize.description:
The arrowhead's (or tick's) length; absent: `DEFAULT_TICK` for ticks,
`DEFAULT_ARROW` for the others.

breaks.description: The gaps in its lines where other objects cross them (docs/adr/0321 §1).

c.description:
Angular: the vertex. Arc length: the arc's centre. Jogged: the centre
the line starts from (docs/adr/0147).

decimals.description:
A length's, a coordinate's or a slope's decimals; absent: the
project's length decimals (a slope's 2). Angles keep the project's.

dimLineColor.description:
The dimension line's and its arrowheads' colour, `#RRGGBB`; absent:
the object's (docs/adr/0205 §6).

dimLineType.description: The dimension line's type; absent: continuous.

dimLineWeight.description: The dimension line's weight, paper mm as an object's; absent: a hairline.

dimStyle.description: The project's dimension style it follows, by its id; absent: Standart.

extBeyond.description: How far the extension lines pass the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_BEYOND`.

extColor.description: The extension lines' colour; absent: the object's.

extLineType.description: The extension lines' type; absent: continuous.

extOffset.description: The extension lines' gap from the measured points; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_OFFSET`.

extWeight.description: The extension lines' weight, paper mm; absent: a hairline.

font.description: The value's typeface; absent: the project's.

matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

always.description: Always; absent, only when the label does not fit.

LabelAlign.description: How a label's lines line up.

fill.description: Hex or a theme name (`paper`: the drawing area's colour, a mask); absent, not filled.

padding.description: CSS px round the letters; absent, 2.

LabelCallout.description: The line from a label placed away from its object to the object.

color.description: Absent, the label's.

minLength.description: A shorter one is not drawn, CSS px; absent, 6.

LabelClass.description:
One class of a rule-based labelling: its name, the condition its objects
meet and its labels' style.

name.description: One of its kind on the layer; a pin names it.

when.description: İfadeyle seç's language; absent, every object.

LabelHalo.description: The halo round a label's letters.

color.description: Hex or a theme name; absent, the drawing area's colour.

LabelObstacle.description: A layer's objects as obstacles to every label.

kind.description: An area's inside (absent) or its outline.

weight.description: 1 to 10: a label of a lower priority cannot cover them; another may, at a cost.

LabelOverlap.description: Whether a label may cover another (QGIS's three).

oneOf.description: Never: a label with no free place is not drawn.
When no free place is left, at its best one.
Always at its best place.

LabelPin.description:
A label moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (an object's
`labelPins`, docs/adr/0212 §3.7).

at.description: Where the label's middle is from the object's anchor, metres; absent, the engine places it.

class.description: The class's name; absent, the object's first label.

rotation.description: Degrees counter-clockwise from east; only with `at`.

LabelPosition.description:
A line label's side of its line; on an area's outline `above` is inside
and `below` outside.

oneOf.description: Above, else below.

LabelShadow.description: A label's shadow: the label again under it, moved.

color.description: Absent, black.

oneOf.description: A rectangle with round corners.

at.description: The letters a line may end at; absent, the space.

chars.description: The most letters a line holds (a longer word stays whole).

LabelStyle.description: How entity labels on a layer are drawn; sizes in CSS px.

align.description: How a label's lines line up; absent, centred.

area.description: Where an area's label goes; absent, by `placement`.

callout.description: The line to the object from a label placed away from it.

color.description: The letters' colour (hex or a theme name): instead of `ink`.

curved.description: An outline's label (perimeter, boundary) letter by letter.

distance.description: CSS px between a label and its object; absent, 2.

duplicates.description: CSS px within which the same text is labelled once.

halo.description: The halo round the letters; absent, 1.5 px of the drawing area's colour.

inside.description: An area's label only where it fits inside.

line.description: Where a line's label goes; absent, by `placement`.

maxAngle.description: Degrees two neighbouring letters of a curved label may turn; absent, 25.

mergeLines.description: Lines meeting end to end with the same text labelled once.

outside.description: An area's label that fits nowhere inside, outside with a callout.

overlap.description: Whether it may cover another label; absent, never.

point.description: Where a point's label goes; absent, by `placement`.

position.description: A line label's side of its line (on an outline, `above` inside).

priority.description: 0 to 10; absent, 5: higher first.

repeat.description: CSS px between a line's repeated labels.

shrink.description: The smallest size a label is made when it does not fit, a factor 0.5–1.

text.description: The text as an expression (İfadeyle seç's language, docs/adr/0212 §2): instead of the template.

LabelWord.description: One word of an abbreviation dictionary.

oneOf.description: One label: the style's `label`, else its kind's default.
The classes, in order: each whose condition holds labels an object.
None (its objects may still be obstacles).

LayerAction.description:
An action of a layer's objects (docs/adr/0225 §4): its name and the
address or file it opens, a template.

name.description: The name in the menus and on the card.

target.description: An `http`, `https` or `mailto` address or a file's path, a template.

LayerCompose.description:
How a layer is composed into the drawing (Katman çizimi, docs/adr/0226 §3,
§4); absent, as it always was: opaque, normal, no mask.

LayerField.description: A field of a layer (docs/adr/0199 §1): its name is the attribute's key.

alias.description: The name the table and the form show.

default.description: The value a new object takes, in its canonical text.

domain.description:
The project's value list it links (docs/adr/0430): its `values` (or `min` and `max`) are that
list's copy, written anew whenever the list changes. None: its own.

id.description:
The field's stable id (docs/adr/0401 §2): what a form binds to. None: its name is its id; a
rename writes the old name here so a binding holds. Unique among the layer's fields' keys.

max.description: A number's greatest value, in its canonical text; included.

maxExclusive.description: `max` is not itself in the range; only with `max`; written only as `true`.

merge.description:
What the field's value becomes when objects are merged into one (Alan birleştir, Birleştir,
Parçaları birleştir; docs/adr/0419). None: the first object's.

min.description: A number's least value, in its canonical text; included.

minExclusive.description: `min` is not itself in the range (docs/adr/0438 §4); only with `min`; written only as `true`.

multiple.description:
A text field holds several values (docs/adr/0408 §1, 0409 §1): a listed one its codes in the
list's order, an unlisted one its values in their order (objects' persistent ids for a
many-to-many reference), joined with `; `; written only as `true`.

required.description: An object may not leave it empty; written only as `true`.

scale.description: A decimal's most fraction digits (0–15).

split.description:
What the field's value becomes in the pieces when its object is split (Alan böl, Parçala,
Kır, Parçalara ayır; docs/adr/0419). None: each piece keeps it.

unique.description:
No two objects of the layer hold the same value (empty ones aside; docs/adr/0438 §3): every
write is refused `not_unique` that would; written only as `true`.

unit.description:
The unit a number is in, shown after it (`m²`, `kg`; 1–16 characters; docs/adr/0438 §4); the value
stays the number.

values.description: The values a text or a number takes, when only some.

oneOf.description: A date and a time of day, local (docs/adr/0412 §1): `YYYY-AA-GGTSS:DD:SS`.
A time of day (docs/adr/0412 §1): `SS:DD:SS`.

LayerFilter.description:
A layer's filter (docs/adr/0211 §2): an object passes when the condition
holds for it and, when there is a list, the list names it.

expression.description:
The condition (İfadeyle seç's language, docs/adr/0100): an object
passes when it is true.

objects.description:
Only these objects, by their persistent ids (Seçimden süzgeç); an id
the drawing does not hold is not wrong.

LayerGeometry.description:
What a layer holds (docs/adr/0622 §5): GIS's layer type, a layer of points, lines, areas or annotation; absent,
any kind (Karışık, a CAD layer). A typed layer takes only the objects of its kind: a write that would put another
kind on it is refused (`layer_geometry_mismatch`) and the tools that draw another kind are off while it is active.

LayerLabels.description: How a layer is labelled (`LayerStyle.labels`, docs/adr/0212 §2).

classes.description: The rules' classes, in order; only with `rules`.

LayerMask.description: The mask a layer's labels and markers cut into other layers (docs/adr/0226 §3).

labels.description: Its placed labels' boxes.

size.description: How far the shapes grow, paper mm (0–10); their corners round as far.

targets.description: The layers it cuts into, by their ids.

LayerNode.description: A node of the layer tree: a group or a layer.

actions.description:
The addresses and files its objects open (docs/adr/0225 §4). Only a
layer holding objects has them, never a group or a layer drawn from a
service.

card.description:
What the Bilgi tool shows of its objects (docs/adr/0225 §5); absent:
the default card. Only on a layer holding objects.

contingents.description:
Değer bileşimleri (docs/adr/0423): the groups of fields whose values go together. Only a
layer holding objects has them.

feed.description:
Where the layer's objects were taken from, to take them again
(docs/adr/0208 §10). Only a layer has it, never a group.

fields.description:
A layer's fields (docs/adr/0199 §1): the schema of its objects'
attributes, in the order the table and the form show them; empty, no
schema (and nothing written). Only a layer has them, never a group.

filter.description:
The layer's filter (docs/adr/0211 §2): only the objects that pass it
are shown, picked and given to its tools. Only a layer has it, never a
group or a layer drawn from a service.

frozen.description:
Dondur (AutoCAD's freeze, DXF's 70 bit 1; docs/adr/0311 §1): absent,
thawed; `true`, frozen: neither drawn, picked, snapped to nor counted
in the drawing's extent, and Hepsini göster leaves it frozen; the
active layer is never frozen. A group's covers what it holds. Only
`true` is written.

geometry.description:
What the layer holds (docs/adr/0622 §5): points, lines, areas or annotation; absent, any kind. Only a layer
has it, never a group.

replaces.description: A scenario's layer: the base layer it stands for (docs/adr/0210 §9).

rules.description:
Kayıt kuralları (docs/adr/0438 §1): the constraints every write of the layer's records keeps.
Only a layer holding objects has them.

scenario.description: A group made a scenario (docs/adr/0210 §9). Only a group has it.

service.description:
A layer drawn from a map service (docs/adr/0208 §2): it holds no
objects. Only a layer has it, never a group.

snap.description:
A layer's own snapping (docs/adr/0163 §4): off, or only some kinds;
absent, the general kinds. Only a layer has it, never a group.

sourceCrs.description: The system its objects came from (docs/adr/0583 §1); absent: not known. Only a layer has it, never a group.

subtypes.description:
Alt türler (docs/adr/0422): the field that sorts the records and what each kind narrows.
Only a layer holding objects has them.

tableStyles.description:
Koşullu biçim (docs/adr/0413 §1): how the attribute table paints its rows and cells by
conditions; empty, plainly. Only a layer holding objects has them.

time.description:
A temporal layer's time setting (docs/adr/0210 §2): which attributes
hold its objects' start and end. Only a layer has it, never a group.

LayerRule.description: A record rule of a layer.

fields.description:
The fields' keys a form shows it on and a refusal points at, in order; none: the first field it
reads.

id.description: Its id, once in the layer: what a form or a refusal names it by (1–64 characters).

message.description: What a write breaking it is told (1–500 characters).

name.description: Its name as the interface shows it (1–64 characters).

rule.description:
The expression that must hold (the record's fields by name, `$alan` and the project's `@`
values).

warning.description: A soft rule: broken, it warns and the write goes in; written only as `true`.

LayerSnap.description:
A layer's own snapping (docs/adr/0163 §4): `{ "off": true }`, no
snapping to its objects; or `{ "kinds": [...] }`, only these kinds (as
far as the general kinds take them). Exactly one of the two, and a list
that is not empty: the readers refuse anything else ([`LayerSnap::problem`]).

off.description: No snapping to the layer's objects; written only as `true`.

LayerSourceCrs.description: The system a layer's objects came from.

area.description: Where the system is meant for, in the registry's words.

axisOrder.description: `en`, `ne` or `latlon`: EPSG's order of its axes (the drawing's are always east, north).

srid.description: Its EPSG code, when the registry knows it.

unit.description: `metre` or `degree`.

LayerStyle.description: A layer's look. `renderer` (the style engine, docs/STYLE.md) is opaque JSON in v1.

color.description: Hex colour or a theme token (fg, fg-dim, ink, paper).

labels.description:
How the layer is labelled (docs/adr/0212 §2): rule-based classes,
none, its objects as obstacles; absent, by `label` (one label).

linePattern.description: A project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1; `pattern` is a hatch's); absent: `line_type`.

lineType.description: Its built-in line type; with a `pattern`, the one nearest to it (what a reader without patterns draws).

lineWeight.description: Plot line weight in mm.

LayerSubtypes.description: A layer's subtypes: the field that sorts the records (its key) and the subtypes, in their order.

field.description: The subtype field's key (its id, else its name): a field with a value list, one value each.

LayerTime.description:
A layer's time setting (docs/adr/0210 §2): its objects' start (or
moment) and end are the values of these attributes.

cumulative.description: Birikimli: an object shows from its start on, whatever its end; written only as `true`.

end.description: The attribute holding the end; absent, the objects are moments.

key.description: The attribute naming an object across its versions (Zamanı karşılaştır's key).

recordedEnd.description: The attribute holding when the version was superseded (its system time's end); empty: still current.

recordedStart.description:
The attribute holding when the object's version was recorded (its system time's start, docs/adr/0537):
what was known on a day is the versions recorded by then and not yet superseded. `.kcad` schema 90.

start.description: The attribute holding the start (an instant layer's moment).

LeaderArm.description: A leader's arm after its first (docs/adr/0326 §1).

pts.description: At least one: its tip first, then its bends; it ends at the leader's last vertex.

tip.description: The place on an object its tip follows; absent: a free tip.

LeaderArrow.description:
A leader's arrowhead other than the filled triangle (Dolu üçgen,
AutoCAD's Closed filled), which is no value but the field's absence: a
leader has one spelling (docs/adr/0146 §1). The first three are the
first leaders'; the others AutoCAD's arrowheads (docs/adr/0205 §7, `.kcad`
schema 30).

oneOf.description: Açık ok: the filled triangle's two sides (Open).
Dolu nokta: a filled dot (Dot).
Yok: no arrowhead, the line ends at the tip (None).
Boş üçgen: the triangle's outline (Closed blank).
İnce açık ok: two sides 15° off the line (Open 30).
Dik açık ok: two sides square to each other (Open 90, Right angle).
Küçük nokta (Dot small).
Boş nokta: a ring (Dot blank).
Eğik çizgi: a tick across the tip (Oblique).
Mimari çentik: a heavy tick (Architectural tick).
Dolu kare (Box filled).
Boş kare (Box blank).
Dayanak üçgeni: a filled triangle standing on the tip (Datum triangle filled).

LeaderEntity.description:
A leader (docs/adr/0146): an arrowhead at its first vertex, a line
through its vertices and, with a note, a landing from its last vertex
along the note's direction and the note past the landing's end; one
object. The arrowhead and the landing are measured by the note's height.

annotative.description:
Its scales: drawn at the paper height it was given at every scale it takes part in, hidden
at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

arms.description:
Its other arms (docs/adr/0326 §1): each from its own tip through its bends to the leader's last vertex, where
the landing starts; the arrowhead, the note and the look the first arm's.

arrow.description: The arrowhead; absent: a filled arrow.

arrowSize.description:
The arrowhead's length, times the note's height (docs/adr/0205 §7);
absent: 1. From `MIN_LEADER_ARROW` to `MAX_LEADER_ARROW`.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

blocks.description:
Its content blocks (docs/adr/0326 §2): inserts standing in a row at its landing's end, by persistent id; a
leader with blocks has no note.

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

height.description:
The note's height, metres, finite and over 0; the arrowhead and the
landing are measured by it.

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

leaderStyle.description: The leader style it follows (docs/adr/0326 §4), by its id.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

mask.description:
The note's box is filled with the drawing area's colour before the
note is drawn, as a text's mask (docs/adr/0145).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

pts.description: At least two: the arrow's tip first, where the landing starts last.

rotation.description: The note's and the landing's direction, degrees counter-clockwise from east.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

text.description:
The note, one line; absent: the arrow alone, no landing and no note.
Never empty: no note is the field's absence.

tip.description: The place on an object its first arm's tip follows (docs/adr/0326 §3); absent: a free tip.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

LengthStyle.description:
How lengths are written (docs/adr/0262 §2); none (no setting) is decimal
in the drawing's unit. The three are an inch or foot drawing's.

oneOf.description: Decimal in the drawing's unit: no setting, here for a command to say so.

za.description: The start's elevation, m; absent = none (docs/adr/0142).

oneOf.description: Straight, along the line.

Level, on the line.

LookupRow.description: One row of a lookup: its label and the values it sets.

oneOf.description: The first object's value.
Empty.

The values a number parameter may take: within `min` and `max`, on `step`s from `min` (from 0 without one), one
of `list`; or computed by `expression` from the other number parameters (it is not set then).

knots.description:

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

tangents.description: The fit points' start and end tangent directions; null where none was given.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

weights.description: Each control point's weight, above 0; absent: all 1 (not rational).

wipeout.description:

what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

ObjectValue.description: An object's value a field writes.

oneOf.description: A closed object's area, its holes taken off.
A closed object's perimeter.
A line's, an arc's, a path's or a curve's length.
Its layer's name.
Its label.
The attribute named: a block insert's attribute value, else the object's attribute.
A text's letters (a cross reference).
Its east and north: a point's place, a text's, a block's or a table's insertion point, else where its label goes.

oneOf.description: Its inside: a label covering any of it.

oneOf.description: Its jamb nearer the wall's start.

oneOf.description: Its wall is gone, or is no wall.

broken.description: Why it is not where its wall says; absent: it is.

frame.description: Its frame's width at each jamb, along the wall, metres. Absent: none.

hand.description: Its hinge's end. Absent: its start.

head.description: Its head's height above the floor, metres.

place.description:

commands.title: Yapıştır
commands.summary: cad.entities.copy'nin verdiği kopyayı bu çizime yapıştırır (AutoCAD'in PASTECLIP, PASTEORIG ve PASTEBLOCK'u); tek geri alma adımı “Yapıştır”. Kopyanın taban noktası at'a gelir; at verilmezse nesneler kopyalandıkları yerde kalır. Her nesne bu çizimde kendi katmanının yolundaki katmana gider (adlar büyük küçük harf ve Türkçe harf farkı gözetmeden); olmayan yol kaynağın görünüşüyle ve gruplarıyla açılır. Bu çizimde aynı adlı blok varsa bu çizimin tanımı kullanılır (report.kept), yoksa eklenir (report.blocks); stiller de adıyla, olmayanlar eklenir (proje ayarı). conflicts: rename ile aynı adlı blok ve stil kopyanınkiyle “Ad (2)” gibi boş bir adla gelir, nesneler onu kullanır (report.renamed, names_renamed uyarısı). Nesneler yeni kimlik alır; kopyanın dışına bağlar düşer. asBlock ile nesneler o adla (boş bir ad: “Ad (2)” …) tek blok olur, tabanı kopyanın taban noktası, etkin katmanda at'a yerleştirilir. Uzunluklar her çizimde metre olduğundan başka birimli çizimden gelen nesneler boylarını korur (units_differ uyarısı). Retler: no_entities, invalid_clip, not_finite, empty_name, invalid_revision, revision_conflict, not_a_layer, layer_locked.

constant.description: Its value is the definition's `value` in every insert; an insert holds none of its own (bit 2).

field.description:
A field (docs/adr/0317 §1): a template whose `{ifade}` parts are filled for each insert (its attributes, its
place, the project's `@` values); the commands that place, sync and update fields write it as the value.

height.description: Metres, in the definition's size.

invisible.description: Not drawn: its value is kept, listed and scheduled (DXF 70 bit 1).

movable.description: An insert may move its text (`attributePlaces`); off: locked where the definition puts it (bit 16 set).

multiline.description: Its value may hold line breaks, each a line; wrapped to `boxWidth` when given (an MTEXT attribute).

preset.description: Blok ekle takes its default without asking (bit 8).

prompt.description: What Blok ekle asks for it.

value.description: The default value.

layer; one on a layer of its own shows only while that layer does
(docs/adr/0315 §2). A part of its look it has is its own, a `byLayer` part
its layer's (its insert's layer on the block's layer), any other part its
insert's (BYBLOCK).

their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

overlap.description: Whether it may cover another label; absent, never.

point.description: Where a point's label goes; absent, by `placement`.

position.description: A line label's side of its line (on an outline, `above` inside).

priority.description: 0 to 10; absent, 5: higher first.

repeat.description: CSS px between a line's repeated labels.

shrink.description: The smallest size a label is made when it does not fit, a factor 0.5–1.

text.description: The text as an expression (İfadeyle seç's language, docs/adr/0212 §2): instead of the template.

LabelWord.description: One word of an abbreviation dictionary.

oneOf.description: One label: the style's `label`, else its kind's default.
The classes, in order: each whose condition holds labels an object.
None (its objects may still be obstacles).

LayerAction.description:
An action of a layer's objects (docs/adr/0225 §4): its name and the
address or file it opens, a template.

name.description: The name in the menus and on the card.

target.description: An `http`, `https` or `mailto` address or a file's path, a template.

LayerCompose.description:
How a layer is composed into the drawing (Katman çizimi, docs/adr/0226 §3,
§4); absent, as it always was: opaque, normal, no mask.

LayerField.description: A field of a layer (docs/adr/0199 §1): its name is the attribute's key.

alias.description: The name the table and the form show.

default.description: The value a new object takes, in its canonical text.

domain.description:
The project's value list it links (docs/adr/0430): its `values` (or `min` and `max`) are that
list's copy, written anew whenever the list changes. None: its own.

id.description:
The field's stable id (docs/adr/0401 §2): what a form binds to. None: its name is its id; a
rename writes the old name here so a binding holds. Unique among the layer's fields' keys.

max.description: A number's greatest value, in its canonical text; included.

maxExclusive.description: `max` is not itself in the range; only with `max`; written only as `true`.

merge.description:
What the field's value becomes when objects are merged into one (Alan birleştir, Birleştir,
Parçaları birleştir; docs/adr/0419). None: the first object's.

min.description: A number's least value, in its canonical text; included.

minExclusive.description: `min` is not itself in the range (docs/adr/0438 §4); only with `min`; written only as `true`.

multiple.description:
A text field holds several values (docs/adr/0408 §1, 0409 §1): a listed one its codes in the
list's order, an unlisted one its values in their order (objects' persistent ids for a
many-to-many reference), joined with `; `; written only as `true`.

required.description: An object may not leave it empty; written only as `true`.

scale.description: A decimal's most fraction digits (0–15).

split.description:
What the field's value becomes in the pieces when its object is split (Alan böl, Parçala,
Kır, Parçalara ayır; docs/adr/0419). None: each piece keeps it.

unique.description:
No two objects of the layer hold the same value (empty ones aside; docs/adr/0438 §3): every
write is refused `not_unique` that would; written only as `true`.

unit.description:
The unit a number is in, shown after it (`m²`, `kg`; 1–16 characters; docs/adr/0438 §4); the value
stays the number.

values.description: The values a text or a number takes, when only some.

oneOf.description: A date and a time of day, local (docs/adr/0412 §1): `YYYY-AA-GGTSS:DD:SS`.
A time of day (docs/adr/0412 §1): `SS:DD:SS`.

LayerFilter.description:
A layer's filter (docs/adr/0211 §2): an object passes when the condition
holds for it and, when there is a list, the list names it.

expression.description:
The condition (İfadeyle seç's language, docs/adr/0100): an object
passes when it is true.

objects.description:
Only these objects, by their persistent ids (Seçimden süzgeç); an id
the drawing does not hold is not wrong.

LayerGeometry.description:
What a layer holds (docs/adr/0622 §5): GIS's layer type, a layer of points, lines, areas or annotation; absent,
any kind (Karışık, a CAD layer). A typed layer takes only the objects of its kind: a write that would put another
kind on it is refused (`layer_geometry_mismatch`) and the tools that draw another kind are off while it is active.

LayerLabels.description: How a layer is labelled (`LayerStyle.labels`, docs/adr/0212 §2).

classes.description: The rules' classes, in order; only with `rules`.

LayerMask.description: The mask a layer's labels and markers cut into other layers (docs/adr/0226 §3).

labels.description: Its placed labels' boxes.

size.description: How far the shapes grow, paper mm (0–10); their corners round as far.

targets.description: The layers it cuts into, by their ids.

LayerNode.description: A node of the layer tree: a group or a layer.

actions.description:
The addresses and files its objects open (docs/adr/0225 §4). Only a
layer holding objects has them, never a group or a layer drawn from a
service.

card.description:
What the Bilgi tool shows of its objects (docs/adr/0225 §5); absent:
the default card. Only on a layer holding objects.

contingents.description:
Değer bileşimleri (docs/adr/0423): the groups of fields whose values go together. Only a
layer holding objects has them.

feed.description:
Where the layer's objects were taken from, to take them again
(docs/adr/0208 §10). Only a layer has it, never a group.

fields.description:
A layer's fields (docs/adr/0199 §1): the schema of its objects'
attributes, in the order the table and the form show them; empty, no
schema (and nothing written). Only a layer has them, never a group.

filter.description:
The layer's filter (docs/adr/0211 §2): only the objects that pass it
are shown, picked and given to its tools. Only a layer has it, never a
group or a layer drawn from a service.

frozen.description:
Dondur (AutoCAD's freeze, DXF's 70 bit 1; docs/adr/0311 §1): absent,
thawed; `true`, frozen: neither drawn, picked, snapped to nor counted
in the drawing's extent, and Hepsini göster leaves it frozen; the
active layer is never frozen. A group's covers what it holds. Only
`true` is written.

geometry.description:
What the layer holds (docs/adr/0622 §5): points, lines, areas or annotation; absent, any kind. Only a layer
has it, never a group.

replaces.description: A scenario's layer: the base layer it stands for (docs/adr/0210 §9).

rules.description:
Kayıt kuralları (docs/adr/0438 §1): the constraints every write of the layer's records keeps.
Only a layer holding objects has them.

scenario.description: A group made a scenario (docs/adr/0210 §9). Only a group has it.

service.description:
A layer drawn from a map service (docs/adr/0208 §2): it holds no
objects. Only a layer has it, never a group.

snap.description:
A layer's own snapping (docs/adr/0163 §4): off, or only some kinds;
absent, the general kinds. Only a layer has it, never a group.

sourceCrs.description: The system its objects came from (docs/adr/0583 §1); absent: not known. Only a layer has it, never a group.

subtypes.description:
Alt türler (docs/adr/0422): the field that sorts the records and what each kind narrows.
Only a layer holding objects has them.

tableStyles.description:
Koşullu biçim (docs/adr/0413 §1): how the attribute table paints its rows and cells by
conditions; empty, plainly. Only a layer holding objects has them.

time.description:
A temporal layer's time setting (docs/adr/0210 §2): which attributes
hold its objects' start and end. Only a layer has it, never a group.

LayerRule.description: A record rule of a layer.

fields.description:
The fields' keys a form shows it on and a refusal points at, in order; none: the first field it
reads.

id.description: Its id, once in the layer: what a form or a refusal names it by (1–64 characters).

message.description: What a write breaking it is told (1–500 characters).

name.description: Its name as the interface shows it (1–64 characters).

rule.description:
The expression that must hold (the record's fields by name, `$alan` and the project's `@`
values).

warning.description: A soft rule: broken, it warns and the write goes in; written only as `true`.

LayerSnap.description:
A layer's own snapping (docs/adr/0163 §4): `{ "off": true }`, no
snapping to its objects; or `{ "kinds": [...] }`, only these kinds (as
far as the general kinds take them). Exactly one of the two, and a list
that is not empty: the readers refuse anything else ([`LayerSnap::problem`]).

off.description: No snapping to the layer's objects; written only as `true`.

LayerSourceCrs.description: The system a layer's objects came from.

area.description: Where the system is meant for, in the registry's words.

axisOrder.description: `en`, `ne` or `latlon`: EPSG's order of its axes (the drawing's are always east, north).

srid.description: Its EPSG code, when the registry knows it.

unit.description: `metre` or `degree`.

LayerStyle.description: A layer's look. `renderer` (the style engine, docs/STYLE.md) is opaque JSON in v1.

color.description: Hex colour or a theme token (fg, fg-dim, ink, paper).

labels.description:
How the layer is labelled (docs/adr/0212 §2): rule-based classes,
none, its objects as obstacles; absent, by `label` (one label).

linePattern.description: A project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1; `pattern` is a hatch's); absent: `line_type`.

lineType.description: Its built-in line type; with a `pattern`, the one nearest to it (what a reader without patterns draws).

lineWeight.description: Plot line weight in mm.

LayerSubtypes.description: A layer's subtypes: the field that sorts the records (its key) and the subtypes, in their order.

field.description: The subtype field's key (its id, else its name): a field with a value list, one value each.

LayerTime.description:
A layer's time setting (docs/adr/0210 §2): its objects' start (or
moment) and end are the values of these attributes.

cumulative.description: Birikimli: an object shows from its start on, whatever its end; written only as `true`.

end.description: The attribute holding the end; absent, the objects are moments.

key.description: The attribute naming an object across its versions (Zamanı karşılaştır's key).

recordedEnd.description: The attribute holding when the version was superseded (its system time's end); empty: still current.

recordedStart.description:
The attribute holding when the object's version was recorded (its system time's start, docs/adr/0537):
what was known on a day is the versions recorded by then and not yet superseded. `.kcad` schema 90.

start.description: The attribute holding the start (an instant layer's moment).

LeaderArm.description: A leader's arm after its first (docs/adr/0326 §1).

pts.description: At least one: its tip first, then its bends; it ends at the leader's last vertex.

tip.description: The place on an object its tip follows; absent: a free tip.

LeaderArrow.description:
A leader's arrowhead other than the filled triangle (Dolu üçgen,
AutoCAD's Closed filled), which is no value but the field's absence: a
leader has one spelling (docs/adr/0146 §1). The first three are the
first leaders'; the others AutoCAD's arrowheads (docs/adr/0205 §7, `.kcad`
schema 30).

oneOf.description: Açık ok: the filled triangle's two sides (Open).
Dolu nokta: a filled dot (Dot).
Yok: no arrowhead, the line ends at the tip (None).
Boş üçgen: the triangle's outline (Closed blank).
İnce açık ok: two sides 15° off the line (Open 30).
Dik açık ok: two sides square to each other (Open 90, Right angle).
Küçük nokta (Dot small).
Boş nokta: a ring (Dot blank).
Eğik çizgi: a tick across the tip (Oblique).
Mimari çentik: a heavy tick (Architectural tick).
Dolu kare (Box filled).
Boş kare (Box blank).
Dayanak üçgeni: a filled triangle standing on the tip (Datum triangle filled).

LeaderEntity.description:
A leader (docs/adr/0146): an arrowhead at its first vertex, a line
through its vertices and, with a note, a landing from its last vertex
along the note's direction and the note past the landing's end; one
object. The arrowhead and the landing are measured by the note's height.

annotative.description:
Its scales: drawn at the paper height it was given at every scale it takes part in, hidden
at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

arms.description:
Its other arms (docs/adr/0326 §1): each from its own tip through its bends to the leader's last vertex, where
the landing starts; the arrowhead, the note and the look the first arm's.

arrow.description: The arrowhead; absent: a filled arrow.

arrowSize.description:
The arrowhead's length, times the note's height (docs/adr/0205 §7);
absent: 1. From `MIN_LEADER_ARROW` to `MAX_LEADER_ARROW`.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

blocks.description:
Its content blocks (docs/adr/0326 §2): inserts standing in a row at its landing's end, by persistent id; a
leader with blocks has no note.

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

height.description:
The note's height, metres, finite and over 0; the arrowhead and the
landing are measured by it.

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

leaderStyle.description: The leader style it follows (docs/adr/0326 §4), by its id.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

mask.description:
The note's box is filled with the drawing area's colour before the
note is drawn, as a text's mask (docs/adr/0145).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

pts.description: At least two: the arrow's tip first, where the landing starts last.

rotation.description: The note's and the landing's direction, degrees counter-clockwise from east.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

text.description:
The note, one line; absent: the arrow alone, no landing and no note.
Never empty: no note is the field's absence.

tip.description: The place on an object its first arm's tip follows (docs/adr/0326 §3); absent: a free tip.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

LengthStyle.description:
How lengths are written (docs/adr/0262 §2); none (no setting) is decimal
in the drawing's unit. The three are an inch or foot drawing's.

oneOf.description: Decimal in the drawing's unit: no setting, here for a command to say so.

Fields every object has. `id` is the object's local id inside a v1 file.
v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.
