ma.description:
The start's measure (M) on a route, in the route's own unit; absent =
none (docs/adr/0224 §1).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

za.description: The start's elevation, m; absent = none (docs/adr/0142).

zb.description: The end's elevation, m; absent = none.

oneOf.description: Straight, along the line.
Letter by letter, following the line.
Level, on the line.
A contour's height: curved on the line, its top uphill.

LookPart.description: A part of an object's look whose source can be its layer.

LookupRow.description: One row of a lookup: its label and the values it sets.

MergePolicy.description: A field's value in the object merged from several (docs/adr/0419).

oneOf.description: The first object's value.
Empty.
The values' sum, exact to the field's last digit: integers and decimals with fraction digits.
The least value (numbers).
The greatest value (numbers).

NumberRule.description:
The values a number parameter may take: within `min` and `max`, on `step`s from `min` (from 0 without one), one
of `list`; or computed by `expression` from the other number parameters (it is not set then).

NurbsEntity.description:
Fields every object has. `id` is the object's local id inside a v1 file.
v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

attachments.description:

§1); none on a block's objects.

follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

closed.description: Its ends meet (AutoCAD's flag 1); the source's word, kept as written.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

fit.description: The points it was drawn through, kept with it; the control points are the source.

fitTolerance.description: How far the curve may pass from its fit points, ≥ 0 (AutoCAD's 44).

knots.description:
The knot vector: `ctrl.len() + degree + 1` numbers, never decreasing;
the curve runs over `knots[degree] .. knots[ctrl.len()]`, which is not empty.

Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

tangents.description: The fit points' start and end tangent directions; null where none was given.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

weights.description: Each control point's weight, above 0; absent: all 1 (not rational).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

ObjectValue.description: An object's value a field writes.

oneOf.description: A closed object's area, its holes taken off.
A closed object's perimeter.
A line's, an arc's, a path's or a curve's length.
Its layer's name.
Its label.
The attribute named: a block insert's attribute value, else the object's attribute.
A text's letters (a cross reference).
Its east and north: a point's place, a text's, a block's or a table's insertion point, else where its label goes.

ObstacleKind.description: What of an obstacle area a label avoids.

oneOf.description: Its inside: a label covering any of it.
Its outline: a label crossing an edge.

OpeningAnchor.description: Which point of the opening `at` names, along its wall's base line.

oneOf.description: Its jamb nearer the wall's start.
Its jamb nearer the wall's end.

OpeningBreak.description: Why an opening is not where its wall says (docs/adr/0341 §3): it stays, drawn from its jambs, until it is fixed.

oneOf.description: Its wall is gone, or is no wall.
It runs past its wall's end or round one of its corners.
It runs into another opening of its wall.

at.description: The distance along its wall's base line, from its start, to its `anchor`.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

broken.description: Why it is not where its wall says; absent: it is.

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

frame.description: Its frame's width at each jamb, along the wall, metres. Absent: none.

hand.description: Its hinge's end. Absent: its start.

head.description: Its head's height above the floor, metres.

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

place.description:
Its jambs: the start jamb's points on its wall's left and right face, then the end jamb's; written from its
wall by the document.

showSwing.description: The swing's arc is drawn. Absent: it is.

side.description: The side it opens to. Absent: the path's left.

sill.description: Its sill's height above the floor, metres.

style.description: The opening type it was made with, by its id (`builtin_opening_types`).

swing.description: How far a leaf swings open, degrees, above 0, at most 180. Absent: 90.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

width.description: The rough opening in the wall, jamb to jamb, metres.

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

oneOf.description: Kapı.
Pencere.
Boşluk: a gap in the wall and nothing in it.

OpeningHand.description: An end of the opening along its wall: where its hinge is.

oneOf.description: At its jamb nearer the wall's start.
Kanatlı: about a hinge.
Sürme: along the wall.
Sabit: it does not open.

OpeningSide.description: A side of its wall's base line: where its leaves open to.

ParagraphLayout.description:
A multi-line text's indents, tab stops and columns (docs/adr/0324 §1), in its height (MTEXT's `\p` codes):
every paragraph's first line starts `leftIndent + indent` heights from the box's left, its other lines
`leftIndent`; a tab goes to the next stop past where it is, a stop every `DEFAULT_TAB` heights after the last
given; columns take the lines in turn, each `columns.height` metres tall.

columns.description: Static columns; a text in columns has a box.

indent.description: A paragraph's first line from the others', heights; below 0 a hanging indent (a list's). Absent: 0.

leftIndent.description: Every line but a paragraph's first from the box's left, heights. Absent: 0.

tabs.description: The tab stops from the box's left, heights, ascending, each over 0.

ParamValue.description:
A parameter's value: a number (a length, an angle in radians), a point of the definition's coordinates, a flip
or a name (a visibility state, a lookup row).

PasteConflicts.description: What a paste does with a copy's block or style of a name the drawing has (docs/adr/0351 §4).

oneOf.description: This drawing's is used.
The copy's comes in under a free name.

PathEntity.description: Polyline or polygon: vertices, DXF bulges (tan(θ/4), CCW positive) and, for polygons, holes.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

closed.description:
A polyline whose last vertex joins its first: a closed line, not an

input.description:
Input of `cad.entities.paste` v1 (Yapıştır, Özgün koordinatlara yapıştır, Blok olarak yapıştır): the copy
`clip` pasted as one undo step “Yapıştır”, its base point at `at` (absent: where it was copied).

- The layers: each object goes to the layer of this drawing at its layer's path (names compared case and
  Turkish letters aside); a path this drawing lacks is made, with the source's look and its groups.
- The blocks: a definition of a name this drawing has is this drawing's (its own definition is used); the others
  are added.
- The styles: a style of a name this drawing has is this drawing's; the others are added (a project setting).
- The objects take new persistent ids. Their links drop, as when a layer is taken from another drawing: a linked
  label is pasted as a plain text, an associative hatch as a plain hatch, a schedule without its source.
- With `asBlock` the objects become one new block named after it (a free name: “Ad (2)” …), its base the
  copy's base point, placed at `at` on the active layer.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `no_entities` (an empty copy), `invalid_clip` (its ids and
objects do not match, a layer or a block it names is not in it), `not_finite`, `empty_name` (`asBlock`
blank), `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict` (status `conflict`), `layer_locked` (a layer an object would go
to). Warnings: `units_differ` (the source's unit is not this drawing's: sizes kept), `layer_hidden`.

at.description: Where the copy's base point goes; absent: where it was copied (Özgün koordinatlara yapıştır).

A copy's block or style of a name this drawing has (docs/adr/0351 §4): `keep` uses this drawing's, `rename`
brings the copy's under a free name (“Ad (2)” …) and the pasted objects take it; absent: `keep`.

expectedRevision.description:
The document revision the input was prepared against, as decimal text. When given and the document is no
longer at it, nothing is written and the answer is `conflict`.

ArchDiscipline.description: The discipline an architectural object belongs to.

ArchInfo.description:
What every architectural object carries beside its geometry (`CAD-ARCH-03`): its level (by the project level's
id), phase, construction status and discipline; absent fields are not said.

ArchPhase.description: An architectural object's phase (renovation): what is there, what goes, what is new.

ArchStatus.description: Where an architectural object is in its construction.

AreaPart.description:
A part of a multi-part area past its first (docs/adr/0143): its outer
ring in vertex + bulge form, its holes and its vertices' elevations, as
the area's own fields hold the first part's. A multi-part polyline's
part is the same, open and without holes (docs/adr/0174).

ms.description:
A polyline's part's measures, as the polyline's own `ms`
(docs/adr/0224 §1); an area's part has none.

zs.description: Each vertex's elevation, as the area's own `zs` (docs/adr/0142).

Attachment.description:

`asset`, `file` and `url`) and an optional note.

asset.description: Embedded: the project library's PNG or JPEG asset its bytes are.

file.description:
Linked: a file's path, relative to the drawing's folder when it is
relative.

name.description: The name shown (the file's name by default).

note.description: A note shown with it (lines allowed).

url.description: A web address (`http` or `https`).

BreakLine.description: Which of a dimension's lines a break is on.

oneOf.description: The dimension line, from its first end (0) to its second (1).
The first extension line, from the measured point (0) to its far end (1).
The second.

CellField.description: A cell bound to a source (docs/adr/0327 §3): its words are the value last written, `####` when broken.

CellFormula.description: A cell's formula (docs/adr/0327 §2): its words begin with `=`; the cell's words are its result.

CellRange.description: A merged range: `rows` × `cols` cells from row `row`, column `col`.

CellStyle.description:
A style over a range of cells (docs/adr/0327 §1); what it leaves absent the cells take from the styles before it,
then from the table.

color.description: Its words' colour, `#rrggbb`.

decimals.description: The decimals a formula's or a field's number is written with.

fill.description: Its background, `#rrggbb`.

CircleEntity.description:

v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

the field's absence (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: A filled triangle, its tip on the dimension line's end (Dolu ok).
The triangle's two sides (Açık ok).
A filled circle about the end (Nokta).
Nothing at the ends (Yok).

A gap in one of a dimension's lines where another object crosses it (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK), at the fraction `t` of
the line; its width the options' `breakSize`.

angle.description: Linear: measured direction in degrees (0 = ΔY, 90 = ΔX).

annotative.description:
Its scales: drawn at the paper height it was given at every scale it takes part in, hidden
at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

arrowSize.description:
The arrowhead's (or tick's) length; absent: `DEFAULT_TICK` for ticks,
`DEFAULT_ARROW` for the others.

the line starts from (docs/adr/0147).

decimals.description:

project's length decimals (a slope's 2). Angles keep the project's.

dimLineColor.description:

dimLineType.description: The dimension line's type; absent: continuous.

dimLineWeight.description: The dimension line's weight, paper mm as an object's; absent: a hairline.

extWeight.description: The extension lines' weight, paper mm; absent: a hairline.

font.description: The value's typeface; absent: the project's.

their value when the style changes. Empty: each field follows while it holds the style's old value.

prefix.description: Written before the value (and its kind's own prefix).

refs.description: The objects its points follow (docs/adr/0249): an associative dimension; none, free points.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

textColor.description: The value's colour; absent: the object's.

textGap.description: The value's baseline over the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_TEXT_GAP`.

textPlace.description: Where the value stands; absent: over the line.

textShift.description: Its value moved from its place (docs/adr/0321 §1).

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

unit.description: The unit lengths and coordinates are written in; absent: the project's.

za.description: Slope: the two points' elevations, metres (docs/adr/0147).

DimensionFit.description:
Where the value goes when it does not fit between the extension lines (AutoCAD's DIMATFIT and DIMTIX): absent,
always between them.

oneOf.description: Beyond the second extension line when the value and the two arrowheads are longer than the line between them.
Always beyond the second extension line, the arrowheads outside.

DimensionOptions.description: A dimension's options (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2): all absent, the dimension as it always was.

breakSize.description: A break's width, times the value's height, over 0; absent: 1 (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK size).

lengthStyle.description:
Feet and inches in an inch or foot unit (AutoCAD's DIMLUNIT, docs/adr/0262 §2); absent: the project's, unless
the dimension names its own unit.

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

DrawingFont.description:
The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

EllipseEntity.description: DXF ELLIPSE: centre, major axis vector, minor/major ratio, parameters t0 → t1.

oneOf.description: A general NURBS curve: degree, control points, weights and knots (docs/adr/0259).
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144).
An arrow with a note (docs/adr/0146).
Rows and columns of cells (docs/adr/0184).
A picture (docs/adr/0192).
An orthophoto, a scanned sheet or an elevation model (docs/adr/0204).
A point cloud: LAS, LAZ, COPC or text files (docs/adr/0207).
A wall (docs/adr/0339): its path, width, justification and components; its faces drawn from them.

A door, a window or a bare opening in a wall (docs/adr/0341): its wall's id, its place along it and its
jambs' points.
A grid (docs/adr/0343): its line, label and bubbles.
A column (docs/adr/0343): its centre, outline and the grids it stands on.
A stair (docs/adr/0343): its walking line and its risers, treads and landings.
A ramp (docs/adr/0343): its centre line, width, rise and landings.
A tag (docs/adr/0344): its object, its words and frame.
A view mark (docs/adr/0345): a section, elevation or detail mark pointing at a view.

A record without a geometry (docs/adr/0410): a table's row, with the base's attributes,

FieldFormat.description: How a field writes a number.

comma.description: A decimal comma (`24,35`) instead of a point.

unit.description: Absent: the drawing unit for a length or a place, the project's area unit for an area.

name.description: The attribute's name, with `attribute`.

oneOf.description: The project.

name.description: The variable's name, with `variable`; the block's, with `blockCount`.

GeorefMethod.description: A transform from the source's pixels to the drawing (docs/adr/0204 §6).

GeorefOutput.description: A resampled raster's grid: north-up, its corner on a multiple of its pixel (docs/adr/0204 §6).

digest.description: The written file's SHA-256 when it was written.

GeorefPoint.description:
A control or check point: a pixel of the source (column, row; pixel corners, 0, 0 the upper left corner of the
upper left pixel, as GDAL's GCPs) and where it is (`target`, in the record's `srid`).

check.description: A check point: kept out of the fit; its error says how good the fit is where no control point is.

name.description: What the user calls it (a mark on the sheet, a survey point's name).

off.description: Left out (Kullan off): neither fits nor checks; its residual is still shown.

target.description: Its east and north (a geographic system's longitude and latitude, degrees).

GeorefSource.description: The raster the points' pixels are of: what it read and its size.

asset.description: The project library's raster it was (embedded).

digest.description: Its bytes' SHA-256 (64 lowercase hex digits) when they were read: the revision the points belong to.

commands.title: Denetle
commands.summary: Çizimin bozuk ilişkilerini ve kayıp tanımlarını bulur, istenirse onarır; kullanılmayan adlı kaynakları raporlar, istenirse stilleri temizler (AutoCAD'in AUDIT ve PURGE'ü). Bulunanlar: nesnesi olmayan bağlı yazı (brokenLink), sınır nesnesi olmayan ilişkili tarama (brokenHatch), boş bıraktığı yazısı çizimde olmayan tarama (missingCutout) ve kendi bağlı etiketini boş bırakan tarama (hatchTextCycle; döngü), nesnesi olmayan canlı ölçü bağı (brokenDimension), projede olmayan yazı ya da ölçü stili (missingTextStyle, missingDimensionStyle). fix ile onarım tek geri alma adımıdır, “Denetle”: bağ kopar, ilişki kalkar, yazı taramanın listesinden çıkar ve tarama yeniden kesilir, ölçü bağı “nesne yok” nedeniyle kopar, stil Standart olur, görünüş kalır; kilitli katmandaki nesne onarılmaz, uyarılır. Kullanılmayanlar: boş katmanlar ve gruplar, yerleştirilmeyen bloklar (cad.layers.edit'in purge'ünün bulduğu, kilitli olmayanlar), hiçbir nesnenin adını anmadığı yazı ve ölçü stilleri; purge (textStyles, dimensionStyles) stilleri siler, bu bir proje ayarıdır. Retler: invalid_revision; expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

AuditPurge.description: The named resources Denetle removes when nothing uses them.

input.description:
Input of `cad.drawing.audit` v1. Finds what the drawing carries broken (`AuditCode`) and the named resources
nothing uses (empty layers and groups and unplaced block definitions as `cad.layers.edit`'s purge finds them, not
locked ones; the text and dimension styles no object of the drawing or of a block definition names). With `fix`
each broken object is repaired (a linked text loses its link, a hatch its association, a dimension's reference
breaks as `object_gone`, an unknown style becomes Standart, the look kept) as one undo step “Denetle”; an object on
a locked layer is left broken with a warning (`layer_locked`). `purge` removes the unused styles of the kinds named
(the styles' table is a project setting: no undo step). Nothing asked: nothing is written.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`): `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict` (status `conflict`).

expectedRevision.description:
The document revision the input was prepared against, as decimal text. When given and the document is no
longer at it, nothing is written and the answer is `conflict`.

commands.summary: Çizimin şimdiki hâliyle aynı çizimin başka bir hâli arasında ne değiştiğini söyler; çizimi değiştirmez. Öbür hâl (against) açık çizimin geri alma geçmişinde steps adım gerisi (history) ya da bir çizim dosyasıdır (file: mutlak yol, .kcad v2 ya da v1 JSON). Nesneler kalıcı kimlikleriyle eşlenir: şimdi olup öbüründe olmayan eklenmiş (added), öbüründe olup şimdi olmayan silinmiş (removed), ikisinde olup ayrılan değişmiş (changed). Değişim, veri karşılaştırmanın kuralıyla (ADR 0179) bulunur: geometri tolerance (metre; varsayılan 0,001) içinde aynıysa ve öznitelikler eşitse aynı; katman bir öznitelik gibi sayılır (fields'ta layer). Cevap sayıları (same, changed, added, removed) ve kimlik listelerini verir; her liste limit'te kesilir ve truncated bunu söyler. Retler: invalid_tolerance, invalid_limit, no_such_step (geri alma geçmişi o kadar adım tutmuyor), invalid_file_path, file_not_found, import_unreadable.

A drawing file: its absolute path (`.kcad`, v2 or a v1 JSON file).

`file_not_found`, `import_unreadable`, `invalid_limit`.

tolerance.description: How far points may lie apart and the geometry still be the same, metres, 0 to 10; absent: `COMPARE_TOLERANCE`.

commands.title: Nesneleri ötele
commands.summary: Kalıcı kimlikleriyle verilen nesnelerin paralel kopyalarını yapar; kopyalar ve kaynakların silinmesi tek geri alma adımındadır, adı “Ötele”. Girdi sonucun geometrisi değil, istenen öteleme: distance ile mesafe (metre, sıfırdan büyük) ve side noktası (çizgide ve yolda noktaya en yakın kenarın o yanı, daire, yay ve elipste nokta dışarıdaysa büyür, içerideyse küçülür) ya da through ile kopyanın geçeceği nokta (Noktadan geç: mesafe noktanın nesneye uzaklığıdır). bothSides (İki yana) öbür yana da aynı mesafede bir kopya yapar; deleteSource (Kaynağı sil) kopyası yapılan kaynakları aynı adımda siler; layerId kopyaların katmanıdır, verilmezse her kopya kaynağının katmanına gider. Çizgi, çoklu çizgi (yaylarıyla, çok parçalısı parça parça), kapalı alan, daire, yay, elips ve yardımcı çizgi ile ışın ötelenir; diğer türler not_offsettable ile reddedilir. Kopyayı ortak geometri çekirdeği hesaplar: Ötele aracı, Python ve ajan aynı nesneyi aynı mesafeyle öteleyince aynı kopyayı bulur. Kopya kaynağının katmanını, rengini ve çizgi kalınlığını alır; özniteliklerini, etiketini, simgesini ve eklerini almaz; köşeler kaynağın köşelerinin kotunu ve ölçüsünü (M) taşır. Yapılamayan kopya (merkezini geçen daire, içe dönen yay) offset_failed uyarısıyla atlanır; hiçbir kopya yapılamazsa hiçbir şey yazılmaz. Kilitli katmandaki nesne ötelenmez: hiçbir şey yazılmaz. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur. Plan yazmadan kopyaları gösterir; planın sürümüyle yazma planı yazar. Yerel çizim izin istemez; bulut projesine değişiklik project.changes ile gider.

OffsetBy.description: How far the copies go and to which side.

oneOf.description:
`distance` metres (above zero) from each object, on the side of
`side`: the side of a line or a path is judged at its edge nearest
the point; a circle, an arc or an ellipse grows when the point is
outside it and shrinks when inside.

Noktadan geç: each copy passes through `point`, its distance that of
the point from its object's nearest edge (the side is the point's).

Vec2.description: A point in world units: x = east (Y, sağa), y = north (X, yukarı).

input.description:
Input of `cad.entities.offset` v1: parallel copies of the objects named
by their persistent ids (docs/adr/0014), as one undo step “Ötele”. The
Ötele tool gives the object it picked; the command reads no selection,
layer or view (TODOS.md CMD-07). A whole object is offset: the tool picks
objects, not their edges, so there is no sub-object reference in v1.

What is offset: a line, a polyline (with its arcs; a multi-part one part
by part), a closed area (a multi-part one with its parts joined), a
circle, an arc, an ellipse or an elliptical arc, a construction line or a
ray. Each copy is a new object from its source: its layer (or
`layerId`), its colour and its own line weight, not its attributes,
label, symbol or attachments; a vertex takes its source vertex's
elevation and measure. The copies are written in the input's order, each
source's copy on the side asked for first and, with `bothSides`, the one
on the other side next; then, with `deleteSource`, the sources that gave
a copy are deleted in the same step.

A copy that cannot be made (a circle shrunk past its centre, a path
whose arc would turn inside out, the side point on the object with
`bothSides`) is left out with an `offset_failed` warning at `uids[i]`;
when no copy can be made nothing is written and the answer is
`offset_failed`. A repeated id counts once.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `no_entities`,
`invalid_uid` (each id in order), `not_finite` (the distance, then the
point's x and y), `invalid_distance` (a distance not above zero),
`invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict` (status `conflict`),
`entity_not_found` (each id in order), `layer_locked` (an object on a
locked layer, by itself or a group above it, at `uids[i]`: nothing is
written), `not_offsettable` (an object of another kind, at `uids[i]`),
the target layer's `layer_not_found`, `not_a_layer`, `service_layer` and
`layer_locked` at `layerId`, then `offset_failed`; on the desktop also
`slots_exhausted`.

bothSides.description: İki yana: a second copy of each object at the same distance on the other side.

by.description: The distance and the side, or the point the copies pass through.

deleteSource.description: Kaynağı sil: the objects offset are deleted in the same step.

expectedRevision.description:
The document revision the input was prepared against, as decimal text
(from a plan, or the document). When given and the document is no
longer at it, nothing is written and the answer is `conflict`.

layerId.description:
The layer the copies go on (`LayerNode.id`, a layer, not a group);
without it each copy goes on its source's layer.

uids.description: The objects' persistent ids (lowercase UUID text with hyphens), at least one.

removed.description: The sources deleted (`deleteSource`), in the input's order.

revision.description:

Where the value goes when it does not fit between the extension lines (AutoCAD's DIMATFIT and DIMTIX): absent,
always between them.

oneOf.description: Beyond the second extension line when the value and the two arrowheads are longer than the line between them.
Always beyond the second extension line, the arrowheads outside.

breakSize.description: A break's width, times the value's height, over 0; absent: 1 (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK size).

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers

ends; its height above its level; its architectural information. Its faces, ends, component lines and hatches are

commands.summary: Kalıcı kimlikleriyle verilen nesneleri katmanlarının çizim sırasında öne (front, Öne getir) ya da arkaya (back, Arkaya gönder) alır; tek geri alma adımıdır. Nesnenin sırası order alanıdır (yoksa 0); eşitlerde belgenin sırası geçer. Her katmanda öbür nesnelerin en büyük (öne) ya da en küçük (arkaya) sırası bulunur, nesneler onun ötesindeki sıraları kendi aralarındaki sırayla alır. Çizim sırası katmanı aşmaz: katmanların sırası ağacın sırasıdır. Zaten önde (arkada) olan katman değişmez; hiçbir şey değişmezse hiçbir şey yazılmaz. Kilitli katmandaki nesne varsa hiçbir şey yazılmaz (layer_locked). expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

oneOf.description: Öne getir: drawn after every other object of their layer. “Öne getir”.
Arkaya gönder: drawn before every other object of their layer. “Arkaya gönder”.
Nesnenin üstüne: drawn right after the `reference` object (AutoCAD's DRAWORDER Above). “Nesnenin üstüne”.
Nesnenin altına: drawn right before the `reference` object (AutoCAD's DRAWORDER Under). “Nesnenin altına”.

input.description:
Input of `cad.entities.order` v1: the objects' persistent ids and where
they go, as one undo step. For each layer the objects are on, the others'
highest order (to the front) or lowest (to the back) is found, absent
counting 0; the objects take the next orders past it, in their own
drawing order (order, then the document's). A layer whose objects
already are all in front of (or behind) its others does not change; when
nothing changes, nothing is written. The command reads no selection
(TODOS.md CMD-07): Sırala ▾ gives the selection's ids.

Above and under (docs/adr/0310 §3) take the `reference` object, on the
objects' layer: the objects take the orders right after (before) the
reference's, in their own drawing order; the layer's objects drawn after
(before) the reference move together by the same step when there is no
room, so every other pair keeps its order. Objects already right above
(under) it do not change.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `no_entities`,
`invalid_uid`, `invalid_reference` (no reference for above or under, one
for front or back, or the reference among the objects), `invalid_revision`,
`revision_conflict` (status `conflict`), `entity_not_found` (an object or
the reference), `layer_locked` (every object on a locked layer: the first
one's, in the input's order; when only some are, they are left out with the
warning `layer_locked`, docs/adr/0278), `not_same_layer` (an object on
another layer than the reference's), `order_limit` (a layer's orders at the
32-bit bound, −2³¹ or 2³¹ − 1: no room past them).

expectedRevision.description: The document revision the input was prepared against, as decimal text.

reference.description: The object the others go right above or under (its persistent id); only with `above` and `under`.

to.description: To the front or the back, above or under the reference.

uids.description: The objects' persistent ids, at least one; a repeated one counts once.

their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:

(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

commands.summary: Kalıcı kimlikleriyle verilen yazı, ölçü ve kılavuzları ölçekli yapar ve ölçeklerini düzenler; tek geri alma adımıdır. Ölçekli nesne katıldığı her ölçekte kâğıtta aynı yükseklikte çizilir: kendi geometrisi annotative.at ölçeğindeki (yapıldığında projenin çizim ölçeği) temsilidir, diğer ölçeklerde ölçek/at kadar büyür, o ölçeğin ayrı değerleriyle (yazının ve notun yeri ve doğrultusu, ölçünün çizgisinin uzaklığı ve değerinin yeri); katılmadığı ölçekte çizilmez. Paftanın haritası her nesneyi kendi ölçeğinde çizer. make (Ölçekli yap; scales eklenir), unmake (tek yükseklik, nesnenin kendisi), add ve remove (scales; kendi ölçeği kaldırılmaz: own_scale), set (scale ölçeğinde point, rotation; ölçüde offset, textShift), reset (scales ya da bütün diğer ölçeklerde ayrı değer kalmaz). Ölçekli olmayan ya da olamayan nesne (eğri boyunca yazı, bağlı yazı, diğer türler) not_annotative uyarısıyla atlanır, hiçbiri kalmazsa ret; kilitli katmandakiler layer_locked uyarısıyla atlanır. Çizim ölçeği değişince ölçekli nesnenin kendi geometrisi yeni ölçeğin temsili olur, eski ölçeği diğer ölçeklerine geçer; ölçekli olmayan nesneler eskisi gibi izler. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

oneOf.description:
Ölçekli yap: the objects' own geometry is their representation at the project's plot scale;
`scales` are added. One annotative already only takes the scales. “Ölçekli yap”.
Ölçekliliği kaldır: one height again, the object's own; its other scales are dropped. “Ölçekliliği kaldır”.
Ölçek ekle: the objects take part in `scales` too, as their own scale draws them, scaled. “Ölçek ekle”.
Ölçek kaldır: the objects are not drawn at `scales` any more; their own scale stays (`own_scale`). “Ölçek kaldır”.

Ölçekteki yeri: at `scale`, the given values (`point`, `rotation`; a dimension's `offset`,
`textShift`) set apart from the object's own. “Ölçekteki yeri”.
Ölçeği sıfırla: at `scales` (none: every other scale) nothing set apart. “Ölçeği sıfırla”.

input.description:
Input of `cad.annotations.scales` v1 (docs/adr/0323 §4). The command reads
no selection (TODOS.md CMD-07): the Properties panel and the tool give the ids.

Objects that are not texts, dimensions or leaders (or are texts along a
curve, or linked to an object) are left out with the warning
`not_annotative`, as are those not annotative for every other operation
but `make`; when none is left, it is the refusal. What is on a locked layer
is left out with the warning `layer_locked` (docs/adr/0278). An object that
would not change is not written.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `no_entities`,
`invalid_uid`, `no_scales` (`add` and `remove` without `scales`), `no_scale`
(`set` without `scale`), `invalid_scale` (a scale not over 0, not finite, or
past 1:1 000 000), `no_value` (`set` without a value), `invalid_revision`,
`revision_conflict` (status `conflict`), `entity_not_found`, `layer_locked`,
`not_annotative`, `own_scale` (removing or setting an object's own scale),
`scale_not_taken` (`set` at a scale an object does not take part in),
`invalid_annotative` (a value its kind does not have: a text's offset, a
dimension's point; more than 32 scales).

commands.summary: Açık çizimde verilen katmana bir NURBS eğrisi ekler; tek geri alma adımıdır. by.kind control (Denetim noktalı): derece, denetim noktaları, isteğe bağlı ağırlıklar ve düğümler; düğüm verilmezse uçlara sıkıştırılmış eşit aralıklı düğümler kurulur, eğri ilk ve son denetim noktasından geçer. by.kind fit (Geçiş noktalı): eğrinin sırayla geçeceği noktalar ve derece (verilmezse 3; nokta sayısından küçük olur); komut kiriş uzunluğuyla parametreler, ortalanmış düğümler ve çözülen denklem sistemiyle eğriyi kurar (Piegl ve Tiller'ın global interpolasyonu), noktalar eğrinin geçiş noktaları olarak saklanır. closed: true eğriyi kendi üstüne düzgünce kapatır (periyodik): denetim noktalarında ilk derece kadar nokta sona sarılır, geçiş noktalarında son nokta ilkine bağlanır; kapalı eğriye düğüm verilmez. Eğriyi ortak geometri çekirdeği kurar: araç, Python ve ajan aynı noktalarla aynı eğriyi bulur. Katman girdide açıkça verilir: kilitli katmana yazılmaz, gizli katmana uyarıyla yazılır. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur. Plan yazmadan eğriyi gösterir.

input.description:
Input of `cad.nurbs.create` v1: one NURBS curve on a named layer,
written as one undo step. The curve tools give what was drawn: the
control points or the points it passes, the degree, whether it is
closed; the command computes the curve (TODOS.md CMD-07: it reads no
active layer, colour or view).

An open curve by control points keeps them as given, with the knots
given or clamped and uniform. A closed one wraps its first `degree`
control points after the last and takes uniform knots: a periodic
curve, as smooth where it closes as anywhere. A curve through points
takes chord-length parameters and averaged knots (Piegl and Tiller's
global interpolation; a closed one periodic, its knots the parameters,
or their midpoints when the degree is even) and passes through every
point; the points are kept with it as its fit points.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `not_finite` (a
coordinate, weight or knot, at its place), `coincident_points` (two
points in a row at one place; a closed curve's last and first too),
`invalid_nurbs` (a degree, count or knot vector that makes no curve),
`invalid_line_weight`, `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict` (status
`conflict`), `layer_not_found`, `not_a_layer`, `layer_locked`; on the
desktop also `slots_exhausted`. Warning: `layer_hidden`.

On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

closed.description: Its ends meet (AutoCAD's flag 1); the source's word, kept as written.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

fit.description: The points it was drawn through, kept with it; the control points are the source.

fitTolerance.description: How far the curve may pass from its fit points, ≥ 0 (AutoCAD's 44).

knots.description:
The knot vector: `ctrl.len() + degree + 1` numbers, never decreasing;
the curve runs over `knots[degree] .. knots[ctrl.len()]`, which is not empty.

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

linePattern.description:

`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:

(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

order.description:

document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

tangents.description: The fit points' start and end tangent directions; null where none was given.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

weights.description: Each control point's weight, above 0; absent: all 1 (not rational).

wipeout.description:

what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

ParagraphLayout.description:
A multi-line text's indents, tab stops and columns (docs/adr/0324 §1), in its height (MTEXT's `\p` codes):
every paragraph's first line starts `leftIndent + indent` heights from the box's left, its other lines
`leftIndent`; a tab goes to the next stop past where it is, a stop every `DEFAULT_TAB` heights after the last
given; columns take the lines in turn, each `columns.height` metres tall.

columns.description: Static columns; a text in columns has a box.

indent.description: A paragraph's first line from the others', heights; below 0 a hanging indent (a list's). Absent: 0.

commands.title: Duvar oluştur
commands.summary: Açık çizimde verilen katmana duvarlar ekler; tek geri alma adımı “Duvar”. Her duvar çizildiği yolla verilir: köşeler, kenar başına büküm (yay), kapalı ya da açık. Genişlik (m), hiza (left: yol duvarın sol yüzü, center: ortası, right: sağ yüzü; yolun gidişine göre) ve öteleme (yol, hiza çizgisinden sola) duvarın gövdesinin yolun neresinde durduğunu söyler. style projenin ya da KentOS'un duvar stilidir (kimliği ya da adı): bileşenleri (sıva, tuğla, yalıtım …), uçları ve şematik dolgusu duvara geçer; KentOS'un stili aynı adımda projeye eklenir. Bileşenlerin hepsinin kalınlığı belliyse genişlik onların toplamıdır, biri kalınlıksızsa genişliğin kalanını o alır. Duvarın yüzleri, uçları, bileşen çizgileri ve taramaları yoldan çizilir, saklanmaz; ayrıntısı çizimin ölçeğine göredir. Yayı duvarın yüzünden dar olan duvar yazılmaz (wall_collapses). arch duvarın katını (projenin katlarından), evresini, yapım durumunu ve disiplinini taşır. Katman girdide açıkça verilir: kilitli katmana yazılmaz, gizli katmana uyarıyla yazılır. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz. Plan yazmadan duvarları gösterir.

input.description:
Input of `cad.walls.create` v1: walls on a named layer, along their paths, written as one undo step “Duvar”. The
wall tool gives the path clicked and the width, justification, offset and style chosen (TODOS.md CMD-07: it reads
no active layer, colour or style).

A wall of a style takes the style's components, ends and fill; its width is the style's when all its components
have their thickness, else the input's (the style's new width when absent), the rest going to the component
without one. A style of KentOS's own is taken into the project's wall styles in the same step.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `no_objects` (no wall), `not_finite` (a coordinate, bulge
or length, at its place), `coincident_points`, `style_not_found`, `invalid_wall` (the path, the width, the offset
or the components), `wall_collapses` (an arc tighter than a face), `level_not_found`, `invalid_line_weight`,
`invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict` (status `conflict`), `layer_not_found`, `not_a_layer`, `layer_locked`; on
the desktop also `slots_exhausted`. Warning: `layer_hidden`.

expectedRevision.description: The document revision the input was prepared against, as decimal text; another one writes nothing (`conflict`).

lineType.description: Their own line type. Absent: the layer's.

lineWeight.description: Their own line weight, paper mm (0 to 100). Absent: the layer's.

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

drawn from these (`geom::wall` of the shared core), at the detail the drawing's scale asks.

commands.summary: Çizimin çizgilerinden duvar yapar; tek geri alma adımı “Çizgiden duvar”. mode each (Tek tek): her çizgi, açık ya da kapalı çoklu çizgi (yayları da), kapalı alanın dış halkası, yay ve daire boyunca verilen genişlik, hiza ve stille bir duvar. mode pairs (Çiftler): düz çizgiler (çizgi, iki köşeli çoklu çizgi) eşlenir, en yakını önce: doğrultuları angle dereceden (verilmezse 1°) az farklı, aralarındaki uzaklık en çok maxWidth (verilmezse 0,6 m) ve izdüşümleri örtüşen iki çizgi; duvar örtüşen kısımda ikisinin ortasından, ilk çizginin yönünde, aralarındaki uzaklık genişliğinde, ortası yolda. Eşi bulunmayan çizgi söylenir (wall_unpaired). Kaynak çizgiler keepSources verilmezse silinir; duvarın bütünüyle örtmediği kaynak kalır ve söylenir (source_kept). Duvar türünden olmayan nesne bırakılır (not_a_wall_path). Duvarlar layerId verilmişse o katmana, verilmemişse her biri kaynağının katmanına yazılır. Plan yazmadan duvarları ve silinecek kaynakları gösterir.

WallJustify.description:
Where the wall's body lies across its path (AutoCAD Architecture's justification): `Left`, the path is the wall's
left face and the body to its right; `Center`, the path is its middle; `Right`, the path is its right face.

oneOf.description: Tek tek: a wall along each line, polyline, area's ring, arc or circle.

Çiftler: two parallel straight lines at most `maxWidth` apart, overlapping, a wall between them as wide as they
are apart, along the first's direction over their overlap.

input.description:
Input of `cad.walls.convert` v1 (`CAD-ARCH-09`): walls from the drawing's line work, one undo step “Çizgiden
duvar”; the sources are taken away unless kept, those a wall does not cover whole are kept (`source_kept`).

Tek tek (`each`): a line, an open or closed polyline (its arcs too), an area's outer ring, an arc and a circle each
give one wall along it, of the width, justification and style given; another kind is left (`not_a_wall_path`).

Çiftler (`pairs`): straight lines (a line, a polyline of two vertices) are paired, the nearest first: two whose
directions are within `angle` degrees, at most `maxWidth` apart and whose projections overlap; the wall runs along
the first line's direction over the overlap, midway between them, as wide as they are apart, centred. Lines left
without a pair are reported (`wall_unpaired`).

Refusals: `no_entities`, `invalid_uid`, `entity_not_found`, `not_a_wall_path` (no source a wall is drawn along),
`wall_unpaired` (no pair in pairs mode), `not_finite`, `style_not_found`, `invalid_wall`, `wall_collapses`,
`invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict`, `layer_not_found`, `not_a_layer`, `layer_locked`. Warnings:
`not_a_wall_path`, `wall_unpaired`, `source_kept`, `layer_hidden`.

angle.description: Pairs: degrees two lines may be apart and be parallel. Absent: 1°.

keepSources.description: Kaynağı koru: the sources stay. Absent: those a wall covers whole go.

layerId.description: The layer the walls go on. Absent: each source's own.

maxWidth.description: Pairs: the widest wall, metres. Absent: 0.6 m.

style.description: A wall style by its id or name. Absent: plain walls.

uids.description: The sources' persistent ids, at least one.

width.description: Each mode's width, metres. Absent: the style's new width, else 0.2 m.

left.description: The sources no wall was drawn from: another kind, or a line without a pair.

removed.description: The sources taken away.

uids.description: The walls written, in the sources' order (a pair's at its first line's place).

The objects a hatch follows (docs/adr/0186 §6, 0328 §3): a hatch made inside a closed object follows the

(`bounds`: the objects whose line work bounds it, its islands' too) follows that line work; the point clicked
inside picks the region's part or face. Exactly one of `outer` and `bounds` is given.

to `t1` (radians): counter-clockwise when `t1` is past `t0`, clockwise when before it; a whole ellipse
`t1 = t0 ± 2π`.
A NURBS curve run whole, from its first knot to its last.

InsertEntity.description:
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144): its definition drawn

definition's x axis when `mirror`, then scaled and turned about `p`. The
transform is a similarity, shapes keeping their kind, unless the insert
has a y factor of its own (docs/adr/0315 §3): then an affine, a circle
becoming the exact ellipse of its image. The insert's own attributes
carry the values of the definition's attribute definitions.

LeaderArrow.description:
A leader's arrowhead other than the filled triangle (Dolu üçgen,
AutoCAD's Closed filled), which is no value but the field's absence: a
leader has one spelling (docs/adr/0146 §1). The first three are the
first leaders'; the others AutoCAD's arrowheads (docs/adr/0205 §7, `.kcad`
schema 30).

oneOf.description: Açık ok: the filled triangle's two sides (Open).
Dolu nokta: a filled dot (Dot).
Yok: no arrowhead, the line ends at the tip (None).
Boş üçgen: the triangle's outline (Closed blank).
İnce açık ok: two sides 15° off the line (Open 30).
Dik açık ok: two sides square to each other (Open 90, Right angle).
Küçük nokta (Dot small).
Boş nokta: a ring (Dot blank).
Eğik çizgi: a tick across the tip (Oblique).
Mimari çentik: a heavy tick (Architectural tick).
Dolu kare (Box filled).
Boş kare (Box blank).
Dayanak üçgeni: a filled triangle standing on the tip (Datum triangle filled).

along the note's direction and the note past the landing's end; one
object. The arrowhead and the landing are measured by the note's height.

drawn from these (`geom::wall` of the shared core), at the detail the drawing's scale asks.

commands.summary: Kalıcı kimlikleriyle verilen duvarların kendi alanlarını değiştirir; tek geri alma adımı “Duvarı düzenle”, hepsi ya da hiçbiri. operation.kind set: genişlik, hiza, öteleme, stil (kimliği ya da adı; null stilsiz tek gövde), uçlar, şematik dolgu, yükseklik, kat (projenin katlarından), evre, yapım durumu ve disiplin; verilmeyenler kalır, null olanlar kalkar. Stilin bileşenleri duvara geçer; bileşenlerin sığmadığı genişlik ya da yayı yeni genişlikte çizilemeyen duvar yazılmaz. split (Böl): her duvar yolunun at noktasına en yakın yerinde ikiye; nokta duvarın iki yüzü arasında olmalı (point_off_wall), uçta olmaz (split_at_end); kapalı duvar orada açılır. join (Birleştir): uçları 1 mm içinde buluşan, alanları aynı iki ya da daha çok duvar tek duvar olur, ilk verilenin kimliğiyle (ters yöndeki gövdesi yerinde çevrilir; walls_not_touching, walls_differ); uçları buluşursa kapanır. extend (Uzat): her duvarın ucu (end, verilmezse to duvarına yakın olanı) son kenarının doğrultusunda to duvarının yoluna dek; trim (Buda): her duvar to duvarının yolunu kestiği yerde kısalır, keep noktasına en yakın parça (verilmezse uzun olanı) kalır (wall_misses, wall_closed). flip (Çevir): yol ters döner, gövde yolun öbür yanına aynalanır, uçların birleşimi yer değiştirir. replaceStyle (Stili değiştir): from stilindeki duvarlar (uids boşsa çizimin bütün duvarları) to stilini alır (style_not_used). joins (Birleşim): başlangıcın ve sonun birleşimi (auto, none, miter, butt, through) ve bileşen temizliği (cleanup); resetJoins ikisini de kurala döndürür. Birleşimler duvarlardan çizilir, aynı adımda izler; düzenlemeden sonra birleşmeyen duvarlar uyarıda onaran öneriyle söylenir (wall_join_overlap, wall_join_crowded, wall_join_acute, wall_join_unresolved). Plan yazmadan duvarları gösterir.

ArchDiscipline.description: The discipline an architectural object belongs to.

Vec2.description: A point in world units: x = east (Y, sağa), y = north (X, yukarı).

WallCaps.description: Whether an open wall's ends are closed by a line across it.

WallJoin.description:
How one end of a wall joins another (docs/adr/0340 §1, `CAD-ARCH-07`): by the rule; not at all (its end line
drawn); at a corner mitred; butting the other (it stops at the other's face); running through it (the other butts).

WallJustify.description:
Where the wall's body lies across its path (AutoCAD Architecture's justification): `Left`, the path is the wall's
left face and the body to its right; `Center`, the path is its middle; `Right`, the path is its right face.

oneOf.description: Değiştir: the fields given, on every wall named.

fill.description: The schematic fill (`#RRGGBB`); null: none.

height.description: Metres above its level's floor; null: the level's.

level.description: Its level by the project level's id; null: none.

style.description: A wall style by its id or name: its components, ends and fill; null: no style, one plain body.

width.description: Metres, above 0, at most 100; the component without a thickness takes the rest.

oneOf.description:
Böl: each wall named cut in two where its path passes nearest `at` (a point on the wall, within its body);
a closed wall opened there. The second part is a new wall with the first's fields; the parts join inline.

Birleştir: two walls or more whose path ends meet (within 1 mm) and whose fields are the same (a wall the other
way round reversed with its body in place) made one, the first named keeping its id; their ends meeting at the
last closes it.

Uzat: each wall's end (the one given, else the nearer to `to`) run on along its last edge's direction to where
it meets the path of the wall `to` (its persistent id), so the two join there.

Buda: each wall cut back where its path crosses the path of the wall `to`: the part `keep` is nearest stays
(absent: the longer).

Çevir: each wall's path reversed with its fields as they are: its body mirrored about its path (its layers
facing the other way), its start's and end's joins swapped.

Stili değiştir: the walls of the style `from` (its id or name) given the style `to` (the project's or KentOS's
own, taken in): the named ones, or with no ids every wall of `from` in the drawing.
Birleşim: the ends' joins (a closed wall has none) and the components' cleanup, the ones given.
Birleşimleri sıfırla: both ends by the rule, the cleanup on.

input.description:
Input of `cad.walls.edit` v1: walls named by their persistent ids changed as one undo step “Duvarı düzenle”, all
or none. A width a style's components do not fit, an arc a new width collapses, a level the project does not have:
nothing is written. Their joins with the walls round them follow in the same step (they are drawn from the walls);
what then does not join is said (`wall_join_overlap`, `wall_join_crowded`, `wall_join_acute`,
`wall_join_unresolved`, each with its fix).

Refusals: `no_entities`, `invalid_uid`, `entity_not_found`, `not_a_wall`, `nothing_to_set`, `not_finite`,
`style_not_found`, `style_not_used`, `invalid_wall`, `wall_collapses`, `level_not_found`, `point_off_wall`,
`split_at_end`, `walls_not_touching`, `walls_differ`, `too_few_objects`, `wall_closed`, `no_crossing`,
`invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict`, `layer_locked`; on the desktop also `slots_exhausted`.

AreaPart.description:
A part of a multi-part area past its first (docs/adr/0143): its outer
ring in vertex + bulge form, its holes and its vertices' elevations, as

part is the same, open and without holes (docs/adr/0174).

ms.description:
A polyline's part's measures, as the polyline's own `ms`
(docs/adr/0224 §1); an area's part has none.

zs.description: Each vertex's elevation, as the area's own `zs` (docs/adr/0142).

file.description:

note.description: A note shown with it (lines allowed).

url.description: A web address (`http` or `https`).

oneOf.description: The dimension line, from its first end (0) to its second (1).

CellField.description: A cell bound to a source (docs/adr/0327 §3): its words are the value last written, `####` when broken.

CellFormula.description: A cell's formula (docs/adr/0327 §2): its words begin with `=`; the cell's words are its result.

CellRange.description: A merged range: `rows` × `cols` cells from row `row`, column `col`.

CellStyle.description:

fill.description: Its background, `#rrggbb`.

breakSize.description: A break's width, times the value's height, over 0; absent: 1 (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK size).

lengthStyle.description:

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

DrawingFont.description:
The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

EllipseEntity.description: DXF ELLIPSE: centre, major axis vector, minor/major ratio, parameters t0 → t1.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

labelPins.description:

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineWeight.description:

(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

order.description:

document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

Entity.description: Any drawing object, tagged by `kind` as in the TypeScript model.

oneOf.description: A general NURBS curve: degree, control points, weights and knots (docs/adr/0259).
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144).
An arrow with a note (docs/adr/0146).
Rows and columns of cells (docs/adr/0184).
A picture (docs/adr/0192).
An orthophoto, a scanned sheet or an elevation model (docs/adr/0204).
A point cloud: LAS, LAZ, COPC or text files (docs/adr/0207).
A wall (docs/adr/0339): its path, width, justification and components; its faces drawn from them.

A door, a window or a bare opening in a wall (docs/adr/0341): its wall's id, its place along it and its
jambs' points.
A grid (docs/adr/0343): its line, label and bubbles.
A column (docs/adr/0343): its centre, outline and the grids it stands on.
A stair (docs/adr/0343): its walking line and its risers, treads and landings.
A ramp (docs/adr/0343): its centre line, width, rise and landings.
A tag (docs/adr/0344): its object, its words and frame.
A view mark (docs/adr/0345): a section, elevation or detail mark pointing at a view.

A record without a geometry (docs/adr/0410): a table's row, with the base's attributes,
attachments and label; not drawn, picked or snapped to.

comma.description: A decimal comma (`24,35`) instead of a point.

decimals.description: Absent: the project's length or area decimals.

unit.description: Absent: the drawing unit for a length or a place, the project's area unit for an area.

GeorefMethod.description: A transform from the source's pixels to the drawing (docs/adr/0204 §6).

GeorefOutput.description: A resampled raster's grid: north-up, its corner on a multiple of its pixel (docs/adr/0204 §6).

digest.description: The written file's SHA-256 when it was written.

GeorefPoint.description:
A control or check point: a pixel of the source (column, row; pixel corners, 0, 0 the upper left corner of the
upper left pixel, as GDAL's GCPs) and where it is (`target`, in the record's `srid`).

check.description: A check point: kept out of the fit; its error says how good the fit is where no control point is.

name.description: What the user calls it (a mark on the sheet, a survey point's name).

off.description: Left out (Kullan off): neither fits nor checks; its residual is still shown.

target.description: Its east and north (a geographic system's longitude and latitude, degrees).

GeorefSource.description: The raster the points' pixels are of: what it read and its size.

asset.description: The project library's raster it was (embedded).

digest.description: Its bytes' SHA-256 (64 lowercase hex digits) when they were read: the revision the points belong to.

file.description: The file it was (linked), as kept.

url.description: The address it was read from.

oneOf.description: From one side of the hatch to the other along `angle`.

HatchAssoc.description:
The objects a hatch follows (docs/adr/0186 §6, 0328 §3): a hatch made inside a closed object follows the
object (`outer`), its islands, the texts and inserts left open; a hatch made in the face line work closes
(`bounds`: the objects whose line work bounds it, its islands' too) follows that line work; the point clicked
inside picks the region's part or face. Exactly one of `outer` and `bounds` is given.

bounds.description: The objects whose line work closes its face (docs/adr/0328 §3).

gap.description: A face's tie: the gaps its line work was closed across, metres (docs/adr/0329 §3); absent: none.

HatchCurve.description: A boundary edge that is no line or circular arc (docs/adr/0328 §1).

oneOf.description:
An ellipse's arc: centre `c`, major semi-axis `major` (from `c`), minor to major `ratio`, from parameter `t0`
to `t1` (radians): counter-clockwise when `t1` is past `t0`, clockwise when before it; a whole ellipse
`t1 = t0 ± 2π`.
A NURBS curve run whole, from its first knot to its last.

v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

annotative.description:
Its scales (docs/adr/0331 §3): an annotative hatch's pattern is drawn at each scale it takes part in as large
on paper as at its own; absent: one pattern for every scale.

assoc.description: The objects its region follows (docs/adr/0186 §6); none: it stays as drawn.

the ring and holes are all it has.

HatchLoop.description:
One closed loop of a hatch's boundary as its source holds it (docs/adr/0328 §1): edge `i` runs from `pts[i]` to
the next point (the last to the first); it is straight, a circular arc of `bulges[i]` (tan(θ/4), counter-clockwise
positive, as a polygon's), or the curve `curves[i]` (an ellipse's arc or a NURBS curve), whose ends are those
points. A loop of one point is one closed curve.

angle.description:

gradient.description: A gradient's shape and second colour.

spacing.description: Metres between the lines (lines, cross); 1 and unread for the others.

InsertEntity.description:
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144): its definition drawn
moved from the definition's base point to `p`, mirrored in the
definition's x axis when `mirror`, then scaled and turned about `p`. The
transform is a similarity, shapes keeping their kind, unless the insert
has a y factor of its own (docs/adr/0315 §3): then an affine, a circle
becoming the exact ellipse of its image. The insert's own attributes
carry the values of the definition's attribute definitions.

pts.description: At least one: its tip first, then its bends; it ends at the leader's last vertex.

tip.description: The place on an object its tip follows; absent: a free tip.

LeaderArrow.description:
A leader's arrowhead other than the filled triangle (Dolu üçgen,
AutoCAD's Closed filled), which is no value but the field's absence: a
leader has one spelling (docs/adr/0146 §1). The first three are the
first leaders'; the others AutoCAD's arrowheads (docs/adr/0205 §7, `.kcad`
schema 30).

oneOf.description: Açık ok: the filled triangle's two sides (Open).
Dolu nokta: a filled dot (Dot).
Yok: no arrowhead, the line ends at the tip (None).
Boş üçgen: the triangle's outline (Closed blank).
İnce açık ok: two sides 15° off the line (Open 30).
Dik açık ok: two sides square to each other (Open 90, Right angle).
Küçük nokta (Dot small).
Boş nokta: a ring (Dot blank).
Eğik çizgi: a tick across the tip (Oblique).
Mimari çentik: a heavy tick (Architectural tick).
Dolu kare (Box filled).
Boş kare (Box blank).
Dayanak üçgeni: a filled triangle standing on the tip (Datum triangle filled).

LeaderEntity.description:
A leader (docs/adr/0146): an arrowhead at its first vertex, a line
through its vertices and, with a note, a landing from its last vertex
along the note's direction and the note past the landing's end; one
object. The arrowhead and the landing are measured by the note's height.

annotative.description:

at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

arms.description:
Its other arms (docs/adr/0326 §1): each from its own tip through its bends to the leader's last vertex, where
the landing starts; the arrowhead, the note and the look the first arm's.

arrow.description: The arrowhead; absent: a filled arrow.

arrowSize.description:

absent: 1. From `MIN_LEADER_ARROW` to `MAX_LEADER_ARROW`.

AreaPart.description:

part is the same, open and without holes (docs/adr/0174).

ms.description:
A polyline's part's measures, as the polyline's own `ms`
(docs/adr/0224 §1); an area's part has none.

zs.description: Each vertex's elevation, as the area's own `zs` (docs/adr/0142).

note.description: A note shown with it (lines allowed).

url.description: A web address (`http` or `https`).

oneOf.description: The dimension line, from its first end (0) to its second (1).
The first extension line, from the measured point (0) to its far end (1).
The second.

CellField.description: A cell bound to a source (docs/adr/0327 §3): its words are the value last written, `####` when broken.

CellFormula.description: A cell's formula (docs/adr/0327 §2): its words begin with `=`; the cell's words are its result.

CellRange.description: A merged range: `rows` × `cols` cells from row `row`, column `col`.

CellStyle.description:

then from the table.

color.description: Its words' colour, `#rrggbb`.

decimals.description: The decimals a formula's or a field's number is written with.

fill.description: Its background, `#rrggbb`.

The triangle's two sides (Açık ok).

angle.description: Linear: measured direction in degrees (0 = ΔY, 90 = ΔX).

annotative.description:

at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

arrowSize.description:

`DEFAULT_ARROW` for the others.

Where the value goes when it does not fit between the extension lines (AutoCAD's DIMATFIT and DIMTIX): absent,
always between them.

oneOf.description: Beyond the second extension line when the value and the two arrowheads are longer than the line between them.
Always beyond the second extension line, the arrowheads outside.

DimensionOptions.description: A dimension's options (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2): all absent, the dimension as it always was.

breakSize.description: A break's width, times the value's height, over 0; absent: 1 (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK size).

lengthStyle.description:
