the dimension names its own unit.

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

name.description: Its label (A, B … 1, 2 …), on the wire `name`: an object's own `label` is another field.

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

pts.description: Its start and end.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

HatchAssoc.description:
The objects a hatch follows (docs/adr/0186 §6, 0328 §3): a hatch made inside a closed object follows the
object (`outer`), its islands, the texts and inserts left open; a hatch made in the face line work closes
(`bounds`: the objects whose line work bounds it, its islands' too) follows that line work; the point clicked
inside picks the region's part or face. Exactly one of `outer` and `bounds` is given.

bounds.description: The objects whose line work closes its face (docs/adr/0328 §3).

gap.description: A face's tie: the gaps its line work was closed across, metres (docs/adr/0329 §3); absent: none.

HatchCurve.description: A boundary edge that is no line or circular arc (docs/adr/0328 §1).

oneOf.description:
An ellipse's arc: centre `c`, major semi-axis `major` (from `c`), minor to major `ratio`, from parameter `t0`
to `t1` (radians): counter-clockwise when `t1` is past `t0`, clockwise when before it; a whole ellipse
`t1 = t0 ± 2π`.
A NURBS curve run whole, from its first knot to its last.

HatchEntity.description:
Fields every object has. `id` is the object's local id inside a v1 file.
v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

annotative.description:
Its scales (docs/adr/0331 §3): an annotative hatch's pattern is drawn at each scale it takes part in as large
on paper as at its own; absent: one pattern for every scale.

assoc.description: The objects its region follows (docs/adr/0186 §6); none: it stays as drawn.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

boundary.description:
Its boundary as its source holds it (docs/adr/0328 §1): the outer loop, then the holes', lines, arcs,
ellipses' arcs and NURBS curves exact; `ring` and `holes` are drawn from it (arcs and curves as chords). None:
the ring and holes are all it has.

HatchLoop.description:
One closed loop of a hatch's boundary as its source holds it (docs/adr/0328 §1): edge `i` runs from `pts[i]` to
the next point (the last to the first); it is straight, a circular arc of `bulges[i]` (tan(θ/4), counter-clockwise
positive, as a polygon's), or the curve `curves[i]` (an ellipse's arc or a NURBS curve), whose ends are those
points. A loop of one point is one closed curve.

angle.description:

pattern's turn (pattern), the gradient's direction (gradient).

gradient.description: A gradient's shape and second colour.

name.description: A pattern's name (`ANSI31`).

origin.description:

scale.description: A pattern's metres per unit of its definition.

spacing.description: Metres between the lines (lines, cross); 1 and unread for the others.

oneOf.description: User-defined lines at `angle`, `spacing` apart.

InsertEntity.description:
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144): its definition drawn
moved from the definition's base point to `p`, mirrored in the
definition's x axis when `mirror`, then scaled and turned about `p`. The
transform is a similarity, shapes keeping their kind, unless the insert
has a y factor of its own (docs/adr/0315 §3): then an affine, a circle
becoming the exact ellipse of its image. The insert's own attributes
carry the values of the definition's attribute definitions.

§1); none on a block's objects.

attributePlaces.description:
Where this insert shows a movable attribute (docs/adr/0317 §1): its tag's text at this point of the
definition's coordinates rather than the definition's. Only a movable attribute's tag; absent: every text where
the definition puts it.

tip.description: The place on an object its tip follows; absent: a free tip.

LeaderArrow.description:
A leader's arrowhead other than the filled triangle (Dolu üçgen,
AutoCAD's Closed filled), which is no value but the field's absence: a
leader has one spelling (docs/adr/0146 §1). The first three are the
first leaders'; the others AutoCAD's arrowheads (docs/adr/0205 §7, `.kcad`
schema 30).

oneOf.description: Açık ok: the filled triangle's two sides (Open).
Dolu nokta: a filled dot (Dot).
Yok: no arrowhead, the line ends at the tip (None).
Boş üçgen: the triangle's outline (Closed blank).
İnce açık ok: two sides 15° off the line (Open 30).
Dik açık ok: two sides square to each other (Open 90, Right angle).
Küçük nokta (Dot small).
Boş nokta: a ring (Dot blank).
Eğik çizgi: a tick across the tip (Oblique).
Mimari çentik: a heavy tick (Architectural tick).
Dolu kare (Box filled).
Boş kare (Box blank).
Dayanak üçgeni: a filled triangle standing on the tip (Datum triangle filled).

LeaderEntity.description:
A leader (docs/adr/0146): an arrowhead at its first vertex, a line
through its vertices and, with a note, a landing from its last vertex
along the note's direction and the note past the landing's end; one
object. The arrowhead and the landing are measured by the note's height.

annotative.description:
Its scales: drawn at the paper height it was given at every scale it takes part in, hidden
at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

arms.description:
Its other arms (docs/adr/0326 §1): each from its own tip through its bends to the leader's last vertex, where
the landing starts; the arrowhead, the note and the look the first arm's.

arrow.description: The arrowhead; absent: a filled arrow.

arrowSize.description:
The arrowhead's length, times the note's height (docs/adr/0205 §7);
absent: 1. From `MIN_LEADER_ARROW` to `MAX_LEADER_ARROW`.

ParagraphLayout.description:
A multi-line text's indents, tab stops and columns (docs/adr/0324 §1), in its height (MTEXT's `\p` codes):
every paragraph's first line starts `leftIndent + indent` heights from the box's left, its other lines
`leftIndent`; a tab goes to the next stop past where it is, a stop every `DEFAULT_TAB` heights after the last
given; columns take the lines in turn, each `columns.height` metres tall.

columns.description: Static columns; a text in columns has a box.

commands.summary: Verilen duvarların (uids boşsa çizimin bütün duvarlarının) çevrelerindeki duvarlarla birleşimlerini söyler: köşe (corner: gönye ya da alın), düz devam (inline), T (tee: duvarın ucu öbürünün içinde) ve kesişme (cross); her birleşimin yeri ve duvarları (uçlarıyla). Buluşup birleşmeyen duvarlar issues'tadır: aynı doğrultuda üst üste (wall_join_overlap), ikiden çok uç bir doğruda değil (wall_join_crowded), köşe çok dar (wall_join_acute), çizgiler kesilemedi (wall_join_unresolved); her birinin ne olduğu, nasıl onarılacağı ve fix: olduğu gibi cad.walls.edit'e verilecek bir girdi (bir ucun birleşimi). T'de bağlanan duvarın bileşenleri öncelikleri (1 en güçlü) konağınkinden güçlü oldukça geçer; temizlik kapalıysa yalnız yüzler buluşur. Çizimi değiştirmez; plan aynı cevabı verir.

WallsEdit.description:
Input of `cad.walls.edit` v1: walls named by their persistent ids changed as one undo step “Duvarı düzenle”, all
or none. A width a style's components do not fit, an arc a new width collapses, a level the project does not have:
nothing is written. Their joins with the walls round them follow in the same step (they are drawn from the walls);
what then does not join is said (`wall_join_overlap`, `wall_join_crowded`, `wall_join_acute`,
`wall_join_unresolved`, each with its fix).

Refusals: `no_entities`, `invalid_uid`, `entity_not_found`, `not_a_wall`, `nothing_to_set`, `not_finite`,
`style_not_found`, `style_not_used`, `invalid_wall`, `wall_collapses`, `level_not_found`, `point_off_wall`,
`split_at_end`, `walls_not_touching`, `walls_differ`, `too_few_objects`, `wall_closed`, `no_crossing`,
`invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict`, `layer_locked`; on the desktop also `slots_exhausted`.

oneOf.description: Değiştir: the fields given, on every wall named.

fill.description: The schematic fill (`#RRGGBB`); null: none.

height.description: Metres above its level's floor; null: the level's.

level.description: Its level by the project level's id; null: none.

style.description: A wall style by its id or name: its components, ends and fill; null: no style, one plain body.

width.description: Metres, above 0, at most 100; the component without a thickness takes the rest.

oneOf.description:
Böl: each wall named cut in two where its path passes nearest `at` (a point on the wall, within its body);
a closed wall opened there. The second part is a new wall with the first's fields; the parts join inline.

Birleştir: two walls or more whose path ends meet (within 1 mm) and whose fields are the same (a wall the other
way round reversed with its body in place) made one, the first named keeping its id; their ends meeting at the
last closes it.

Uzat: each wall's end (the one given, else the nearer to `to`) run on along its last edge's direction to where
it meets the path of the wall `to` (its persistent id), so the two join there.

Buda: each wall cut back where its path crosses the path of the wall `to`: the part `keep` is nearest stays
(absent: the longer).

Çevir: each wall's path reversed with its fields as they are: its body mirrored about its path (its layers
facing the other way), its start's and end's joins swapped.

Stili değiştir: the walls of the style `from` (its id or name) given the style `to` (the project's or KentOS's
own, taken in): the named ones, or with no ids every wall of `from` in the drawing.
Birleşim: the ends' joins (a closed wall has none) and the components' cleanup, the ones given.
Birleşimleri sıfırla: both ends by the rule, the cleanup on.

or none. A width a style's components do not fit, an arc a new width collapses, a level the project does not have:

what then does not join is said (`wall_join_overlap`, `wall_join_crowded`, `wall_join_acute`,
`wall_join_unresolved`, each with its fix).

Refusals: `no_entities`, `invalid_uid`, `entity_not_found`, `not_a_wall`, `nothing_to_set`, `not_finite`,
`style_not_found`, `style_not_used`, `invalid_wall`, `wall_collapses`, `level_not_found`, `point_off_wall`,

oneOf.description:
Böl: each wall named cut in two where its path passes nearest `at` (a point on the wall, within its body);
a closed wall opened there. The second part is a new wall with the first's fields; the parts join inline.

Birleştir: two walls or more whose path ends meet (within 1 mm) and whose fields are the same (a wall the other
way round reversed with its body in place) made one, the first named keeping its id; their ends meeting at the
last closes it.

Uzat: each wall's end (the one given, else the nearer to `to`) run on along its last edge's direction to where
it meets the path of the wall `to` (its persistent id), so the two join there.

Buda: each wall cut back where its path crosses the path of the wall `to`: the part `keep` is nearest stays
(absent: the longer).

Çevir: each wall's path reversed with its fields as they are: its body mirrored about its path (its layers
facing the other way), its start's and end's joins swapped.

Stili değiştir: the walls of the style `from` (its id or name) given the style `to` (the project's or KentOS's
own, taken in): the named ones, or with no ids every wall of `from` in the drawing.
Birleşim: the ends' joins (a closed wall has none) and the components' cleanup, the ones given.
Birleşimleri sıfırla: both ends by the rule, the cleanup on.

commands.title: Mahal oluştur
commands.summary: Mahaller (odalar) ekler; tek geri alma adımı “Mahal”. Her mahal ya duvarlardan bulunur (seed: duvarlarla çevrili bir iç nokta; sınırı duvarların yüzlerinden, kapı boşlukları kapalı sayılarak, delikleriyle bulunur ve duvar değişince belge yeniden bulur) ya da sınırı çizilir (parts: dış halka ve delikler, birden çok parça olabilir). method sınırın neyi gösterdiğidir: net (iç yüzler), centerline (duvar eksenleri: her kenar duvarın yarı kalınlığı kadar duvara kayar), gross (dış yüzler: tam kalınlık); verilmezse projenin yöntemi (settings.arch.spaceMethod), o da yoksa net. number, name, usage, arch (kat, evre), height (yoksa katın), finishes (döşeme, duvar, tavan kaplaması) ve katmanın tipli alanlarıyla öznitelikler. Alan, çevre ve hacim sınırdan ölçülür; yöntemin bir mevzuata uyduğu söylenmez. Kapanmayan duvarlarda mahal yazılmaz (space_not_enclosed). Katman açıkça verilir; kilitli katmana yazılmaz, gizli katmana uyarıyla yazılır. Plan yazmadan mahalleri sınırlarıyla gösterir.

On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

closed.description: Its ends meet (AutoCAD's flag 1); the source's word, kept as written.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

fit.description: The points it was drawn through, kept with it; the control points are the source.

fitTolerance.description: How far the curve may pass from its fit points, ≥ 0 (AutoCAD's 44).

knots.description:
The knot vector: `ctrl.len() + degree + 1` numbers, never decreasing;
the curve runs over `knots[degree] .. knots[ctrl.len()]`, which is not empty.

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

linePattern.description:

`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:

(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

order.description:

document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

tangents.description: The fit points' start and end tangent directions; null where none was given.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

weights.description: Each control point's weight, above 0; absent: all 1 (not rational).

wipeout.description:

what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

ParagraphLayout.description:
A multi-line text's indents, tab stops and columns (docs/adr/0324 §1), in its height (MTEXT's `\p` codes):
every paragraph's first line starts `leftIndent + indent` heights from the box's left, its other lines
`leftIndent`; a tab goes to the next stop past where it is, a stop every `DEFAULT_TAB` heights after the last
given; columns take the lines in turn, each `columns.height` metres tall.

columns.description: Static columns; a text in columns has a box.

indent.description: A paragraph's first line from the others', heights; below 0 a hanging indent (a list's). Absent: 0.

commands.summary: Kalıcı kimlikleri verilen mahalleri değiştirir; tek geri alma adımı “Mahali düzenle”, hepsi ya da hiçbiri. operation: set (numara, ad, kullanım, yöntem, kat, evre, yükseklik, kaplamalar; null alanı kaldırır; duvarlardan bulunan mahalin yöntemi değişince sınırı yeniden bulunur), merge (mahaller birleşir: ilki kimliğini korur, öbürleri silinir; birleşen sınır çizilmiş olur; değmeyen mahaller spaces_not_touching), split (line: iki ya da daha çok nokta; mahal çizgiyle bölünür, en büyük parça kimliğini korur, öbürleri aynı alanlarla yeni mahaller; bölmeyen çizgi split_missed), rebound (sınır duvarlardan yeniden bulunur: seed verilirse ondan, yoksa kendi tohumundan, o da yoksa etiket noktasından; çizilmiş mahal duvarlardan bulunan olur). Cevap kept (kimliği korunanlar), added (yeni mahaller) ve removed (silinenler) ile söyler. Kilitli katmandaki mahal bütün değişikliği reddeder. Plan yazmadan mahalleri olacakları gibi gösterir.

ArchPhase.description: An architectural object's phase (renovation): what is there, what goes, what is new.

SpaceMethod.description: What a space's rings stand for (docs/adr/0342 §1): the walls' inner faces, their centre lines or their outer faces.

oneOf.description: Değiştir: the fields given, on every space named.

method.description: The method its boundary is found again with (a space from the walls) or its rings stand for (a drawn one).

oneOf.description: Birleştir: the spaces named one, the first's id kept; its boundary drawn.
Böl: each space named cut along the line `line` (two points or more); the largest part keeps its id.

Duvarlardan bul: each space's boundary found again from the walls round `seed` (absent: its own seed, else
its pole of inaccessibility).

Vec2.description: A point in world units: x = east (Y, sağa), y = north (X, yukarı).

input.description:
Input of `cad.spaces.edit` v1: spaces named by their persistent ids changed as one undo step “Mahali düzenle”, all
or none.

Refusals: `no_entities`, `invalid_uid`, `entity_not_found`, `not_a_space`, `nothing_to_set`, `not_finite`,
`invalid_space`, `level_not_found`, `too_few_objects`, `spaces_not_touching`, `split_missed`, `space_not_enclosed`,
`invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict`, `layer_locked`; on the desktop also `slots_exhausted`.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

relative.

name.description: The name shown (the file's name by default).

note.description: A note shown with it (lines allowed).

url.description: A web address (`http` or `https`).

BreakLine.description: Which of a dimension's lines a break is on.

oneOf.description: The dimension line, from its first end (0) to its second (1).
The first extension line, from the measured point (0) to its far end (1).
The second.

CellField.description: A cell bound to a source (docs/adr/0327 §3): its words are the value last written, `####` when broken.

CellFormula.description: A cell's formula (docs/adr/0327 §2): its words begin with `=`; the cell's words are its result.

CellRange.description: A merged range: `rows` × `cols` cells from row `row`, column `col`.

CellStyle.description:
A style over a range of cells (docs/adr/0327 §1); what it leaves absent the cells take from the styles before it,
then from the table.

color.description: Its words' colour, `#rrggbb`.

decimals.description: The decimals a formula's or a field's number is written with.

fill.description: Its background, `#rrggbb`.

CircleEntity.description:
Fields every object has. `id` is the object's local id inside a v1 file.
v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

byLayer.description:

follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

labelPins.description:

linePattern.description:

DimensionArrow.description:

oneOf.description: A filled triangle, its tip on the dimension line's end (Dolu ok).
The triangle's two sides (Açık ok).
A filled circle about the end (Nokta).
Nothing at the ends (Yok).

DimensionBreak.description:
A gap in one of a dimension's lines where another object crosses it (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK), at the fraction `t` of
the line; its width the options' `breakSize`.

angle.description: Linear: measured direction in degrees (0 = ΔY, 90 = ΔX).

annotative.description:

at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

arrowSize.description:
The arrowhead's (or tick's) length; absent: `DEFAULT_TICK` for ticks,
`DEFAULT_ARROW` for the others.

decimals.description:

dimLineColor.description:

dimLineType.description: The dimension line's type; absent: continuous.

dimLineWeight.description: The dimension line's weight, paper mm as an object's; absent: a hairline.

prefix.description: Written before the value (and its kind's own prefix).

refs.description: The objects its points follow (docs/adr/0249): an associative dimension; none, free points.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

textColor.description: The value's colour; absent: the object's.

textGap.description: The value's baseline over the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_TEXT_GAP`.

textPlace.description: Where the value stands; absent: over the line.

textShift.description: Its value moved from its place (docs/adr/0321 §1).

unit.description: The unit lengths and coordinates are written in; absent: the project's.

za.description: Slope: the two points' elevations, metres (docs/adr/0147).

DimensionFit.description:
Where the value goes when it does not fit between the extension lines (AutoCAD's DIMATFIT and DIMTIX): absent,
always between them.

oneOf.description: Beyond the second extension line when the value and the two arrowheads are longer than the line between them.
Always beyond the second extension line, the arrowheads outside.

DimensionOptions.description: A dimension's options (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2): all absent, the dimension as it always was.

breakSize.description: A break's width, times the value's height, over 0; absent: 1 (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK size).

lengthStyle.description:
Feet and inches in an inch or foot unit (AutoCAD's DIMLUNIT, docs/adr/0262 §2); absent: the project's, unless
the dimension names its own unit.

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

DrawingFont.description:
The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

A tag (docs/adr/0344): its object, its words and frame.
A view mark (docs/adr/0345): a section, elevation or detail mark pointing at a view.

A record without a geometry (docs/adr/0410): a table's row, with the base's attributes,

digest.description: The written file's SHA-256 when it was written.

check.description: A check point: kept out of the fit; its error says how good the fit is where no control point is.

name.description: What the user calls it (a mark on the sheet, a survey point's name).

off.description: Left out (Kullan off): neither fits nor checks; its residual is still shown.

target.description: Its east and north (a geographic system's longitude and latitude, degrees).

GeorefSource.description: The raster the points' pixels are of: what it read and its size.

asset.description: The project library's raster it was (embedded).

digest.description: Its bytes' SHA-256 (64 lowercase hex digits) when they were read: the revision the points belong to.

file.description: The file it was (linked), as kept.

url.description: The address it was read from.

The objects a hatch follows (docs/adr/0186 §6, 0328 §3): a hatch made inside a closed object follows the

inside picks the region's part or face. Exactly one of `outer` and `bounds` is given.

An ellipse's arc: centre `c`, major semi-axis `major` (from `c`), minor to major `ratio`, from parameter `t0`
to `t1` (radians): counter-clockwise when `t1` is past `t0`, clockwise when before it; a whole ellipse
`t1 = t0 ± 2π`.
A NURBS curve run whole, from its first knot to its last.

commands.title: Metraj
commands.summary: Çizimin mahallerini, duvarlarını ve açıklıklarını kaynak geometriden ölçer; çizimi değiştirmez. Mahal: numara, ad, kullanım, kat, yöntem, alan (halkaların alanı, delikler düşülür), çevre, yükseklik (kendi, yoksa katın), hacim; duvarlardan bulunanda üç yöntemin alanı ayrı (byMethod). Duvar: stil, kat, uzunluk (taban çizgisi), kalınlık, yükseklik, brüt yüzey (uzunluk × yükseklik), açıklıkların alanı, net yüzey, hacim (net yüzey × kalınlık), açıklıklarının kimlikleri. Açıklık: biçim, tür, numara, duvarı, genişlik, yükseklik (lento − denizlik), alan. Her satır kuralını (rule) söyler; toplamlar satırların sırasıyla toplanır. levels, phases, usages ve layers verilen kat, evre, kullanım ve katmanlarla süzer (usages verilince yalnız mahaller).

commands.title: Aks
commands.summary: Akslar ekler; tek geri alma adımı “Aks”. grids: her biri iki nokta (pts; bulges ile yaylı), etiket (label), balonlar (bubbles: both, start, end, none) ve balon çapı (bubbleSize, kâğıtta mm; yoksa 8). series: paralel akslar: ilki from → to, her sonraki spacings'teki aralık kadar side (left, right) yana; ilk etiket start. Etiket verilmezse bir öncekinin sıradakidir: harfler A … H, J … N, P … Z, AA (I ve O atlanır), sayılar 1, 2 …; çağrının ilki çizimin son aksından sonrakini, aks yoksa A alır. Aksın çizimi (kesikli çizgi, balonlar, etiket) alanlarından türer. Katman açıkça verilir; kilitli katmana yazılmaz, gizli katmana uyarıyla yazılır.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

commands.title: Kolon
commands.summary: Kolonlar ekler; tek geri alma adımı “Kolon”. columns: her biri merkez (at) ya da iki aks (grids: kalıcı kimlikler; kolon kesişimlerinde durur, at verilirse ona en yakın kesişimde), biçim (shape: rect, round), en (width), boy (depth; yoksa en), dönüş (rotation, radyan), tür (type), etiket (tag), dolu (fill). crossings: verilen aksların her çiftinin, ikisinin de içinde kalan kesişimlerinde birer kolon; aynı ölçülerle. Etiketsiz kolonlar tagStart'tan artarak etiketlenir (S1, S2 …). Akslara bağlı kolonun yerini belge izler: aks taşınınca kolon kesişimde kalır, konum yazısı (place) iki aksın etiketlerinden “B-3” olur; aks silinir ya da akslar kesişmezse broken: gridGone. Katman açıkça verilir; kilitli katmana yazılmaz, gizli katmana uyarıyla yazılır.

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).

mask.description:
The text's box is filled with the drawing area's colour before the
text is drawn (Netcad's “fon”): what lies under it does not show.

oblique.description:
How far its letters lean, degrees, positive with their tops to the
right; within ±`MAX_OBLIQUE`, never 0 (upright is the field's absence).

order.description:

document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

overrides.description: The fields set apart from its style by hand (docs/adr/0322 §5), by name (`TEXT_OVERRIDES`), as a dimension's.

path.description:

in its own frame; absent: a straight text.

rotation.description: Degrees, counter-clockwise from east.

runs.description:
The letters' formats: ranges of the text's Unicode scalar values (not
UTF-16 units), in order, not overlapping, each with a format; a run
with no format is not written, and touching runs of one format are one.
Absent: none.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

textStyle.description: The project's text style it follows, by its id; absent: Standart.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

widthFactor.description:

broken.description: Why its value cannot be read; its letters are then `####`. Absent: it reads.

format.description: How a number is written; absent: the project's decimals and unit.

start.description:

TextPath.description:
The curve a text's letters stand on (docs/adr/0196 §1). Its vertices are
in the text's own frame: `p` its start, x along the text's `rotation`, y
square to it on the left, metres. The first vertex is `p` itself and is
not written; `pts` are the ones after it. The frame carries the curve with
the text when it moves, turns or scales.

bulges.description:

DXF's tan(θ/4), counter-clockwise positive; as many as `pts`. Absent:

pts.description: The vertices after `p`, at least one.

script.description: Raised or lowered, at 0.6 of the height; absent: on the line.

drawn from these (`geom::wall` of the shared core), at the detail the drawing's scale asks.

commands.title: Merdiven
commands.summary: Merdivenler ekler; tek geri alma adımı “Merdiven”. Her biri yürüme çizgisi (pts: 2 nokta düz, 3 L, 4 U; yolun yönü çıkış yönüdür), genişlik, rıht sayısı (risers), rıht yüksekliği (riserHeight), basamak derinliği (tread), dönüşteki sahanlığın boyu (landing; yoksa genişlik), kesme çizgisinin rıhtı (cut), basamak numaraları (numbering). Basamak çizgileri başlangıçtan tread aralıkla, sahanlıkları atlayarak çizilir. Uymayanlar uyarıdır, ret değildir: yol rıhtlara yetmiyorsa stair_short, uzunsa stair_long; 2 × rıht + basamak 0,60–0,65 m dışındaysa stair_step_rule (yalnız bilgi); katın yüksekliği biliniyorsa rıht sayısı × rıht onu tutmuyorsa stair_rise_level. Hiçbir söz yönetmeliğe uyum söylemez. Katman açıkça verilir; kilitli katmana yazılmaz, gizli katmana uyarıyla yazılır.

input.description:
Input of `cad.stairs.create` v1 (“Merdiven”): stairs on a named layer, as one undo step. How their fields fit
(`stair_short`, `stair_long`, `stair_step_rule`, `stair_rise_level`) are warnings.

Refusals, in this order: `no_objects`, `not_finite`, `invalid_stair`, `level_not_found`, `invalid_line_weight`, `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict`, `layer_not_found`, `not_a_layer`,
`layer_locked`, `invalid_attribute`, `attribute_required`; on the desktop also `slots_exhausted`.
Warnings: `layer_hidden`, `stair_short`, `stair_long`, `stair_step_rule`, `stair_rise_level`.

the field's absence (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: A filled triangle, its tip on the dimension line's end (Dolu ok).
The triangle's two sides (Açık ok).
A filled circle about the end (Nokta).
Nothing at the ends (Yok).

DimensionBreak.description:
A gap in one of a dimension's lines where another object crosses it (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK), at the fraction `t` of
the line; its width the options' `breakSize`.

DimensionEntity.description:
Fields every object has. `id` is the object's local id inside a v1 file.
v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

angle.description: Linear: measured direction in degrees (0 = ΔY, 90 = ΔX).

annotative.description:
Its scales: drawn at the paper height it was given at every scale it takes part in, hidden
at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

arrowSize.description:
The arrowhead's (or tick's) length; absent: `DEFAULT_TICK` for ticks,
`DEFAULT_ARROW` for the others.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

breaks.description: The gaps in its lines where other objects cross them (docs/adr/0321 §1).

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

c.description:
Angular: the vertex. Arc length: the arc's centre. Jogged: the centre
the line starts from (docs/adr/0147).

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

decimals.description:
A length's, a coordinate's or a slope's decimals; absent: the
project's length decimals (a slope's 2). Angles keep the project's.

dimLineColor.description:
The dimension line's and its arrowheads' colour, `#RRGGBB`; absent:
the object's (docs/adr/0205 §6).

dimLineType.description: The dimension line's type; absent: continuous.

dimLineWeight.description: The dimension line's weight, paper mm as an object's; absent: a hairline.

dimStyle.description: The project's dimension style it follows, by its id; absent: Standart.

extBeyond.description: How far the extension lines pass the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_BEYOND`.

extColor.description: The extension lines' colour; absent: the object's.

extLineType.description: The extension lines' type; absent: continuous.

extOffset.description: The extension lines' gap from the measured points; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_OFFSET`.

extWeight.description: The extension lines' weight, paper mm; absent: a hairline.

font.description: The value's typeface; absent: the project's.

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

mask.description:
The value is drawn over the drawing's background (docs/adr/0147, as a
text's mask, docs/adr/0145).

options.description: Where the value goes when it does not fit and how it is written (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

overrides.description:
The fields set apart from its style by hand (docs/adr/0322 §5), by name (`DIMENSION_OVERRIDES`): they keep
their value when the style changes. Empty: each field follows while it holds the style's old value.

prefix.description: Written before the value (and its kind's own prefix).

refs.description: The objects its points follow (docs/adr/0249): an associative dimension; none, free points.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

textColor.description: The value's colour; absent: the object's.

textGap.description: The value's baseline over the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_TEXT_GAP`.

textPlace.description: Where the value stands; absent: over the line.

textShift.description: Its value moved from its place (docs/adr/0321 §1).

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

unit.description: The unit lengths and coordinates are written in; absent: the project's.

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

za.description: Slope: the two points' elevations, metres (docs/adr/0147).

DimensionFit.description:
Where the value goes when it does not fit between the extension lines (AutoCAD's DIMATFIT and DIMTIX): absent,
always between them.

oneOf.description: Beyond the second extension line when the value and the two arrowheads are longer than the line between them.
Always beyond the second extension line, the arrowheads outside.

DimensionOptions.description: A dimension's options (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2): all absent, the dimension as it always was.

breakSize.description: A break's width, times the value's height, over 0; absent: 1 (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK size).

lengthStyle.description:
Feet and inches in an inch or foot unit (AutoCAD's DIMLUNIT, docs/adr/0262 §2); absent: the project's, unless
the dimension names its own unit.

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

DrawingFont.description:
The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

commands.title: Rampa
commands.summary: Rampalar ekler; tek geri alma adımı “Rampa”. Her biri orta çizgi (pts: 2–4 nokta), genişlik, toplam yükseklik (rise), eğim (slope, yüzde; yoksa yükseklik ve eğimli uzunluktan), başlangıç kotu (base; yoksa 0), dönüşteki sahanlığın boyu (landing; yoksa genişlik). Uçlarında kot yazısı (+0.00 gibi), eğimli kollarında ok. Verilen eğim yükseklik bölü eğimli uzunluktan 0,1 puandan çok farklıysa ramp_slope_mismatch, sahanlıklar bütün uzunluğu alıyorsa ramp_no_run uyarısı; ret değildir. Katman açıkça verilir; kilitli katmana yazılmaz, gizli katmana uyarıyla yazılır.

input.description:
Input of `cad.ramps.create` v1 (“Rampa”): ramps on a named layer, as one undo step. A slope that does not fit
(`ramp_slope_mismatch`) and landings with no sloped run left (`ramp_no_run`) are warnings.

Refusals, in this order: `no_objects`, `not_finite`, `invalid_ramp`, `level_not_found`, `invalid_line_weight`, `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict`, `layer_not_found`, `not_a_layer`,
`layer_locked`, `invalid_attribute`, `attribute_required`; on the desktop also `slots_exhausted`.
Warnings: `layer_hidden`, `ramp_slope_mismatch`, `ramp_no_run`.

curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

How much of a wall is drawn (`CAD-ARCH-12`), the least first: `Schematic` its outline and its style's fill,

WallEntity.description:
A wall (`CAD-ARCH-01`, `02`): its path, the base line it was drawn along, with arcs as a polyline's bulges (one per
vertex, as the document keeps a polyline's: an open wall's last is 0); its width; where its body lies across the
justification line (the path moved `offset` to its left); the components it is built of, from its left face; its
ends; its height above its level; its architectural information. Its faces, ends, component lines and hatches are
drawn from these (`geom::wall` of the shared core), at the detail the drawing's scale asks.

commands.title: Mimari nesneyi düzenle
commands.summary: Kalıcı kimlikleri verilen aks, kolon, merdiven ve rampaları değiştirir; tek geri alma adımı “Mimari nesneyi düzenle”, hepsi ya da hiçbiri. operation: set (türün alanları: aksın label, bubbles, bubbleSize; kolonun shape, width, depth, rotation, type, tag, fill; merdivenin width, risers, riserHeight, tread, landing, cut, numbering; rampanın width, rise, slope, base, landing; hepsinin level, phase; null alanı kaldırır; nesnenin türünde olmayan alan field_not_for_kind), renumber (akslar ya da kolonlar, tek tür, verildiği sırayla start'tan; aks etiketi değişince bağlı kolonların konum yazısı da), attach (kolonları iki aksın kesişimine bağlar, merkezlerine en yakın kesişime), detach (bağı koparır, kolon yerinde kalır). Kilitli katmandaki nesne bütün değişikliği reddeder. Merdiven ve rampanın denetimleri uyarıdır. Plan yazmadan nesneleri olacakları gibi gösterir.

oneOf.description: Numarala: the grids' labels or the columns' tags `start` and on, in the order given (all of one kind).
Akslara bağla: each column to the crossing of these two grids (nearest its centre).
Bağı kopar: each column off its grids, staying where it is.

input.description:
Input of `cad.arch.edit` v1: grids, columns, stairs and ramps named by their persistent ids changed as one undo step
“Mimari nesneyi düzenle”, all or none.

Refusals: `no_entities`, `invalid_uid`, `entity_not_found`, `not_arch_element`, `nothing_to_set`,
`field_not_for_kind`, `mixed_kinds`, `not_finite`, `invalid_grid`, `invalid_column`, `invalid_stair`, `invalid_ramp`,
`not_a_grid`, `grids_parallel`, `level_not_found`, `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict`, `layer_locked`.
Warnings: those of the stairs and ramps written.

curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:

(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

commands.title: Etiket
commands.summary: Nesnelere etiket koyar; tek geri alma adımı “Etiket”. Her etiket nesnesinin kalıcı kimliğiyle (of) verilir: açıklık, mahal, kolon, aks, duvar, merdiven, rampa ya da blok; başka nesne not_taggable. content şablondur: {number}, {type}, {form}, {width}, {height}, {sill}, {head}, {name}, {usage}, {area}, {perimeter}, {level}, {phase}, {tag}, {place}, {label}, {style}, {risers}, {slope} ve {attr:Ad}, satırlar \n ile, en çok 6 satır; verilmezse türün şablonu (açıklıkta {number}, mahalde {number}, {name} ve {area} üç satır, kolonda {tag}, aksta {label}, duvarda {style}, merdivende {risers}, rampada {slope}, blokta {attr:NO}). shape çerçevedir (circle, hexagon, rectangle, rounded, none; verilmezse açıklıkta altıgen, mahalde dikdörtgen, ötekilerde daire), size yazının kâğıttaki yüksekliği (mm, verilmezse 2,5), leader çerçeveden nesnenin bağ noktasına çizgi. at verilmezse mahalde bağ noktası, ötekilerde onun 4 yazı yüksekliği üstü. all verilen türlerin etiketsiz ve görünen nesnelerine etiket koyar. Etiketin yazısı ve bağ noktası belgenindir: nesne değişince aynı adımda yeniden yazılır, nesne taşınınca etiket de taşınır, nesne silinince etiket son yazısıyla targetGone kalır. Katman açıkça verilir; kilitli katmana yazılmaz, gizli katmana uyarıyla yazılır.

What every architectural object carries beside its geometry (`CAD-ARCH-03`): its level (by the project level's
id), phase, construction status and discipline; absent fields are not said.

ArchPhase.description: An architectural object's phase (renovation): what is there, what goes, what is new.

ArchStatus.description: Where an architectural object is in its construction.

AreaPart.description:
A part of a multi-part area past its first (docs/adr/0143): its outer
ring in vertex + bulge form, its holes and its vertices' elevations, as
the area's own fields hold the first part's. A multi-part polyline's
part is the same, open and without holes (docs/adr/0174).

ms.description:
A polyline's part's measures, as the polyline's own `ms`
(docs/adr/0224 §1); an area's part has none.

zs.description: Each vertex's elevation, as the area's own `zs` (docs/adr/0142).

Attachment.description:
One of an object's attachments: its name, its source (exactly one of
`asset`, `file` and `url`) and an optional note.

asset.description: Embedded: the project library's PNG or JPEG asset its bytes are.

file.description:
Linked: a file's path, relative to the drawing's folder when it is
relative.

name.description: The name shown (the file's name by default).

note.description: A note shown with it (lines allowed).

url.description: A web address (`http` or `https`).

BreakLine.description: Which of a dimension's lines a break is on.

oneOf.description: The dimension line, from its first end (0) to its second (1).
The first extension line, from the measured point (0) to its far end (1).
The second.

CellField.description: A cell bound to a source (docs/adr/0327 §3): its words are the value last written, `####` when broken.

CellFormula.description: A cell's formula (docs/adr/0327 §2): its words begin with `=`; the cell's words are its result.

CellRange.description: A merged range: `rows` × `cols` cells from row `row`, column `col`.

CellStyle.description:
A style over a range of cells (docs/adr/0327 §1); what it leaves absent the cells take from the styles before it,
then from the table.

color.description: Its words' colour, `#rrggbb`.

decimals.description: The decimals a formula's or a field's number is written with.

fill.description: Its background, `#rrggbb`.

CircleEntity.description:
Fields every object has. `id` is the object's local id inside a v1 file.
v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

byLayer.description:

labelPins.description:

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

index shown, its values (coordinates; moments in milliseconds since 1970

DimensionArrow.description:
A dimension's arrowheads other than the oblique tick, which is no value but

oneOf.description: A filled triangle, its tip on the dimension line's end (Dolu ok).
The triangle's two sides (Açık ok).
A filled circle about the end (Nokta).

DimensionBreak.description:
A gap in one of a dimension's lines where another object crosses it (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK), at the fraction `t` of
the line; its width the options' `breakSize`.

angle.description: Linear: measured direction in degrees (0 = ΔY, 90 = ΔX).

annotative.description:
Its scales: drawn at the paper height it was given at every scale it takes part in, hidden
at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

arrowSize.description:
The arrowhead's (or tick's) length; absent: `DEFAULT_TICK` for ticks,
`DEFAULT_ARROW` for the others.

decimals.description:

dimLineColor.description:

dimLineWeight.description: The dimension line's weight, paper mm as an object's; absent: a hairline.

prefix.description: Written before the value (and its kind's own prefix).

refs.description: The objects its points follow (docs/adr/0249): an associative dimension; none, free points.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

textColor.description: The value's colour; absent: the object's.

textGap.description: The value's baseline over the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_TEXT_GAP`.

textPlace.description: Where the value stands; absent: over the line.

DimensionFit.description:
Where the value goes when it does not fit between the extension lines (AutoCAD's DIMATFIT and DIMTIX): absent,
always between them.

oneOf.description: Beyond the second extension line when the value and the two arrowheads are longer than the line between them.
Always beyond the second extension line, the arrowheads outside.

DimensionOptions.description: A dimension's options (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2): all absent, the dimension as it always was.

breakSize.description: A break's width, times the value's height, over 0; absent: 1 (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK size).

lengthStyle.description:
Feet and inches in an inch or foot unit (AutoCAD's DIMLUNIT, docs/adr/0262 §2); absent: the project's, unless
the dimension names its own unit.

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

DrawingFont.description:
The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

Dolu nokta: a filled dot (Dot).

Dolu kare (Box filled).
Boş kare (Box blank).
Dayanak üçgeni: a filled triangle standing on the tip (Datum triangle filled).

Öznitelik tablosu: these objects' attributes.

A CSV or Excel file by its name (and sheet). Linked (docs/adr/0327 §5): its path (absolute, or from the
drawing's folder), the SHA-256 of the bytes last read, the cells they gave (the embedded copy: what a cell
changed by hand differs from) and what is done with such a cell; unlinked, it is chosen again to update.

Blok çizelgesi (docs/adr/0327 §4): the inserts of the blocks named (none named: every block placed) counted,
by the attribute `by` when given; written again by the document at every step.

Kapı ve pencere, mahal, kolon ya da duvar çizelgesi (docs/adr/0344 §3): the objects of `of` that the filter
takes, a row each (alike ones one row when grouped), in the columns' order, sorted, with a total; written again
by the document at every step, which writes `members` too: each data row's objects by their persistent ids.

TagBreak.description: Why a tag's words are no longer its object's.

oneOf.description: Its object is gone.

anchor.description: The point of its object it ties to, which the document writes.

at.description: Its middle.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,

content.description: Its template; absent: its object's kind's.

labelPins.description:

§3.7), one a class at most.

leader.description: A line from its frame to the point it ties to.

linePattern.description:

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:

of.description: The object it tags, by its persistent id.

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

size.description: Its words' height on paper, millimetres; absent: 2.5.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

text.description: Its words: its template filled with its object's values, which the document writes.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

TextAlign.description:
Which point of a text its `p` is (docs/adr/0145 §1): horizontally its
left, centre or right; vertically on its baseline, at its bottom (0.2 of
its height under the baseline), its middle (half its height over it) or
its top (its height over it). The left of the baseline, where a text
always stood, is no value but the field's absence: a text has one
spelling.

TextColumns.description:
A multi-line text's static columns (docs/adr/0324 §1): `count` columns of the box's width, `gap` heights
apart, each `height` metres tall; lines past the last column's height go on down in it.

gap.description: The space between two columns, heights.

height.description: A column's height, metres.

TextEntity.description:
Fields every object has. `id` is the object's local id inside a v1 file.
v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

align.description: Where `p` is on the text; absent: the left of the baseline (docs/adr/0145).

annotative.description:
Its scales: drawn at the paper height it was given at every scale it takes part in, hidden
at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

boxWidth.description:
Metres, finite and over 0: the lines wrap word by word to this width.
Absent: they end only at line breaks.

fields.description: Ranges of its letters bound to a source (docs/adr/0325 §1), in order, not overlapping; absent: none.

font.description: Its typeface; absent: the project's, in the look of docs/adr/0055.

height.description: Metres.

labelOf.description:
The object whose label this text writes (Etiketleri yazıya çevir's
“Nesneye bağlı”, docs/adr/0175 §4): its persistent id. The text
follows the object as its label at `label_scale`; absent: a text of
its own. Given with `label_scale` or not at all.

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

labelScale.description: The scale's denominator (1:N) the linked label is written at; finite, over 0.

layout.description:
Its indents, tab stops and columns (docs/adr/0324 §1); absent: none, a tab every
`DEFAULT_TAB` heights, one column.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineSpacing.description:
The distance between the lines' baselines in 5/3 of the height (DXF's
group 44); absent: 1. From `MIN_LINE_SPACING` to `MAX_LINE_SPACING`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

object (docs/adr/0139).

mask.description:
The text's box is filled with the drawing area's colour before the
text is drawn (Netcad's “fon”): what lies under it does not show.

oblique.description:
How far its letters lean, degrees, positive with their tops to the
right; within ±`MAX_OBLIQUE`, never 0 (upright is the field's absence).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

overrides.description: The fields set apart from its style by hand (docs/adr/0322 §5), by name (`TEXT_OVERRIDES`), as a dimension's.

path.description:
The curve its letters stand on (Eğri boyunca yazı, docs/adr/0196 §1),
in its own frame; absent: a straight text.

rotation.description: Degrees, counter-clockwise from east.

runs.description:
The letters' formats: ranges of the text's Unicode scalar values (not
UTF-16 units), in order, not overlapping, each with a format; a run
with no format is not written, and touching runs of one format are one.
Absent: none.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

textStyle.description: The project's text style it follows, by its id; absent: Standart.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

widthFactor.description:
The letters' width times this, the height kept (Netcad's “sıkışma”,
DXF's group 41); absent: 1. Finite, over 0, at most `MAX_WIDTH_FACTOR`.

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

TextField.description: A range of a text's letters bound to a source (docs/adr/0325 §1).

broken.description: Why its value cannot be read; its letters are then `####`. Absent: it reads.

format.description: How a number is written; absent: the project's decimals and unit.

start.description:
Its first letter and the one past its last, counting Unicode scalar values (as a run's); its letters are the
value last written.

TextPath.description:
The curve a text's letters stand on (docs/adr/0196 §1). Its vertices are
in the text's own frame: `p` its start, x along the text's `rotation`, y
square to it on the left, metres. The first vertex is `p` itself and is
not written; `pts` are the ones after it. The frame carries the curve with
the text when it moves, turns or scales.

bulges.description:
Edge i's bulge, from vertex i to vertex i + 1 (vertex 0 is `p`):
DXF's tan(θ/4), counter-clockwise positive; as many as `pts`. Absent:
every edge straight.

pts.description: The vertices after `p`, at least one.

TextRun.description: A range of a text's letters and their format (docs/adr/0182 §1).

color.description: Its own colour, as an object's (`#E5484D`, or a theme name); absent: the text's.

script.description: Raised or lowered, at 0.6 of the height; absent: on the line.

start.description: Its first letter and the one past its last, counting Unicode scalar values.

TextScript.description: A run raised over the line (superscript) or lowered under it (subscript).

oneOf.description:
A stacked fraction (docs/adr/0324 §1): the run's letters before its first `/`, `#` or `^` raised over
those after it; `/` a horizontal bar, `#` a slanted one beside them, `^` none (a tolerance).

TextShift.description:
The value moved from its place (AutoCAD's text moved, DIMTMOVE 2): metres along the value's own direction and
across it (left positive).

oneOf.description: ` ±upper`.
` +upper -lower`.
The largest and the smallest value instead of the number: `max/min`.

Vec2.description: A point in world units: x = east (Y, sağa), y = north (X, yukarı).

top.description: The top half: the mark's number.
