WallCaps.description: Whether an open wall's ends are closed by a line across it.

WallComponent.description: One layer of a wall's body, from its left face towards its right (`CAD-ARCH-04`): plaster, brick, insulation.

detail.description: The least detail it is drawn at as its own (its lines and hatch); below, it is part of the body.

edge.description: The lines along its sides; absent: the wall's.

priority.description:
Its strength where walls meet (docs/adr/0340 §1), 1 to 9, the smaller the stronger: a joining wall's component
passes the host's weaker ones and stops at the first as strong. Absent: 3 (between a core's 1 and a finish's 5).

thickness.description: Its thickness, metres; absent: what the wall's width leaves of the others (one component at most).

WallDetail.description:
How much of a wall is drawn (`CAD-ARCH-12`), the least first: `Schematic` its outline and its style's fill,
`Standard` the components shown at construction scales, `Detailed` every component.

WallEntity.description:
A wall (`CAD-ARCH-01`, `02`): its path, the base line it was drawn along, with arcs as a polyline's bulges (one per
vertex, as the document keeps a polyline's: an open wall's last is 0); its width; where its body lies across the
justification line (the path moved `offset` to its left); the components it is built of, from its left face; its
ends; its height above its level; its architectural information. Its faces, ends, component lines and hatches are
drawn from these (`geom::wall` of the shared core), at the detail the drawing's scale asks.

closed.description: Its path's last vertex joins its first: a ring of wall.

components.description: Its body's layers from its left face; none: one plain body.

WallJoin.description:
How one end of a wall joins another (docs/adr/0340 §1, `CAD-ARCH-07`): by the rule; not at all (its end line
drawn); at a corner mitred; butting the other (it stops at the other's face); running through it (the other butts).

WallJoins.description: A wall's start's and end's join.

WallJustify.description:
Where the wall's body lies across its path (AutoCAD Architecture's justification): `Left`, the path is the wall's
left face and the body to its right; `Center`, the path is its middle; `Right`, the path is its right face.

frame.description: Whether its boundary is drawn (AutoCAD's WIPEOUTFRAME, per mask).

commands.title: Etiketi düzenle
commands.summary: Kalıcı kimlikleri verilen etiketlerin şablonunu (content; null türün şablonu), çerçevesini (shape), yazı yüksekliğini (size, kâğıtta mm; null 2,5) ya da kolunu (leader) değiştirir; yazıları nesnelerinden yeniden yazılır. Tek geri alma adımı “Etiketi düzenle”, hepsi ya da hiçbiri; kilitli katmandaki etiket bütün değişikliği reddeder. Plan yazmadan etiketleri olacakları gibi gösterir.

TagChange.description: The fields of tags to change; absent ones stay, a nullable one's null takes it away (its kind's template, 2.5 mm).

input.description:
Input of `cad.tags.edit` v1 (“Etiketi düzenle”): the tags' template, frame, words' height or leader changed, their
words written again from their objects; one undo step, all or none.

Refusals, in this order: `no_entities`, `invalid_uid`, `entity_not_found`, `not_a_tag`, `nothing_to_set`,
`not_finite`, `invalid_tag`, `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict`, `layer_locked`.
input.title: TagsEdit

note.description: A note shown with it (lines allowed).

oneOf.description: The dimension line, from its first end (0) to its second (1).

decimals.description: The decimals a formula's or a field's number is written with.

On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

grids.description: The two grids it stands where they cross, by their persistent ids.

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

place.description: Its place by its grids' labels (“B-3”), which the document writes.

rotation.description: Its turn, radians counter-clockwise.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

ComponentEdge.description: The lines along a component's sides: its own colour, line weight and line type; absent fields the wall's.

lineWeight.description: Paper mm, 0 to 100.

ComponentHatch.description:
A component's hatch: a pattern of the library or the project by its name (`SOLID` a solid fill), as large on paper
as at 1:1 times `scale` at every drawing scale, turned `angle` degrees along the wall's path, in its own colour.

scale.description: Times the pattern's paper size, above 0.

ConstructionEntity.description: Construction line or ray: base point and unit direction.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

DatasetDim.description:
One of a dataset's slice dimensions (docs/adr/0243 §6): its name, the
index shown, its values (coordinates; moments in milliseconds since 1970
when `time`) and units.

time.description: The values are a CF time axis's moments.

DimensionArrow.description:
A dimension's arrowheads other than the oblique tick, which is no value but
the field's absence (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: A filled triangle, its tip on the dimension line's end (Dolu ok).
The triangle's two sides (Açık ok).
A filled circle about the end (Nokta).
Nothing at the ends (Yok).

DimensionBreak.description:
A gap in one of a dimension's lines where another object crosses it (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK), at the fraction `t` of
the line; its width the options' `breakSize`.

DimensionEntity.description:
Fields every object has. `id` is the object's local id inside a v1 file.
v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

angle.description: Linear: measured direction in degrees (0 = ΔY, 90 = ΔX).

annotative.description:
Its scales: drawn at the paper height it was given at every scale it takes part in, hidden
at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

arrowSize.description:
The arrowhead's (or tick's) length; absent: `DEFAULT_TICK` for ticks,
`DEFAULT_ARROW` for the others.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

breaks.description: The gaps in its lines where other objects cross them (docs/adr/0321 §1).

c.description:
Angular: the vertex. Arc length: the arc's centre. Jogged: the centre
the line starts from (docs/adr/0147).

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

decimals.description:
A length's, a coordinate's or a slope's decimals; absent: the
project's length decimals (a slope's 2). Angles keep the project's.

dimLineColor.description:
The dimension line's and its arrowheads' colour, `#RRGGBB`; absent:
the object's (docs/adr/0205 §6).

dimLineType.description: The dimension line's type; absent: continuous.

dimLineWeight.description: The dimension line's weight, paper mm as an object's; absent: a hairline.

dimStyle.description: The project's dimension style it follows, by its id; absent: Standart.

extBeyond.description: How far the extension lines pass the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_BEYOND`.

extColor.description: The extension lines' colour; absent: the object's.

extLineType.description: The extension lines' type; absent: continuous.

extOffset.description: The extension lines' gap from the measured points; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_OFFSET`.

extWeight.description: The extension lines' weight, paper mm; absent: a hairline.

font.description: The value's typeface; absent: the project's.

labelPins.description:

§3.7), one a class at most.

mask.description:
The value is drawn over the drawing's background (docs/adr/0147, as a
text's mask, docs/adr/0145).

options.description: Where the value goes when it does not fit and how it is written (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

overrides.description:
The fields set apart from its style by hand (docs/adr/0322 §5), by name (`DIMENSION_OVERRIDES`): they keep
their value when the style changes. Empty: each field follows while it holds the style's old value.

prefix.description: Written before the value (and its kind's own prefix).

refs.description: The objects its points follow (docs/adr/0249): an associative dimension; none, free points.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

textColor.description: The value's colour; absent: the object's.

textGap.description: The value's baseline over the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_TEXT_GAP`.

textPlace.description: Where the value stands; absent: over the line.

textShift.description: Its value moved from its place (docs/adr/0321 §1).

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

unit.description: The unit lengths and coordinates are written in; absent: the project's.

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

za.description: Slope: the two points' elevations, metres (docs/adr/0147).

DimensionFit.description:
Where the value goes when it does not fit between the extension lines (AutoCAD's DIMATFIT and DIMTIX): absent,
always between them.

oneOf.description: Beyond the second extension line when the value and the two arrowheads are longer than the line between them.
Always beyond the second extension line, the arrowheads outside.

DimensionOptions.description: A dimension's options (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2): all absent, the dimension as it always was.

breakSize.description: A break's width, times the value's height, over 0; absent: 1 (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK size).

lengthStyle.description:
Feet and inches in an inch or foot unit (AutoCAD's DIMLUNIT, docs/adr/0262 §2); absent: the project's, unless
the dimension names its own unit.

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

DrawingFont.description:
The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

EllipseEntity.description: DXF ELLIPSE: centre, major axis vector, minor/major ratio, parameters t0 → t1.

Entity.description: Any drawing object, tagged by `kind` as in the TypeScript model.

oneOf.description: A general NURBS curve: degree, control points, weights and knots (docs/adr/0259).
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144).
An arrow with a note (docs/adr/0146).
Rows and columns of cells (docs/adr/0184).
A picture (docs/adr/0192).
An orthophoto, a scanned sheet or an elevation model (docs/adr/0204).
A point cloud: LAS, LAZ, COPC or text files (docs/adr/0207).
A wall (docs/adr/0339): its path, width, justification and components; its faces drawn from them.

A door, a window or a bare opening in a wall (docs/adr/0341): its wall's id, its place along it and its
jambs' points.
A grid (docs/adr/0343): its line, label and bubbles.
A column (docs/adr/0343): its centre, outline and the grids it stands on.
A stair (docs/adr/0343): its walking line and its risers, treads and landings.
A ramp (docs/adr/0343): its centre line, width, rise and landings.
A tag (docs/adr/0344): its object, its words and frame.
A view mark (docs/adr/0345): a section, elevation or detail mark pointing at a view.

A record without a geometry (docs/adr/0410): a table's row, with the base's attributes,
attachments and label; not drawn, picked or snapped to.

FieldBroken.description: Why a field's value cannot be read.

oneOf.description: The object is gone.
The object has no such value (an open object's area, a line's text).
The attribute or the variable named is not there.
Texts whose fields read each other in a ring.

FieldFormat.description: How a field writes a number.

comma.description: A decimal comma (`24,35`) instead of a point.

decimals.description: Absent: the project's length or area decimals.

unit.description: Absent: the drawing unit for a length or a place, the project's area unit for an area.

FieldSource.description: Where a field's value comes from.

oneOf.description: An object, by its persistent id.

name.description: The attribute's name, with `attribute`.

oneOf.description: The project.

name.description: The variable's name, with `variable`; the block's, with `blockCount`.

FieldUnit.description: The unit a field writes a number in.

GeorefMethod.description: A transform from the source's pixels to the drawing (docs/adr/0204 §6).

GeorefOutput.description: A resampled raster's grid: north-up, its corner on a multiple of its pixel (docs/adr/0204 §6).

digest.description: The written file's SHA-256 when it was written.

GeorefPoint.description:
A control or check point: a pixel of the source (column, row; pixel corners, 0, 0 the upper left corner of the
upper left pixel, as GDAL's GCPs) and where it is (`target`, in the record's `srid`).

check.description: A check point: kept out of the fit; its error says how good the fit is where no control point is.

name.description: What the user calls it (a mark on the sheet, a survey point's name).

off.description: Left out (Kullan off): neither fits nor checks; its residual is still shown.

target.description: Its east and north (a geographic system's longitude and latitude, degrees).

GeorefSource.description: The raster the points' pixels are of: what it read and its size.

asset.description: The project library's raster it was (embedded).

digest.description: Its bytes' SHA-256 (64 lowercase hex digits) when they were read: the revision the points belong to.

file.description: The file it was (linked), as kept.

url.description: The address it was read from.

GradientShape.description: How a gradient runs over its hatch (docs/adr/0186 §3).

oneOf.description: From one side of the hatch to the other along `angle`.
The second colour along the middle, the first at both sides.
The second colour in the middle, the first at the farthest corner.

GridBubbles.description: Which ends of a grid carry a bubble.

HatchAssoc.description:
The objects a hatch follows (docs/adr/0186 §6, 0328 §3): a hatch made inside a closed object follows the
object (`outer`), its islands, the texts and inserts left open; a hatch made in the face line work closes
(`bounds`: the objects whose line work bounds it, its islands' too) follows that line work; the point clicked
inside picks the region's part or face. Exactly one of `outer` and `bounds` is given.

bounds.description: The objects whose line work closes its face (docs/adr/0328 §3).

gap.description: A face's tie: the gaps its line work was closed across, metres (docs/adr/0329 §3); absent: none.

HatchCurve.description: A boundary edge that is no line or circular arc (docs/adr/0328 §1).

oneOf.description:
An ellipse's arc: centre `c`, major semi-axis `major` (from `c`), minor to major `ratio`, from parameter `t0`
to `t1` (radians): counter-clockwise when `t1` is past `t0`, clockwise when before it; a whole ellipse
`t1 = t0 ± 2π`.
A NURBS curve run whole, from its first knot to its last.

assoc.description: The objects its region follows (docs/adr/0186 §6); none: it stays as drawn.

HatchLoop.description:
One closed loop of a hatch's boundary as its source holds it (docs/adr/0328 §1): edge `i` runs from `pts[i]` to
the next point (the last to the first); it is straight, a circular arc of `bulges[i]` (tan(θ/4), counter-clockwise
positive, as a polygon's), or the curve `curves[i]` (an ellipse's arc or a NURBS curve), whose ends are those
points. A loop of one point is one closed curve.

angle.description:
Degrees, counter-clockwise from east: the lines' (lines, cross), the
pattern's turn (pattern), the gradient's direction (gradient).

gradient.description: A gradient's shape and second colour.

origin.description:

spacing.description: Metres between the lines (lines, cross); 1 and unread for the others.

follows the object as its label at `label_scale`; absent: a text of

§3.7), one a class at most.

layout.description:

lineSpacing.description:

group 44); absent: 1. From `MIN_LINE_SPACING` to `MAX_LINE_SPACING`.

text is drawn (Netcad's “fon”): what lies under it does not show.

oblique.description:

right; within ±`MAX_OBLIQUE`, never 0 (upright is the field's absence).

order.description:

document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

overrides.description: The fields set apart from its style by hand (docs/adr/0322 §5), by name (`TEXT_OVERRIDES`), as a dimension's.

path.description:

in its own frame; absent: a straight text.

rotation.description: Degrees, counter-clockwise from east.

runs.description:

UTF-16 units), in order, not overlapping, each with a format; a run
with no format is not written, and touching runs of one format are one.
Absent: none.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

widthFactor.description:

DXF's group 41); absent: 1. Finite, over 0, at most `MAX_WIDTH_FACTOR`.

broken.description: Why its value cannot be read; its letters are then `####`. Absent: it reads.

format.description: How a number is written; absent: the project's decimals and unit.

start.description:

value last written.

in the text's own frame: `p` its start, x along the text's `rotation`, y
square to it on the left, metres. The first vertex is `p` itself and is
not written; `pts` are the ones after it. The frame carries the curve with
the text when it moves, turns or scales.

Edge i's bulge, from vertex i to vertex i + 1 (vertex 0 is `p`):
DXF's tan(θ/4), counter-clockwise positive; as many as `pts`. Absent:

pts.description: The vertices after `p`, at least one.

script.description: Raised or lowered, at 0.6 of the height; absent: on the line.

start.description: Its first letter and the one past its last, counting Unicode scalar values.

TextScript.description: A run raised over the line (superscript) or lowered under it (subscript).

oneOf.description:

those after it; `/` a horizontal bar, `#` a slanted one beside them, `^` none (a tolerance).

drawn from these (`geom::wall` of the shared core), at the detail the drawing's scale asks.

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers

project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).

Dolu nokta: a filled dot (Dot).

Dolu kare (Box filled).
Boş kare (Box blank).

through its vertices and, with a note, a landing from its last vertex
along the note's direction and the note past the landing's end; one

commands.title: Görünüm işareti
commands.summary: Kesit, görünüş ve detay işaretleri ekler; tek geri alma adımı “Görünüm işareti”. Her işaret biçimiyle (form: section, elevation, detail) ve noktalarıyla verilir: kesitin kesme çizgisi 2–32 nokta (flip bakış yönünü çevirir), görünüş tek nokta ve bakış yönü (angle, derece, doğudan saat yönünün tersine; yoksa 90), detay merkezi ve sınırının yarıçapı (radius), balonun yeri (at; yoksa sağ üstte iki yarıçap uzakta). mark balonun üst yarısındaki numaradır (en çok 16 harf); target işaretin baktığı yerdir: adlı görünüm ({view}) ya da paftadaki görünüm penceresi ({sheet, item}); projede olmayan hedef target_not_found. Balonun alt yarısına hedefin numarası yazılır (paftanın adı ya da görünümün adı; hedef yoksa “—”), mark boşsa üst yarıya pencerenin paftadaki sırası; yazılar belgenindir: pafta ya da görünüm yeniden adlandırılınca aynı anda yeniden yazılır, hedef silinince işaret son yazısıyla targetGone kalır. size yazının kâğıttaki yüksekliğidir (mm, yoksa 2,5). Katman açıkça verilir; kilitli katmana yazılmaz, gizli katmana uyarıyla yazılır.

DimensionFit.description:
Where the value goes when it does not fit between the extension lines (AutoCAD's DIMATFIT and DIMTIX): absent,
always between them.

oneOf.description: Beyond the second extension line when the value and the two arrowheads are longer than the line between them.
Always beyond the second extension line, the arrowheads outside.

DimensionOptions.description: A dimension's options (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2): all absent, the dimension as it always was.

breakSize.description: A break's width, times the value's height, over 0; absent: 1 (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK size).

lengthStyle.description:

the dimension names its own unit.

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

DrawingFont.description:
The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

oneOf.description: Açık ok: the filled triangle's two sides (Open).
Dolu nokta: a filled dot (Dot).

detail.description: The least detail it is drawn at as its own (its lines and hatch); below, it is part of the body.

edge.description: The lines along its sides; absent: the wall's.

priority.description:
Its strength where walls meet (docs/adr/0340 §1), 1 to 9, the smaller the stronger: a joining wall's component
passes the host's weaker ones and stops at the first as strong. Absent: 3 (between a core's 1 and a finish's 5).

thickness.description: Its thickness, metres; absent: what the wall's width leaves of the others (one component at most).

WallDetail.description:
How much of a wall is drawn (`CAD-ARCH-12`), the least first: `Schematic` its outline and its style's fill,
`Standard` the components shown at construction scales, `Detailed` every component.

WallEntity.description:
A wall (`CAD-ARCH-01`, `02`): its path, the base line it was drawn along, with arcs as a polyline's bulges (one per
vertex, as the document keeps a polyline's: an open wall's last is 0); its width; where its body lies across the
justification line (the path moved `offset` to its left); the components it is built of, from its left face; its
ends; its height above its level; its architectural information. Its faces, ends, component lines and hatches are
drawn from these (`geom::wall` of the shared core), at the detail the drawing's scale asks.

cleanup.description:
Its components are cleaned up by their priorities where another wall tees into or crosses it; false: the
walls meet at their faces only.

closed.description: Its path's last vertex joins its first: a ring of wall.

components.description: Its body's layers from its left face; none: one plain body.

fill.description: The body's solid fill when drawn schematically (`#RRGGBB`); absent: none.

height.description: Its height above its level's floor, metres; absent: the level's height.

joins.description: How its ends join (docs/adr/0340 §1); absent: both by the rule.

WallJoin.description:
How one end of a wall joins another (docs/adr/0340 §1, `CAD-ARCH-07`): by the rule; not at all (its end line
drawn); at a corner mitred; butting the other (it stops at the other's face); running through it (the other butts).

WallJoins.description: A wall's start's and end's join.

WallJustify.description:
Where the wall's body lies across its path (AutoCAD Architecture's justification): `Left`, the path is the wall's
left face and the body to its right; `Center`, the path is its middle; `Right`, the path is its right face.

frame.description: Whether its boundary is drawn (AutoCAD's WIPEOUTFRAME, per mask).

plan.description: What `cad.viewmarks.create` would write (plan mode): the marks as they would be stored, their words written, `id` 0.

commands.title: Görünüm işaretini düzenle
commands.summary: Kalıcı kimlikleri verilen görünüm işaretlerini değiştirir; tek geri alma adımı “Görünüm işaretini düzenle”, hepsi ya da hiçbiri. operation: set (mark, size: kâğıtta mm, null 2,5; flip; angle yalnız görünüşte; radius yalnız detayda), retarget (target: adlı görünüm ya da paftadaki pencere; projede yoksa target_not_found), detach (hedefi bırakır, alt yarıya “—” yazılır). Yazıları hedeflerinden yeniden yazılır. Kilitli katmandaki işaret bütün değişikliği reddeder. Plan yazmadan işaretleri olacakları gibi gösterir.

oneOf.description: The marks' number, words' height, side, direction or radius changed.
The marks point at another target.
The marks let go of their target: the bottom half writes “—”.

ViewTarget.description: What a mark points at: a named view (`view`, its id), or a map frame on a sheet (`sheet` and `item`, their ids).

input.description:
Input of `cad.viewmarks.edit` v1 (“Görünüm işaretini düzenle”): one undo step, all or none.

Refusals, in this order: `no_entities`, `invalid_uid`, `entity_not_found`, `not_a_viewmark`, `nothing_to_set`,
`not_finite`, `invalid_viewmark`, `target_not_found`, `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict`, `layer_locked`.

always between them.

oneOf.description: Beyond the second extension line when the value and the two arrowheads are longer than the line between them.
Always beyond the second extension line, the arrowheads outside.

breakSize.description: A break's width, times the value's height, over 0; absent: 1 (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK size).

lengthStyle.description:

the dimension names its own unit.

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

DrawingFont.description:
The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

EllipseEntity.description: DXF ELLIPSE: centre, major axis vector, minor/major ratio, parameters t0 → t1.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

labelPins.description:

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineWeight.description:

(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

order.description:

document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

Entity.description: Any drawing object, tagged by `kind` as in the TypeScript model.

oneOf.description: A general NURBS curve: degree, control points, weights and knots (docs/adr/0259).
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144).
An arrow with a note (docs/adr/0146).
Rows and columns of cells (docs/adr/0184).
A picture (docs/adr/0192).
An orthophoto, a scanned sheet or an elevation model (docs/adr/0204).
A point cloud: LAS, LAZ, COPC or text files (docs/adr/0207).
A wall (docs/adr/0339): its path, width, justification and components; its faces drawn from them.

A door, a window or a bare opening in a wall (docs/adr/0341): its wall's id, its place along it and its
jambs' points.
A grid (docs/adr/0343): its line, label and bubbles.
A column (docs/adr/0343): its centre, outline and the grids it stands on.
A stair (docs/adr/0343): its walking line and its risers, treads and landings.
A ramp (docs/adr/0343): its centre line, width, rise and landings.
A tag (docs/adr/0344): its object, its words and frame.
A view mark (docs/adr/0345): a section, elevation or detail mark pointing at a view.

A record without a geometry (docs/adr/0410): a table's row, with the base's attributes,
attachments and label; not drawn, picked or snapped to.

comma.description: A decimal comma (`24,35`) instead of a point.

decimals.description: Absent: the project's length or area decimals.

unit.description: Absent: the drawing unit for a length or a place, the project's area unit for an area.

GeorefMethod.description: A transform from the source's pixels to the drawing (docs/adr/0204 §6).

GeorefOutput.description: A resampled raster's grid: north-up, its corner on a multiple of its pixel (docs/adr/0204 §6).

digest.description: The written file's SHA-256 when it was written.

GeorefPoint.description:
A control or check point: a pixel of the source (column, row; pixel corners, 0, 0 the upper left corner of the
upper left pixel, as GDAL's GCPs) and where it is (`target`, in the record's `srid`).

check.description: A check point: kept out of the fit; its error says how good the fit is where no control point is.

name.description: What the user calls it (a mark on the sheet, a survey point's name).

off.description: Left out (Kullan off): neither fits nor checks; its residual is still shown.

target.description: Its east and north (a geographic system's longitude and latitude, degrees).

GeorefSource.description: The raster the points' pixels are of: what it read and its size.

asset.description: The project library's raster it was (embedded).

digest.description: Its bytes' SHA-256 (64 lowercase hex digits) when they were read: the revision the points belong to.

file.description: The file it was (linked), as kept.

url.description: The address it was read from.

oneOf.description: From one side of the hatch to the other along `angle`.

HatchAssoc.description:
The objects a hatch follows (docs/adr/0186 §6, 0328 §3): a hatch made inside a closed object follows the
object (`outer`), its islands, the texts and inserts left open; a hatch made in the face line work closes
(`bounds`: the objects whose line work bounds it, its islands' too) follows that line work; the point clicked
inside picks the region's part or face. Exactly one of `outer` and `bounds` is given.

bounds.description: The objects whose line work closes its face (docs/adr/0328 §3).

gap.description: A face's tie: the gaps its line work was closed across, metres (docs/adr/0329 §3); absent: none.

HatchCurve.description: A boundary edge that is no line or circular arc (docs/adr/0328 §1).

oneOf.description:
An ellipse's arc: centre `c`, major semi-axis `major` (from `c`), minor to major `ratio`, from parameter `t0`
to `t1` (radians): counter-clockwise when `t1` is past `t0`, clockwise when before it; a whole ellipse
`t1 = t0 ± 2π`.
A NURBS curve run whole, from its first knot to its last.

v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

annotative.description:
Its scales (docs/adr/0331 §3): an annotative hatch's pattern is drawn at each scale it takes part in as large
on paper as at its own; absent: one pattern for every scale.

assoc.description: The objects its region follows (docs/adr/0186 §6); none: it stays as drawn.

the ring and holes are all it has.

HatchLoop.description:
One closed loop of a hatch's boundary as its source holds it (docs/adr/0328 §1): edge `i` runs from `pts[i]` to
the next point (the last to the first); it is straight, a circular arc of `bulges[i]` (tan(θ/4), counter-clockwise
positive, as a polygon's), or the curve `curves[i]` (an ellipse's arc or a NURBS curve), whose ends are those
points. A loop of one point is one closed curve.

angle.description:

gradient.description: A gradient's shape and second colour.

spacing.description: Metres between the lines (lines, cross); 1 and unread for the others.

InsertEntity.description:
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144): its definition drawn
moved from the definition's base point to `p`, mirrored in the
definition's x axis when `mirror`, then scaled and turned about `p`. The
transform is a similarity, shapes keeping their kind, unless the insert
has a y factor of its own (docs/adr/0315 §3): then an affine, a circle
becoming the exact ellipse of its image. The insert's own attributes
carry the values of the definition's attribute definitions.

pts.description: At least one: its tip first, then its bends; it ends at the leader's last vertex.

tip.description: The place on an object its tip follows; absent: a free tip.

LeaderArrow.description:
A leader's arrowhead other than the filled triangle (Dolu üçgen,
AutoCAD's Closed filled), which is no value but the field's absence: a
leader has one spelling (docs/adr/0146 §1). The first three are the
first leaders'; the others AutoCAD's arrowheads (docs/adr/0205 §7, `.kcad`
schema 30).

oneOf.description: Açık ok: the filled triangle's two sides (Open).
Dolu nokta: a filled dot (Dot).
Yok: no arrowhead, the line ends at the tip (None).
Boş üçgen: the triangle's outline (Closed blank).
İnce açık ok: two sides 15° off the line (Open 30).
Dik açık ok: two sides square to each other (Open 90, Right angle).
Küçük nokta (Dot small).
Boş nokta: a ring (Dot blank).
Eğik çizgi: a tick across the tip (Oblique).
Mimari çentik: a heavy tick (Architectural tick).
Dolu kare (Box filled).
Boş kare (Box blank).
Dayanak üçgeni: a filled triangle standing on the tip (Datum triangle filled).

LeaderEntity.description:
A leader (docs/adr/0146): an arrowhead at its first vertex, a line
through its vertices and, with a note, a landing from its last vertex
along the note's direction and the note past the landing's end; one
object. The arrowhead and the landing are measured by the note's height.

annotative.description:

at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

arms.description:
Its other arms (docs/adr/0326 §1): each from its own tip through its bends to the leader's last vertex, where
the landing starts; the arrowhead, the note and the look the first arm's.

arrow.description: The arrowhead; absent: a filled arrow.

arrowSize.description:

absent: 1. From `MIN_LEADER_ARROW` to `MAX_LEADER_ARROW`.

decimals.description: The decimals a formula's or a field's number is written with.

fill.description: Its background, `#rrggbb`.

always between them.

oneOf.description: Beyond the second extension line when the value and the two arrowheads are longer than the line between them.
Always beyond the second extension line, the arrowheads outside.

DimensionOptions.description: A dimension's options (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2): all absent, the dimension as it always was.

breakSize.description: A break's width, times the value's height, over 0; absent: 1 (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK size).

lengthStyle.description:

the dimension names its own unit.

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

commands.summary: Mahallere döşeme deseni ya da tavan ızgarası yazar: her mahalin her parçasına mahale bağlı bir tarama, Kaplama özniteliğiyle (Döşeme, Tavan); mahal duvarlarıyla değişince tarama da izler. Tek geri alma adımı “Döşeme ve tavan”. surface: floor ise pattern kitaplığın ya da projenin desen adıdır (yoksa mahalin döşeme kaplamasının adıyla aynı adlı desen, o da yoksa ANSI31; bilinmeyen ad unknown_pattern), scale desenin ölçeği; desen mahalin sol alt köşesinden başlar. surface: ceiling ise grid ızgaradır: dx ve dy aralıklar (m), angle derece, origin center (mahalin ortası, karşılıklı duvarlarda eşit kesik) ya da corner. Döşemeye ızgara, tavana desen invalid_finish. Aynı yüzün eski taraması yerine geçer (finish_replaced). layerId verilmezse A-ZEMN-DSN ya da A-TAVN-IZG, yoksa aynı adımda açılır. Plan yazmadan taramaları olacakları gibi gösterir.

ANSI31) or its ceiling grid (`grid`), on a layer (absent: A-ZEMN-DSN or A-TAVN-IZG, opened if missing); a space's
earlier hatch of the same face is replaced. One undo step.

matched ends), `offset` past each end.

not written; `pts` are the ones after it. The frame carries the curve with
the text when it moves, turns or scales.

DXF's tan(θ/4), counter-clockwise positive; as many as `pts`. Absent:

script.description: Raised or lowered, at 0.6 of the height; absent: on the line.

those after it; `/` a horizontal bar, `#` a slanted one beside them, `^` none (a tolerance).

curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

mirror.description: The picture mirrored in its own x axis (Aynala), before the turn.

order.description:

document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

rotation.description: Radians, counter-clockwise from east, about `p`.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

boundary.description:
Its corners in the definition's coordinates (relative to nothing: the definition's own), at least three, the
ring closing by itself; no edge crosses another.

inverted.description: The content outside the boundary is drawn, the inside left out.

InsertEntity.description:
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144): its definition drawn
moved from the definition's base point to `p`, mirrored in the
definition's x axis when `mirror`, then scaled and turned about `p`. The
transform is a similarity, shapes keeping their kind, unless the insert
has a y factor of its own (docs/adr/0315 §3): then an affine, a circle
becoming the exact ellipse of its image. The insert's own attributes
carry the values of the definition's attribute definitions.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attributePlaces.description:
Where this insert shows a movable attribute (docs/adr/0317 §1): its tag's text at this point of the
definition's coordinates rather than the definition's. Only a movable attribute's tag; absent: every text where
the definition puts it.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

byLayer.description:

follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

clipping.description:

pts.description: At least one: its tip first, then its bends; it ends at the leader's last vertex.

tip.description: The place on an object its tip follows; absent: a free tip.

LeaderArrow.description:
A leader's arrowhead other than the filled triangle (Dolu üçgen,
AutoCAD's Closed filled), which is no value but the field's absence: a
leader has one spelling (docs/adr/0146 §1). The first three are the
first leaders'; the others AutoCAD's arrowheads (docs/adr/0205 §7, `.kcad`
schema 30).

oneOf.description: Açık ok: the filled triangle's two sides (Open).
Dolu nokta: a filled dot (Dot).
Yok: no arrowhead, the line ends at the tip (None).
Boş üçgen: the triangle's outline (Closed blank).
İnce açık ok: two sides 15° off the line (Open 30).
Dik açık ok: two sides square to each other (Open 90, Right angle).
Küçük nokta (Dot small).
Boş nokta: a ring (Dot blank).
Eğik çizgi: a tick across the tip (Oblique).
Mimari çentik: a heavy tick (Architectural tick).
Dolu kare (Box filled).
Boş kare (Box blank).
Dayanak üçgeni: a filled triangle standing on the tip (Datum triangle filled).

LeaderEntity.description:
A leader (docs/adr/0146): an arrowhead at its first vertex, a line
through its vertices and, with a note, a landing from its last vertex
along the note's direction and the note past the landing's end; one
object. The arrowhead and the landing are measured by the note's height.

annotative.description:
Its scales: drawn at the paper height it was given at every scale it takes part in, hidden
at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

arms.description:
Its other arms (docs/adr/0326 §1): each from its own tip through its bends to the leader's last vertex, where
the landing starts; the arrowhead, the note and the look the first arm's.

arrow.description: The arrowhead; absent: a filled arrow.

arrowSize.description:
The arrowhead's length, times the note's height (docs/adr/0205 §7);
absent: 1. From `MIN_LEADER_ARROW` to `MAX_LEADER_ARROW`.

follows the object as its label at `label_scale`; absent: a text of
its own. Given with `label_scale` or not at all.

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

labelScale.description: The scale's denominator (1:N) the linked label is written at; finite, over 0.

layout.description:
Its indents, tab stops and columns (docs/adr/0324 §1); absent: none, a tab every
`DEFAULT_TAB` heights, one column.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineSpacing.description:
The distance between the lines' baselines in 5/3 of the height (DXF's
group 44); absent: 1. From `MIN_LINE_SPACING` to `MAX_LINE_SPACING`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

mask.description:
The text's box is filled with the drawing area's colour before the
text is drawn (Netcad's “fon”): what lies under it does not show.

oblique.description:
How far its letters lean, degrees, positive with their tops to the
right; within ±`MAX_OBLIQUE`, never 0 (upright is the field's absence).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

overrides.description: The fields set apart from its style by hand (docs/adr/0322 §5), by name (`TEXT_OVERRIDES`), as a dimension's.

path.description:
The curve its letters stand on (Eğri boyunca yazı, docs/adr/0196 §1),
in its own frame; absent: a straight text.

rotation.description: Degrees, counter-clockwise from east.

runs.description:
The letters' formats: ranges of the text's Unicode scalar values (not
UTF-16 units), in order, not overlapping, each with a format; a run
with no format is not written, and touching runs of one format are one.
Absent: none.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

textStyle.description: The project's text style it follows, by its id; absent: Standart.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

widthFactor.description:
The letters' width times this, the height kept (Netcad's “sıkışma”,
DXF's group 41); absent: 1. Finite, over 0, at most `MAX_WIDTH_FACTOR`.

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers

format.description: How a number is written; absent: the project's decimals and unit.

start.description:

TextPath.description:
The curve a text's letters stand on (docs/adr/0196 §1). Its vertices are
in the text's own frame: `p` its start, x along the text's `rotation`, y
square to it on the left, metres. The first vertex is `p` itself and is

the text when it moves, turns or scales.

DXF's tan(θ/4), counter-clockwise positive; as many as `pts`. Absent:

pts.description: The vertices after `p`, at least one.

script.description: Raised or lowered, at 0.6 of the height; absent: on the line.

start.description: Its first letter and the one past its last, counting Unicode scalar values.

oneOf.description:

those after it; `/` a horizontal bar, `#` a slanted one beside them, `^` none (a tolerance).

commands.title: Veri profilini uygula
commands.summary: Bir veri profilinin (yerleşik tucbs-temel ya da profile ile verilen) çizimde olmayan parçalarını ekler; var olanı korur. Profil veridir: sınıfları katman yollarıyla (grupları ve katmanı adlarıyla, Türkçe büyük küçük harf ayrımsız bulunur), geometrileri, alanları, kimlik alanları ve kayıtlı alanlarıyla; projenin değer listeleri, sınıflar arası ilişkiler ve adres verisi. Eksik gruplar ve katmanlar alanlarıyla açılır, var olan katmana eksik alanları eklenir; türü farklı alan (profile_field_differs), farklı değer listesi (profile_domain_differs) korunur, kilitli katman ve yolunda katman olmayan sınıf atlanır (profile_layer_skipped). Katmanlar ve alanları tek geri alma adımıdır (“Veri profili”); değer listeleri, ilişkiler ve adres verisi proje ayarıdır. Profil resmî bir uygulama şeması değildir; temeli profilin basis'inde yazılıdır. Plan yazmadan aynısını söyler. Profil kurumun kendi adlarıyla da uygulanır (docs/adr/0558): name yerleşik olmayan bir ad verilirse profil çizimin “profiller” klasöründeki dosyasından (drawing çizimin dosyası) okunur; mapping (ya da projenin eşlemesinin adı, mappingName) verilirse profil o eşlemeden okunur: kurumun katman yolları, alan adları ve kodlarıyla bulunur ve eklenir, hiçbir şey kendiliğinden yeniden adlandırılmaz (unknown_mapping, invalid_profile_mapping). expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

lists, relations and address data the drawing lacks; what it has is kept and said. The layers and their fields are
one undo step “Veri profili”; the value lists, relations and address data are project settings, no undo step.

The profile is `profile` when given, else the built-in `name`. Refusals, in this order: `unknown_profile` (neither, or
a name KentOS has not), `invalid_profile`, `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict`. Warnings: `profile_field_differs`,
`profile_domain_differs`, `profile_layer_skipped`.

commands.title: Veri profilini denetle
commands.summary: Çizimin verisinin bir veri profilinden nerede ayrıldığını söyler; hiçbir şeyi değiştirmez, plan aynı cevabı verir. Bulgular sırasıyla: projede olmayan değer listeleri; sınıf sınıf eksik katman, eksik alan, türü farklı alan, başka geometrideki nesneler, boş zorunlu alanlar, alanın kuralına uymayan değerler (değer başına), birden çok nesnedeki kimlikler, kayıtlı alanı geometrik alanından profilin toleransından çok ayrılan nesneler (iki alan da söylenir; hiçbiri öbürünün yerine yazılmaz); sonra projede olmayan ilişkiler ve üst sınıfta olmayan nesneyi anan bağlar, en sonda adres verisi. Her bulgu türü, sınıfı, katmanı, konusu, değeri, nesnelerin kalıcı kimlikleri (en çok 1000) ve sayısı, Veri profilini uygula'nın düzeltip düzeltmediği ve Türkçe iletisiyle gelir; sınıfların nesne ve bulgu sayıları da. clean bulgu olmadığını söyler, mevzuata uygunluğu değil. Profil, Veri profilini uygula gibi, çizimin klasöründeki bir dosyadan (name, drawing) ve bir eşlemeden (mapping, mappingName) okunabilir: bulgular kurumun adlarıyla gelir, raporda mapping eşlemenin adını söyler (docs/adr/0558).

commands.title: Veri profili içe aktar
commands.summary: Kurumun kendi veri profilini ya da eşlemesini projeye alır: bir JSON dosyası (source: mutlak yol ya da çizimin klasöründen), profilin kendisi (profile) ya da eşlemenin kendisi (mapping), yalnız biri. Dosya biçimiyle tanınır: kentos.data-profile bir veri profili, kentos.profile-mapping bir eşlemedir; başka biçim unknown_profile_format, 1'den başka biçim sürümü unsupported_profile_version, okunmayan JSON ya da tutmayan profil invalid_profile, tutmayan eşleme invalid_profile_mapping ile reddedilir (eşleme profiliyle denetlenir: sınıflar, alanlar, kodlar profilde olmalı, kurumdaki adlar çakışmamalı). Profil çizimin dosyasının yanındaki “profiller” klasörüne <ad>.profil.json, eşleme <ad>.eslem.json olarak yazılır (ad küçük harf, rakam ve tire; klasör yoksa açılır): çizimin dosyası yoksa invalid_file_path. KentOS'un kendi profilinin adı alınamaz (profile_name_taken). Aynı adlı profil var ve daha yeni sürümdeyse profile_downgrade, aynı sürümdeyse file_exists; daha eski sürümdeyse değiştirilir ve söylenir (profile_replaced); overwrite her birinin üzerine yazar. Dosya geçici adla yazılıp geri okunur, sonra yerine konur: bütün ya da hiç. Çizim değişmez, geri alma adımı yoktur; plan yazmadan aynısını söyler. Profilin sürümü kendi release sayısıdır (biçim sürümü version değil) ve migrations'ı bir sürümden sonrakine veriyi taşıyan adımlardır; Veri profili göçü onları çalıştırır.

commands.title: Veri profili göçü
commands.summary: Projenin verisini bir profilin from sürümünden to sürümüne (verilmezse profilin kendi sürümüne) profilin kendi göç adımlarıyla taşır. Profil profile ile ya da adıyla (yerleşik ya da projenin dosyası) verilir. Göç bir sürümden sonrakine gider ve profilin migrations listesinde yazılıdır; from'dan to'ya kesintisiz bir yol yoksa migration_gap, to from'dan büyük değilse ya da profilin sürümünü aşıyorsa invalid_migration. Adımlar sırasıyla, her biri çizimin o anki hâline göre: renameLayer (katman yolundaki son ad değişir; aynı yerde o ad varsa layer_refused), renameField (alan adı ve nesnelerin değerleri taşınır; formların, ilişkilerin ve ifadelerin anması izler), changeFieldType (alanın yeni tanımı; her değer yeni kuraldan geçip kanonik metniyle yazılır; uymayan onFail'e göre olduğu gibi kalır ya da boşaltılır ve değer değer raporlanır), mapValues (eski değerler yenisi olur; birkaçı birleşebilir, bir eski değer başka alanın değerine göre ikiye ayrılabilir; çok değerli alanda her kod), retireCode (projenin değer listesinde kod kullanımdan kalkar; replaceWith ile ona bağlı alanların o kodlu değerleri başka kod olur). Katmanı, alanı ya da değer listesi çizimde olmayan adım atlanır ve söylenir (migration_step_skipped); zaten uygulanmış adım sessiz atlanır, kilitli katman atlanır (profile_layer_skipped). Hepsi tek geri alma adımıdır (“Profil göçü”, değer listeleri dahil); yalnız katman adları adımın dışındadır: katmanın adı çizimin bayrağıdır, hiçbir katman yeniden adlandırması geri alınmaz (docs/adr/0020), geri alma alanları, değerleri ve listeleri geri verir. layer_refused'ta hiçbir şey yazılmaz. Göç yeni sürümün getirdiklerini eklemez: Veri profilini uygula ekler, Veri profilini denetle verinin hâlâ ayrıldığı yeri söyler; önce göç, sonra uygula. Cevapta adım adım ne yapıldığı, kaç nesneye yazıldığı ve uymayan değerler (katman, alan, değer, nesnelerin kalıcı kimlikleri en çok 1000, sayı) vardır. Plan yazmadan aynısını söyler. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

its release `to` (the profile's own by default) by the steps the profile's migrations list: a layer or a field renamed,
a field's kind changed with its values carried through the new rule, values recoded, a code retired. All of it is one
undo step “Profil göçü” (the value lists too). A step whose layer or field the drawing has not is left out and said;
a value that does not fit is kept or emptied as the step says and reported by object. The profile is `profile`, else
the built-in or project `name`. It does not add what the new release brings: `cad.profiles.apply` does, and
`cad.profiles.check` says where the data still departs.

the profile's release), `migration_gap` (no unbroken chain of the profile's migrations from `from` to `to`),
`invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict`, `layer_refused` (a step the drawing refuses; nothing is written). Warnings:
`migration_step_skipped`, `profile_layer_skipped` (a locked layer), `values_unfit`.

commands.title: Pafta seti
commands.summary: Projenin pafta kitabını pafta seti olarak listeler; çizimi ve kitabı değiştirmez. details=true tam kitap, sistem şablonları, standardRatios ve güncel namedViews listesini verir; pictures=true gömülü resim baytlarını ekler. Canlı adlı görünümün çerçeve ölçeği ve köşeleri güncel kaynaktan hesaplanır; book içindeki capture değişmez. Paftalar kitabın sırasıyla, adlarının numarasıyla serilere ayrılır (A-101 → A-1 Planlar; A-2 Görünüşler, A-3 Kesitler, A-5 Detaylar; numarasız Diğer, en sonda). Her harita çerçevesi: kimliği, adı, ölçeği, gösterdiği zemin (dört köşesi doğu ve kuzey, metre; kutusu) ve ona bakan görünüm işaretleri; atlas gibi sabit görünümü olmayan çerçevenin zemini yoktur. uids verilince etkilenen çerçeveler: nesnelerden birinin kutusu çerçevenin zemin kutusuyla kesişen (shows), nesnelerden bir görünüm işaretinin hedefi olan (marked) ve zemini bilinmeyen (unknown) çerçeveler, kitabın sırasıyla; paftaları yeniden basılacaklardır. Kutu kesişimidir: fazladan pafta listelenebilir, eksik listelenmez.

commands.summary: Başka bir çizim dosyasını dış başvuru olarak bağlar ve yönetir; her işlem tek geri alma adımı. operation.kind: attach (path mutlak .kcad ya da .pdf yolu; page PDF'in sayfası, 1'den, yoksa 1; mode attach ya da overlay; name yoksa dosyanın adı; at, scale, rotation derece; layerId yerleştirmenin katmanı): kaynağın nesneleri (resim, raster ve tablo dışında) bir blok tanımı olur, katmanları “Dış başvuru: ad” grubunun altına gelir, bir yerleştirme konur; reload kaynağı yeniden okur (yerleştirmeler aynı, kaynağın nesnelerine bağlı ölçüler ve kılavuz uçları aynı nesneleri izler, silineninki kopar); unload içeriği boşaltır; repath yeni yoldaki dosyayı bağlar ve yükler; detach tanımı, getirdiklerini, bütün yerleştirmelerini ve katman grubunu siler; bind (mode bind: katmanlar grupta kalır; insert: aynı yoldaki katmanlarla birleşir) sıradan bloğa çevirir; paths projenin arama yollarını yazar (ayar; kaynak yolunda ve göreli yolunda yoksa bu klasörlerde aranır); underlay PDF altlığının görünüşünü yazar (fade %0–80 soldurma, monochrome tek renk, plot false yazdırılmaz). PDF altlığı: sayfanın çizgileri, dolguları ve yazıları kâğıt metresinde (1 pt = 0,0254/72 m) sol alt köşesinden bir çizim olarak okunur, katmanları PDF'in isteğe bağlı içerik grupları; resimler ve gölgelemeler alınmaz (pdf_left_out); kenet ve ölçü onun çizgilerine olur ama sonuç kâğıttan okunmuştur, kanıtlanmış CAD geometrisi değildir (underlay_measure). Kaynağın attach dış başvuruları iç içe gelir, overlay olanlar gelmez; döngü xref_cycle. drawing açık çizimin dosya yolu: göreli yol ve döngü için. İç içe gelen dış başvuru kendi başına değiştirilemez (nested_xref). Plan yazmadan ne olacağını söyler.

commands.title: Raster oturt
commands.summary: Rasteri kontrol noktalarıyla çizime oturtur ve nasıl oturtulduğunu rasterin kaydına yazar (tek geri alma adımı “Raster oturt”). points: kaynağın pikseli (sütun, satır; piksel köşeleri, sol üst köşe 0, 0) ve hedefi (srid'in sisteminde; verilmezse projenin; başka sistem önce projeninkine çevrilir); check: dönüşüme girmeyen denetim noktası, hatası doğruluğu ölçer; off: kullanılmayan. method: helmert ve affine rasterin dönüşümünü değiştirir; projective, poly2, poly3 ve thinPlate rasteri kuzeye bakan ızgaraya yeniden örnekler (pixel verilmezse dönüşümün kontrol noktalarındaki ortalama ölçeği; resampling bilinear ya da nearest): bağlı kaynağın çıktısı output'a ya da kaynağın yanına “<ad>-oturtulmus.tif” olarak yazılır, gömülü kaynağınki kitaplığa gömülür; kaynak dosya değişmez. Yeniden örneklenmiş rasterin noktaları kaydındaki kaynağın pikselleridir; yeniden oturtma kaynaktan yapılır. made: ev sahibinin planın ızgarasıyla kendi yazdığı çıktı (dosya ya da kitaplıktaki raster); ızgarası planınki değilse ret. Kayıt: yöntem, noktalar, hedeflerin sistemi, kaynak ve SHA-256 özeti, m0, denetim noktalarının karesel ortalama ve en büyük hatası, çıktı ızgarası ve örnekleme. Denetim noktası yoksa no_check_points uyarısı. Plan yazmadan artıkları, hataları ve rasterin yeni hâlini verir.

commands.title: GeoPackage karolarını oku
commands.summary: Bir GeoPackage'ın karo (raster) tablosunu okur: tables dosyadaki her karo tablosunu (karo matrisi kümesinin kutusu, veri kutusu, EPSG kodu, her zoom düzeyinin matrisi, karo boyu, pikseli, karo sayısı ve karolarının biçimi) söyler. output verilirse seçilen zoom düzeyi (zoom; yoksa en yükseği) ve alan (area, tablonun sisteminde [en küçük x, en küçük y, en büyük x, en büyük y]; yoksa tablonun veri kutusu, o da yoksa karo matrisi kümesinin kutusu, düzeyin ızgarasına kesilir) tek raster olarak output'a kuzeyi yukarıda, tablonun sisteminde, dört bantlı (kırmızı, yeşil, mavi, alfa) 8 bitlik GeoTIFF yazılır; dosyada karosu olmayan yer saydamdır (alfa 0, tiles_missing). Pencerenin sınırı GDAL'ın GeoPackage sürücüsünün kuralıyla pikselin tamına yuvarlanır (başlangıç (min − küme başlangıcı) / piksel'in yuvarlağı, boy (en büyük − en küçük) / piksel + 0,5'in tamı) ve ızgaradan taşan yer kesilir. Karolar PNG olmalı ve matrisin karo boyunda olmalı (8 bit gri, gri+alfa, RGB, RGBA ve paletli); JPEG, WebP ve 8 bitten fazla PNG okunmaz (tile_format_unsupported); raster en çok 25 milyon piksel olur (gpkg_tiles_too_large). Tablo EPSG sistemini bildirmiyorsa srid 0 olur (crs_undeclared). layer verilirse raster output'a bağlı olarak o katmana eklenir (tek geri alma adımı “GeoPackage karoları”; sistemi projeninkinden başkaysa crs_mismatch); verilmezse çizim değişmez. Dosya yarım kalmaz: geçici adla yazılır, geri okunup denetlenir, sonra yerine konur; var olan output overwrite verilmezse reddedilir (file_exists). plan yazmadan söyler.

(not a `.tif`), `file_exists`, with `layer`: `layer_not_found`, `not_a_layer`, `layer_locked`, `crs_mismatch`, and

commands.title: Zamanda sorgu
commands.summary: Zamansal bir katmanın (layer) hangi nesnelerinin bir geçerlilik zamanında ve bilinen bir günde gösterildiğini söyler; çizimi değiştirmez. Geçerlilik zamanı bir an (at) ya da [from, to) aralığıdır, katmanın zaman ayarının kuralıyla (aralıklı, anlık, birikimli); zamansız nesne her zaman gösterilir. Bilinen gün (knownAt) yalnız o güne dek kaydedilmiş ve henüz yerine başkası geçmemiş sürümleri bırakır: katmanın recordedStart ve recordedEnd alanlarıyla (.kcad şema 90); kayıt zamanı tutmayan katmanda not_recorded. “O gün geçerli olan” ile “o gün sistemde bilinen” ayrı sorulur. An bir tarih ya da tarih ve saattir, bölgesiyle (Z, +03:00); bölgesiz saat UTC'dir; cevap anları UTC yazar. Cevap gösterilenlerin kalıcı kimliklerini çizimin sırasıyla ve öbürlerinin nedenlerini sayar: notValid (geçerlilik zamanı göstermiyor), notKnown (geçerli ama o gün bilinmiyor), timeless, unrecorded, unreadable.

commands.title: Nokta bulutunun bilgisi
commands.summary: Çizimin nokta bulutlarının (uids; yoksa hepsi, çizimin sırasıyla) her kaynağının başlığını okur ve söyler; çizimi değiştirmez. Kaynak: türü (las, laz, copc, text) ve sürümü, nokta biçimi ve kaydın boyu, nokta sayısı, kutusu, ölçek ve öteleme; yatay sistem (EPSG ve dosyanın yazdığı ad) ve düşey sistem (WKT'nin VERT_CS ya da VERTCRS adı, GeoTIFF anahtarı 4096'nın EPSG:n'si; yazmayan dosyada yok: kotların dayanağı bilinmez); başlığın oluşturulma günü (YYYY-MM-DD), noktaların GPS zamanı (standard ya da week), sistem ve yazılım, kaynak kimliği, GUID; her noktanın boyutları LAS'ın sırasıyla ve ek baytların adları ve türleri, dönüşe göre nokta sayıları, COPC'nin düğümleri. classes ile her noktanın sınıfı sayılır (kaynak bütün okunur; bir çağrıda en çok 200 milyon nokta, fazlası too_many_cloud_points). Metin bulutunun başlığı yoktur: sayısı ve kutusu bulutun kaydından. Okunamayan kaynak (bulunamadı, adresteki bulut, bozuk dosya) why ile söylenir ve uyarılır (cloud_source_unreadable); öbürleri okunur. commands.summary: Bir yerin (at) planda radius içindeki en yakın noktasını kaynağın tam çözünürlüğünde okur (çizimin ayrıntı düzeyi değil); çizimi değiştirmez. Bulutlar uids ile verilir, verilmezse görünen bulutlar bakılır. COPC'de yalnız arama karesine değen düğümler okunur, LAS ve LAZ bütün okunur. Cevap noktanın koordinatlarını, uzaklığını, sınıfını, yoğunluğunu, dönüşünü, kaynak kimliğini, GPS zamanını ve rengini, bakılan nokta sayısını (read) verir; eşit uzaklıkta önce bakılan kalır. Metin bulutu ve okunamayan kaynak uyarıyla atlanır (cloud_source_unreadable).

commands.summary: Bir alanın (ring: planda en az üç köşeli halka, kapalı sayılır; holes: delikler) içindeki nokta bulutu noktalarının istatistiğini kaynağın tam çözünürlüğünde okur (çizimin ayrıntı düzeyi değil); çizimi değiştirmez. Sınırdaki nokta alanın içindedir, bir deliğin kesin içindeki dışındadır. Bulutlar uids ile verilir, verilmezse görünen bulutlar bakılır. commands.summary: Bir yolun (path: planda en az iki köşe) çevresindeki koridorda (width: yolun iki yanında toplam genişlik; uçlar yuvarlak) nokta bulutu noktalarını istasyonlara (step: yol boyunca adım) ayırır, kaynağın tam çözünürlüğünde okur (çizimin ayrıntı düzeyi değil); çizimi değiştirmez. Noktanın istasyonu, yolun en yakın doğru parçasındaki ayağının yol boyunca uzaklığıdır (eşit uzaklıkta önceki parça); ofseti yolun solunda artıdır. İstasyon yolun başından sayılır, [from, to) aralıklıdır, son istasyon yolun ucunu da içerir. Cevap yolun uzunluğunu, koridordaki nokta sayısını, her istasyonun (boş olanlar dahil) nokta sayısını ve yükseklik değerlerinin en küçüğünü, en büyüğünü ve ortalamasını, bakılan nokta sayısını (read) verir; points ile noktalar da (kalıcı kimlik, istasyon, ofset, yer, sınıf) istasyona göre sıralı listelenir. commands.summary: Çizimin mesh rasterlerinin (uids; yoksa hepsi, çizimin sırasıyla) dosyasının başlığını ve ağını okur ve söyler; çizimi değiştirmez. Mesh: düğüm, yüz, kenar ve üçgen sayısı, kutusu, yüzlerinin toplam alanı, kenarlarının ortalama uzunluğu, koordinat sistemi (EPSG, coğrafi mi) ve veri setleri: değişkeni (vektörün x bileşeni; y bileşeni), adı ve birimi, düğümde mi yüzde mi, boyutları (zaman boyutu ayrıca: adım sayısı, ilk ve son an ve nasıl yazıldıkları); rasterin gösterdiği veri seti ve adımları. Mesh, NetCDF dosyasındaki UGRID ağıdır (2DM ve DAT Mesh ekle'de böyle bir dosyaya çevrilir). Okunamayan dosya (bulunamadı, bozuk) why ile söylenir ve uyarılır (mesh_source_unreadable); öbürleri okunur. Dosya projenin öbür bağları gibi aranır; drawing açık çizimin dosyasıdır. NetCDF-4, HDF5, GRIB ve Zarr okunmaz (neden iletide).
