commands.title: Mesh sor
commands.summary: Bir yerin (at) hangi mesh yüzünde olduğunu ve veri setlerinin o yerdeki değerlerini söyler; çizimi değiştirmez. Yüz kesin bulunur (kapalı alanı yeri tutan üçgenlerin en küçük sıralısı); kalıcı kimliği meshin kalıcı kimliği (mesh), dosyadaki ağın adı (topology) ve yüzün dosyadaki sırasıdır (face); düğümleri ve alanı da söylenir. Değer: düğümdeki veri setinde üçgende doğrusal ara değer, yüzdeki veri setinde yüzün değeri, vektörde büyüklüğü; değer yoksa ya da yüz kapalıysa (maske 0) değer yok. time (1970'ten beri milisaniye) verilirse her veri setinin ondan önceki ya da onda olan son zaman adımının değeri okunur, ilk adımdan öncesinde değer yok; verilmezse rasterin gösterdiği adımlar. series ile zaman boyutlu her veri setinin her adımdaki değeri de verilir. Meshler uids sırasıyla (yoksa görünenler) bakılır, yeri tutan ilki cevaplar. Dosyadan yalnız gereken değerler okunur (read); bir çağrıda en çok 2 milyon değer (too_many_mesh_values).

commands.summary: Bir STAC API'sinde (endpoint: kökü, örneğin https://earth-search.aws.element84.com/v1) alanı ve zamanı kaplayan görüntü öğelerini arar; çizimi değiştirmez. bbox [batı, güney, doğu, kuzey] derece (WGS 84), datetime RFC 3339 an ya da aralık (başlangıç/bitiş, açık uç ..; 2024-07-01 gibi bir gün kendi günüdür), collections koleksiyonlar, ids öğe kimlikleri, maxCloudCover en çok bulut yüzdesi (eo:cloud_cover; sunucudan istenir ve gelende yeniden denetlenir, bulut oranı olmayan öğe kalır), limit sayfa boyu (1–100, varsayılan 10). Cevap: gönderilen istek (request: POST /search, gövde anahtarları alfabetik), öğeler (kataloğun adresi, koleksiyon, kimlik, çekim zamanı, kutu, bulut oranı, platform, gsd, EPSG, lisans ve varlıkları: anahtar, imzasız adres, roller, bantlar, rasterın veri türü, nodata, ölçek ve öteleme, proj:shape ve proj:transform), sunucunun gönderdiği sayı (returned), süzülenler (dropped), toplam (matched) ve sonraki sayfa (next: sunucunun next bağlantısı; verilirse o sayfa alınır, adresi uç noktanın sunucusunda olmalı). Bir varlığın kalıcı kimliği kataloğun adresi + koleksiyon + öğe + varlık anahtarıdır; imzalı (geçici) adresin sorgusu hiçbir yerde gösterilmez ya da yazılmaz (signed: true). Ağ ev sahibinindir: masaüstü ve MCP ağa gider; ağı olmayan ev sahibi stac_unavailable der.

StacMethod.description: An HTTP method of a STAC request.

StacNext.description:
A `next` link of a search page (STAC API item search §paging): the next request as the server wrote it. It is
taken only when its address is on the endpoint's own host (`stac_next_foreign`).

body.description: A POST's body; with `merge` it is laid over the search's own body.

input.description:
Input of `cad.stac.search` v1. `endpoint` is the STAC API's root (`https://…/v1`), without a query or a login.
`bbox` is `[west, south, east, north]` in degrees (WGS 84; a box crossing the 180° meridian is two searches).
`datetime` is an RFC 3339 instant or interval (`start/end`, an open end `..`); a bare date `2024-07-01` is its
day (`T00:00:00Z`, and `T23:59:59Z` as an interval's end). `maxCloudCover` (percent) is asked of the server
(`eo:cloud_cover`) and checked again on what comes back. With `next` the page after one already read; the other
fields stay the search's (the filter on cloud cover still applies). Refusals, in this order:
`invalid_stac_endpoint`, `invalid_stac_bbox`, `invalid_stac_datetime`, `invalid_stac_cloud_cover`,
`invalid_stac_limit`, `invalid_stac_collection`, `stac_next_foreign`, `stac_unavailable` (the host cannot reach
a network), `stac_request_failed`, `stac_response_unreadable`.

ids.description: Items by id (the search narrowed to them).

Output of `cad.stac.search` v1, and its plan. `items` are the page's, in the server's order, without those over

sent; `matched` is its total (`numberMatched`) when it said; `next` is the page after.

commands.title: STAC verisini hazırla
commands.summary: Aramanın döndürdüğü bir öğenin (item) seçilen varlıklarını (assets: red, nir, swir16 …; her biri tek bantlı COG) çizime adresleriyle bağlı raster olarak ekler: tek yeni grup (group; yoksa “STAC: öğenin kimliği”) ve her varlık için anahtarının adını taşıyan bir katman; tek geri alma adımı “STAC verisini hazırla”. Raster ızgarasını katalogdan alır (proj:shape, proj:transform, proj:epsg; varlıkta ya da öğede) ve dosya açılmaz; sistemi projeninkinden başkaysa crs_mismatch (dönüşüm yok). nodata ve veri türü kataloğundur. qa kalite bandıdır (asset + isteğe bağlı mask: values ya da bits; verilmezse platformun kuralı: Sentinel-2 scl sınıfları 0, 1, 3, 8, 9, 10; Landsat qa_pixel bitleri 0–4): ayrıca eklenir ve veri bantlarından değildir; maske bu komutta uygulanmaz, kaydedilir. search aramanın kaydıdır (endpoint, bbox, datetime, collections, maxCloudCover). Cevaptaki hazırlama kaydı (kentos.stac-preparation 1) aramayı, öğeyi, çekim zamanını, bulut oranını, her bandın adını, adresini (imzasız), veri türünü, nodata'sını, ölçeğini ve ötelemesini, ızgarasını, kalite bandını ve maske kuralını, katman ve nesne kimliklerini taşır; reflectance bantların ortak ölçek ve ötelemesidir (Spektral indis'in Ölçek ve Öteleme'si). Aynı kayıt her rasterin özniteliklerinde de durur (stac.catalog, stac.collection, stac.item, stac.asset, stac.href, stac.scale, stac.offset …). Adresi s3:// olan varlık stac_href_not_http ile reddedilir; imzalı adresin imzası yazılmaz (stac_signed_href_stripped): imza gerektiren dosya açılmaz. plan yazmadan kaydı söyler.

`stac_multiband`, `stac_qa_unknown`, `crs_mismatch`, `invalid_group_name`, then `invalid_revision`,
`revision_conflict`.

commands.title: Kırp
commands.summary: Blok ve dış başvuru yerleştirmelerini kırpar (AutoCAD'in XCLIP'i); tek geri alma adımı “Kırp”. operation.kind: set (boundary çizimde: rectangle a, b köşeleriyle ya da polygon points; inverted dışını gösterir; frame hide, show: yalnız ekranda çerçeve, plot: çerçeve içerikle çizilir ve yazdırılır), remove (sınır kalkar), frame (çerçevenin görünüşü), invert (içi ve dışı yer değiştirir). Sınır yerleştirmenin tanımında saklanır: yerleştirme taşınınca, döndürülünce, ölçeklenince onunla gider. Dolu alanlar alan olarak, çizgiler ve kapalı eğrilerin sınırları yol olarak kesilir; yazı, nokta ve tarama kutusunun ortasına göre ya bütün ya hiç. Kilitli katmandakiler atlanır ve sayılır. Retler: no_entities, invalid_uid, entity_not_found, not_an_insert, layer_locked, invalid_clipping (en az 3, en çok 10 000 köşe, alanı olan, kendini kesmeyen), not_clipped, invalid_revision, revision_conflict; uyarılar layer_locked, clip_empty. commands.title: Çizelge
commands.summary: Çizimin açıklıklarından, mahallerinden, kolonlarından ya da duvarlarından (of: openings, spaces, columns, walls) bir çizelge tablosu yerleştirir; sol üst köşesi at. Tek geri alma adımı “Çizelge”. columns sütunlardır (field: number, type, form, width, height, sill, head, wall, level, phase, count, area, perimeter, volume, name, usage, tag, place, length, thickness, attr; title başlık, attr öznitelik adı); verilmezse türün sütunları. filter kat, evre, biçim (yalnız açıklıkta) ve katmanla süzer; sort sütunlara göre sıralar (yoksa çizimin sırası); group aynı satırları birleştirir (adet, alan, çevre, hacim ve uzunluk toplanır); total toplam satırı ekler. Çizelgenin satırları her adımda belgece yeniden yazılır: kapı değişince satırı da değişir. Uzunluklar projenin biriminde ve basamağında, alanlar alan biriminde. height yazı yüksekliği (m; verilmezse projenin tablo yüksekliği çizim ölçeğinde). Katman açıkça verilir.

curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

Satırın nesnelerinden biri kilitli katmandaysa hiçbir şey yazılmaz. Plan yazmadan çizelgeyi olacağı gibi gösterir.

matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

The objects a hatch follows (docs/adr/0186 §6, 0328 §3): a hatch made inside a closed object follows the

(`bounds`: the objects whose line work bounds it, its islands' too) follows that line work; the point clicked
inside picks the region's part or face. Exactly one of `outer` and `bounds` is given.

oneOf.description:

to `t1` (radians): counter-clockwise when `t1` is past `t0`, clockwise when before it; a whole ellipse
`t1 = t0 ± 2π`.
A NURBS curve run whole, from its first knot to its last.

InsertEntity.description:
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144): its definition drawn

transform is a similarity, shapes keeping their kind, unless the insert
has a y factor of its own (docs/adr/0315 §3): then an affine, a circle
becoming the exact ellipse of its image. The insert's own attributes
carry the values of the definition's attribute definitions.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).

across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

commands.summary: Duvarlara kapı, pencere ya da boşluk koyar; tek geri alma adımı, ilkinin biçimiyle “Kapı”, “Pencere” ya da “Boşluk”. Her açıklık duvarıyla (host: kalıcı kimliği) ve yeriyle verilir: at (duvarın taban çizgisi boyunca başından açıklığın ortasına, m), ya da point (duvarın yanında bir nokta: ortası taban çizgisinin ona en yakın yerinde), ya da point ile distance ve from (açıklığın yakın pervazı duvarın o ucundan, köşeden distance m; from start, end ya da near: noktaya yakın uç), ya da point ile middle (noktanın yanındaki kenarın ortası). type KentOS'un açıklık türüdür (kimliği ya da adı: Kapı 90, Kapı 80, İki kanatlı kapı 140, Sürme kapı 160, Pencere 120, Sabit pencere 100, Boşluk 100); verilmezse biçiminin ilki. form, width, leaves (1 ya da 2), operation (swing kanatlı, slide sürme, fixed sabit), hand (menteşe yolun başında ya da sonunda), side (kanadın açıldığı yan; verilmezse noktanın yanı, o da yoksa sol), swing (açılma açısı, derece) ve number türün değerlerinin üstüne yazılır. Açıklık duvarın tek bir kenarında (düz ya da yay), uçlarının arasında olmalıdır (opening_off_wall) ve aynı duvardaki başka açıklığa binmez (openings_overlap). Pervazları duvardan çizilir, duvarın çizgileri onların arasında açılır; duvar taşınınca, uzayınca ya da kalınlaşınca açıklık onunla gider. Katman girdide açıkça verilir: kilitli katmana yazılmaz, gizli katmana uyarıyla yazılır. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz. Plan yazmadan açıklıkları pervazlarıyla gösterir.

input.description:
Input of `cad.openings.create` v1: doors, windows and bare openings in their walls, written as one undo step
(“Kapı”, “Pencere” or “Boşluk”, the first's form). The tool gives the wall clicked and the point, the type and the
values chosen (TODOS.md CMD-07).

Where it goes: `at`; else `point` with `distance` (its near jamb that far from the wall's end `from`); else `point`
with `middle` (centred on the base line's edge the point is by); else `point` (centred where the base line passes
nearest it). It lies on one edge of its wall's base line, within its ends, clear of the wall's other openings.

Refusals, in this order: `no_objects`, `not_finite`, `invalid_uid`, `entity_not_found`, `not_a_wall`,
`style_not_found`, `invalid_opening`, `opening_off_wall`, `openings_overlap`, `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict`,
`layer_not_found`, `not_a_layer`, `layer_locked`; on the desktop also `slots_exhausted`. Warning: `layer_hidden`.

The triangle's two sides (Açık ok).

A gap in one of a dimension's lines where another object crosses it (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK), at the fraction `t` of

DimensionEntity.description:

file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

angle.description: Linear: measured direction in degrees (0 = ΔY, 90 = ΔX).

annotative.description:

at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

arrowSize.description:

`DEFAULT_ARROW` for the others.

DimensionFit.description:
Where the value goes when it does not fit between the extension lines (AutoCAD's DIMATFIT and DIMTIX): absent,
always between them.

oneOf.description: Beyond the second extension line when the value and the two arrowheads are longer than the line between them.
Always beyond the second extension line, the arrowheads outside.

DimensionOptions.description: A dimension's options (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2): all absent, the dimension as it always was.

breakSize.description: A break's width, times the value's height, over 0; absent: 1 (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK size).

lengthStyle.description:
Feet and inches in an inch or foot unit (AutoCAD's DIMLUNIT, docs/adr/0262 §2); absent: the project's, unless
the dimension names its own unit.

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

DrawingFont.description:
The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

check.description: A check point: kept out of the fit; its error says how good the fit is where no control point is.

name.description: What the user calls it (a mark on the sheet, a survey point's name).

off.description: Left out (Kullan off): neither fits nor checks; its residual is still shown.

target.description: Its east and north (a geographic system's longitude and latitude, degrees).

HatchLoop.description:

InsertEntity.description:
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144): its definition drawn
moved from the definition's base point to `p`, mirrored in the
definition's x axis when `mirror`, then scaled and turned about `p`. The
transform is a similarity, shapes keeping their kind, unless the insert
has a y factor of its own (docs/adr/0315 §3): then an affine, a circle
becoming the exact ellipse of its image. The insert's own attributes
carry the values of the definition's attribute definitions.

first leaders'; the others AutoCAD's arrowheads (docs/adr/0205 §7, `.kcad`
schema 30).

oneOf.description: Açık ok: the filled triangle's two sides (Open).
Dolu nokta: a filled dot (Dot).
Yok: no arrowhead, the line ends at the tip (None).
Boş üçgen: the triangle's outline (Closed blank).
İnce açık ok: two sides 15° off the line (Open 30).
Dik açık ok: two sides square to each other (Open 90, Right angle).
Küçük nokta (Dot small).
Boş nokta: a ring (Dot blank).
Eğik çizgi: a tick across the tip (Oblique).
Mimari çentik: a heavy tick (Architectural tick).
Dolu kare (Box filled).
Boş kare (Box blank).
Dayanak üçgeni: a filled triangle standing on the tip (Datum triangle filled).

through its vertices and, with a note, a landing from its last vertex
along the note's direction and the note past the landing's end; one
object. The arrowhead and the landing are measured by the note's height.

at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

oblique.description:

right; within ±`MAX_OBLIQUE`, never 0 (upright is the field's absence).

path.description:

rotation.description: Degrees, counter-clockwise from east.

runs.description:

UTF-16 units), in order, not overlapping, each with a format; a run

commands.title: Açıklığı düzenle
commands.summary: Kalıcı kimlikleri verilen kapı, pencere ve boşlukları değiştirir; tek geri alma adımı “Açıklığı düzenle”, hepsi ya da hiçbiri. operation: set (alanlar: genişlik, biçim, kanat, açılış, menteşe, yan, açı, açılım yayı, kasa, denizlik, lento, numara; null alanı kaldırır), move (by: duvar boyunca kaydırma, sona doğru artı; at: yeni konum), flip (what: side açılış yanı, hand menteşe, both ikisi), rehost (to: başka duvarın kimliği; point verilirse ortası oraya en yakın yerde, verilmezse pervazlarının ortasına en yakın yerde; aynalanmış gibi düşerse menteşe ve yan çevrilir), replaceType (to: KentOS'un türü; uids boşsa from türündeki bütün açıklıklar), renumber (prefix ve start: K1, K2 …; duvarların sırasıyla ve her duvar boyunca; uids boşsa form biçimindeki ya da bütün açıklıklar), copy (offsets: her uzaklıkta duvar boyunca bir kopya, numarasız). Duvarın dışına ya da köşesine taşan (opening_off_wall), başka açıklığa binen (openings_overlap) açıklık yazılmaz; duvarı olmayan açıklık duvar boyunca taşınmaz ve kopyalanmaz (opening_host_gone), önce rehost'la bir duvara konur. Kilitli katmandaki açıklık bütün değişikliği reddeder. Plan yazmadan açıklıkları olacakları gibi gösterir.

width.description: The rough opening, metres; it grows about its anchor.

oneOf.description: Taşı: along its wall by `by` (toward its end positive), or its anchor to `at`.
Çevir: the side it opens to, its hinge's end, or both.

Başka duvara: each opening into the wall `to` (its persistent id), centred where the wall's base line passes
nearest `point`, else nearest its jambs' middle.

Türü değiştir: the type `to` (its id or name) for the openings named, or with no ids every opening of type
`from`.

Numarala: marks `prefix` + `start`, `start` + 1, … in their walls' order and along each wall; with no ids every
opening of the form `form` (all forms: absent).
Kopyala: a copy of each opening along its wall at each offset (toward its end positive).

input.description:
Input of `cad.openings.edit` v1: openings named by their persistent ids changed as one undo step “Açıklığı
düzenle”, all or none. An opening that would run off its wall or into another: nothing is written.

Refusals: `no_entities`, `invalid_uid`, `entity_not_found`, `not_an_opening`, `nothing_to_set`, `not_finite`,
`invalid_opening`, `style_not_found`, `style_not_used`, `not_a_wall`, `opening_host_gone`, `opening_off_wall`,
`openings_overlap`, `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict`, `layer_locked`; on the desktop also `slots_exhausted`.

as at 1:1 times `scale` at every drawing scale, turned `angle` degrees along the wall's path, in its own colour.

scale.description: Times the pattern's paper size, above 0.

ConstructionEntity.description: Construction line or ray: base point and unit direction.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

DatasetDim.description:
One of a dataset's slice dimensions (docs/adr/0243 §6): its name, the
index shown, its values (coordinates; moments in milliseconds since 1970
when `time`) and units.

time.description: The values are a CF time axis's moments.

DimensionArrow.description:
A dimension's arrowheads other than the oblique tick, which is no value but
the field's absence (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: A filled triangle, its tip on the dimension line's end (Dolu ok).
The triangle's two sides (Açık ok).
A filled circle about the end (Nokta).
Nothing at the ends (Yok).

DimensionBreak.description:
A gap in one of a dimension's lines where another object crosses it (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK), at the fraction `t` of
the line; its width the options' `breakSize`.

DimensionEntity.description:
Fields every object has. `id` is the object's local id inside a v1 file.
v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

angle.description: Linear: measured direction in degrees (0 = ΔY, 90 = ΔX).

annotative.description:
Its scales: drawn at the paper height it was given at every scale it takes part in, hidden
at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

arrowSize.description:
The arrowhead's (or tick's) length; absent: `DEFAULT_TICK` for ticks,
`DEFAULT_ARROW` for the others.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

breaks.description: The gaps in its lines where other objects cross them (docs/adr/0321 §1).

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

c.description:
Angular: the vertex. Arc length: the arc's centre. Jogged: the centre
the line starts from (docs/adr/0147).

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

decimals.description:
A length's, a coordinate's or a slope's decimals; absent: the
project's length decimals (a slope's 2). Angles keep the project's.

dimLineColor.description:
The dimension line's and its arrowheads' colour, `#RRGGBB`; absent:
the object's (docs/adr/0205 §6).

dimLineType.description: The dimension line's type; absent: continuous.

dimLineWeight.description: The dimension line's weight, paper mm as an object's; absent: a hairline.

dimStyle.description: The project's dimension style it follows, by its id; absent: Standart.

extBeyond.description: How far the extension lines pass the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_BEYOND`.

extColor.description: The extension lines' colour; absent: the object's.

extLineType.description: The extension lines' type; absent: continuous.

extOffset.description: The extension lines' gap from the measured points; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_OFFSET`.

extWeight.description: The extension lines' weight, paper mm; absent: a hairline.

font.description: The value's typeface; absent: the project's.

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

mask.description:
The value is drawn over the drawing's background (docs/adr/0147, as a
text's mask, docs/adr/0145).

options.description: Where the value goes when it does not fit and how it is written (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

overrides.description:
The fields set apart from its style by hand (docs/adr/0322 §5), by name (`DIMENSION_OVERRIDES`): they keep
their value when the style changes. Empty: each field follows while it holds the style's old value.

prefix.description: Written before the value (and its kind's own prefix).

refs.description: The objects its points follow (docs/adr/0249): an associative dimension; none, free points.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

textColor.description: The value's colour; absent: the object's.

textGap.description: The value's baseline over the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_TEXT_GAP`.

textPlace.description: Where the value stands; absent: over the line.

textShift.description: Its value moved from its place (docs/adr/0321 §1).

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

unit.description: The unit lengths and coordinates are written in; absent: the project's.

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

za.description: Slope: the two points' elevations, metres (docs/adr/0147).

DimensionFit.description:
Where the value goes when it does not fit between the extension lines (AutoCAD's DIMATFIT and DIMTIX): absent,
always between them.

oneOf.description: Beyond the second extension line when the value and the two arrowheads are longer than the line between them.
Always beyond the second extension line, the arrowheads outside.

DimensionOptions.description: A dimension's options (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2): all absent, the dimension as it always was.

breakSize.description: A break's width, times the value's height, over 0; absent: 1 (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK size).

lengthStyle.description:
Feet and inches in an inch or foot unit (AutoCAD's DIMLUNIT, docs/adr/0262 §2); absent: the project's, unless
the dimension names its own unit.

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

DrawingFont.description:
The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

EllipseEntity.description: DXF ELLIPSE: centre, major axis vector, minor/major ratio, parameters t0 → t1.

Entity.description: Any drawing object, tagged by `kind` as in the TypeScript model.

oneOf.description: A general NURBS curve: degree, control points, weights and knots (docs/adr/0259).
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144).
An arrow with a note (docs/adr/0146).
Rows and columns of cells (docs/adr/0184).
A picture (docs/adr/0192).
An orthophoto, a scanned sheet or an elevation model (docs/adr/0204).
A point cloud: LAS, LAZ, COPC or text files (docs/adr/0207).
A wall (docs/adr/0339): its path, width, justification and components; its faces drawn from them.

A door, a window or a bare opening in a wall (docs/adr/0341): its wall's id, its place along it and its
jambs' points.
A grid (docs/adr/0343): its line, label and bubbles.
A column (docs/adr/0343): its centre, outline and the grids it stands on.
A stair (docs/adr/0343): its walking line and its risers, treads and landings.
A ramp (docs/adr/0343): its centre line, width, rise and landings.
A tag (docs/adr/0344): its object, its words and frame.
A view mark (docs/adr/0345): a section, elevation or detail mark pointing at a view.

A record without a geometry (docs/adr/0410): a table's row, with the base's attributes,
attachments and label; not drawn, picked or snapped to.

FieldBroken.description: Why a field's value cannot be read.

oneOf.description: The object is gone.
The object has no such value (an open object's area, a line's text).
The attribute or the variable named is not there.
Texts whose fields read each other in a ring.

FieldFormat.description: How a field writes a number.

comma.description: A decimal comma (`24,35`) instead of a point.

decimals.description: Absent: the project's length or area decimals.

unit.description: Absent: the drawing unit for a length or a place, the project's area unit for an area.

FieldSource.description: Where a field's value comes from.

oneOf.description: An object, by its persistent id.

name.description: The attribute's name, with `attribute`.

oneOf.description: The project.

name.description: The variable's name, with `variable`; the block's, with `blockCount`.

FieldUnit.description: The unit a field writes a number in.

GeorefMethod.description: A transform from the source's pixels to the drawing (docs/adr/0204 §6).

GeorefOutput.description: A resampled raster's grid: north-up, its corner on a multiple of its pixel (docs/adr/0204 §6).

digest.description: The written file's SHA-256 when it was written.

GeorefPoint.description:
A control or check point: a pixel of the source (column, row; pixel corners, 0, 0 the upper left corner of the
upper left pixel, as GDAL's GCPs) and where it is (`target`, in the record's `srid`).

check.description: A check point: kept out of the fit; its error says how good the fit is where no control point is.

name.description: What the user calls it (a mark on the sheet, a survey point's name).

off.description: Left out (Kullan off): neither fits nor checks; its residual is still shown.

target.description: Its east and north (a geographic system's longitude and latitude, degrees).

GeorefSource.description: The raster the points' pixels are of: what it read and its size.

asset.description: The project library's raster it was (embedded).

digest.description: Its bytes' SHA-256 (64 lowercase hex digits) when they were read: the revision the points belong to.

file.description: The file it was (linked), as kept.

url.description: The address it was read from.

GradientShape.description: How a gradient runs over its hatch (docs/adr/0186 §3).

oneOf.description: From one side of the hatch to the other along `angle`.
The second colour along the middle, the first at both sides.
The second colour in the middle, the first at the farthest corner.

GridBubbles.description: Which ends of a grid carry a bubble.

HatchAssoc.description:
The objects a hatch follows (docs/adr/0186 §6, 0328 §3): a hatch made inside a closed object follows the
object (`outer`), its islands, the texts and inserts left open; a hatch made in the face line work closes
(`bounds`: the objects whose line work bounds it, its islands' too) follows that line work; the point clicked
inside picks the region's part or face. Exactly one of `outer` and `bounds` is given.

bounds.description: The objects whose line work closes its face (docs/adr/0328 §3).

gap.description: A face's tie: the gaps its line work was closed across, metres (docs/adr/0329 §3); absent: none.

HatchCurve.description: A boundary edge that is no line or circular arc (docs/adr/0328 §1).

oneOf.description:
An ellipse's arc: centre `c`, major semi-axis `major` (from `c`), minor to major `ratio`, from parameter `t0`
to `t1` (radians): counter-clockwise when `t1` is past `t0`, clockwise when before it; a whole ellipse
`t1 = t0 ± 2π`.
A NURBS curve run whole, from its first knot to its last.

annotative.description:
Its scales (docs/adr/0331 §3): an annotative hatch's pattern is drawn at each scale it takes part in as large

assoc.description: The objects its region follows (docs/adr/0186 §6); none: it stays as drawn.

the ring and holes are all it has.

HatchLoop.description:
One closed loop of a hatch's boundary as its source holds it (docs/adr/0328 §1): edge `i` runs from `pts[i]` to
the next point (the last to the first); it is straight, a circular arc of `bulges[i]` (tan(θ/4), counter-clockwise
positive, as a polygon's), or the curve `curves[i]` (an ellipse's arc or a NURBS curve), whose ends are those
points. A loop of one point is one closed curve.

angle.description:
Degrees, counter-clockwise from east: the lines' (lines, cross), the
pattern's turn (pattern), the gradient's direction (gradient).

gradient.description: A gradient's shape and second colour.

name.description: A pattern's name (`ANSI31`).

origin.description:
Where its lines are anchored in the world (docs/adr/0331 §2; AutoCAD's HPORIGIN): every family goes through
it as the definition says instead of through the world's origin. Absent: the world's origin.

spacing.description: Metres between the lines (lines, cross); 1 and unread for the others.

inverted.description: The content outside the boundary is drawn, the inside left out.

InsertEntity.description:
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144): its definition drawn
moved from the definition's base point to `p`, mirrored in the
definition's x axis when `mirror`, then scaled and turned about `p`. The
transform is a similarity, shapes keeping their kind, unless the insert
has a y factor of its own (docs/adr/0315 §3): then an affine, a circle
becoming the exact ellipse of its image. The insert's own attributes
carry the values of the definition's attribute definitions.

textGap.description: The value's baseline over the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_TEXT_GAP`.

textPlace.description: Where the value stands; absent: over the line.

textShift.description: Its value moved from its place (docs/adr/0321 §1).

za.description: Slope: the two points' elevations, metres (docs/adr/0147).

DimensionFit.description:
Where the value goes when it does not fit between the extension lines (AutoCAD's DIMATFIT and DIMTIX): absent,
always between them.

oneOf.description: Beyond the second extension line when the value and the two arrowheads are longer than the line between them.
Always beyond the second extension line, the arrowheads outside.

DimensionOptions.description: A dimension's options (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2): all absent, the dimension as it always was.

breakSize.description: A break's width, times the value's height, over 0; absent: 1 (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK size).

lengthStyle.description:
Feet and inches in an inch or foot unit (AutoCAD's DIMLUNIT, docs/adr/0262 §2); absent: the project's, unless
the dimension names its own unit.

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

DrawingFont.description:
The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

EllipseEntity.description: DXF ELLIPSE: centre, major axis vector, minor/major ratio, parameters t0 → t1.

check.description: A check point: kept out of the fit; its error says how good the fit is where no control point is.

off.description: Left out (Kullan off): neither fits nor checks; its residual is still shown.

target.description: Its east and north (a geographic system's longitude and latitude, degrees).

A NURBS curve run whole, from its first knot to its last.

InsertEntity.description:
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144): its definition drawn

transform is a similarity, shapes keeping their kind, unless the insert
has a y factor of its own (docs/adr/0315 §3): then an affine, a circle
becoming the exact ellipse of its image. The insert's own attributes
carry the values of the definition's attribute definitions.

Dolu nokta: a filled dot (Dot).

Dolu kare (Box filled).

commands.title: Ölçüyü yeniden bağla
commands.summary: İlişkili ölçünün noktalarını nesnelerin yerlerine bağlar ya da serbest bırakır; tek geri alma adımı “Ölçüyü yeniden bağla”. Her bağ ölçünün bir noktası (a, b ya da c) ve yeni yeridir: nesnenin kalıcı kimliği ve yeri (node, start, end, center, vertex, mid; parça, halka ve sırasıyla). to null noktayı serbest bırakır: nokta yerinde kalır, hiçbir şeyi izlemez. Bağlanan nokta yerinin şimdiki koordinatına taşınır ve bundan sonra nesneyi izler: nesne taşınır, döner ya da köşesi çekilirse ölçü de gider; köşe silinirse bağ kopar, nokta yerinde kalır. Kopmuş bağa yer verilirse yeniden canlanır. Sonuç ölçünün yeni değerini (value, unit) söyler. Hiçbir nokta değişmiyorsa hiçbir şey yazılmaz. Kilitli katmandaki ölçü değişmez. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

input.description:
Input of `cad.dimensions.reassociate` v1: a dimension's points bound to
places on objects, or freed, as one undo step “Ölçüyü yeniden bağla”. A
bound point moves to its place on the object now and follows it from
then on (docs/adr/0249 §3); a broken reference given a place is live
again. A binding that leaves a point and its reference as they are
changes nothing; when none changes, nothing is written (`changed` 0).

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `invalid_uid` (the
dimension's id, then each place's object's, in order), `no_entities` (no
binding), `invalid_refs` (a point bound twice, a place's index too big),
`invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict` (status `conflict`),
`entity_not_found` (the dimension, then each place's object, at
`points[i].to.uid`), `not_a_dimension`, `layer_locked` (the dimension's
layer), `invalid_refs` (a point the dimension's kind does not measure:
`c` of a dimension without one; a place bound to the dimension itself),
`no_such_place` (a place its object does not have, at
`points[i].to.place`).

their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:

(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

commands.title: Ölçü ekle
commands.summary: measure'ın ölçtüğünü at'nin yerine ölçü olarak yazar; layerId'ye cad.entities.create'in kurallarıyla tek adımda, adı “Ekle”. Ölçülen noktalar koordinat (kind at) ya da nesnenin yeri (kind place: kalıcı kimlik ve yer: node, start, end, center, vertex, mid) olarak verilir; kenarlar nesnenin kimliği ve tıklanan yerle (of, first, second: uid, near), o yere en yakın düz kenar, yay ya da daire ölçülür. Türler: aligned (Hizalı), linear (Doğrusal; angle 0 ΔY, 90 ΔX, yoksa at'ye göre), ordinate (Koordinat; çizgisi at'de biter), azimuth (Semt), slope (Eğim; za, zb ya da yerin köşesinin kotu), angle (iki düz kenar), angleVertex (köşe ve iki kol noktası), angleArc (yayın kendi açısı), radius, diameter, arcLength (between ile yayın iki nokta arası parçası), jogged (Kırıklı yarıçap: shownCentre ve on). at ölçü çizgisinin, yayının ya da çizgisinin geçtiği yerdir; offset verilirse onun yerine yazılan uzaklıktır (yarıçap, çap ve koordinat almaz: invalid_offset). dimensionStyle projenin ölçü stilinin adıdır (yoksa Standart); height verilmezse stilin yüksekliği, Standart'ta projenin Ölçü yüksekliği. Yer olarak verilen noktalar bağlanır: nesnesi değişince ölçü izler (ilişkili ölçü); kenarlardan açı kenarlarını, yarıçap, çap, kırıklı yarıçap, yay uzunluğu ve yaydan açı eğrisini izler (refs.rule). continue (Zincir ölçü) ve baseline (Baz ölçü) base ölçüden to noktasına sürer: ilk noktası temelinkini izler, stili ve görünüşü temelindir, at okunmaz. Ölçülendirme aracı ölçüyü bu komutla yazar: araç, Python ve ajan aynı girdiye aynı ölçüyü alır. Ölçü oluşmuyorsa (noktalar çakışıyor, kenarlar paralel, yay boş) no_dimension; nesnede aranan türde kenar yoksa not_measurable. Çıktı ve plan cad.entities.create'inkidir. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

DimensionMeasure.description: What a dimension measures: Ölçülendirme's ten kinds (docs/adr/0061, 0147), Zincir ölçü and Baz ölçü (docs/adr/0320).

oneOf.description: Hizalı: the distance from `a` to `b`.

Doğrusal: the distance from `a` to `b` along a direction, degrees
(0 ΔY, 90 ΔX, any other); absent: ΔY or ΔX as `at` lies (AutoCAD's rule).

Koordinat: `a`'s Y (angle 0) or X (90), its leader ending at `at`;
absent: the axis `at` lies further along.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.

Eğim: the slope from `a` at `za` to `b` at `zb`, metres; an
elevation absent: its place's vertex's (docs/adr/0142).

Açı between two straight edges: their lines' crossing the vertex, the
sector the one `at` is in.

Açı from its vertex `c` and a point on each arm (Köşeden; a circle's
centre and two points on it, Daireden): the arc from `a` to `b` the
way `at` lies.
Açı of an arc (Yaydan): its own angle about its centre.
Yarıçap of a circle, an arc or a path's arc segment, toward `at`.
Çap of a circle, an arc or a path's arc segment, toward `at`.

Yay uzunluğu of an arc or a path's arc segment; with `between`, the
part between two points put on its circle (Kısmi).

Kırıklı yarıçap of a circle, an arc or a path's arc segment: from the
centre shown to the circle toward `on`, its jog where `at` is.

Zincir ölçü (docs/adr/0320 §3): from the base dimension's second point to `to`, along the base's direction,
its line on the base's line; its first point follows what the base's second follows. The base is an aligned
or a linear dimension; `at` is not read.

base.description: The base dimension's persistent id (lowercase UUID text with hyphens).

oneOf.description:
Baz ölçü (docs/adr/0320 §3): from the base dimension's first point to `to`, along the base's direction, its
line one level (three times the base's value height) further out than the base's; its first point follows
what the base's first follows. The base is an aligned or a linear dimension; `at` is not read.

base.description: The base dimension's persistent id (lowercase UUID text with hyphens).

oneOf.description:
Merkez işareti (docs/adr/0322) of a circle, an arc or a path's arc segment: the cross at its centre, `height`
across (absent: the value height), upright; its axis lines reach `offset` (absent: `height`) past the curve.
It follows the curve; `at` is not read.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322) between two straight edges: from the middle of their starts to the middle of their
ends (the second turned to run the first's way), `offset` (absent: `height`) past each end. It follows the
edges; `at` is not read.

Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation of `a`, `z` metres (absent: its place's vertex's, docs/adr/0142), its mark on
`a` and its value on the shoulder at `at`. A bound point's elevation follows its vertex's.

EdgeNear.description:
An object's edge as a click picks it: of the object's edges of the kind
the measure takes (straight, an arc, a circle), the one nearest `near`.

near.description:
Where it was clicked: its nearest edge is the one measured. An angle's
arms reach as far as their edges were clicked.

uid.description: The object's persistent id (lowercase UUID text with hyphens).

MeasuredPoint.description: A measured point: coordinates, or a place on an object.

oneOf.description: Coordinates: the point follows nothing.

A place on an object: the point is the place's now. Hizalı's,
Doğrusal's, Koordinat's, Semt's and Eğim's points follow their places
from then on (docs/adr/0249 §3); the others' are read from them.

path.description: When `uid` is an insert, the piece inside it the place is on (docs/adr/0263 §3).

uid.description: The object's persistent id (lowercase UUID text with hyphens).

oneOf.description: A point object's position: part 0 its own, `k` its `k`th extra point (docs/adr/0174).
A line's, arc's or elliptical arc's start.
Its end.
A circle's, arc's or ellipse's centre.

A path's vertex: part 0 the object's own path, `k` its `k`th extra part; ring 0 the outer ring, `h` its
`h`th hole; the vertex's index in the ring.
The middle of a line (all zero) or of a path's edge from vertex `index` to the next.

A point along an edge or a curve (docs/adr/0263 §1): a line's (all zero) or a path's edge from vertex `index`
to the next, at the fraction `t` of its chord or of its arc's sweep; an arc's (`a0 + t·sweep`), a circle's
(`t·2π` from east) or an ellipse's (`t0 + t·sweep`) curve (all zero). `t` within 0 and 1.

Vec2.description: A point in world units: x = east (Y, sağa), y = north (X, yukarı).

input.description:
Input of `cad.dimensions.create` v1: the dimension `measure` names,
placed at `at` (the dimension line, its arc or its leader through it),
written on `layerId` by `cad.entities.create`'s rules as one undo step
“Ekle”. The dimension is the one Ölçülendirme draws for the same picks:
the tool writes it with this command. The points given as places are
bound: they follow their objects (docs/adr/0249); an angle by edges, a
radius, a diameter, a jogged radius, an arc length and an arc's angle
follow their edges or their curve too (docs/adr/0320 §1). Zincir ölçü and
Baz ölçü take the base's style, look and height unless a style is named.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `not_finite`
(`at`, `offset`, then the measure's numbers in their order),
`invalid_height`, `invalid_uid` (each place's and edge's object, in
order; a base's first), `invalid_offset` (an `offset` for Yarıçap, Çap,
Koordinat, Zincir, Baz or Kot, which take none; a negative one for Merkez
işareti or Eksen çizgisi), `invalid_revision`,
`revision_conflict` (status `conflict`), `entity_not_found`,
`no_such_place`, `not_measurable` (the object has no edge of the kind the
measure takes), `not_straight` (a base not an aligned or a linear dimension), `missing_elevation`
(Eğim's or Kot's point with no elevation given or kept), `unknown_style`,
`no_dimension` (no dimension forms there: the points meet, the edges are
parallel, the arc spans nothing; an axis's two edges are one), then the layer's and the look's as
`cad.entities.create` checks them (`layer_not_found`, `not_a_layer`,
`layer_locked`, `invalid_line_weight`); a hidden layer gives a
`layer_hidden` warning; on the desktop also `slots_exhausted`.

mask.description:

options.description: Where the value goes when it does not fit and how it is written (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2).

overrides.description:

their value when the style changes. Empty: each field follows while it holds the style's old value.

prefix.description: Written before the value (and its kind's own prefix).

refs.description: The objects its points follow (docs/adr/0249): an associative dimension; none, free points.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

textColor.description: The value's colour; absent: the object's.

textGap.description: The value's baseline over the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_TEXT_GAP`.

textPlace.description: Where the value stands; absent: over the line.

textShift.description: Its value moved from its place (docs/adr/0321 §1).

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

unit.description: The unit lengths and coordinates are written in; absent: the project's.

wipeout.description:

za.description: Slope: the two points' elevations, metres (docs/adr/0147).

DimensionFit.description:
Where the value goes when it does not fit between the extension lines (AutoCAD's DIMATFIT and DIMTIX): absent,
always between them.

oneOf.description: Beyond the second extension line when the value and the two arrowheads are longer than the line between them.
Always beyond the second extension line, the arrowheads outside.

DimensionOptions.description: A dimension's options (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2): all absent, the dimension as it always was.

breakSize.description: A break's width, times the value's height, over 0; absent: 1 (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK size).

lengthStyle.description:
Feet and inches in an inch or foot unit (AutoCAD's DIMLUNIT, docs/adr/0262 §2); absent: the project's, unless
the dimension names its own unit.

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

DrawingFont.description:
The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

EllipseEntity.description: DXF ELLIPSE: centre, major axis vector, minor/major ratio, parameters t0 → t1.

FieldBroken.description: Why a field's value cannot be read.

oneOf.description: The object is gone.

comma.description: A decimal comma (`24,35`) instead of a point.

decimals.description: Absent: the project's length or area decimals.

check.description: A check point: kept out of the fit; its error says how good the fit is where no control point is.

name.description: What the user calls it (a mark on the sheet, a survey point's name).

off.description: Left out (Kullan off): neither fits nor checks; its residual is still shown.

target.description: Its east and north (a geographic system's longitude and latitude, degrees).

GeorefSource.description: The raster the points' pixels are of: what it read and its size.

url.description: The address it was read from.

to `t1` (radians): counter-clockwise when `t1` is past `t0`, clockwise when before it; a whole ellipse
`t1 = t0 ± 2π`.
A NURBS curve run whole, from its first knot to its last.

v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the

HatchLoop.description:

points. A loop of one point is one closed curve.

InsertEntity.description:
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144): its definition drawn

transform is a similarity, shapes keeping their kind, unless the insert
has a y factor of its own (docs/adr/0315 §3): then an affine, a circle
becoming the exact ellipse of its image. The insert's own attributes
carry the values of the definition's attribute definitions.

On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

flip.description: A section looks to the right of its cut line's direction (absent: the left).

(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

mark.description: The mark's number; empty: a sheet frame's order on its sheet.

order.description:

document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

points.description: A section's cut line (2 or more points); an elevation's bubble, a detail's circle's middle (one point).

size.description: Its words' height on paper, millimetres; absent: 2.5.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

words.description: The bubble's words, which the document writes.

oneOf.description: Kesit: a cut line with a bubble at each end, looking to one side.
Görünüş: a bubble looking one way.
Detay: a circle around the detail and a bubble on a leader.

ViewMarkLabel.description: The bubble's words, which the document writes from the target.

bottom.description: The bottom half: the target's number.

top.description: The top half: the mark's number.

ViewTarget.description: What a mark points at: a named view (`view`, its id), or a map frame on a sheet (`sheet` and `item`, their ids).

WallCaps.description: Whether an open wall's ends are closed by a line across it.

WallComponent.description: One layer of a wall's body, from its left face towards its right (`CAD-ARCH-04`): plaster, brick, insulation.

detail.description: The least detail it is drawn at as its own (its lines and hatch); below, it is part of the body.

edge.description: The lines along its sides; absent: the wall's.

priority.description:
Its strength where walls meet (docs/adr/0340 §1), 1 to 9, the smaller the stronger: a joining wall's component
passes the host's weaker ones and stops at the first as strong. Absent: 3 (between a core's 1 and a finish's 5).

thickness.description: Its thickness, metres; absent: what the wall's width leaves of the others (one component at most).

WallDetail.description:
How much of a wall is drawn (`CAD-ARCH-12`), the least first: `Schematic` its outline and its style's fill,
`Standard` the components shown at construction scales, `Detailed` every component.

WallEntity.description:
A wall (`CAD-ARCH-01`, `02`): its path, the base line it was drawn along, with arcs as a polyline's bulges (one per
vertex, as the document keeps a polyline's: an open wall's last is 0); its width; where its body lies across the
justification line (the path moved `offset` to its left); the components it is built of, from its left face; its
ends; its height above its level; its architectural information. Its faces, ends, component lines and hatches are
drawn from these (`geom::wall` of the shared core), at the detail the drawing's scale asks.

height.description: Its height above its level's floor, metres; absent: the level's height.

joins.description: How its ends join (docs/adr/0340 §1); absent: both by the rule.

commands.summary: Ölçülerde tek bir düzenleme yapar; tek geri alma adımı düzenlemenin adıyla. space (Ölçü aralığı, DIMSPACE): base ölçüye paralel hizalı ve doğrusal ölçülerin çizgileri temelinkinden spacing kadar aralıkla dizilir (her yanda uzaklık sırasıyla; yoksa temel değer yüksekliğinin üç katı, 0 temelin çizgisine). break (Ölçüyü kır, DIMBREAK): hizalı ve doğrusal ölçülerin ölçü ve uzatma çizgileri objects'in (yoksa görünen, ölçü ve yazı olmayan bütün nesnelerin) kestiği yerlerden boşlukla kırılır; kesen yoksa no_crossing uyarısı. unbreak kırmaları kaldırır. moveText değeri kendi doğrultusunda (along) ve ona dik (across) kaydırır; 0 ve 0 yerine döndürür. text değerin yerine yazılanı koyar (<> ölçülen değerdir); null ölçülen değere döndürür. options sığdırma, yuvarlama, sıfırlar, ayak-inç biçimi, alternatif birim, tolerans ve kırma genişliğini yazar; null kaldırır. Değişmeyen ölçü sayılmaz; hiçbiri değişmezse hiçbir şey yazılmaz. Kilitli katmandaki ölçü reddedilir. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the project's length decimals.

oneOf.description:
Ölçü aralığı (AutoCAD's DIMSPACE): the dimensions' lines put `spacing` apart from the base's, each side of it
in its order of distance; 0 lines them up with the base's. Aligned and linear dimensions parallel to the base.

base.description: The base dimension's persistent id; it does not move.

spacing.description: Metres between two lines, 0 or more; absent: three times the base's value height (Baz ölçü's level).

oneOf.description:
Ölçüyü kır (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK): a gap in each of the dimensions' lines where `objects` (absent: every shown
object that is not a dimension) cross it; its breaks so far replaced. Aligned and linear dimensions.
Kırmayı kaldır: the dimensions' lines whole again.
Ölçü yazısını taşı: the value moved along and across its own direction from its place; 0 and 0 home again.

Ölçü değerini yaz: the text written over the value, `<>` its measured value (AutoCAD's text override); null:
the measured value again.
Ölçü seçenekleri: the dimensions' options (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2); null: none.

DimensionFit.description:
Where the value goes when it does not fit between the extension lines (AutoCAD's DIMATFIT and DIMTIX): absent,
always between them.

oneOf.description: Beyond the second extension line when the value and the two arrowheads are longer than the line between them.
Always beyond the second extension line, the arrowheads outside.

DimensionOptions.description: A dimension's options (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2): all absent, the dimension as it always was.

breakSize.description: A break's width, times the value's height, over 0; absent: 1 (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK size).

lengthStyle.description:
Feet and inches in an inch or foot unit (AutoCAD's DIMLUNIT, docs/adr/0262 §2); absent: the project's, unless
the dimension names its own unit.

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

LengthStyle.description:
How lengths are written (docs/adr/0262 §2); none (no setting) is decimal
in the drawing's unit. The three are an inch or foot drawing's.

oneOf.description: Decimal in the drawing's unit: no setting, here for a command to say so.
` ±upper`.
` +upper -lower`.
The largest and the smallest value instead of the number: `max/min`.

input.description:
Input of `cad.dimensions.edit` v1 (docs/adr/0321 §4): one edit of dimensions as one undo step named after it
(Ölçü aralığı, Ölçüyü kır, Kırmayı kaldır, Ölçü yazısını taşı, Ölçü değerini yaz, Ölçü seçenekleri). A dimension
the edit leaves as it was is not counted; when none changes, nothing is written.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `invalid_uid` (the base's, then each dimension's, then each
object's), `no_entities` (no dimension), `not_finite` (`spacing`, `along`, `across`), `invalid_offset` (a spacing
below 0), `empty_text` (a written value of spaces), `invalid_style` (options that break their rules),
`invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict` (status `conflict`), `entity_not_found` (the base, each dimension, each
object), `not_a_dimension`, `layer_locked` (a dimension's layer), `not_straight` (Space's and Break's dimensions:
aligned or linear), `not_parallel` (Space's dimension not parallel to its base). Break warns `no_crossing` for a
dimension no object crosses.
input.title: DimensionsEdit

changed.description: The dimensions that changed, by their persistent ids, in the input's order.
