v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

angle.description: Linear: measured direction in degrees (0 = ΔY, 90 = ΔX).

annotative.description:
Its scales: drawn at the paper height it was given at every scale it takes part in, hidden
at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

arrowSize.description:
The arrowhead's (or tick's) length; absent: `DEFAULT_TICK` for ticks,
`DEFAULT_ARROW` for the others.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

breaks.description: The gaps in its lines where other objects cross them (docs/adr/0321 §1).

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

c.description:
Angular: the vertex. Arc length: the arc's centre. Jogged: the centre
the line starts from (docs/adr/0147).

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

decimals.description:
A length's, a coordinate's or a slope's decimals; absent: the
project's length decimals (a slope's 2). Angles keep the project's.

dimLineColor.description:
The dimension line's and its arrowheads' colour, `#RRGGBB`; absent:
the object's (docs/adr/0205 §6).

dimLineType.description: The dimension line's type; absent: continuous.

dimLineWeight.description: The dimension line's weight, paper mm as an object's; absent: a hairline.

dimStyle.description: The project's dimension style it follows, by its id; absent: Standart.

extBeyond.description: How far the extension lines pass the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_BEYOND`.

extColor.description: The extension lines' colour; absent: the object's.

extLineType.description: The extension lines' type; absent: continuous.

extOffset.description: The extension lines' gap from the measured points; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_OFFSET`.

extWeight.description: The extension lines' weight, paper mm; absent: a hairline.

font.description: The value's typeface; absent: the project's.

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

mask.description:
The value is drawn over the drawing's background (docs/adr/0147, as a
text's mask, docs/adr/0145).

options.description: Where the value goes when it does not fit and how it is written (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

overrides.description:
The fields set apart from its style by hand (docs/adr/0322 §5), by name (`DIMENSION_OVERRIDES`): they keep
their value when the style changes. Empty: each field follows while it holds the style's old value.

prefix.description: Written before the value (and its kind's own prefix).

refs.description: The objects its points follow (docs/adr/0249): an associative dimension; none, free points.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

textColor.description: The value's colour; absent: the object's.

textGap.description: The value's baseline over the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_TEXT_GAP`.

textPlace.description: Where the value stands; absent: over the line.

textShift.description: Its value moved from its place (docs/adr/0321 §1).

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

unit.description: The unit lengths and coordinates are written in; absent: the project's.

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

za.description: Slope: the two points' elevations, metres (docs/adr/0147).

DimensionFit.description:
Where the value goes when it does not fit between the extension lines (AutoCAD's DIMATFIT and DIMTIX): absent,
always between them.

oneOf.description: Beyond the second extension line when the value and the two arrowheads are longer than the line between them.
Always beyond the second extension line, the arrowheads outside.

DimensionOptions.description: A dimension's options (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2): all absent, the dimension as it always was.

breakSize.description: A break's width, times the value's height, over 0; absent: 1 (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK size).

lengthStyle.description:
Feet and inches in an inch or foot unit (AutoCAD's DIMLUNIT, docs/adr/0262 §2); absent: the project's, unless
the dimension names its own unit.

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

DrawingFont.description:
The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

EllipseEntity.description: DXF ELLIPSE: centre, major axis vector, minor/major ratio, parameters t0 → t1.

oneOf.description: A general NURBS curve: degree, control points, weights and knots (docs/adr/0259).
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144).
An arrow with a note (docs/adr/0146).
Rows and columns of cells (docs/adr/0184).
A picture (docs/adr/0192).
An orthophoto, a scanned sheet or an elevation model (docs/adr/0204).
A point cloud: LAS, LAZ, COPC or text files (docs/adr/0207).
A wall (docs/adr/0339): its path, width, justification and components; its faces drawn from them.

A door, a window or a bare opening in a wall (docs/adr/0341): its wall's id, its place along it and its

A grid (docs/adr/0343): its line, label and bubbles.
A column (docs/adr/0343): its centre, outline and the grids it stands on.
A stair (docs/adr/0343): its walking line and its risers, treads and landings.
A ramp (docs/adr/0343): its centre line, width, rise and landings.
A tag (docs/adr/0344): its object, its words and frame.
A view mark (docs/adr/0345): a section, elevation or detail mark pointing at a view.

A record without a geometry (docs/adr/0410): a table's row, with the base's attributes,
attachments and label; not drawn, picked or snapped to.

FieldBroken.description: Why a field's value cannot be read.

oneOf.description: The object is gone.

FieldFormat.description: How a field writes a number.

comma.description: A decimal comma (`24,35`) instead of a point.

decimals.description: Absent: the project's length or area decimals.

unit.description: Absent: the drawing unit for a length or a place, the project's area unit for an area.

name.description: The attribute's name, with `attribute`.

GeorefMethod.description: A transform from the source's pixels to the drawing (docs/adr/0204 §6).

GeorefOutput.description: A resampled raster's grid: north-up, its corner on a multiple of its pixel (docs/adr/0204 §6).

digest.description: The written file's SHA-256 when it was written.

GeorefPoint.description:
A control or check point: a pixel of the source (column, row; pixel corners, 0, 0 the upper left corner of the
upper left pixel, as GDAL's GCPs) and where it is (`target`, in the record's `srid`).

check.description: A check point: kept out of the fit; its error says how good the fit is where no control point is.

name.description: What the user calls it (a mark on the sheet, a survey point's name).

off.description: Left out (Kullan off): neither fits nor checks; its residual is still shown.

target.description: Its east and north (a geographic system's longitude and latitude, degrees).

GeorefSource.description: The raster the points' pixels are of: what it read and its size.

asset.description: The project library's raster it was (embedded).

digest.description: Its bytes' SHA-256 (64 lowercase hex digits) when they were read: the revision the points belong to.

file.description: The file it was (linked), as kept.

url.description: The address it was read from.

oneOf.description: From one side of the hatch to the other along `angle`.

HatchAssoc.description:
The objects a hatch follows (docs/adr/0186 §6, 0328 §3): a hatch made inside a closed object follows the

bounds.description: The objects whose line work closes its face (docs/adr/0328 §3).

gap.description: A face's tie: the gaps its line work was closed across, metres (docs/adr/0329 §3); absent: none.

HatchCurve.description: A boundary edge that is no line or circular arc (docs/adr/0328 §1).

oneOf.description:
An ellipse's arc: centre `c`, major semi-axis `major` (from `c`), minor to major `ratio`, from parameter `t0`
to `t1` (radians): counter-clockwise when `t1` is past `t0`, clockwise when before it; a whole ellipse
`t1 = t0 ± 2π`.
A NURBS curve run whole, from its first knot to its last.

HatchLoop.description:
One closed loop of a hatch's boundary as its source holds it (docs/adr/0328 §1): edge `i` runs from `pts[i]` to

points. A loop of one point is one closed curve.

InsertEntity.description:
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144): its definition drawn
moved from the definition's base point to `p`, mirrored in the
definition's x axis when `mirror`, then scaled and turned about `p`. The
transform is a similarity, shapes keeping their kind, unless the insert
has a y factor of its own (docs/adr/0315 §3): then an affine, a circle
becoming the exact ellipse of its image. The insert's own attributes
carry the values of the definition's attribute definitions.

first leaders'; the others AutoCAD's arrowheads (docs/adr/0205 §7, `.kcad`

LeaderEntity.description:
A leader (docs/adr/0146): an arrowhead at its first vertex, a line
through its vertices and, with a note, a landing from its last vertex
along the note's direction and the note past the landing's end; one
object. The arrowhead and the landing are measured by the note's height.

at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

the landing starts; the arrowhead, the note and the look the first arm's.

arrowSize.description:

commands.summary: Çizimin yazı stillerinin adlandırdığı yazı tiplerini ve KentOS'un hangi yazı tipiyle çizdiğini söyler; hiçbir şey yazmaz. KentOS yalnız kendi yedi yazı tipiyle çizer, ölçer ve PDF'e alt küme olarak gömer: Barlow, Arimo, Overpass, Quicksand, Architects Daughter, Courier Prime, IBM Plex Mono. Her stil için: adı, adlandırdığı dosya (DXF'in STYLE'ı), çizildiği yazı tipi ve nasıl (own: kendi yazı tipi; equivalent: ölçüleri aynı ikizi, Arial, Helvetica ve Liberation Sans için Arimo, Courier için Courier Prime; shx: AutoCAD'in SHX çizgi yazı tipi, okunmaz; missing: KentOS'ta yok), stili kullanan yazı sayısı. shx ve missing stilin kendi yazı tipiyle çizilir ve her biri font_substituted uyarısıdır: değişim sessiz değildir. names verilirse her ad aynı kuralla çözülür (face yoksa projenin yazı tipi). faces çizimin yazılarının, ölçülerinin ve kılavuzlarının çizildiği yazı tipleridir: paftanın PDF'i bunların alt kümelerini gömer.

commands.title: Taramaları düzenle
commands.summary: Taramalarda tek bir düzenleme yapar; tek geri alma adımı düzenlemenin adıyla. recreate (Sınırı yeniden oluştur) taramanın sınırını layerId'ye (yoksa taramanın katmanı) nesne olarak yazar: form area tek alan (delikleri taramanınkiler; yaylar kesin, elips ve eğri kenarları 0,1 mm'lik kirişlerle, curves_approximated uyarısıyla), form polyline her halkayı ayrı nesne (doğru ve yaylardan kapalı çoklu çizgi, tam elips elips, tam kapalı eğri NURBS); associative (varsayılan açık) tarama sonra bu nesneleri izler. reselect (Sınırı yeniden seç) bölgeyi cad.entities.hatch'in point bölgesiyle yeniden bulur (desen, katman ve görünüş kalır). addIslands (Ada ekle) kapalı nesneleri ada yapar: ilişkili tarama onları adaları arasına alır ve nesnelerinden yeniden kesilir, ilişkisiz taramanın bölgesinden alanları çıkarılır. removeIslands (Ada çıkar) ilişkili taramanın adalarını nesneleriyle (uids), ilişkisiz taramanınkileri deliklerinin sırasıyla (holes, 0 ilki) kaldırır. untie (İlişkiyi kopar) taramalar bir şeyi izlemez. pattern (Deseni değiştir) taramaların desenini cad.entities.hatch'in pattern'iyle değiştirir (bölge, bağ ve görünüş kalır; origin köşesi her taramanın kutusunun, across ile hepsininkinin; origin verilmezse her biri kendininkini korur; annotative verilmezse ölçekleri kalır). align (Hizala) taramaların çizgilerini reference'ınkileri sürdürecek biçimde başlangıcını, aynı desendeyseler açısını ve ölçeğini de alır. Kilitli katmandaki tarama reddedilir. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

BoundaryForm.description: What a hatch's boundary is made again as.

oneOf.description: One area, its holes the hatch's holes; arcs exact, an ellipse's or a curve's edges its chords within 0.1 mm.

One object a loop: a closed polyline of its lines and arcs, a whole ellipse an ellipse, a whole closed curve a
NURBS curve; a loop mixing curves and lines a closed polyline of their chords.

BoxCorner.description: A region's corner, or its middle (docs/adr/0331 §2).

oneOf.description:
Sınırı yeniden oluştur: the hatch's boundary written as new objects on `layerId` (absent: the hatch's layer)
in `form`; with `associative` (absent: true) the hatch then follows them.

Sınırı yeniden seç: the hatch's region found again as Tarama finds it (`region`, a point; its pattern, layer
and look kept), its tie and boundary the new region's.

Ada ekle: closed objects left open in the hatch. A tied hatch names them among its islands and is cut again
from its objects; another has their areas taken away from its region.

Ada çıkar: islands hatched over again: a tied hatch's by their objects (`uids`, among its islands), any
hatch's by its holes' places (`holes`, 0 the first).

Hizala: the hatches' lines continue the reference's (AutoCAD's hatch origin across objects, docs/adr/0331 §2):
each takes its origin, and the angle and scale too where its pattern is the reference's.
İlişkiyi kopar: the hatches follow nothing; they stay as they are.

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

commands.title: Kılavuzları düzenle
commands.summary: Kılavuzlarda tek bir düzenleme yapar; tek geri alma adımı düzenlemenin adıyla. Kılavuzun ilk kolu pts'idir (ucu ilk köşe, ortak kolun başı son köşe); ek kolları arms (her biri ucundan kırıklarından geçerek son köşeye), blok içeriği blocks (notun yerinde, ortak kolun ucunda sırayla duran yerleştirmeler; notsuz), uçların bağı tip (ilişkili ölçünün başvurusu gibi: nesne değişince uç yerin gittiği yere gider, silinince kopar). addArm ucu pts[0] olan kol ekler (tip verilirse uç yerin noktasına); removeArm arm'ı (0 ilk kol) kaldırır, ilk kol kalkınca ilk ek kol ilk kol olur, tek kol kalkmaz; align (MLEADERALIGN) ilkini yerinde bırakır, diğerlerinin son köşelerini ilkinin son köşesinden angle doğrultusundaki doğruya izdüşümüyle, spacing verilirse önde ve arkada sırayla eşit aralıkla indirir; collect (MLEADERCOLLECT) blok içerikli kılavuzları ilkinde toplar (diğerlerinin kolları ek kol, blokları ilkinin ardına; diğerleri silinir, blokları kalır); content notu yazar ya da kaldırır; blocks içerik bloklarını yazar (not kalkar); look ok başını (filled ya da LeaderArrow adı), ok boyunu, yüksekliği, zemini; style bir kılavuz stilini izletir (değerleri yazılır) ya da bırakır; bind arm'ın ucunu bir yere bağlar ya da serbest bırakır. Kilitli katmandaki kılavuz reddedilir. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

oneOf.description:
Kol ekle: an arm whose tip is `pts[0]` (its bends after it) to the leader's last vertex; `tip` what the tip
follows.
Kol sil: arm `arm` (0 the first) taken away; without its first arm the next is first. The last arm stays.

Hizala (MLEADERALIGN): the first leader stays; the others' last vertices go onto the line through its last
vertex at `angle` (degrees counter-clockwise from east), where they fall on it, or `spacing` metres apart from
it in that order.

Topla (MLEADERCOLLECT): block content leaders into the first: the others' arms its arms, their blocks after its
own; the others taken away, their blocks kept.
The note written (null: taken away).
The content blocks (inserts, by persistent id; empty: none): they stand in a row at the landing's end.

The leaders' look, each field given set apart from their style: the arrowhead (`filled` or a `LeaderArrow`
name), its length in the note's height, the note's height in metres, the mask.

The leaders follow the leader style `style` (its values written into them; null: they keep their look and
follow none).
Arm `arm`'s tip bound to `tip` (it goes to the place's point) or (null) freed.
A point object's position: part 0 its own, `k` its `k`th extra point (docs/adr/0174).
A line's, arc's or elliptical arc's start.
Its end.
A circle's, arc's or ellipse's centre.

A path's vertex: part 0 the object's own path, `k` its `k`th extra part; ring 0 the outer ring, `h` its
`h`th hole; the vertex's index in the ring.
The middle of a line (all zero) or of a path's edge from vertex `index` to the next.

A point along an edge or a curve (docs/adr/0263 §1): a line's (all zero) or a path's edge from vertex `index`
to the next, at the fraction `t` of its chord or of its arc's sweep; an arc's (`a0 + t·sweep`), a circle's
(`t·2π` from east) or an ellipse's (`t0 + t·sweep`) curve (all zero). `t` within 0 and 1.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).

across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

HatchLoop.description:
One closed loop of a hatch's boundary as its source holds it (docs/adr/0328 §1): edge `i` runs from `pts[i]` to
the next point (the last to the first); it is straight, a circular arc of `bulges[i]` (tan(θ/4), counter-clockwise
positive, as a polygon's), or the curve `curves[i]` (an ellipse's arc or a NURBS curve), whose ends are those
points. A loop of one point is one closed curve.

origin.description:

InsertEntity.description:
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144): its definition drawn
moved from the definition's base point to `p`, mirrored in the
definition's x axis when `mirror`, then scaled and turned about `p`. The
transform is a similarity, shapes keeping their kind, unless the insert
has a y factor of its own (docs/adr/0315 §3): then an affine, a circle
becoming the exact ellipse of its image. The insert's own attributes
carry the values of the definition's attribute definitions.

LeaderArrow.description:

leader has one spelling (docs/adr/0146 §1). The first three are the
first leaders'; the others AutoCAD's arrowheads (docs/adr/0205 §7, `.kcad`
schema 30).

oneOf.description: Açık ok: the filled triangle's two sides (Open).
Dolu nokta: a filled dot (Dot).
Yok: no arrowhead, the line ends at the tip (None).
Boş üçgen: the triangle's outline (Closed blank).
İnce açık ok: two sides 15° off the line (Open 30).
Dik açık ok: two sides square to each other (Open 90, Right angle).
Küçük nokta (Dot small).
Boş nokta: a ring (Dot blank).
Eğik çizgi: a tick across the tip (Oblique).
Mimari çentik: a heavy tick (Architectural tick).
Dolu kare (Box filled).
Boş kare (Box blank).
Dayanak üçgeni: a filled triangle standing on the tip (Datum triangle filled).

LeaderEntity.description:
A leader (docs/adr/0146): an arrowhead at its first vertex, a line
through its vertices and, with a note, a landing from its last vertex
along the note's direction and the note past the landing's end; one
object. The arrowhead and the landing are measured by the note's height.

annotative.description:

at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

arms.description:
Its other arms (docs/adr/0326 §1): each from its own tip through its bends to the leader's last vertex, where
the landing starts; the arrowhead, the note and the look the first arm's.

arrow.description: The arrowhead; absent: a filled arrow.

arrowSize.description:

absent: 1. From `MIN_LEADER_ARROW` to `MAX_LEADER_ARROW`.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

wipeout.description:

TextAlign.description:
Which point of a text its `p` is (docs/adr/0145 §1): horizontally its
left, centre or right; vertically on its baseline, at its bottom (0.2 of
its height under the baseline), its middle (half its height over it) or
its top (its height over it). The left of the baseline, where a text
always stood, is no value but the field's absence: a text has one
spelling.

TextColumns.description:
A multi-line text's static columns (docs/adr/0324 §1): `count` columns of the box's width, `gap` heights
apart, each `height` metres tall; lines past the last column's height go on down in it.

gap.description: The space between two columns, heights.

height.description: A column's height, metres.

TextEntity.description:

v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

align.description: Where `p` is on the text; absent: the left of the baseline (docs/adr/0145).

annotative.description:
Its scales: drawn at the paper height it was given at every scale it takes part in, hidden
at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

Metres, finite and over 0: the lines wrap word by word to this width.

group 44); absent: 1. From `MIN_LINE_SPACING` to `MAX_LINE_SPACING`.

object (docs/adr/0139).

The text's box is filled with the drawing area's colour before the
text is drawn (Netcad's “fon”): what lies under it does not show.

oblique.description:

right; within ±`MAX_OBLIQUE`, never 0 (upright is the field's absence).

order.description:

document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

path.description:

in its own frame; absent: a straight text.

rotation.description: Degrees, counter-clockwise from east.

runs.description:

UTF-16 units), in order, not overlapping, each with a format; a run
with no format is not written, and touching runs of one format are one.

in the text's own frame: `p` its start, x along the text's `rotation`, y

not written; `pts` are the ones after it. The frame carries the curve with
the text when it moves, turns or scales.

DXF's tan(θ/4), counter-clockwise positive; as many as `pts`. Absent:
every edge straight.

pts.description: The vertices after `p`, at least one.

script.description: Raised or lowered, at 0.6 of the height; absent: on the line.

start.description: Its first letter and the one past its last, counting Unicode scalar values.

those after it; `/` a horizontal bar, `#` a slanted one beside them, `^` none (a tolerance).

The value moved from its place (AutoCAD's text moved, DIMTMOVE 2): metres along the value's own direction and
across it (left positive).

vertex, as the document keeps a polyline's: an open wall's last is 0); its width; where its body lies across the

commands.summary: Tablolarda tek bir işlem yapar; tek geri alma adımı. edit (Tabloyu düzenle) edits'i sırayla uygular: setCell hücrenin yazısı                       (= ile başlayan yazı formüldür, hücrenin yazısı sonucu: A1 başvuruları, A1:C3 aralıkları, + - * / ^, TOPLA/SUM, ORTALAMA/AVERAGE, MİN/MIN, MAK/MAX, SAY/COUNT,                       YUVARLA/ROUND, MUTLAK/ABS; argümanlar , ya da ; ile; hatalar #AD? #BAŞV! #DEĞER! #SAYI/0! #SAYI! #DÖNGÜ!), insertRows, deleteRows, insertColumns,                       deleteColumns (birleşik alanlar, biçimler, formüllerin başvuruları ve alanlar kayar; silinen hücreye başvuru #BAŞV!), merge, unmerge,                       style (aralığa hiza, kalın, yazı rengi, dolgu, formül ve alan değerinin basamağı; sonraki öncekinin üstüne), clearStyle,                       field (hücreyi bir kaynağa bağlar: nesnenin alanı, uzunluğu …, projenin değişkeni ya da blockCount adlı bloğun yerleştirme sayısı; değer her adımda yazılır),                       unfield, rowHeight, columnWidth, fit (sütunları yazılarına sığdırır). refresh (Tabloyu güncelle) çizelgeyi nesnelerinden, bağlı tabloyu dosyasının yolundan                       (göreliyse base'den) yeniden yazar: aynı baytlar (SHA-256 özeti) yazılmaz, yolunda olmayan dosya source_missing; elle değiştirilen hücre, dosyadaki                       karşılığı değişmedikçe korunur (overrides keep) ya da dosyanınki yazılır (replace); blok çizelgesi çizimin her adımında kendiliğinden yazılır.                       link (Dosyaya bağla) tabloyu dosyanın sayfasından yazar ve ona bağlar; unlink kaynağı bırakır. Kilitli katmandaki tablo reddedilir.                       expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

oneOf.description:
The cell's words (one line); words beginning with `=` are its formula, its words then its result. A cell
inside a merged range is its top left's.

`count` empty rows before row `at` (the number of rows: after the last); merged ranges, styles, formulas'
references and fields move with the rows.
`count` rows from row `from` taken away; a formula reading one of them reads `#BAŞV!`.
The range merged: its words its cells', the empty ones left out, joined by a space; ranges inside it absorbed.
The merged range the cell is in let go of.
A style over the range: what it gives (at least one), over the styles before it.
The styles that meet the range taken away, whole.
The cell bound to `source` (its formula, if any, taken away): its words the value.
The cell's field let go of: its words stay.
`count` rows from `from` made `height` metres high.
`count` columns from `from` made `width` metres wide.

Sığdır: `count` columns from `from` as wide as their words ask, in the drawing's typeface; with `grow` only
those narrower get wider; with `rows` every row `ROW` text heights high too (Yazıya sığdır).
`count` columns from `from` aligned so (the column's, under the cells' styles).
The first row the heading (bold, centred) or not.
Which lines are drawn (null: all).
Kalın çerçeve's width, metres (null: a line as the others).
Kaynağı bırak: the table follows no source.

oneOf.description: Its outline alone.

None: the words alone.
Tabloyu düzenle: the edits in order, as one step.

Tabloyu güncelle: each table written again from its source (a schedule from its objects, a linked file
from its path, read from `base`, the drawing's folder, when relative); a block schedule is the document's.

Dosyaya bağla: the table's cells from the file at `path` (its sheet `sheet`, the first when none) and the table
linked to it: its path, digest and copy kept, `overrides` its rule.
Kaynağı bırak: the tables keep their cells and follow no source.

commands.title: Yazının alanlarını düzenle
commands.summary: Yazının alanlarında tek bir düzenleme yapar; tek geri alma adımı. Alan, yazının harflerinden bir aralığın bir kaynağa bağlanmasıdır; harfleri kaynağın son yazılan değeridir ve kaynak değişince çizim aynı adımda yeniden yazar (sonraki biçim dilimleri ve alanlar kayar). Kaynak: object (uid'li nesnenin area alanı, perimeter çevresi, length uzunluğu, layer katmanının adı, label etiketi, attribute name adlı özniteliği, text yazının harfleri, x ve y yeri) ya da project (name proje adı, scale çizim ölçeği 1:500, unit çizim birimi, crs koordinat sistemi, variable name adlı değişkeni). format: decimals (yoksa projenin basamağı), unit (mm, cm, m, km uzunlukta; m2, donum, ha alanda; yoksa çizim birimi ve projenin alan birimi), comma ondalık virgül, prefix, suffix. insert uid'li yazının start–end harflerinin yerine alan koyar (eşitse o harfe ekler), değeri hemen yazılır; remove index'inci alanı kaldırır (harfleri yazı olarak kalır); format biçimini yazar (null projeninki); update uids'in (boşsa bütün alanlı yazıların) alanlarını yeniden yazar. Değeri okunamayan alanın harfleri #### olur, nedeni broken'da (removed nesne silindi, noValue değeri yok, notNamed öznitelik ya da değişken yok, cycle yazılar birbirini okuyor) ve field_broken uyarısıdır. Kilitli katmandaki yazı reddedilir. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

apart, each `height` metres tall; lines past the last column's height go on down in it.

gap.description: The space between two columns, heights.

height.description: A column's height, metres.

TextEntity.description:
Fields every object has. `id` is the object's local id inside a v1 file.
v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

align.description: Where `p` is on the text; absent: the left of the baseline (docs/adr/0145).

annotative.description:
Its scales: drawn at the paper height it was given at every scale it takes part in, hidden
at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

boxWidth.description:
Metres, finite and over 0: the lines wrap word by word to this width.
Absent: they end only at line breaks.

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

fields.description: Ranges of its letters bound to a source (docs/adr/0325 §1), in order, not overlapping; absent: none.

font.description: Its typeface; absent: the project's, in the look of docs/adr/0055.

height.description: Metres.

labelOf.description:
The object whose label this text writes (Etiketleri yazıya çevir's
“Nesneye bağlı”, docs/adr/0175 §4): its persistent id. The text
follows the object as its label at `label_scale`; absent: a text of
its own. Given with `label_scale` or not at all.

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

labelScale.description: The scale's denominator (1:N) the linked label is written at; finite, over 0.

layout.description:
Its indents, tab stops and columns (docs/adr/0324 §1); absent: none, a tab every
`DEFAULT_TAB` heights, one column.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineSpacing.description:
The distance between the lines' baselines in 5/3 of the height (DXF's
group 44); absent: 1. From `MIN_LINE_SPACING` to `MAX_LINE_SPACING`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

mask.description:
The text's box is filled with the drawing area's colour before the
text is drawn (Netcad's “fon”): what lies under it does not show.

oblique.description:
How far its letters lean, degrees, positive with their tops to the
right; within ±`MAX_OBLIQUE`, never 0 (upright is the field's absence).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

overrides.description: The fields set apart from its style by hand (docs/adr/0322 §5), by name (`TEXT_OVERRIDES`), as a dimension's.

path.description:
The curve its letters stand on (Eğri boyunca yazı, docs/adr/0196 §1),
in its own frame; absent: a straight text.

rotation.description: Degrees, counter-clockwise from east.

runs.description:
The letters' formats: ranges of the text's Unicode scalar values (not
UTF-16 units), in order, not overlapping, each with a format; a run
with no format is not written, and touching runs of one format are one.
Absent: none.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

textStyle.description: The project's text style it follows, by its id; absent: Standart.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

widthFactor.description:
The letters' width times this, the height kept (Netcad's “sıkışma”,
DXF's group 41); absent: 1. Finite, over 0, at most `MAX_WIDTH_FACTOR`.

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

TextField.description: A range of a text's letters bound to a source (docs/adr/0325 §1).

broken.description: Why its value cannot be read; its letters are then `####`. Absent: it reads.

format.description: How a number is written; absent: the project's decimals and unit.

start.description:
Its first letter and the one past its last, counting Unicode scalar values (as a run's); its letters are the
value last written.

TextPath.description:
The curve a text's letters stand on (docs/adr/0196 §1). Its vertices are
in the text's own frame: `p` its start, x along the text's `rotation`, y
square to it on the left, metres. The first vertex is `p` itself and is
not written; `pts` are the ones after it. The frame carries the curve with
the text when it moves, turns or scales.

bulges.description:
Edge i's bulge, from vertex i to vertex i + 1 (vertex 0 is `p`):
DXF's tan(θ/4), counter-clockwise positive; as many as `pts`. Absent:
every edge straight.

pts.description: The vertices after `p`, at least one.

TextRun.description: A range of a text's letters and their format (docs/adr/0182 §1).

color.description: Its own colour, as an object's (`#E5484D`, or a theme name); absent: the text's.

script.description: Raised or lowered, at 0.6 of the height; absent: on the line.

start.description: Its first letter and the one past its last, counting Unicode scalar values.

TextScript.description: A run raised over the line (superscript) or lowered under it (subscript).

oneOf.description:
A stacked fraction (docs/adr/0324 §1): the run's letters before its first `/`, `#` or `^` raised over
those after it; `/` a horizontal bar, `#` a slanted one beside them, `^` none (a tolerance).

TextShift.description:
The value moved from its place (AutoCAD's text moved, DIMTMOVE 2): metres along the value's own direction and
across it (left positive).

oneOf.description: ` ±upper`.
` +upper -lower`.
The largest and the smallest value instead of the number: `max/min`.

WallComponent.description: One layer of a wall's body, from its left face towards its right (`CAD-ARCH-04`): plaster, brick, insulation.

detail.description: The least detail it is drawn at as its own (its lines and hatch); below, it is part of the body.

edge.description: The lines along its sides; absent: the wall's.

priority.description:

WallEntity.description:
A wall (`CAD-ARCH-01`, `02`): its path, the base line it was drawn along, with arcs as a polyline's bulges (one per
vertex, as the document keeps a polyline's: an open wall's last is 0); its width; where its body lies across the
justification line (the path moved `offset` to its left); the components it is built of, from its left face; its
ends; its height above its level; its architectural information. Its faces, ends, component lines and hatches are
drawn from these (`geom::wall` of the shared core), at the detail the drawing's scale asks.

commands.title: Yazıları düzenle
commands.summary: Yazılarda tek bir düzenleme yapar; tek geri alma adımı düzenlemenin adıyla. replace (Bul ve değiştir): uids'in (boşsa görünen bütün yazıların) her find'ı with olur; matchCase büyük-küçük harfi ayırır (Türkçe İ ve ı), wholeWord yalnız bütün sözcük; biçim dilimleri ve alanlar kayar, değiştirilen harflere değen alan kalkar; boş kalacak yazı (text_left_blank) ve kilitli katmandaki yazı (layer_locked) uyarıyla atlanır. number (Numarala, TCOUNT): uids sırayla start, start+step … sayılarını alır, en az digits basamakla (önüne sıfır), prefix ve suffix'le; place replace yazının yerine, prefix başına, suffix sonuna. combine (Yazıları birleştir, TXT2MTXT): yazılar en yukarıdan aşağıya (eşitse soldan) satır satır tek yazı olur; en yukarıdakinin yerinde (üstünden), yüksekliği ve görünüşüyle, öbürleri silinir. split (Satırlara ayır): yazının her paragrafı (satır sonları arası) durduğu yerde, biçimleri ve alanlarıyla ayrı yazı olur; yazı silinir. Tek paragraflı, sütunlu ya da eğri boyunca yazı not_splittable. fit (Yazıyı eğriye oturt): tek satırlık, nesneye bağlı olmayan yazılar curve'ün üstüne, kutularının ortasının düştüğü yere; turn (Doğrultuya döndür): düz yazılar edge'in at'a en yakın kenarının doğrultusuna, okunur; straighten (Düzleştir): eğri boyunca yazılar ilk harflerinde düz; almadıkları sayılır (skipped), hiçbirini almazsa text_not_taken. combine, split, number, fit, turn ve straighten'de kilitli katmandaki yazı reddedilir. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

oneOf.description: The text becomes the number.
Before the text.
After the text.

Bul ve değiştir: every `find` in the texts `uids` (empty: every shown text) replaced by `with`; a text left
blank, or on a locked layer, is left as it was and said.

matchCase.description: Big and small letters apart (Turkish İ and ı); absent: alike.

oneOf.description:
Numarala (TCOUNT): the texts `uids`, in their order, numbered `start`, `start + step` …, each written with at
least `digits` digits (zeros before), `prefix` and `suffix` around it, in place of the text, before or after.

Yazıları birleştir (TXT2MTXT): the texts `uids` as one text, from the highest down (then from the left), at
the top of the highest, with its look; the others taken away.

Satırlara ayır: text `uid`'s paragraphs (its lines between line breaks) as texts of their own, each where it
stood, with its formats and fields; the text taken away.

Yazıyı eğriye oturt (docs/adr/0196 §4): each one-line text of `uids` not linked to an object put on the curve
`curve` where its box's middle falls, its letters' middle there; the others are left and counted.

Doğrultuya döndür: each straight text of `uids` turned about its point to the direction of the edge of `edge`
nearest `at`, readable; the curved ones are left and counted.

Düzleştir: each curved text of `uids` made straight at its first letter, along its direction; the straight
ones are left and counted.

Vec2.description: A point in world units: x = east (Y, sağa), y = north (X, yukarı).

input.description:
Input of `cad.texts.edit` v1. Refusals: `invalid_uid`, `entity_not_found`, `not_a_text`, `layer_locked`,
`no_entities`, `empty_text` (an empty `find`), `too_few_objects` (combining one text), `not_splittable` (one
paragraph, columns, a curve), `invalid_number`, `not_a_path` (a curve or an edge that is none), `not_finite`,
`text_not_taken` (no given text the edit takes).

replaced.description: How many places Bul ve değiştir replaced.

skipped.description: Eğriye oturt, Doğrultuya döndür, Düzleştir: the given texts the edit does not take.

Where the value goes when it does not fit between the extension lines (AutoCAD's DIMATFIT and DIMTIX): absent,
always between them.

oneOf.description: Beyond the second extension line when the value and the two arrowheads are longer than the line between them.
Always beyond the second extension line, the arrowheads outside.

breakSize.description: A break's width, times the value's height, over 0; absent: 1 (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK size).

lengthStyle.description:

the dimension names its own unit.

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

commands.title: Nesneleri buda
commands.summary: Kalıcı kimlikleriyle verilen nesneleri tıklandıkları yerde sınırlarına kadar budar; tek geri alma adımı “Buda”. Her seçim (picks) bir nesne ve onun üstünde ya da yakınında bir noktadır: o noktanın iki yanındaki sınırların arasındaki parça kalkar. Aynı nesnenin seçimleri sırayla, önceki seçimlerin bıraktığı parçalar üstünde işlenir (Çit). boundaries sınırları söyler: all (varsayılan; bütün görünen nesneler: görünür katmanda, katman süzgecinden geçen), area (köşeleri verilen dikdörtgene değen görünen nesneler; aracın görünümü) ya da objects (verilen nesneler, Sınır seç). Nesne kendini sınırlamaz; her nesne komuttan önceki çizimle sınırlanır. Nesnenin yerini kalan ilk parça alır, öbür parçalar ondan yeni nesnelerdir; tek parça kalırsa özellikleri korunur (kapalı alan değilse). Adalı alan budanmaz. Sonraki seçimin durduğu parçayı hiçbir sınır kesmiyorsa parça bütünüyle kalkar: uçları önceki kesimlerdir. AutoCAD'in TRIM seçenekleri (ADR 0294): fence (Çit) açık bir yoldur, geçtiği her görünen nesne geçtiği yerden seçilir; crossing (Kesişen) bir penceredir, ona değen her görünen nesnenin sınırlar arasındaki pencereye değen her parçası kalkar. Çit ve pencerenin kilitli katmandaki nesneleri sayılarak atlanır (layer_locked uyarısı). edgeMode extend (AutoCAD'in EDGEMODE 1'i) sınırları uzantılarıyla da sayar: çizgi bütün doğrusuyla, yay çemberiyle, açık çoklu çizginin ilk ve son kenarı uçlarının ötesine. eraseUncut (hızlı kip) hiçbir sınırın kesmediği nesneyi seçildiği yerden bütünüyle siler. Bir şey yapamayan seçim trim_failed uyarısıyla atlanır; hiçbiri bir şey yapamazsa hiçbir şey yazılmaz. Parçaları paylaşılan geometri çekirdeği bulur: Buda aracı, Python ve ajan aynı isteğe aynı parçaları alır. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

input.description:
Input of `cad.entities.trim` v1 and `cad.entities.extend` v1: the picked
objects trimmed (or extended) at their picks, as one undo step “Buda”
(“Uzat”), AutoCAD's TRIM and EXTEND (docs/adr/0294): the picks are clicks,
a fence (Çit) or a crossing window (Kesişen); the boundaries chosen
(standard mode) or every shown edge (quick mode); `edgeMode` bounds along
the boundaries' extensions; `eraseUncut` is quick mode's erase of what no
boundary cuts. A trim replaces the object by the pieces that stay, the first
in its place keeping its id, its data kept when one piece is left (not
for a closed area); an extend gives the object its new geometry.

Picks of one object are taken in their order, each on the object as the
earlier ones left it: a trim cuts the piece the pick lies on, and takes
away whole a piece no boundary cuts between its ends (each of its ends is
then an earlier cut or the object's end); an extend grows each end at
most once.

The fence's crossings are picks after `picks`, each object's in the
fence's order, the objects in the drawing's order. The window's objects
come last: Buda takes away every piece between the boundaries that meets
the rectangle, Uzat grows every end inside it. A fence or a window takes
only shown objects; those on a locked layer are left out with a
`layer_locked` warning counting them, and one that does nothing with a
`trim_failed` (`extend_failed`) warning at `fence` (`crossing`). Every object
is bounded by the drawing as it was before the command. A pick that can
do nothing (no boundary crosses there, the end meets none) is left out
with a `trim_failed` (`extend_failed`) warning at `picks[i]`; when no
pick does anything nothing is written and that is the answer.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `no_entities`
(no pick, no fence and no window; `boundaries.uids` empty),
`too_few_points` (a fence of fewer than two points), `invalid_uid` (the
picks' ids, then the boundaries'), `not_finite` (a pick's, the fence's,
the window's, then the rectangle's x and y),
`invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict` (status `conflict`),
`entity_not_found` (the picks' objects, then the boundaries'),
`layer_locked` (a picked object, at `picks[i]`), `not_trimmable` (Buda:
an area with holes, which would lose them), then `trim_failed`
(`extend_failed`, at `picks`, with the first pick's reason: the core's
words for a kind it does not cut or grow, a closed path for Uzat, no
boundary there; at `fence` or `crossing` when it picked nothing); on the
desktop also `slots_exhausted`.

boundaries.description: The boundaries; absent: every shown object (`all`).

eraseUncut.description:
Buda: an object no boundary cuts goes whole where it is picked
(AutoCAD's quick mode) instead of being left with a `trim_failed`

written and the answer is `conflict`.

picks.description: The picks; none when a fence or a window picks.

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

input.description:
Input of `cad.entities.trim` v1 and `cad.entities.extend` v1: the picked
objects trimmed (or extended) at their picks, as one undo step “Buda”
(“Uzat”), AutoCAD's TRIM and EXTEND (docs/adr/0294): the picks are clicks,
a fence (Çit) or a crossing window (Kesişen); the boundaries chosen
(standard mode) or every shown edge (quick mode); `edgeMode` bounds along
the boundaries' extensions; `eraseUncut` is quick mode's erase of what no
boundary cuts. A trim replaces the object by the pieces that stay, the first
in its place keeping its id, its data kept when one piece is left (not
for a closed area); an extend gives the object its new geometry.

Picks of one object are taken in their order, each on the object as the
earlier ones left it: a trim cuts the piece the pick lies on, and takes
away whole a piece no boundary cuts between its ends (each of its ends is
then an earlier cut or the object's end); an extend grows each end at
most once.

The fence's crossings are picks after `picks`, each object's in the
fence's order, the objects in the drawing's order. The window's objects
come last: Buda takes away every piece between the boundaries that meets
the rectangle, Uzat grows every end inside it. A fence or a window takes
only shown objects; those on a locked layer are left out with a
`layer_locked` warning counting them, and one that does nothing with a
`trim_failed` (`extend_failed`) warning at `fence` (`crossing`). Every object
is bounded by the drawing as it was before the command. A pick that can
do nothing (no boundary crosses there, the end meets none) is left out
with a `trim_failed` (`extend_failed`) warning at `picks[i]`; when no
pick does anything nothing is written and that is the answer.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `no_entities`
(no pick, no fence and no window; `boundaries.uids` empty),
`too_few_points` (a fence of fewer than two points), `invalid_uid` (the
picks' ids, then the boundaries'), `not_finite` (a pick's, the fence's,
the window's, then the rectangle's x and y),
`invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict` (status `conflict`),
`entity_not_found` (the picks' objects, then the boundaries'),
`layer_locked` (a picked object, at `picks[i]`), `not_trimmable` (Buda:
an area with holes, which would lose them), then `trim_failed`
(`extend_failed`, at `picks`, with the first pick's reason: the core's
words for a kind it does not cut or grow, a closed path for Uzat, no
boundary there; at `fence` or `crossing` when it picked nothing); on the
desktop also `slots_exhausted`.

eraseUncut.description:
Buda: an object no boundary cuts goes whole where it is picked
(AutoCAD's quick mode) instead of being left with a `trim_failed`
warning. Uzat ignores it.

written and the answer is `conflict`.

crosses is picked where it crosses.

v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the

PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

DimensionFit.description:
Where the value goes when it does not fit between the extension lines (AutoCAD's DIMATFIT and DIMTIX): absent,
always between them.

oneOf.description: Beyond the second extension line when the value and the two arrowheads are longer than the line between them.
Always beyond the second extension line, the arrowheads outside.

DimensionOptions.description: A dimension's options (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2): all absent, the dimension as it always was.

breakSize.description: A break's width, times the value's height, over 0; absent: 1 (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK size).

lengthStyle.description:
Feet and inches in an inch or foot unit (AutoCAD's DIMLUNIT, docs/adr/0262 §2); absent: the project's, unless
the dimension names its own unit.

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

DrawingFont.description:
The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

has a y factor of its own (docs/adr/0315 §3): then an affine, a circle
becoming the exact ellipse of its image. The insert's own attributes
carry the values of the definition's attribute definitions.

commands.title: Köşe yuvarla
commands.summary: Bir köşeyi verilen yarıçapla yuvarlar; tek geri alma adımı “Köşe yuvarla”. corner köşeyi söyler: vertex (çoklu çizginin ya da alanın düz kenarlar arasındaki köşesi, kimliği ve köşe sırası), lines (iki çizgi, her biri tıklandığı tarafı korur) ya da all (verilen çoklu çizgi ve alanların bütün köşeleri; sığmayan köşe atlanır ve sayılır). trim (Kırp, varsayılan açık) kenarları yaya kadar kırpar; iki çizginin yayı ilk çizgiden yeni nesnedir. Kırp kapalıyken kenarlar kalır, yalnız yay eklenir. Sıfır yarıçap iki çizgiyi buluştukları noktada birleştirir. Hesap paylaşılan geometri çekirdeğinindir; araç, Python ve ajan aynı köşeyi aynı yarıçapla aynı biçimde yuvarlar. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

Two straight sides, each keeping the side of its pick (docs/adr/0295): a line, or an open polyline's first or
last straight edge (the edge nearest the pick), whose free end moves to the arc or the cut. The first and last
edges of one open polyline close it, the arc or the cut its closing edge.

Every corner between straight edges of these polylines and areas;
at least one. Kırp is always on.

input.description:
Input of `cad.entities.fillet` v1: the corner rounded with `radius`, as
one undo step “Köşe yuvarla”. With Kırp (`trim`, the default) the sides
take their new geometry and two lines get the arc as a new object from
the first; a vertex is rounded in its path. Without it the sides stay
and the arc alone is added (a radius above zero). A radius of zero joins
two lines at their meeting point.

With `all`, a corner that cannot be rounded (too short a side) is left
as it is and counted in `skipped`; an object none of whose corners can
be is left out with a `fillet_failed` warning at `corner.uids[i]`.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), in this order: `no_entities` (`all`
without ids), `invalid_uid`, `not_finite` (the radius, a pick's x and
y), `invalid_distance` (a negative radius; zero without Kırp or with
`all`), `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict` (status `conflict`),
`entity_not_found`, `layer_locked` (an object of the corner), `not_a_corner`
(a vertex out of its path or not between straight edges, two sides that are
one line, the same end of a path or parallel, a polyline's inner or arc edge,
a corner at a polyline's inner vertex, an object of another kind), `fillet_failed` (the
radius does not fit; with `all`, none fits).

trim.description: Kırp: the sides are cut back to the arc (the default).

oneOf.description: Beyond the second extension line when the value and the two arrowheads are longer than the line between them.

breakSize.description: A break's width, times the value's height, over 0; absent: 1 (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK size).

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

a lookup's is not kept (its row's values are).

rotation.description: Radians, counter-clockwise from east.

scale.description: Positive and finite; 1 is the definition's size. With `yScale`, the factor along the definition's x axis.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

yScale.description:
The factor along the definition's y axis when it is not `scale` (docs/adr/0315 §3), positive and finite;
absent: `scale`. A negative factor of a DXF is a mirror and a turn here.

LabelPin.description:
A label moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (an object's
`labelPins`, docs/adr/0212 §3.7).

at.description: Where the label's middle is from the object's anchor, metres; absent, the engine places it.

class.description: The class's name; absent, the object's first label.

rotation.description: Degrees counter-clockwise from east; only with `at`.

LeaderArm.description: A leader's arm after its first (docs/adr/0326 §1).

pts.description: At least one: its tip first, then its bends; it ends at the leader's last vertex.

tip.description: The place on an object its tip follows; absent: a free tip.

LeaderArrow.description:
A leader's arrowhead other than the filled triangle (Dolu üçgen,
AutoCAD's Closed filled), which is no value but the field's absence: a
leader has one spelling (docs/adr/0146 §1). The first three are the
first leaders'; the others AutoCAD's arrowheads (docs/adr/0205 §7, `.kcad`
schema 30).

oneOf.description: Açık ok: the filled triangle's two sides (Open).
Dolu nokta: a filled dot (Dot).
Yok: no arrowhead, the line ends at the tip (None).
Boş üçgen: the triangle's outline (Closed blank).
İnce açık ok: two sides 15° off the line (Open 30).
Dik açık ok: two sides square to each other (Open 90, Right angle).
Küçük nokta (Dot small).
Boş nokta: a ring (Dot blank).
Eğik çizgi: a tick across the tip (Oblique).
Mimari çentik: a heavy tick (Architectural tick).
Dolu kare (Box filled).
Boş kare (Box blank).
Dayanak üçgeni: a filled triangle standing on the tip (Datum triangle filled).

LeaderEntity.description:
A leader (docs/adr/0146): an arrowhead at its first vertex, a line
through its vertices and, with a note, a landing from its last vertex
along the note's direction and the note past the landing's end; one
object. The arrowhead and the landing are measured by the note's height.

annotative.description:
Its scales: drawn at the paper height it was given at every scale it takes part in, hidden
at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

arms.description:
Its other arms (docs/adr/0326 §1): each from its own tip through its bends to the leader's last vertex, where
the landing starts; the arrowhead, the note and the look the first arm's.

arrow.description: The arrowhead; absent: a filled arrow.

arrowSize.description:
The arrowhead's length, times the note's height (docs/adr/0205 §7);
absent: 1. From `MIN_LEADER_ARROW` to `MAX_LEADER_ARROW`.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

blocks.description:
Its content blocks (docs/adr/0326 §2): inserts standing in a row at its landing's end, by persistent id; a
leader with blocks has no note.

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

height.description:
The note's height, metres, finite and over 0; the arrowhead and the
landing are measured by it.

labelPins.description:

leaderStyle.description: The leader style it follows (docs/adr/0326 §4), by its id.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

mask.description:
The note's box is filled with the drawing area's colour before the
note is drawn, as a text's mask (docs/adr/0145).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

pts.description: At least two: the arrow's tip first, where the landing starts last.

text.description:
The note, one line; absent: the arrow alone, no landing and no note.
Never empty: no note is the field's absence.

tip.description: The place on an object its first arm's tip follows (docs/adr/0326 §3); absent: a free tip.

every paragraph's first line starts `leftIndent + indent` heights from the box's left, its other lines

not written; `pts` are the ones after it. The frame carries the curve with
the text when it moves, turns or scales.

commands.title: Nesneleri esnet
commands.summary: Pencerenin (window) içindeki köşeleri dx, dy kadar taşır, öbürlerini bırakır; tek geri alma adımı “Esnet”. Yayın köşeleri uçlarıdır: yalnız ortası pencerede olan yay değişmez, bir ucu taşınan yay kiriş yüksekliğini korur; çoklu çizginin yay kenarı bükümünü korur. Bağlı olduğu nesneyi izleyen nesne kendisi esnemez, nesnesiyle izler: ilişkili tarama, bağlı yazı ve ölçünün bağlı noktası; izleyenler planın ve sonucun dependents'ındadır. uids verilirse yalnız onlar (seçim); penceresinde köşesi olmayan outside_window, bağlı olduğu nesneyi izleyen follows_object uyarısıyla atlanır. Verilmezse pencereye değen görünen nesneler. Kilitli katmandakiler locked_skipped uyarısıyla atlanır; hiçbiri kalmazsa nothing_to_stretch. topology verilirse (Topolojik düzenleme) taşınan köşeleri paylaşan görünen komşular aynı adımda izler; points noktaları da köşe sayar. Kilitli ya da geçersiz kalacak komşu uyarıyla değişmez. Yer değiştirme sıfırsa hiçbir şey yazılmaz. Yeni şekilleri paylaşılan geometri çekirdeği bulur: Esnet aracı, Python ve ajan aynı isteğe aynı şekilleri alır. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.
