input.description:
Input of `cad.entities.stretch` v1: the vertices inside `window` move by
(`dx`, `dy`), the others stay, as one undo step “Esnet”.

The objects: those of `uids` (the selection), each without a vertex in
the window left out with an `outside_window` warning at `uids[i]`, each
that follows the objects it is tied to (an associative hatch, a linked
text, a dimension whose points in the window are all tied) with a
`follows_object` one (docs/adr/0297 §2); or,
with no `uids`, every shown object meeting the window that has a vertex
in it, those that follow their objects left out unsaid. An arc's vertices
are its ends; one moving keeps the arc's chord height. A dimension's tied
points stay with their objects. The objects tied to the stretched ones
follow at the step's end (`dependents`). Those on a locked layer are left out with a `locked_skipped`
warning (at `uids[i]` when listed). With `topology`, the shown objects
sharing a moved vertex follow; a locked one does not (`neighbour_locked`
warning), nor one it would leave invalid (`neighbour_invalid`). A zero
displacement writes nothing.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `not_finite` (the
window's corners, then `dx`, `dy`), `no_entities` (`uids` given empty),
`invalid_uid` (at `uids[i]`), `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict`
(status `conflict`), `entity_not_found` (at `uids[i]`),
`nothing_to_stretch` (no object left to stretch); on the desktop also
`slots_exhausted`.

dx.description: How far east (Y) the vertices move, metres.

dy.description: How far north (X) the vertices move, metres.

expectedRevision.description:
The document revision the input was prepared against, as decimal
text. When given and the document is no longer at it, nothing is
written and the answer is `conflict`.

uids.description: Only these objects (the selection); absent: every shown object the window meets.

window.description: The window over the vertices to move, metres.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

Dolu kare (Box filled).

Dayanak üçgeni: a filled triangle standing on the tip (Datum triangle filled).

LeaderEntity.description:
A leader (docs/adr/0146): an arrowhead at its first vertex, a line
through its vertices and, with a note, a landing from its last vertex
along the note's direction and the note past the landing's end; one
object. The arrowhead and the landing are measured by the note's height.

annotative.description:
Its scales: drawn at the paper height it was given at every scale it takes part in, hidden
at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

arms.description:
Its other arms (docs/adr/0326 §1): each from its own tip through its bends to the leader's last vertex, where
the landing starts; the arrowhead, the note and the look the first arm's.

arrow.description: The arrowhead; absent: a filled arrow.

arrowSize.description:
The arrowhead's length, times the note's height (docs/adr/0205 §7);
absent: 1. From `MIN_LEADER_ARROW` to `MAX_LEADER_ARROW`.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

blocks.description:
Its content blocks (docs/adr/0326 §2): inserts standing in a row at its landing's end, by persistent id; a
leader with blocks has no note.

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

height.description:
The note's height, metres, finite and over 0; the arrowhead and the
landing are measured by it.

labelPins.description:

leaderStyle.description: The leader style it follows (docs/adr/0326 §4), by its id.

lineWeight.description:

(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

mask.description:
The note's box is filled with the drawing area's colour before the
note is drawn, as a text's mask (docs/adr/0145).

order.description:

document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

pts.description: At least two: the arrow's tip first, where the landing starts last.

rotation.description: The note's and the landing's direction, degrees counter-clockwise from east.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

text.description:
The note, one line; absent: the arrow alone, no landing and no note.
Never empty: no note is the field's absence.

tip.description: The place on an object its first arm's tip follows (docs/adr/0326 §3); absent: a free tip.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

ParagraphLayout.description:
A multi-line text's indents, tab stops and columns (docs/adr/0324 §1), in its height (MTEXT's `\p` codes):
every paragraph's first line starts `leftIndent + indent` heights from the box's left, its other lines
`leftIndent`; a tab goes to the next stop past where it is, a stop every `DEFAULT_TAB` heights after the last
given; columns take the lines in turn, each `columns.height` metres tall.

columns.description: Static columns; a text in columns has a box.

leftIndent.description: Every line but a paragraph's first from the box's left, heights. Absent: 0.

tabs.description: The tab stops from the box's left, heights, ascending, each over 0.

commands.title: Nesneyi kır
commands.summary: Kalıcı kimliğiyle verilen nesnenin first ile second arasındaki kısmını siler; second yoksa nesneyi first'te ikiye böler. Tek geri alma adımı “Kır”. Çizgi, çoklu çizgi, alan, yay, daire, elips, NURBS eğrisi, yardımcı çizgi ve ışın kırılır; öbürleri not_breakable. Kilitli katmandaki nesne kırılmaz. Nesnenin yerini ilk parça alır, öbür parçalar ondan yeni nesnelerdir. Her parça nesnenin taşıdıklarını alır (ADR 0296): katman, renk, kalınlık, çizgi tipi, saydamlık, sembol, öznitelikler, etiket ve ekler; kot, ölçü (M) ve genişlikler köşeleriyle gider. İlişkili ölçünün nesnedeki noktası üstünde durduğu parçayı izler, silinen kısımdaysa kopar (vertex_gone). Parçaları paylaşılan geometri çekirdeği bulur; bulamadığında break_failed çekirdeğin sözüyle döner. Çıktı ve plan cad.entities.edit'inkidir. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

input.description:
Input of `cad.entities.break` v1: the part of the object between `first`
and `second` goes; without `second` (or with it on `first`) the object
splits at `first`. One undo step “Kır”. The object is replaced by its
pieces, the first in its place keeping its id, the others new objects
from it. Every piece keeps what the object carried (docs/adr/0296): its
layer, colour, line weight, line type, transparency, symbol, attributes,
label and attachments; its elevations, measures and widths go with the
vertices where they lie. An associative dimension's point on the object
follows the piece it lies on, or breaks (`vertex_gone`) when it lay in
the part taken away. Lines, polylines, areas, arcs, circles, ellipses,
NURBS curves, construction lines and rays break.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `invalid_uid`,
`not_finite` (`first`, then `second`), `invalid_revision`,
`revision_conflict` (status `conflict`), `entity_not_found`,
`not_breakable` (another kind; an area with holes, which would lose
them), `layer_locked`, `break_failed` (the
core's words: the points off the object, a closed object split at one
point); on the desktop also `slots_exhausted`.

expectedRevision.description:
The document revision the input was prepared against, as decimal
text. When given and the document is no longer at it, nothing is
written and the answer is `conflict`.

first.description: The first break point, on or near the object.

second.description: The second; absent: the object splits at `first`.

uid.description: The object's persistent id (lowercase UUID text with hyphens).

matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

commands.title: Nesneleri birleştir
commands.summary: Kalıcı kimlikleriyle verilen çizgi, yay ve açık çoklu çizgilerden uç uca buluşanları her zincir için tek nesne yapar; kapanan zincir kapalı alan olur. Tek geri alma adımı “Birleştir”. Zincir ilk nesnesinin yerini, kimliğini ve verisini alır, öbürleri silinir. tolerance uçların aralığıdır (metre, varsayılan 0,001). Kilitli katmandakiler locked_skipped uyarısıyla dışarıda kalır; hiç zincir kurulamazsa nothing_to_join. chain verilirse (Zincir) uids tek nesnedir, tohum: ona uç uca bağlı nesneler chain'in nesneleri arasında (all, area ya da objects) serbest uca, kavşağa, kilitli nesneye ya da başa dönene kadar onunla birleşir; tohum yerini, kimliğini ve verisini verir. AutoCAD'in JOIN'i gibi (ADR 0296): aynı doğrudaki çizgiler tek çizgi, aynı çemberin yayları tek yay, kapanırsa daire olur; öbür zincirler çoklu çizgi. Birleşen nesne ilk nesnenin taşıdıklarını korur; öbürlerinin kot, ölçü ve genişlikleri köşeleriyle gelir, öznitelik ve etiketleri gelmez: değeri ayrışan anahtar data_conflict uyarısıyla söylenir. Hiçbir şeyle birleşmeyen nesne not_joined uyarısıyla nedeni söylenerek kalır. İlişkili ölçünün birleşen nesnedeki noktası birleşen nesneyi izler. Zincirleri paylaşılan geometri çekirdeği bulur. Çıktı ve plan cad.entities.edit'inkidir. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

input.description:
Input of `cad.entities.join` v1: the lines, arcs and open polylines of
`uids` meeting end to end within `tolerance` become one object each
chain (a chain that closes, a closed area), in the place and with the
persistent id and the data of its first object; the others go. One undo
step “Birleştir”. Those on a locked layer are left out with a
`locked_skipped` warning at `uids[i]`.

As AutoCAD's JOIN (docs/adr/0296): a chain of lines on one straight line
is that line; a chain of arcs of one circle is one arc, or the circle
when it closes; any other chain a polyline. The joined object keeps all
its first object carried; the others' elevations, measures and widths go
with their vertices, their attributes and label do not: a key whose value
differs is said (`data_conflict`). An object of `uids` that joins nothing
is said with why (`not_joined`). An associative dimension's point on a
joined object follows the joined one.

Zincir (`chain`, docs/adr/0161 §2): `uids` is one object, the seed; the
objects joined end to end with it among `chain`'s objects (lines, arcs,
open polylines) are joined with it, up to a free end, a junction, a
locked object (a `chain_stopped` warning) or the start again. The seed
keeps its place, its id and its data.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `no_entities`
(no id; with `chain` more than one), `invalid_uid` (at `uids[i]`), then
`chain`'s ids, `invalid_distance` (`tolerance` not over 0 or not
finite), `not_finite` (`chain`'s rectangle), `invalid_revision`,
`revision_conflict` (status `conflict`), `entity_not_found`,
`not_joinable` (a seed that is not a line, an arc or an open polyline),
`layer_locked` (the seed), `nothing_to_join` (no chain of two),
`join_failed` (the core's words); on the desktop also `slots_exhausted`.

chain.description: Zincir: the objects the seed's chain walks over; absent: the objects of `uids`.

expectedRevision.description:
The document revision the input was prepared against, as decimal

written and the answer is `conflict`.

tolerance.description: How far apart two ends may be and still meet, metres; absent: 0.001.

uids.description: The objects to join; with `chain`, the seed alone.

curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

commands.title: Yönü çevir
commands.summary: Kalıcı kimlikleriyle verilen nesneleri aynı biçimde, öbür yöne çevirir (AutoCAD'in REVERSE'ü); tek geri alma adımı “Yönü çevir”. Çizginin uçları yer değiştirir; çoklu çizgi, kapalı çoklu çizgi, alan (delikleriyle), eğri ve NURBS eğrisi geriye doğru gider, yayları öbür yöne döner. Her nesne kimliğini ve taşıdıklarını korur; kot, ölçü (M) ve genişlikler köşeleriyle gider, yani onlar da tersine döner; ilişkili ölçünün noktası nesnedeki yerinde kalır (ADR 0296). Yay, daire ve elips hep saat yönünün tersine gider: onlar ve yönsüz türler not_reversible, kilitli katmandakiler layer_locked uyarısıyla atlanır; hiçbiri çevrilemezse ret. Çıktı ve plan cad.entities.edit'inkidir. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

input.description:
Input of `cad.entities.reverse` v1, Yönü çevir (AutoCAD's REVERSE): the
objects of `uids` run the other way round, the same outline, as one undo
step “Yönü çevir”. Lines swap their ends; polylines, areas (and their
holes), closed polylines, fit-point curves and NURBS curves run
backwards, their arcs turning the other way. Every object keeps its id
and all it carries; its elevations, measures and widths go with their
vertices, so they run backwards too; an associative dimension's point
keeps its place on it (docs/adr/0296). Arcs, circles and ellipses always
run counter-clockwise: they, and kinds with no direction, are left out
with a `not_reversible` warning; those on a locked layer with a
`layer_locked` warning counting them.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `no_entities`,
`invalid_uid` (at `uids[i]`), `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict`
(status `conflict`), `entity_not_found`, `layer_locked` (every object on
a locked layer), `not_reversible` (none has a direction).

expectedRevision.description:
The document revision the input was prepared against, as decimal
text. When given and the document is no longer at it, nothing is
written and the answer is `conflict`.

uids.description: The objects' persistent ids (lowercase UUID text with hyphens), at least one.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

commands.title: Uzat-kısalt
commands.summary: Kalıcı kimliğiyle verilen nesnenin uzunluğunu bir ucunda (end: start ya da end) değiştirir (AutoCAD'in LENGTHEN'i); tek geri alma adımı “Uzat-kısalt”. change: delta (length kadar uzar, eksiyle kısalır; yayda angle radyan kadar açısı değişir), percent (uzunluğun yüzdesi), total (yeni toplam length ya da yayın açısı angle), dynamic (uç to noktasına nesnenin kendi yolu boyunca en yakın yere gider). Çizgi, yay, elips yayı ve tek parçalı açık çoklu çizgi uzar ya da kısalır; kapalı çoklu çizgi, alan, daire, bütün elips ve eğri not_lengthenable. Uzatma uç kenarı kendi doğrusunda, çemberinde ya da elipsinde sürdürür: kenarlar genişliklerini korur, taşınan ucun kotu ve ölçüsü (M) uç kenar boyunca uzunlukla sürer. Kısaltma yolu keser: kalan köşeler kendilerininkini, yeni uç kesilen kenarınkini uzunlukla alır. Yeni uzunluk sıfırdan büyük değilse invalid_length, yay ya da yaylı kenar kendini kapatırsa arc_closes, açı yay dışında angle_needs_arc. Çıktı ve plan cad.entities.edit'inkidir. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

oneOf.description:

Yüzde: the new length as this percentage of the current one (above zero).

Toplam: the new total `length`, or an arc's new included `angle`
radians; exactly one of them.

Dinamik: the moving end as near `to` as the object's own path lets it:
past the end along the end edge's line, circle or ellipse, before it
cut back to the nearest point.
The first point: a line's `a`, an arc's start, a polyline's first vertex.
The last point.

Vec2.description: A point in world units: x = east (Y, sağa), y = north (X, yukarı).

input.description:
Input of `cad.entities.lengthen` v1: the object's length changed at `end`
by `change`, as one undo step “Uzat-kısalt”. A line, an arc, an
elliptical arc or an open single-part polyline; a closed polyline, an
area, a circle, a whole ellipse and a curve are refused
(`not_lengthenable`). Lengthening keeps every vertex and edge but the
moving end's: a polyline's edges keep their widths, and the moving end's
elevation and measure (M) run on along the end edge by length
(extrapolated from its two ends). Shortening cuts the path; the kept
vertices keep theirs, the new end takes the cut edge's by length. An
associative dimension's point on the object follows it.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `invalid_uid`,
`not_finite` (the change's numbers), `invalid_change` (Fark or Toplam
with neither or both of `length` and `angle`), `invalid_revision`,
`revision_conflict` (status `conflict`), `entity_not_found`,
`layer_locked`, `not_lengthenable`, `multi_part`, `angle_needs_arc`
(an angle for other than an arc), `invalid_length` (the new length not
above zero), `arc_closes` (an arc or an arc edge would close on itself).

end.description: The end that moves.

expectedRevision.description:
The document revision the input was prepared against, as decimal

written and the answer is `conflict`.

commands.title: Nesneyi böl
commands.summary: Kalıcı kimliğiyle verilen nesnenin üstüne noktalar koyar: division eşit parçalar (parts, 2–10 000) ya da aralık (step, metre). Noktalar nesnenin başından, fromEnd ile sonundan ölçülür; layerId'ye cad.entities.create'in kurallarıyla yazılır. Tek geri alma adımı “Böl”. Çizgi, çoklu çizgi, alan, yay, daire, elips ve eğri bölünür; öbürleri not_divisible. Aralık nesneden uzunsa no_points, 10 000'den çok nokta too_many_points. Noktaların yerini paylaşılan geometri çekirdeği bulur (elipsinkiler eğrinin üstünde, gerçek yay uzunluğuyla). block verilirse noktalar yerine bloğun adıyla yerleştirmeleri konur (align varsayılan açık: nesnenin oradaki doğrultusunda, rotation radyan eklenir; scale); bilinmeyen ad unknown_block. start aralıkla bölmede ilk noktanın ölçülen uçtan uzaklığıdır (0: uçta; parça sayısıyla start_needs_step); ends açık nesnenin kendi başını, sonunu ya da ikisini de işaretler (orada nokta yoksa). color, lineWeight, attrs, label ve symbol noktaların görünüşü ve taşıdıklarıdır. Çıktı ve plan cad.entities.create'inkidir. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

input.description:
Input of `cad.entities.divide` v1: points along the object at
`division`, measured from its start (or its end, `fromEnd`), on
`layerId`, as one undo step “Böl” written by `cad.entities.create`'s
rules. Lines, polylines, areas, arcs, circles, ellipses and splines divide.
With `block` the places get the block's inserts (aligned to the object
by default); with `start` a step's first place is that far from the
measuring end (0: at it); `ends` also marks the open object's own start or
end where no place is already.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `invalid_uid`,
`invalid_count` (parts out of 2 to 10 000), `invalid_distance` (a step
not over 0 or not finite), `not_finite`, `invalid_distance` and
`start_needs_step` for `start` (below 0; with parts), `not_finite` and
`invalid_scale` for the block's numbers, `invalid_revision`,
`revision_conflict` (status `conflict`), `entity_not_found`,
`not_divisible` (another kind), `unknown_block`, `no_points` (a step or
first distance longer than the object), `too_many_points` (over
10 000), then the layer's and the look's as `cad.entities.create` checks
them (`layer_not_found`, `not_a_layer`, `layer_locked`, `invalid_line_weight`);
a hidden layer gives a `layer_hidden` warning; on the desktop also
`slots_exhausted`.

Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DrawingFont.description:
The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

EllipseEntity.description: DXF ELLIPSE: centre, major axis vector, minor/major ratio, parameters t0 → t1.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

labelPins.description:

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineWeight.description:

(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

order.description:

document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

Entity.description: Any drawing object, tagged by `kind` as in the TypeScript model.

oneOf.description: A general NURBS curve: degree, control points, weights and knots (docs/adr/0259).
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144).
An arrow with a note (docs/adr/0146).
Rows and columns of cells (docs/adr/0184).
A picture (docs/adr/0192).
An orthophoto, a scanned sheet or an elevation model (docs/adr/0204).
A point cloud: LAS, LAZ, COPC or text files (docs/adr/0207).
A wall (docs/adr/0339): its path, width, justification and components; its faces drawn from them.

A door, a window or a bare opening in a wall (docs/adr/0341): its wall's id, its place along it and its
jambs' points.
A grid (docs/adr/0343): its line, label and bubbles.
A column (docs/adr/0343): its centre, outline and the grids it stands on.
A stair (docs/adr/0343): its walking line and its risers, treads and landings.
A ramp (docs/adr/0343): its centre line, width, rise and landings.
A tag (docs/adr/0344): its object, its words and frame.
A view mark (docs/adr/0345): a section, elevation or detail mark pointing at a view.

A record without a geometry (docs/adr/0410): a table's row, with the base's attributes,
attachments and label; not drawn, picked or snapped to.

comma.description: A decimal comma (`24,35`) instead of a point.

decimals.description: Absent: the project's length or area decimals.

unit.description: Absent: the drawing unit for a length or a place, the project's area unit for an area.

GeorefMethod.description: A transform from the source's pixels to the drawing (docs/adr/0204 §6).

GeorefOutput.description: A resampled raster's grid: north-up, its corner on a multiple of its pixel (docs/adr/0204 §6).

digest.description: The written file's SHA-256 when it was written.

GeorefPoint.description:
A control or check point: a pixel of the source (column, row; pixel corners, 0, 0 the upper left corner of the
upper left pixel, as GDAL's GCPs) and where it is (`target`, in the record's `srid`).

check.description: A check point: kept out of the fit; its error says how good the fit is where no control point is.

name.description: What the user calls it (a mark on the sheet, a survey point's name).

off.description: Left out (Kullan off): neither fits nor checks; its residual is still shown.

target.description: Its east and north (a geographic system's longitude and latitude, degrees).

GeorefSource.description: The raster the points' pixels are of: what it read and its size.

asset.description: The project library's raster it was (embedded).

digest.description: Its bytes' SHA-256 (64 lowercase hex digits) when they were read: the revision the points belong to.

file.description: The file it was (linked), as kept.

url.description: The address it was read from.

oneOf.description: From one side of the hatch to the other along `angle`.

HatchAssoc.description:
The objects a hatch follows (docs/adr/0186 §6, 0328 §3): a hatch made inside a closed object follows the
object (`outer`), its islands, the texts and inserts left open; a hatch made in the face line work closes
(`bounds`: the objects whose line work bounds it, its islands' too) follows that line work; the point clicked
inside picks the region's part or face. Exactly one of `outer` and `bounds` is given.

bounds.description: The objects whose line work closes its face (docs/adr/0328 §3).

gap.description: A face's tie: the gaps its line work was closed across, metres (docs/adr/0329 §3); absent: none.

HatchCurve.description: A boundary edge that is no line or circular arc (docs/adr/0328 §1).

oneOf.description:
An ellipse's arc: centre `c`, major semi-axis `major` (from `c`), minor to major `ratio`, from parameter `t0`
to `t1` (radians): counter-clockwise when `t1` is past `t0`, clockwise when before it; a whole ellipse
`t1 = t0 ± 2π`.
A NURBS curve run whole, from its first knot to its last.

v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

annotative.description:
Its scales (docs/adr/0331 §3): an annotative hatch's pattern is drawn at each scale it takes part in as large
on paper as at its own; absent: one pattern for every scale.

assoc.description: The objects its region follows (docs/adr/0186 §6); none: it stays as drawn.

the ring and holes are all it has.

HatchLoop.description:
One closed loop of a hatch's boundary as its source holds it (docs/adr/0328 §1): edge `i` runs from `pts[i]` to
the next point (the last to the first); it is straight, a circular arc of `bulges[i]` (tan(θ/4), counter-clockwise
positive, as a polygon's), or the curve `curves[i]` (an ellipse's arc or a NURBS curve), whose ends are those
points. A loop of one point is one closed curve.

angle.description:

gradient.description: A gradient's shape and second colour.

spacing.description: Metres between the lines (lines, cross); 1 and unread for the others.

InsertEntity.description:
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144): its definition drawn
moved from the definition's base point to `p`, mirrored in the
definition's x axis when `mirror`, then scaled and turned about `p`. The
transform is a similarity, shapes keeping their kind, unless the insert
has a y factor of its own (docs/adr/0315 §3): then an affine, a circle
becoming the exact ellipse of its image. The insert's own attributes
carry the values of the definition's attribute definitions.

pts.description: At least one: its tip first, then its bends; it ends at the leader's last vertex.

tip.description: The place on an object its tip follows; absent: a free tip.

LeaderArrow.description:
A leader's arrowhead other than the filled triangle (Dolu üçgen,
AutoCAD's Closed filled), which is no value but the field's absence: a
leader has one spelling (docs/adr/0146 §1). The first three are the
first leaders'; the others AutoCAD's arrowheads (docs/adr/0205 §7, `.kcad`
schema 30).

oneOf.description: Açık ok: the filled triangle's two sides (Open).
Dolu nokta: a filled dot (Dot).
Yok: no arrowhead, the line ends at the tip (None).
Boş üçgen: the triangle's outline (Closed blank).
İnce açık ok: two sides 15° off the line (Open 30).
Dik açık ok: two sides square to each other (Open 90, Right angle).
Küçük nokta (Dot small).
Boş nokta: a ring (Dot blank).
Eğik çizgi: a tick across the tip (Oblique).
Mimari çentik: a heavy tick (Architectural tick).
Dolu kare (Box filled).
Boş kare (Box blank).
Dayanak üçgeni: a filled triangle standing on the tip (Datum triangle filled).

LeaderEntity.description:
A leader (docs/adr/0146): an arrowhead at its first vertex, a line
through its vertices and, with a note, a landing from its last vertex
along the note's direction and the note past the landing's end; one
object. The arrowhead and the landing are measured by the note's height.

annotative.description:

at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

arms.description:
Its other arms (docs/adr/0326 §1): each from its own tip through its bends to the leader's last vertex, where
the landing starts; the arrowhead, the note and the look the first arm's.

arrow.description: The arrowhead; absent: a filled arrow.

arrowSize.description:

absent: 1. From `MIN_LEADER_ARROW` to `MAX_LEADER_ARROW`.

commands.summary: at noktasını çevreleyen ve sınırların çizgilerinin kapattığı bölgeyi layerId'de alan yapar; içindeki kapalı gruplar delik olur (islands, varsayılan açık). Tek geri alma adımı “Alan oluştur”. boundaries sınırları söyler: all (varsayılan; görünen bütün nesneler), area (dikdörtgene değen görünen nesneler; aracın görünümü) ya da objects (verilen nesneler). boundaryLayer verilirse yalnız o katmanın çizgileri sayılır. Bölge yoksa not_enclosed. Bölgeyi paylaşılan geometri çekirdeği bulur; alan cad.entities.create'in kurallarıyla yazılır (color, lineWeight, attrs, label, symbol). Çıktı ve plan cad.entities.create'inkidir. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

input.description:
Input of `cad.entities.boundary` v1: the region around `at` that the
boundaries' line work closes becomes an area on `layerId`, closed groups
inside it holes unless `islands` is false. One undo step “Alan oluştur”,
written by `cad.entities.create`'s rules.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `not_finite`
(`at`, then the rectangle's corners), `no_entities` (`boundaries.uids`
empty), `invalid_uid` (at `boundaries.uids[i]`), `invalid_revision`,
`revision_conflict` (status `conflict`), `entity_not_found` (at
`boundaries.uids[i]`), `layer_not_found` (`boundaryLayer`),
`not_enclosed` (no region closes around `at`), then the layer's and the
look's as `cad.entities.create` checks them (`layer_not_found`,
`not_a_layer`, `layer_locked`, `invalid_line_weight`); a hidden layer
gives a `layer_hidden` warning; on the desktop also `slots_exhausted`.

expectedRevision.description:

islands.description: Adalar: closed groups inside the region are holes; absent: true.

The objects a hatch follows (docs/adr/0186 §6, 0328 §3): a hatch made inside a closed object follows the

(`bounds`: the objects whose line work bounds it, its islands' too) follows that line work; the point clicked
inside picks the region's part or face. Exactly one of `outer` and `bounds` is given.

to `t1` (radians): counter-clockwise when `t1` is past `t0`, clockwise when before it; a whole ellipse
`t1 = t0 ± 2π`.
A NURBS curve run whole, from its first knot to its last.

InsertEntity.description:
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144): its definition drawn

definition's x axis when `mirror`, then scaled and turned about `p`. The
transform is a similarity, shapes keeping their kind, unless the insert
has a y factor of its own (docs/adr/0315 §3): then an affine, a circle
becoming the exact ellipse of its image. The insert's own attributes
carry the values of the definition's attribute definitions.

LeaderArrow.description:
A leader's arrowhead other than the filled triangle (Dolu üçgen,
AutoCAD's Closed filled), which is no value but the field's absence: a
leader has one spelling (docs/adr/0146 §1). The first three are the
first leaders'; the others AutoCAD's arrowheads (docs/adr/0205 §7, `.kcad`
schema 30).

oneOf.description: Açık ok: the filled triangle's two sides (Open).
Dolu nokta: a filled dot (Dot).
Yok: no arrowhead, the line ends at the tip (None).
Boş üçgen: the triangle's outline (Closed blank).
İnce açık ok: two sides 15° off the line (Open 30).
Dik açık ok: two sides square to each other (Open 90, Right angle).
Küçük nokta (Dot small).
Boş nokta: a ring (Dot blank).
Eğik çizgi: a tick across the tip (Oblique).
Mimari çentik: a heavy tick (Architectural tick).
Dolu kare (Box filled).
Boş kare (Box blank).
Dayanak üçgeni: a filled triangle standing on the tip (Datum triangle filled).

along the note's direction and the note past the landing's end; one
object. The arrowhead and the landing are measured by the note's height.

commands.title: Tara
commands.summary: region'ın bölgelerini pattern ile tarar, her bölgeye bir tarama; layerId'ye cad.entities.create'in kurallarıyla tek adımda yazar, adı “Tarama”. region point: at'yi (ve alsoAt'nin her noktasını; iki noktanın bulduğu aynı bölge bir kez) çevreleyen bölge. way object (varsayılan, kapalı nesne): noktayı çevreleyen en küçük kapalı nesne, içindeki ya da kenarını aşan küçük kapalı nesneler adadır; associative (varsayılan açık) taramayı nesnelerine bağlar. way lines (çizgiler): sınırların (boundaries, boundaryLayer) çizgilerinin kapattığı yüz; associative açıksa tarama yüzü kapatan çizgileri izler; gap verilirse o kadar metreye kadar boşluklar sarkan uçtan en yakın çizgiye köprüyle kapanır, gaps_closed uyarısı kapanan boşlukları ve alanı söyler. islandStyle (verilirse islands'ın yerine): outer adaları boş bırakır, normal adaların içindeki kapalı nesneleri yeniden tarar (sırayla, ayrı taramalar; çizgiler yolunda outer gibi, islands_not_nested uyarısıyla), ignore adaları da tarar. texts açıksa bölgedeki yazılar ve bloklar kutularıyla boş kalır. region objects (Çoklu tara): her kapalı nesne, çok parçalı alanın her parçası kendi içinden taranır; kapalı olmayan not_closed uyarısıyla atlanır. pattern: name (Dolu, Çizgili, Çapraz, ANSI31, ISO02W100 …, degradeler; projenin kendi desenleri önce, cad.hatchpatterns.edit), scale (basis paper, varsayılan: kâğıtta, çizim ölçeğiyle çarpılır; basis world: desenin birimi çizimde), angle (derece), secondColor ve inverted (degrade), origin (desenin başlangıcı: world dünya başlangıcı, point bir nokta, corner her bölgenin kutusunun köşesi ya da ortası, across ile bütün bölgelerin kutusunun; yalnız çizgili ve desenli), annotative (ölçekli: çizim ölçeğinde, paftanın her ölçeğinde kâğıtta aynı büyüklükte; basis world ile ya da dolu ve degradede not_annotative). transparency (0–0,9) taramaların kendi saydamlığı; drawOrder katmanın içindeki sıra: none (yeni nesne gibi), back, front, behindBoundary ve aboveBoundary (sınırının kapalı nesnesi ve adalarının hemen altı ya da üstü; sınır başka katmandaysa sıra yazılmaz, order_other_layer); sınıra gelen sıra order_limit. Bilinmeyen ad unknown_pattern; desen bölge için çok sıksa ya da bütün bölgeler birlikte 200 000'den çok çizgi verirse pattern_too_dense; bölge yoksa not_enclosed. İş olarak çalışırken noktalar ve bölgeler arasında durdurulabilir (cancelled). Bölgeleri paylaşılan geometri çekirdeği bulur: Tarama ve Çoklu tara araçları, Python ve ajan aynı isteğe aynı halkaları alır. Çıktı ve plan cad.entities.create'inkidir. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

input.description:
Input of `cad.entities.hatch` v1: the regions of `region` hatched with
`pattern` on `layerId`, one hatch each, as one undo step “Tarama”,
written by `cad.entities.create`'s rules. Çoklu tara's objects that are
not closed are left out with a `not_closed` warning at `region.uids[i]`.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: the pattern's
(`unknown_pattern` at `pattern.name`, `invalid_scale` at `pattern.scale`
when not over 0, not finite or over 10 000, `not_finite` at
`pattern.angle`, `invalid_color` at `pattern.secondColor`), then the
region's (`not_finite` at `region.at` and the rectangle's corners;
`no_entities` when `region.uids` or `boundaries.uids` is empty,
`invalid_uid`), `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict` (status
`conflict`), `entity_not_found`, `layer_not_found` (`boundaryLayer`),
`not_enclosed` (no region around `at`; Çoklu tara: the islands and the
texts cover every object), `not_closed` (none of the objects closed),
`pattern_too_dense` (the pattern too dense for a region), then the
layer's and the look's as `cad.entities.create` checks them; on the
desktop also `slots_exhausted`.

curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:

(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

vertex, as the document keeps a polyline's: an open wall's last is 0); its width; where its body lies across the
justification line (the path moved `offset` to its left); the components it is built of, from its left face; its
ends; its height above its level; its architectural information. Its faces, ends, component lines and hatches are
drawn from these (`geom::wall` of the shared core), at the detail the drawing's scale asks.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

cleanup.description:
Its components are cleaned up by their priorities where another wall tees into or crosses it; false: the
walls meet at their faces only.

closed.description: Its path's last vertex joins its first: a ring of wall.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

components.description: Its body's layers from its left face; none: one plain body.

fill.description: The body's solid fill when drawn schematically (`#RRGGBB`); absent: none.

height.description: Its height above its level's floor, metres; absent: the level's height.

joins.description: How its ends join (docs/adr/0340 §1); absent: both by the rule.

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

offset.description: The base line offset: the justification line is the path moved this far to its left (negative: right).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

style.description: The project's wall style it was made with, by its id; its components are the style's.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

WallJoin.description:
How one end of a wall joins another (docs/adr/0340 §1, `CAD-ARCH-07`): by the rule; not at all (its end line
drawn); at a corner mitred; butting the other (it stops at the other's face); running through it (the other butts).

WallJoins.description: A wall's start's and end's join.

WallJustify.description:
Where the wall's body lies across its path (AutoCAD Architecture's justification): `Left`, the path is the wall's
left face and the body to its right; `Center`, the path is its middle; `Right`, the path is its right face.

frame.description: Whether its boundary is drawn (AutoCAD's WIPEOUTFRAME, per mask).

plan.description: What `cad.entities.create` would write (plan mode); nothing is written.

entities.description:
The objects as they would be stored, in the input's order: `id` 0,
as their slots are given when they are written.

revision.description:
The document revision the plan was made against. Give it as
`expectedRevision` to write exactly this plan, or nothing.

plan.title: EntitiesCreatePlan

targets.note: Çoklu tara kapalı nesneleri tarar: alan (çok parçalının her parçası), daire, tam elips ve kapalı eğri.

examples.title: Parselin içine tıklayıp ANSI31 ile tara; binalar ada

commands.title: Nesneleri ekle
commands.summary: Verilen nesneleri bir katmana yazar; hepsi tek geri alma adımındadır, adı “Ekle” ya da aracın ya da hesabın adı (Paralel çizgi, Dik in, Dik çık, Böl, Tarama, Alan oluştur, Poligon hesabı, Kutupsal alım, Önden kestirme, Geriden kestirme). Her nesne geometrisiyle verilir, cad.entities.edit'teki gibi: nokta, çizgi, çoklu çizgi, kapalı alan, daire, yay, elips, eğri, yardımcı çizgi, ışın, yazı, ölçü, tarama, blok yerleştirmesi (çizimde tanımlı bir blok, ölçeği pozitif); renk, öznitelik ve etiket isteğe bağlıdır. Elips, Eğri, Yardımcı çizgi, Işın, Halka, Paralel çizgi, Dik in, Dik çık ve Böl araçları geometriyi ortak geometri çekirdeğiyle bulur, önizlemede gösterdiklerini bu komutla yazar; Yazı, Ölçülendirme, Tarama, Parsel oluştur ve İçine tıklayarak alan da. Hesap menüsünün pencereleri (Poligon hesabı, Kutupsal alım, Önden ve Geriden kestirme) bulduğu noktaları adları, etiketleri ve öznitelikleriyle bu komutla çizime ekler. Kilitli katmana hiçbir şey yazılmaz; gizli katmana uyarıyla yazılır. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur. Yerel çizim izin istemez; bulut projesine değişiklik project.changes ile gider.

AltUnits.description: An alternate unit written after the value in brackets (AutoCAD's DIMALT): `2.500 [2500]`.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the project's length decimals.

at.description: The scale (1:at) its own geometry is drawn at.

scales.description: The other scales it takes part in, ascending, each with what it sets apart.

AnnotativeScale.description:
One of an object's other scales and what it sets apart from the object's
own values; a field not given is the object's own (`textShift` scaled with
the height).

offset.description: A dimension's line offset.

point.description: A text's point; a leader's landing start (its last point: the points after the arrow's tip move with it).

rotation.description: A text's or a leader's note's direction, degrees counter-clockwise from east.

scale.description: 1:scale.

textShift.description: A dimension's value moved from its place (0 and 0: in its place).

ArchDiscipline.description: The discipline an architectural object belongs to.

ArchInfo.description:
What every architectural object carries beside its geometry (`CAD-ARCH-03`): its level (by the project level's
id), phase, construction status and discipline; absent fields are not said.

ArchPhase.description: An architectural object's phase (renovation): what is there, what goes, what is new.

ArchStatus.description: Where an architectural object is in its construction.

AreaPart.description:
A part of a multi-part area past its first (docs/adr/0143): its outer
ring in vertex + bulge form, its holes and its vertices' elevations, as
the area's own fields hold the first part's. A multi-part polyline's
part is the same, open and without holes (docs/adr/0174).

ms.description:
A polyline's part's measures, as the polyline's own `ms`
(docs/adr/0224 §1); an area's part has none.

zs.description: Each vertex's elevation, as the area's own `zs` (docs/adr/0142).

BreakLine.description: Which of a dimension's lines a break is on.

oneOf.description: The dimension line, from its first end (0) to its second (1).
The first extension line, from the measured point (0) to its far end (1).
The second.

CellField.description: A cell bound to a source (docs/adr/0327 §3): its words are the value last written, `####` when broken.

CellFormula.description: A cell's formula (docs/adr/0327 §2): its words begin with `=`; the cell's words are its result.

CellRange.description: A merged range: `rows` × `cols` cells from row `row`, column `col`.

CellStyle.description:
A style over a range of cells (docs/adr/0327 §1); what it leaves absent the cells take from the styles before it,
then from the table.

color.description: Its words' colour, `#rrggbb`.

decimals.description: The decimals a formula's or a field's number is written with.

fill.description: Its background, `#rrggbb`.

oneOf.description: The file's colours.
ASPRS's classes, each its colour.
Heights through a ramp.
Intensity in grey.
Single, first, intermediate and last returns in four colours.
The object's colour.

asset.description:
The project library's asset its bytes are (embedded); exactly one of
`asset`, `file` and `url` is given.

bounds.description: `[x₁, y₁, z₁, x₂, y₂, z₂]`, as its header says.

count.description: Its points, as its header says.

file.description: The file (linked): absolute, or relative to the drawing's folder.

url.description: An HTTP or HTTPS address read by ranges.

ComponentEdge.description: The lines along a component's sides: its own colour, line weight and line type; absent fields the wall's.

lineWeight.description: Paper mm, 0 to 100.

ComponentHatch.description:
A component's hatch: a pattern of the library or the project by its name (`SOLID` a solid fill), as large on paper
as at 1:1 times `scale` at every drawing scale, turned `angle` degrees along the wall's path, in its own colour.

scale.description: Times the pattern's paper size, above 0.

CreateOperation.description:
The drawing tool or Hesap window whose step has its own name; without
one the step is “Ekle”, as for every object a drawing tool adds.

oneOf.description: Paralel çizgi: the lines beside an axis, the corridor between them, the axis.
Dik in: a perpendicular from a point down to a reference line.
Dik çık: a perpendicular up from a point of a reference line.
Böl: points along an object.
Tarama: a hatch filling the region clicked inside.
İçine tıklayarak alan: the region clicked inside, as an area. The step is “Alan oluştur”.
Poligon hesabı: the traverse's new points (Hesap menu).
Kutupsal alım: the points measured from a station (Hesap menu).
Önden kestirme: the point found from two known points (Hesap menu).
Geriden kestirme: the station found from three known points (Hesap menu).
Ara nokta: points on the line between two points (docs/adr/0140).
Kesişim noktası: the point where two distances, two bearings or two lines meet.
Zincir ölçü: the next dimension of a chain.
Baz ölçü: a dimension measured from the base dimension's first point.
Metin dosyası yerleştir (docs/adr/0145 §6): a text file's lines as texts.
Kılavuz (docs/adr/0146 §6): a leader drawn by its tool.
Toplu alan (docs/adr/0151): the regions line work closes, as areas.
Köşelere nokta (docs/adr/0152): named points at the vertices of lines and areas.

Bitişik alan (docs/adr/0162 §3): the region a drawn path closes with
the neighbouring areas, as one area (its parts and holes as they are).

Etiketleri yazıya çevir (docs/adr/0175 §2): the layers' labels as
texts, placed and sized as a sheet at a scale writes them.
Tablo (docs/adr/0184 §3): a table placed by its tool.

Koordinat yaz (docs/adr/0185): coordinate labels (texts and their
leaders) at clicked points or at the selection's vertices.

Km yaz (docs/adr/0189): a route's stations: their ticks, km texts,
cross-sections and points.
Orta hat (docs/adr/0190): the axis between two sides, a polyline.
Resim ekle (docs/adr/0192): a picture placed.
Eğri boyunca yazı (docs/adr/0196 §4): a text along a curve.
İki daireye teğet (docs/adr/0197 §1): a common tangent of two circles or arcs, a line.
Dördüncü köşe (docs/adr/0197 §2): a parallelogram's fourth corner, a point or the four as an area.
Menzil halkaları (docs/adr/0197 §3): rings round a centre and rays to the outer one.
Plan yolu (docs/adr/0198 §2): a road's areas from its axis, and the axis.
Yatay ağ dengelemesi (docs/adr/0203 §8): the network's new points the drawing has not.
Raster ekle (docs/adr/0204 §8): a raster placed.
Nokta bulutu ekle (docs/adr/0207 §9): a point cloud added.

DatasetDim.description:
One of a dataset's slice dimensions (docs/adr/0243 §6): its name, the
index shown, its values (coordinates; moments in milliseconds since 1970
when `time`) and units.

time.description: The values are a CF time axis's moments.

DimensionArrow.description:
A dimension's arrowheads other than the oblique tick, which is no value but
the field's absence (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: A filled triangle, its tip on the dimension line's end (Dolu ok).
The triangle's two sides (Açık ok).
A filled circle about the end (Nokta).
Nothing at the ends (Yok).

DimensionBreak.description:
A gap in one of a dimension's lines where another object crosses it (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK), at the fraction `t` of
the line; its width the options' `breakSize`.

DimensionFit.description:
Where the value goes when it does not fit between the extension lines (AutoCAD's DIMATFIT and DIMTIX): absent,
always between them.

oneOf.description: Beyond the second extension line when the value and the two arrowheads are longer than the line between them.
Always beyond the second extension line, the arrowheads outside.

DimensionOptions.description: A dimension's options (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2): all absent, the dimension as it always was.

breakSize.description: A break's width, times the value's height, over 0; absent: 1 (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK size).

lengthStyle.description:
Feet and inches in an inch or foot unit (AutoCAD's DIMLUNIT, docs/adr/0262 §2); absent: the project's, unless
the dimension names its own unit.

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

DrawingFont.description:
The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

EntityGeometry.description:
A drawing object's geometry alone: its kind and the fields that place and
shape it, without the fields every object has (layer, colour, attributes,
label, symbol). Coordinates are x east (Y), y north (X), in the project's
units (m), float64; angles in radians unless said otherwise.

parts.description:
A multi-point object's points past its first, each with its
elevation (docs/adr/0174). The geometry is the whole object:
absent, it has one point, so an edit of a multi-point object
writes every point.

ms.description:
The ends' measures (M) as written (docs/adr/0224 §2), as `zs`;
absent: each takes one from the objects the edit names.

zs.description:
The vertices' elevations as written (docs/adr/0142): its two ends, `null` for one without; all `null`: none. Absent:
each vertex takes one from the objects the edit names.

oneOf.description:
A path: vertices and DXF bulges (tan(θ/4), CCW positive), the one at
vertex i bending the edge to vertex i + 1; open unless `closed`.

closed.description:
A closed line, not an area (docs/adr/0258 §1): its last vertex
joins its first by the edge the last of `bulges` bends. Absent:
open. One part only.

ms.description:
The vertices' measures (M) as written (docs/adr/0224 §2), as
`zs`; a part's come with it (`AreaPart.ms`). Absent: each vertex
takes one from the objects the edit names.

parts.description:
A multi-part polyline's parts past its first, each its vertices,
arcs and elevations, without holes (docs/adr/0174). The geometry
is the whole polyline: absent, it has one part, so an edit of a
multi-part polyline writes every part.

widths.description:
The edges' widths as written (docs/adr/0258 §2): a start and an
end for each vertex's edge, in the drawing's length (the last
`[0, 0]` on an open line); all 0: none. Absent: each edge takes
its widths from the objects the edit names, where it runs along
one of their edges, as elevations do. One part only.

zs.description:
The vertices' elevations as written (docs/adr/0142): as many as
the vertices, `null` for one without; all `null`: none. Absent:
each vertex takes one from the objects the edit names.

oneOf.description: A closed area: its ring and, when it has any, its holes.

parts.description:
A multi-part area's parts past its first, each its ring, arcs,
holes and elevations (docs/adr/0143). The geometry is the whole
area: absent, it has one part, so an edit of a multi-part area
writes every part.

zs.description:
The vertices' elevations as written (docs/adr/0142): as many as
the vertices, `null` for one without; all `null`: none. The holes' come with them (`RingGeometry.zs`). Absent:
each vertex takes one from the objects the edit names.

oneOf.description: Counter-clockwise from `a0` to `a1`.
Centre, major axis vector, minor/major ratio, parameters `t0` → `t1`.
A general NURBS curve (docs/adr/0259): its source numbers as `NurbsEntity` holds them.
A construction line through `p` along the unit direction `dir`.
A ray from `p` along the unit direction `dir`.
Text at `p`; `height` in metres, `rotation` in degrees counter-clockwise from east.

align.description: Where `p` is on the text; absent: the left of its baseline (docs/adr/0145).

annotative.description:
Its scales (docs/adr/0323 §4); absent: an object updated keeps its own (only
`cad.annotations.scales` takes them away), a new one has none.

boxWidth.description: A multi-line text's box width, metres (docs/adr/0182 §1); absent: no box.

font.description: Its typeface; absent: the project's, in the look of docs/adr/0055.

layout.description:
Its indents, tab stops and columns (docs/adr/0324 §1); absent: an object updated keeps its own, a new one
has none; an empty layout (`{}`) takes it away.

lineSpacing.description: Its line spacing, times 5/3 of the height; absent: 1. From 0.25 to 4.

mask.description: Its box filled with the drawing area's colour before it is drawn.

oblique.description:
How far its letters lean, degrees, positive with their tops to the
right; within ±`MAX_OBLIQUE`, never 0 (upright is the field's absence).

overrides.description: The fields set apart from its style by hand (docs/adr/0322 §5), by name (`TEXT_OVERRIDES`), as a dimension's.

path.description: The curve its letters stand on, in its own frame (docs/adr/0196 §1); absent: straight.

runs.description: Its letters' formats (`TextRun`), in order, not overlapping; absent: none.

textStyle.description: The project's text style it follows, by its id; absent: Standart.

widthFactor.description: The letters' width times this, the height kept; absent: 1. Over 0, at most 100.

oneOf.description:
A dimension from `a` to `b` (an angular one's vertex is `c`), its line
`offset` metres away, its text `height` metres high; `text` replaces
the measured value, `angle` is a linear one's measured direction in
degrees counter-clockwise from east (0 = ΔY, 90 = ΔX). What the fields
mean for the styles of docs/adr/0147 (an ordinate's `angle`, an arc
length's and a jogged one's `c`, a slope's `za` and `zb`) is that ADR's
table.

annotative.description:
Its scales (docs/adr/0323 §4); absent: an object updated keeps its own (only
`cad.annotations.scales` takes them away), a new one has none.

arrowSize.description:
The arrowhead's (or tick's) length; absent: `DEFAULT_TICK` for ticks,
`DEFAULT_ARROW` for the others.

breaks.description: The gaps in its lines (docs/adr/0321 §1).

decimals.description:
A length's, a coordinate's or a slope's decimals; absent: the
project's length decimals (a slope's 2). Angles keep the project's.

dimLineColor.description:
The dimension line's and its arrowheads' colour, `#RRGGBB`; absent:
the object's (docs/adr/0205 §6).

dimLineType.description: The dimension line's type; absent: continuous.

dimLineWeight.description: The dimension line's weight, paper mm as an object's; absent: a hairline.

dimStyle.description: The project's dimension style it follows, by its id; absent: Standart.

extBeyond.description: How far the extension lines pass the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_BEYOND`.

extColor.description: The extension lines' colour; absent: the object's.

extLineType.description: The extension lines' type; absent: continuous.

extOffset.description: The extension lines' gap from the measured points; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_OFFSET`.

extWeight.description: The extension lines' weight, paper mm; absent: a hairline.

font.description: The value's typeface; absent: the project's.

mask.description: The value over the drawing's background (docs/adr/0147).

options.description: Where the value goes when it does not fit and how it is written (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2).

overrides.description:
The fields set apart from its style by hand (docs/adr/0322 §5), by name (`DIMENSION_OVERRIDES`): they keep
their value when the style changes. Empty: each field follows while it holds the style's old value.

prefix.description: Written before the value (and its kind's own prefix).

refs.description: The objects its points follow (docs/adr/0249): an associative dimension; none, free points.

textColor.description: The value's colour; absent: the object's.

textGap.description: The value's baseline over the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_TEXT_GAP`.

textPlace.description: Where the value stands; absent: over the line.

textShift.description: Its value moved from its place (docs/adr/0321 §1).

unit.description: The unit lengths and coordinates are written in; absent: the project's.

za.description: A slope's two elevations, metres (docs/adr/0147).

oneOf.description: A hatched area: its ring, its holes when it has any, and its pattern.

annotative.description: Its scales (docs/adr/0331 §3): an annotative hatch's pattern as large on paper at each.

assoc.description: The objects its region follows (docs/adr/0186 §6).

boundary.description:
Its boundary exact (docs/adr/0328 §1): the outer loop, then the holes'; `ring` and `holes` are then
drawn from it and may be left empty.

oneOf.description:
A block placed (docs/adr/0144): the definition's base point goes to
`p`, its objects are mirrored in the definition's x axis when
`mirror`, scaled by `scale` (above 0) and turned by `rotation`
(radians, counter-clockwise) about `p`. The block is the drawing's. `yScale` is its own y factor when it is
not `scale` (docs/adr/0315 §3).

A leader (docs/adr/0146): an arrowhead at `pts[0]`, a line through
`pts` and, with a note, a landing from the last vertex and the note
past it; `height` (metres, over 0) measures the note, the arrowhead
and the landing, `rotation` (degrees counter-clockwise from east)
turns the note and the landing.

annotative.description:
Its scales (docs/adr/0323 §4); absent: an object updated keeps its own (only
`cad.annotations.scales` takes them away), a new one has none.

arms.description:
Its other arms' points, each its tip first (docs/adr/0326 §1); absent: an object updated keeps its own, a new
one has none; an arm kept keeps what its tip follows.

arrow.description: The arrowhead; absent: a filled arrow.

arrowSize.description:
The arrowhead's length, times the note's height (docs/adr/0205
§7); absent: 1. From `MIN_LEADER_ARROW` to `MAX_LEADER_ARROW`.

mask.description: The note's box filled with the drawing area's colour before it is drawn.

pts.description: At least two: the arrow's tip first.

text.description: The note, one line; absent: the arrow alone. Never empty.

oneOf.description:
A table (docs/adr/0184 §1): rows and columns of one-line cells
hanging from `p`, its top left corner, turned by `rotation` (degrees
counter-clockwise from east); `height` (metres, over 0) its cells'
text height; `rows` and `columns` its rows' heights and columns'
widths (metres, over 0); `cells` the words, row by row.

aligns.description: Each column's alignment; absent: all left.

font.description: Its typeface; absent: the project's, in the look of docs/adr/0055.

frame.description: Its frame's width, metres (Kalın çerçeve); absent: a line.

grid.description: Which lines are drawn; absent: all.

merges.description: Merged ranges, their words in their top left cells.

oblique.description:

oneOf.description:
A picture (docs/adr/0192 §1): its lower left corner `p`, its width
and height (metres, over 0), turned by `rotation` (radians,
counter-clockwise) about `p` and mirrored in its own x axis when
`mirror`; its bytes the project library's asset `asset` or the file
`file`, exactly one; clipped to `clip` in its own fractions; drawn at

A raster (docs/adr/0204 §2): its pixels placed by `affine`, its size,
bands and samples, its file (`asset` embedded, `file` linked or `url`
read by ranges, exactly one), the file's system, its look and opacity.

A point cloud (docs/adr/0207 §3): its files (each embedded, linked or
an address), their points and bounds, the system, its look and opacity.

A wall (docs/adr/0339 §1): its path (the base line, bulges one per vertex), width, justification, base line
offset, components from its left face, ends, schematic fill, height and architectural information.

A control or check point: a pixel of the source (column, row; pixel corners, 0, 0 the upper left corner of the

GradientShape.description: How a gradient runs over its hatch (docs/adr/0186 §3).

oneOf.description: From one side of the hatch to the other along `angle`.
The second colour along the middle, the first at both sides.
The second colour in the middle, the first at the farthest corner.

HatchAssoc.description:
The objects a hatch follows (docs/adr/0186 §6, 0328 §3): a hatch made inside a closed object follows the
object (`outer`), its islands, the texts and inserts left open; a hatch made in the face line work closes
(`bounds`: the objects whose line work bounds it, its islands' too) follows that line work; the point clicked

bounds.description: The objects whose line work closes its face (docs/adr/0328 §3).

gap.description: A face's tie: the gaps its line work was closed across, metres (docs/adr/0329 §3); absent: none.

HatchCurve.description: A boundary edge that is no line or circular arc (docs/adr/0328 §1).

oneOf.description:
An ellipse's arc: centre `c`, major semi-axis `major` (from `c`), minor to major `ratio`, from parameter `t0`
to `t1` (radians): counter-clockwise when `t1` is past `t0`, clockwise when before it; a whole ellipse
`t1 = t0 ± 2π`.
A NURBS curve run whole, from its first knot to its last.

HatchGradient.description: A gradient: its shape, whether it runs the other way, its second colour.

HatchLoop.description:
One closed loop of a hatch's boundary as its source holds it (docs/adr/0328 §1): edge `i` runs from `pts[i]` to
the next point (the last to the first); it is straight, a circular arc of `bulges[i]` (tan(θ/4), counter-clockwise
positive, as a polygon's), or the curve `curves[i]` (an ellipse's arc or a NURBS curve), whose ends are those
points. A loop of one point is one closed curve.

angle.description:
Degrees, counter-clockwise from east: the lines' (lines, cross), the
pattern's turn (pattern), the gradient's direction (gradient).

gradient.description: A gradient's shape and second colour.

name.description: A pattern's name (`ANSI31`).

origin.description:
Where its lines are anchored in the world (docs/adr/0331 §2; AutoCAD's HPORIGIN): every family goes through
it as the definition says instead of through the world's origin. Absent: the world's origin.

scale.description: A pattern's metres per unit of its definition.

spacing.description: Metres between the lines (lines, cross); 1 and unread for the others.

oneOf.description: User-defined lines at `angle`, `spacing` apart.
User-defined lines and the same turned 90°.
A pattern of line families (`name`, `scale`, `lines`).
A gradient from the hatch's colour to `gradient.color2`.

ImageFields.description:
What places and shows a picture: the image object's own fields, and its
geometry in the commands (`EntityGeometry::Image`).

asset.description:
The project library's PNG or JPEG asset its bytes are (embedded);
exactly one of `asset` and `file` is given.

file.description: The file it shows (linked): absolute, or relative to the drawing's folder.

height.description: Along its left edge, metres, over 0.

mirror.description: The picture mirrored in its own x axis (Aynala), before the turn.

rotation.description: Radians, counter-clockwise from east, about `p`.

width.description: Along its bottom edge, metres, over 0.

LeaderArrow.description:
A leader's arrowhead other than the filled triangle (Dolu üçgen,
AutoCAD's Closed filled), which is no value but the field's absence: a
leader has one spelling (docs/adr/0146 §1). The first three are the
first leaders'; the others AutoCAD's arrowheads (docs/adr/0205 §7, `.kcad`
schema 30).

oneOf.description: Açık ok: the filled triangle's two sides (Open).
Dolu nokta: a filled dot (Dot).
Yok: no arrowhead, the line ends at the tip (None).
Boş üçgen: the triangle's outline (Closed blank).
İnce açık ok: two sides 15° off the line (Open 30).
Dik açık ok: two sides square to each other (Open 90, Right angle).
Küçük nokta (Dot small).
Boş nokta: a ring (Dot blank).
Eğik çizgi: a tick across the tip (Oblique).
Mimari çentik: a heavy tick (Architectural tick).
Dolu kare (Box filled).
Boş kare (Box blank).
Dayanak üçgeni: a filled triangle standing on the tip (Datum triangle filled).

LengthStyle.description:
How lengths are written (docs/adr/0262 §2); none (no setting) is decimal
in the drawing's unit. The three are an inch or foot drawing's.

oneOf.description: Decimal in the drawing's unit: no setting, here for a command to say so.

NewObject.description:
One new object: its geometry and what else it carries. The layer is the
input's; the persistent id and the slot are given when it is written.

attrs.description: GIS attributes, text in v1. Absent: none.

color.description: Colour override (`EntityBase.color`). Absent: the layer's colour (katmana göre).

geometry.description: Its kind and the fields that place and shape it.

The object whose label this new text writes (Etiketleri yazıya

(lowercase UUID text with hyphens), an object of the drawing. On a
text only, given with `labelScale`; the text then follows the object

The scale's denominator (1:N) the linked label is written at:

lineType.description:

from the current line type. Absent: its layer's (katmana göre).

Its place in its layer's draw order (`ObjectLook.order`, docs/adr/0260 §4): Tarama's Sıra (docs/adr/0332 §1).
Absent: 0, drawn by its slot after the objects before it.

Its own symbol, a library item's id (`EntityBase.symbol`), drawn
instead of its layer's style: an object template's (docs/adr/0176).
The id is not looked up: the libraries are the host's. Absent: the
layer's style.

The curve a text's letters stand on (docs/adr/0196 §1). Its vertices are

square to it on the left, metres. The first vertex is `p` itself and is

passes the host's weaker ones and stops at the first as strong. Absent: 3 (between a core's 1 and a finish's 5).

thickness.description: Its thickness, metres; absent: what the wall's width leaves of the others (one component at most).

WallDetail.description:
How much of a wall is drawn (`CAD-ARCH-12`), the least first: `Schematic` its outline and its style's fill,
`Standard` the components shown at construction scales, `Detailed` every component.

Its components are cleaned up by their priorities where another wall tees into or crosses it; false: the
walls meet at their faces only.

drawn); at a corner mitred; butting the other (it stops at the other's face); running through it (the other butts).

WallJoins.description: A wall's start's and end's join.

WallJustify.description:
Where the wall's body lies across its path (AutoCAD Architecture's justification): `Left`, the path is the wall's
left face and the body to its right; `Center`, the path is its middle; `Right`, the path is its right face.

input.description:
Input of `cad.entities.create` v1: new objects on a named layer, written
as one undo step. Everything the command depends on is here (TODOS.md
CMD-07): the tool fills `layerId` from the active layer and each object's
`color` from the current colour; the command reads neither.

The objects are written in their order, each with a new persistent id.
The undo step is named after `operation`, or “Ekle”.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `no_objects`, then
each object's geometry in order: `too_few_points` (a polyline),
`too_few_corners` (a closed area's or a hatch's ring or hole, by
`cad.entities.edit`'s rule: a closed area's may have 2 corners when an
edge is an arc), `empty_text` (a text whose text is empty or only white space),
`invalid_elevations`, `not_finite`, `invalid_radius`, `invalid_scale` (an
insert's), `invalid_line_weight` (the object's weight not from 0 to 100
mm), `invalid_link` (`labelOf` or `labelScale` on an object that is not
a text, one without the other, an id that is not lowercase UUID text
with hyphens, a scale not finite or not over 0; docs/adr/0175 §4); then
`invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict` (status `conflict`),
`layer_not_found`, `not_a_layer`, `layer_locked`, `unknown_block` (each
insert's block, in order; docs/adr/0144), `link_not_found` (each linked
text's object, in order: no object of the drawing has that id), then
`invalid_attribute` and `attribute_required` (each object's attributes by
the layer's fields, objects in order, names in theirs, at
`objects[i].attrs.<name>`; docs/adr/0199 §2), then an associative
dimension's places (docs/adr/0250): `entity_not_found` (a live
reference's object, at `objects[i].geometry.refs.<point>.uid`),
`no_such_place` (a place its object has not, at `….place`); on the
desktop also `slots_exhausted`. Warning: `layer_hidden` (they are written
all the same). A dimension's references must hold (`invalid_refs`,
with the geometry's checks).

An associative dimension (`refs`, docs/adr/0249) is made by its places:
each point with a live reference is written where its place is now,
whatever coordinates were given for it; a broken reference's point is
written as given.

A layer with fields (docs/adr/0199 §2): a value given to a field's key is
written in its canonical text; a value that does not keep the field's
rules is refused (`invalid_attribute`), an empty one of a required field
too (`attribute_required`); a field an object does not give takes its
default. A required field without a value or a default is not refused.

off.description: Left out (Kullan off): neither fits nor checks; its residual is still shown.

The objects a hatch follows (docs/adr/0186 §6, 0328 §3): a hatch made inside a closed object follows the

(`bounds`: the objects whose line work bounds it, its islands' too) follows that line work; the point clicked
inside picks the region's part or face. Exactly one of `outer` and `bounds` is given.

gap.description: A face's tie: the gaps its line work was closed across, metres (docs/adr/0329 §3); absent: none.

oneOf.description:

to `t1` (radians): counter-clockwise when `t1` is past `t0`, clockwise when before it; a whole ellipse
`t1 = t0 ± 2π`.
A NURBS curve run whole, from its first knot to its last.
