commands.title: Nesnelerin özelliklerini değiştir
commands.summary: Kalıcı kimlikleriyle verilen nesnelerin katmanını, rengini, sembolünü, özniteliklerini ya da etiketini değiştirir; hepsi tek geri alma adımında, adı işlemin: Katman değiştir, Renk değiştir, Sembol ata (null ile Sembolü kaldır), Değiştir (öznitelik), Etiket değiştir. Verilmeyen özellik değişmez. Renk, sembol ve etiket null ile kaldırılır: nesne katmanının rengiyle ve stiliyle çizilir. Öznitelik adıyla verilir ya da null ile silinir; adı geçmeyenler kalır. Öznitelikler panelinin katman, renk, sembol ve öznitelik satırları, Sembol ver ve Sembolü kaldır bu komutla yazar. Kilitli katmandaki nesne değişmez, kilitli katmana nesne taşınmaz: böyle bir nesne ya da katman verilirse hiçbir şey yazılmaz. Gizli katmana uyarıyla taşınır. Zaten istendiği gibi olan nesne değişmez; hiçbiri değişmiyorsa hiçbir şey yazılmaz. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur. Yerel çizim izin istemez; bulut projesine değişiklik project.changes ile gider.

input.description:
Input of `cad.entities.set` v1: properties set for objects named by their
persistent ids (docs/adr/0014), written as one undo step named after
`operation`. Everything the command depends on is here (TODOS.md CMD-07):
Öznitelikler fills `uids` from the selection and the property from the
row; the command reads no selection, library or view.

A property absent from the input stays as it is (`unlink`: false). `color`, `lineWeight`,
`symbol` and `label` are removed with null: the object is drawn in its
layer's colour, weight and style again, and shows no label. An attribute is set by its name, or
removed with null; the attributes not named stay. What an object already
has is not a change: an object as the input asks is left alone and is
not in the output, and when no object changes nothing is written (no
undo step, the revision stays).

An object on a locked layer (by itself or a group above it) is not
changed (docs/adr/0278): the others are, and the warning `layer_locked`
counts it; when every one is locked nothing is written and the answer is
`layer_locked`. No object moves to a locked layer (`layer_locked`).
Objects move to a hidden layer with the warning `layer_hidden`.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `no_entities`,
`invalid_uid` (each id in order), `nothing_to_set` (no property given),
`invalid_attribute` (an attribute name empty or only white space),
`invalid_line_weight` (a weight not a number from 0 to 100 mm),
`invalid_line_type_scale` (a scale not above 0 or above 1000),
`invalid_transparency` (a transparency not from 0 to 0.9),
`invalid_attachments` (`attachments_problem`, docs/adr/0225 §1), then
`invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict` (status `conflict`),
`entity_not_found` (each id in order), `invalid_wipeout` (a mask given to
an object not an area, the first in the input's order; docs/adr/0310 §1),
`unknown_asset` (an embedded
photo whose asset is not an image of the project's library, in the
attachments' order), `layer_not_found` and
`not_a_layer` (the `layerId` given), `layer_locked` (every object on a
locked layer: the first one's, in the input's order; then the `layerId` given), then `invalid_attribute`
and `attribute_required` (the attributes given, by the fields of each
object's layer, the one it moves to else its own, objects in the input's
order, names in theirs, at `attrs.<name>`; docs/adr/0199 §2). Warning:
`layer_hidden` (the `layerId` given is hidden and at least one object
moves to it).

A layer with fields (docs/adr/0199 §2): a value given to a field's key is
written in its canonical text; a value that does not keep the field's
rules is refused (`invalid_attribute`), an empty or removed one of a
required field too (`attribute_required`). Keys no field names are free.
White space is Unicode's `White_Space` (Rust's `char::is_whitespace`).

commands.title: Blok tanımla
commands.summary: Kalıcı kimlikleriyle verilen nesnelerden, verilen adla ve taban noktasıyla yeni bir blok tanımı yapar; tek geri alma adımı, adı Blok tanımla. Nesneler olduğu gibi, koordinatları, katmanları, renkleri ve verileriyle kopyalanır; blok iç içe olabilir, en çok 16 düzey. Ad boş olamaz ve çizimde bir kez bulunur (büyük küçük harf Türkçe kurallarıyla ayırt edilmez). replace ile nesneler silinir, yerine yeni bloğun taban noktasına, layerId katmanına bir yerleştirmesi konur (ölçek 1, dönüş yok); kilitli katmandaki nesne tanıma girer ama silinmez, böyle bir nesne varsa replace reddedilir. Blok oluştur aracı bu komutla yazar; blok cad.entities.create'in insert geometrisiyle yerleştirilir, Patlat onu cad.entities.edit ile açar. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur. Yerel çizim izin istemez; bulut projesine değişiklik project.changes ile gider.

input.description:
Input of `cad.blocks.define` v1: a new definition made of the objects
named by their persistent ids, copied as they are (their coordinates,
layers, colours and data; local ids 1, 2, … in the input's order), with
the base point given. Everything the command depends on is here (TODOS.md
CMD-07): Blok oluştur fills `layerId` from the active layer.

With `replace` the objects are deleted and an insert of the new block
takes their place at the base point (scale 1, no turn) on `layerId`, in
the same undo step, “Blok tanımla”.

An id given twice is one object.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `empty_name` (a
name empty or only white space), `no_entities`, `invalid_uid` (each id in
order), `not_finite` (the base point), `no_layer` (`replace` without
`layerId`); then `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict` (status
`conflict`), `entity_not_found` (each id in order), `duplicate_block`
(the name taken, Turkish case folded), `block_too_deep`; with `replace`
`layer_not_found`, `not_a_layer`, `layer_locked` (the insert's layer),
then `layer_locked` for an object on a locked layer (it is taken into the
definition, but not deleted); on the desktop also `slots_exhausted`.
Warning: `layer_hidden` (the insert's layer).

its layer's (its insert's layer on the block's layer), any other part its

of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

start.description: Its first letter and the one past its last, counting Unicode scalar values.

those after it; `/` a horizontal bar, `#` a slanted one beside them, `^` none (a tolerance).

A wall (`CAD-ARCH-01`, `02`): its path, the base line it was drawn along, with arcs as a polyline's bulges (one per
vertex, as the document keeps a polyline's: an open wall's last is 0); its width; where its body lies across the
justification line (the path moved `offset` to its left); the components it is built of, from its left face; its
ends; its height above its level; its architectural information. Its faces, ends, component lines and hatches are
drawn from these (`geom::wall` of the shared core), at the detail the drawing's scale asks.

examples.title: Rögar: bir çember ve yazısı, taban noktası çemberin merkezi
Seçilenleri blokla değiştir: nesneler gider, yerine bloğun bir yerleştirmesi gelir

commands.title: Blok tanımını değiştir
commands.summary: Bir blok tanımını kimliğiyle değiştirir; tek geri alma adımı, adı işlemin: rename yeni ad (Blok değiştir), redefine içindekileri kalıcı kimlikleriyle verilen nesnelerden yeniden kurar (Blok değiştir), rebase taban noktasını taşır (Blok değiştir), remove kullanılmayan tanımı siler (Blok sil), purge kullanılmayan bütün tanımları siler (Blokları temizle), attributes tanımın öznitelik listesini bütün yazar (Blok değiştir; etiket boş olamaz, listede bir kez bulunur; boş liste öznitelikleri kaldırır). Tanım değişince bütün yerleştirmeleri yenisini gösterir. Çizimde ya da başka bir tanımda yerleştirmesi olan tanım silinmez; tanım kendini içeremez, en çok 16 düzey iç içe olabilir. redefine'da replace ile nesneler silinir, yerine tanımın bir yerleştirmesi konur. Bir şey değiştirmeyen istek hiçbir şey yazmaz. Bloklar paneli bu komutla yazar. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur. Yerel çizim izin istemez; bulut projesine değişiklik project.changes ile gider.

ArchInfo.description:
What every architectural object carries beside its geometry (`CAD-ARCH-03`): its level (by the project level's

AreaPart.description:
A part of a multi-part area past its first (docs/adr/0143): its outer
ring in vertex + bulge form, its holes and its vertices' elevations, as
the area's own fields hold the first part's. A multi-part polyline's
part is the same, open and without holes (docs/adr/0174).

ms.description:
A polyline's part's measures, as the polyline's own `ms`
(docs/adr/0224 §1); an area's part has none.

zs.description: Each vertex's elevation, as the area's own `zs` (docs/adr/0142).

Attachment.description:
One of an object's attachments: its name, its source (exactly one of
`asset`, `file` and `url`) and an optional note.

asset.description: Embedded: the project library's PNG or JPEG asset its bytes are.

file.description:
Linked: a file's path, relative to the drawing's folder when it is
relative.

name.description: The name shown (the file's name by default).

note.description: A note shown with it (lines allowed).

url.description: A web address (`http` or `https`).

AttributeDefinition.description:
One attribute an insert shows as text (docs/adr/0144 §7): the insert's
attribute `tag`, else `value`, written at `p` in the definition's
coordinates, moved with the insert.

align.description: Where `p` is on the text, as a text's (docs/adr/0145).

boxWidth.description: A multiline attribute's box width, metres in the definition's size.

constant.description: Its value is the definition's `value` in every insert; an insert holds none of its own (bit 2).

field.description:
A field (docs/adr/0317 §1): a template whose `{ifade}` parts are filled for each insert (its attributes, its
place, the project's `@` values); the commands that place, sync and update fields write it as the value.

height.description: Metres, in the definition's size.

invisible.description: Not drawn: its value is kept, listed and scheduled (DXF 70 bit 1).

movable.description: An insert may move its text (`attributePlaces`); off: locked where the definition puts it (bit 16 set).

multiline.description: Its value may hold line breaks, each a line; wrapped to `boxWidth` when given (an MTEXT attribute).

preset.description: Blok ekle takes its default without asking (bit 8).

prompt.description: What Blok ekle asks for it.

rotation.description: Degrees, counter-clockwise from east, as a text's.

value.description: The default value.

verify.description: Blok ekle asks for it twice, the two the same (bit 4).

widthFactor.description: The letters' width times this, as a text's (docs/adr/0145).

BlockAction.description: An action (docs/adr/0318 §2): the objects (local ids) a parameter's change moves.

oneOf.description:
The objects move by the parameter's change (a linear's along its line, a polar's and a point's by the moved
point).
The objects' points inside the box move by the parameter's change; the rest stay.
The objects scale about the parameter's `from` by its value over its default.

Copies of the objects every `spacing` along a linear parameter's line: one for each further `spacing` its
value holds past its default (the definition shows what the default holds).
The objects turn about an angle parameter's centre by its change.
The objects mirror about a flip parameter's line while it is on.

BlockEditOperation.description: What `cad.blocks.edit` does; it names the undo step.

oneOf.description: A new name (“Blok değiştir”).
New objects from the drawing's (“Blok değiştir”): every insert shows them.
A new base point (“Blok değiştir”): every insert shifts by the difference.
A definition no insert uses deleted (“Blok sil”).
Every definition no insert uses deleted (“Blokları temizle”).

Its attribute definitions, the whole list (“Blok değiştir”): every
insert shows them (docs/adr/0144 §7).

A copy of a definition under a new name (“Blok kopyala”, docs/adr/0314 §3): its objects, base point,
description and attributes; the drawing's inserts stay on the original.

Definitions as a `kentos.blocks` file's text, with the definitions they insert (“Blokları dışa aktar”);
nothing is written.

A `kentos.blocks` file's definitions taken in (“Blokları al”): a name the drawing has is kept, or with
`replace` redefined; inserts in them point at the drawing's definitions of their names.

The unit it is drawn in (“Blok birimi”, docs/adr/0315 §4): with `rescale` its numbers are kept and their
meaning changes (a block drawn in millimetres in a drawing taken for metres is a thousandth of its size
after); a block made unitless or real-size keeps its size in this drawing.

Its objects given whole, in its own coordinates, each with its local id (“Blok düzenle”, the block editor's
save; docs/adr/0316 §1): an id it had is kept (a reference to that piece follows it), 0 is a new object
and takes the next id the definition never had; the base point and the attribute definitions when given.

Its inserts' attribute values made to fit its definition (“Öznitelikleri eşitle”, ATTSYNC; docs/adr/0317 §2):
values renamed (`renames`), taken off (`removeTags`, a constant attribute's), places of attributes no longer
movable dropped, fields filled; the definition stays.

Its inserts' fields filled again (“Alanları güncelle”, UPDATEFIELD; docs/adr/0317 §1); every block's when no
block is given.

Where inserts (`uids`) show a movable attribute (`tag`): at `at`, a point of the drawing; absent, where the
definition puts it (“Öznitelik konumu”, docs/adr/0317 §1).

Its library card (“Blok kartı”, docs/adr/0317 §4): `category`, `tags` and `description`; its version is
counted by the drawing.

Its parameters and actions (“Dinamik blok”, docs/adr/0318 §1): `dynamic`, or none to make it a plain block;
its inserts' values that no longer fit are dropped and counted.

BlockParameter.description: A parameter (docs/adr/0318 §1). Its points are the definition's coordinates.

oneOf.description: A length along `from`→`to`: its default the distance between them; a change moves `to` along the line.
`to` moved anywhere: its value a point, its rule on the distance from `from`.
An angle about `center`, radians counter-clockwise from east; its default `base`.
A point: its default `at`.
A mirror about the line `a`→`b`, off by default.
The objects shown: its first state by default.
Rows of values set together, chosen by label; it has no value of its own to keep.

BlockUnits.description: The unit a block was drawn in (docs/adr/0315 §4).

oneOf.description: Its numbers are the drawing's units: a 1 is a millimetre in a millimetre drawing, a metre in a metre one.

BreakLine.description: Which of a dimension's lines a break is on.

oneOf.description: The dimension line, from its first end (0) to its second (1).
The first extension line, from the measured point (0) to its far end (1).
The second.

CellField.description: A cell bound to a source (docs/adr/0327 §3): its words are the value last written, `####` when broken.

CellFormula.description: A cell's formula (docs/adr/0327 §2): its words begin with `=`; the cell's words are its result.

CellRange.description: A merged range: `rows` × `cols` cells from row `row`, column `col`.

CellStyle.description:

color.description: Its words' colour, `#rrggbb`.

decimals.description: The decimals a formula's or a field's number is written with.

fill.description: Its background, `#rrggbb`.

PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

WallComponent.description: One layer of a wall's body, from its left face towards its right (`CAD-ARCH-04`): plaster, brick, insulation.

detail.description: The least detail it is drawn at as its own (its lines and hatch); below, it is part of the body.

edge.description: The lines along its sides; absent: the wall's.

priority.description:
Its strength where walls meet (docs/adr/0340 §1), 1 to 9, the smaller the stronger: a joining wall's component
passes the host's weaker ones and stops at the first as strong. Absent: 3 (between a core's 1 and a finish's 5).

thickness.description: Its thickness, metres; absent: what the wall's width leaves of the others (one component at most).

WallDetail.description:
How much of a wall is drawn (`CAD-ARCH-12`), the least first: `Schematic` its outline and its style's fill,
`Standard` the components shown at construction scales, `Detailed` every component.

WallEntity.description:
A wall (`CAD-ARCH-01`, `02`): its path, the base line it was drawn along, with arcs as a polyline's bulges (one per
vertex, as the document keeps a polyline's: an open wall's last is 0); its width; where its body lies across the
justification line (the path moved `offset` to its left); the components it is built of, from its left face; its
ends; its height above its level; its architectural information. Its faces, ends, component lines and hatches are
drawn from these (`geom::wall` of the shared core), at the detail the drawing's scale asks.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

cleanup.description:
Its components are cleaned up by their priorities where another wall tees into or crosses it; false: the
walls meet at their faces only.

closed.description: Its path's last vertex joins its first: a ring of wall.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

components.description: Its body's layers from its left face; none: one plain body.

fill.description: The body's solid fill when drawn schematically (`#RRGGBB`); absent: none.

height.description: Its height above its level's floor, metres; absent: the level's height.

joins.description: How its ends join (docs/adr/0340 §1); absent: both by the rule.

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

offset.description: The base line offset: the justification line is the path moved this far to its left (negative: right).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

style.description: The project's wall style it was made with, by its id; its components are the style's.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

WallJoin.description:
How one end of a wall joins another (docs/adr/0340 §1, `CAD-ARCH-07`): by the rule; not at all (its end line
drawn); at a corner mitred; butting the other (it stops at the other's face); running through it (the other butts).

WallJoins.description: A wall's start's and end's join.

WallJustify.description:
Where the wall's body lies across its path (AutoCAD Architecture's justification): `Left`, the path is the wall's
left face and the body to its right; `Center`, the path is its middle; `Right`, the path is its right face.

frame.description: Whether its boundary is drawn (AutoCAD's WIPEOUTFRAME, per mask).

at.description: `place`: where the attribute's text stands, a point of the drawing; absent: where the definition puts it.

attributes.description:
`attributes`: the definition's attribute definitions, the whole list
in its order (empty: it has none).

base.description: `rebase`: the new base point; `redefine`: the base point (absent: kept).

blocks.description: `export`: the definitions, by id (absent: every one).

description.description: `card`: its description (empty: none).

dynamic.description: `dynamic`: the parameters and actions (absent: none, a plain block).

entities.description:
`update`: the definition's objects, in its own coordinates, each with its local id (0: a new one;
docs/adr/0316 §1).

expectedRevision.description: The document revision the input was prepared against, as decimal text.

layerId.description: `redefine` with `replace`: the layer the insert goes on.

name.description: `rename`: the new name.

removeTags.description: `sync`: tags whose values are taken off the inserts though no attribute has them.

renames.description: `attributes`, `sync`: an insert's value under an old tag moved to the new one (old → new).

replace.description: `redefine`: true, the objects are replaced by an insert of the block.

rescale.description:
`units` between two units: true keeps its numbers (its size changes by their ratio); absent or false keeps
its size (only the unit's name changes).

sync.description:
`attributes`, `update`: false leaves the inserts' values as they are; absent or true syncs them as `sync`
does (docs/adr/0317 §2).

tags.description: `card`: the words it is found by.

uids.description: `redefine`: the objects it is made of now, by persistent id.

units.description: `units`: the unit it is drawn in (docs/adr/0315 §4).

input.title: BlocksEdit

AttributeSync.description:
What syncing a block's inserts with its definition did (docs/adr/0317 §2): each list in the definition's order,
then the inserts' (a tag once).

added.description: The definition's tags an insert has no value of: it shows their default (nothing written).

constant.description: The constant attributes' tags whose own values were taken off.

fields.description: Values a field wrote.

parameters.description: Parameter values dropped: the block's dynamic part no longer has them or they no longer fit (docs/adr/0318).

places.description: Places dropped: their attributes are no longer movable.

removed.description: The tags whose values were taken off the inserts: no attribute has them, or `removeTags` named them.

renamed.description: The renames done, old and new.

output.description: Output of `cad.blocks.edit` v1.

added.description: `duplicate`, `import`: the definitions added, in the drawing's order.

changed.description: The definitions changed (`rename`, `redefine`, `rebase`, `attributes`).

deleted.description: `redefine` with `replace`: the objects deleted, in the input's order.

insert.description: `redefine` with `replace`: the insert's persistent id and its slot.

removed.description: The definitions deleted (`remove`, `purge`), in the drawing's order.

revision.description:
The document's revision after the write (the same when nothing was
written), as decimal text.

skipped.description: `import`: the file's names the drawing has, kept as they are.

sync.description: `attributes`, `update`, `sync`, `fields`, `place`: what was done to the inserts' values (docs/adr/0317 §2).

output.title: BlocksEdited

AltUnits.description: An alternate unit written after the value in brackets (AutoCAD's DIMALT): `2.500 [2500]`.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the project's length decimals.

at.description: The scale (1:at) its own geometry is drawn at.

scales.description: The other scales it takes part in, ascending, each with what it sets apart.

AnnotativeScale.description:
One of an object's other scales and what it sets apart from the object's
own values; a field not given is the object's own (`textShift` scaled with
the height).

offset.description: A dimension's line offset.

point.description: A text's point; a leader's landing start (its last point: the points after the arrow's tip move with it).

rotation.description: A text's or a leader's note's direction, degrees counter-clockwise from east.

scale.description: 1:scale.

textShift.description: A dimension's value moved from its place (0 and 0: in its place).

ArchDiscipline.description: The discipline an architectural object belongs to.

ArchInfo.description:
What every architectural object carries beside its geometry (`CAD-ARCH-03`): its level (by the project level's
id), phase, construction status and discipline; absent fields are not said.

ArchPhase.description: An architectural object's phase (renovation): what is there, what goes, what is new.

ArchStatus.description: Where an architectural object is in its construction.

AreaPart.description:
A part of a multi-part area past its first (docs/adr/0143): its outer
ring in vertex + bulge form, its holes and its vertices' elevations, as
the area's own fields hold the first part's. A multi-part polyline's
part is the same, open and without holes (docs/adr/0174).

ms.description:
A polyline's part's measures, as the polyline's own `ms`
(docs/adr/0224 §1); an area's part has none.

zs.description: Each vertex's elevation, as the area's own `zs` (docs/adr/0142).

Attachment.description:
One of an object's attachments: its name, its source (exactly one of
`asset`, `file` and `url`) and an optional note.

asset.description: Embedded: the project library's PNG or JPEG asset its bytes are.

file.description:
Linked: a file's path, relative to the drawing's folder when it is
relative.

name.description: The name shown (the file's name by default).

note.description: A note shown with it (lines allowed).

url.description: A web address (`http` or `https`).

AttributeDefinition.description:
One attribute an insert shows as text (docs/adr/0144 §7): the insert's
attribute `tag`, else `value`, written at `p` in the definition's
coordinates, moved with the insert.

align.description: Where `p` is on the text, as a text's (docs/adr/0145).

boxWidth.description: A multiline attribute's box width, metres in the definition's size.

constant.description: Its value is the definition's `value` in every insert; an insert holds none of its own (bit 2).

field.description:
A field (docs/adr/0317 §1): a template whose `{ifade}` parts are filled for each insert (its attributes, its
place, the project's `@` values); the commands that place, sync and update fields write it as the value.

height.description: Metres, in the definition's size.

invisible.description: Not drawn: its value is kept, listed and scheduled (DXF 70 bit 1).

movable.description: An insert may move its text (`attributePlaces`); off: locked where the definition puts it (bit 16 set).

multiline.description: Its value may hold line breaks, each a line; wrapped to `boxWidth` when given (an MTEXT attribute).

preset.description: Blok ekle takes its default without asking (bit 8).

prompt.description: What Blok ekle asks for it.

rotation.description: Degrees, counter-clockwise from east, as a text's.

value.description: The default value.

verify.description: Blok ekle asks for it twice, the two the same (bit 4).

widthFactor.description: The letters' width times this, as a text's (docs/adr/0145).

BlockAction.description: An action (docs/adr/0318 §2): the objects (local ids) a parameter's change moves.

oneOf.description:
The objects move by the parameter's change (a linear's along its line, a polar's and a point's by the moved
point).
The objects' points inside the box move by the parameter's change; the rest stay.
The objects scale about the parameter's `from` by its value over its default.

Copies of the objects every `spacing` along a linear parameter's line: one for each further `spacing` its
value holds past its default (the definition shows what the default holds).
The objects turn about an angle parameter's centre by its change.
The objects mirror about a flip parameter's line while it is on.

BlockCard.description:
A block's library card (docs/adr/0317 §4): what the Bloklar panel's cards and search show beside its name, its
description, its size and its attributes.

category.description: A path of categories by `/` (`Mimari/Kapılar`); absent: none.

tags.description: Words it is found by, each once, Turkish case folded.

version.description:
How many times its definition has changed since it was made: 1 when made; each change of its objects, base,
attributes or unit adds one.

BlockDefinition.description:
A block definition (docs/adr/0144): objects drawn once, placed many
times. Its objects' ids are local to it, once each and kept by every edit
of it, so a reference to a piece follows it (docs/adr/0315 §1). An object
on the block's layer (`""`, the DXF's layer 0) is drawn on its insert's
layer; one on a layer of its own shows only while that layer does
(docs/adr/0315 §2). A part of its look it has is its own, a `byLayer` part
its layer's (its insert's layer on the block's layer), any other part its
insert's (BYBLOCK).

attributes.description: The texts an insert shows from its attributes (ATTDEF).

base.description: The point placed at an insert's `p`, in the definition's coordinates.

card.description: Its library card (docs/adr/0317 §4): category, tags and version.

dynamic.description: Its parameters and actions (docs/adr/0318): one definition at many sizes and looks.

name.description: Unique in the drawing, Turkish case folded.

units.description:
The unit it was drawn in (docs/adr/0315 §4): a unit, its geometry being metres as the drawing's (an insert
keeps its size anywhere); `unitless`, its numbers being drawing units (an insert is scaled by the drawing's
unit). Absent: a real-size block of an unknown unit.

xref.description: An external reference's source (docs/adr/0348 §1): its objects are that drawing's as last loaded.

BlockParameter.description: A parameter (docs/adr/0318 §1). Its points are the definition's coordinates.

oneOf.description: A length along `from`→`to`: its default the distance between them; a change moves `to` along the line.
`to` moved anywhere: its value a point, its rule on the distance from `from`.
An angle about `center`, radians counter-clockwise from east; its default `base`.
A point: its default `at`.
A mirror about the line `a`→`b`, off by default.
The objects shown: its first state by default.
Rows of values set together, chosen by label; it has no value of its own to keep.

BlockUnits.description: The unit a block was drawn in (docs/adr/0315 §4).

oneOf.description: Its numbers are the drawing's units: a 1 is a millimetre in a millimetre drawing, a metre in a metre one.

BreakLine.description: Which of a dimension's lines a break is on.

oneOf.description: The dimension line, from its first end (0) to its second (1).
The first extension line, from the measured point (0) to its far end (1).
The second.

CellField.description: A cell bound to a source (docs/adr/0327 §3): its words are the value last written, `####` when broken.

CellFormula.description: A cell's formula (docs/adr/0327 §2): its words begin with `=`; the cell's words are its result.

CellRange.description: A merged range: `rows` × `cols` cells from row `row`, column `col`.

CellStyle.description:
A style over a range of cells (docs/adr/0327 §1); what it leaves absent the cells take from the styles before it,
then from the table.

color.description: Its words' colour, `#rrggbb`.

decimals.description: The decimals a formula's or a field's number is written with.

fill.description: Its background, `#rrggbb`.

CircleEntity.description:
Fields every object has. `id` is the object's local id inside a v1 file.
v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

index shown, its values (coordinates; moments in milliseconds since 1970

time.description: The values are a CF time axis's moments.

DimensionArrow.description:
A dimension's arrowheads other than the oblique tick, which is no value but
the field's absence (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: A filled triangle, its tip on the dimension line's end (Dolu ok).
The triangle's two sides (Açık ok).
A filled circle about the end (Nokta).
Nothing at the ends (Yok).

DimensionBreak.description:
A gap in one of a dimension's lines where another object crosses it (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK), at the fraction `t` of
the line; its width the options' `breakSize`.

angle.description: Linear: measured direction in degrees (0 = ΔY, 90 = ΔX).

annotative.description:
Its scales: drawn at the paper height it was given at every scale it takes part in, hidden
at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

arrowSize.description:
The arrowhead's (or tick's) length; absent: `DEFAULT_TICK` for ticks,
`DEFAULT_ARROW` for the others.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

breaks.description: The gaps in its lines where other objects cross them (docs/adr/0321 §1).

follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,

c.description:
Angular: the vertex. Arc length: the arc's centre. Jogged: the centre
the line starts from (docs/adr/0147).

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

decimals.description:
A length's, a coordinate's or a slope's decimals; absent: the
project's length decimals (a slope's 2). Angles keep the project's.

dimLineColor.description:
The dimension line's and its arrowheads' colour, `#RRGGBB`; absent:
the object's (docs/adr/0205 §6).

dimLineType.description: The dimension line's type; absent: continuous.

dimLineWeight.description: The dimension line's weight, paper mm as an object's; absent: a hairline.

dimStyle.description: The project's dimension style it follows, by its id; absent: Standart.

extBeyond.description: How far the extension lines pass the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_BEYOND`.

extColor.description: The extension lines' colour; absent: the object's.

extLineType.description: The extension lines' type; absent: continuous.

extOffset.description: The extension lines' gap from the measured points; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_OFFSET`.

extWeight.description: The extension lines' weight, paper mm; absent: a hairline.

oneOf.description: Beyond the second extension line when the value and the two arrowheads are longer than the line between them.

breakSize.description: A break's width, times the value's height, over 0; absent: 1 (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK size).

lengthStyle.description:

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,

the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

actions.description: Applied in this order to the definition's objects, each on what the ones before left.

LeaderArrow.description:
A leader's arrowhead other than the filled triangle (Dolu üçgen,
AutoCAD's Closed filled), which is no value but the field's absence: a
leader has one spelling (docs/adr/0146 §1). The first three are the
first leaders'; the others AutoCAD's arrowheads (docs/adr/0205 §7, `.kcad`

oneOf.description: Açık ok: the filled triangle's two sides (Open).
Dolu nokta: a filled dot (Dot).
Yok: no arrowhead, the line ends at the tip (None).
Boş üçgen: the triangle's outline (Closed blank).
İnce açık ok: two sides 15° off the line (Open 30).
Dik açık ok: two sides square to each other (Open 90, Right angle).
Küçük nokta (Dot small).
Boş nokta: a ring (Dot blank).
Eğik çizgi: a tick across the tip (Oblique).
Mimari çentik: a heavy tick (Architectural tick).
Dolu kare (Box filled).
Boş kare (Box blank).
Dayanak üçgeni: a filled triangle standing on the tip (Datum triangle filled).

LeaderEntity.description:
A leader (docs/adr/0146): an arrowhead at its first vertex, a line
through its vertices and, with a note, a landing from its last vertex
along the note's direction and the note past the landing's end; one
object. The arrowhead and the landing are measured by the note's height.

annotative.description:

at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

arms.description:
Its other arms (docs/adr/0326 §1): each from its own tip through its bends to the leader's last vertex, where
the landing starts; the arrowhead, the note and the look the first arm's.

arrow.description: The arrowhead; absent: a filled arrow.

commands.title: Bloğu başkasıyla değiştir
commands.summary: from bloğunun çizimdeki yerleştirmelerini (ya da uids ile verilenleri) to bloğuna geçirir; tek geri alma adımı. Her yerleştirme yerini, ölçeğini, dönüşünü, katmanını ve görünüşünü korur; to'nun sabit olmayan özniteliklerinin değerleri ve taşınabilir özniteliklerinin yerleri kalır, öbürleri düşer ve söylenir (dropped, places); to'nun alanları doldurulur. purge ile from artık hiçbir yerde yerleşmiyorsa silinir. Kilitli katmandakiler atlanır ve söylenir. AutoCAD'in BLOCKREPLACE'i. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

input.description:
Input of `cad.blocks.replace` v1: the drawing's inserts of `from` (or those named) place `to` instead, as one undo
step “Bloğu başkasıyla değiştir”; each keeps its place, scale, turn, layer and look, the values of `to`'s attributes
(not constant) and the places of its movable ones; `to`'s fields are filled. With `purge`, `from` is deleted when
no insert uses it any more.

Refusals in order: `no_block` (`from` or `to` missing), `same_block`, `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict`,
`unknown_block` (`from`, `to`), `entity_not_found`, `not_insert` (an object named that is not an insert of
`from`), `layer_locked` (every one locked; some: a warning), `invalid_field`.

from.description: The block whose inserts are replaced.

purge.description: Deletes `from` when no insert uses it after.

uids.description: Only these inserts of `from`, by persistent id (absent: every one of the drawing's).

fields.description: Values `to`'s fields wrote.

places.description: Places dropped: `to` has no movable attribute of their tag.

replaced.description: The inserts that place `to` now, in the drawing's order.

their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).

Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144): its definition drawn

definition's x axis when `mirror`, then scaled and turned about `p`. The
transform is a similarity, shapes keeping their kind, unless the insert
has a y factor of its own (docs/adr/0315 §3): then an affine, a circle
becoming the exact ellipse of its image. The insert's own attributes
carry the values of the definition's attribute definitions.

the definition puts it.

first leaders'; the others AutoCAD's arrowheads (docs/adr/0205 §7, `.kcad`

oneOf.description: Açık ok: the filled triangle's two sides (Open).
Dolu nokta: a filled dot (Dot).

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).

oneOf.description: Açık ok: the filled triangle's two sides (Open).
Dolu nokta: a filled dot (Dot).
Yok: no arrowhead, the line ends at the tip (None).
Boş üçgen: the triangle's outline (Closed blank).
İnce açık ok: two sides 15° off the line (Open 30).
Dik açık ok: two sides square to each other (Open 90, Right angle).
Küçük nokta (Dot small).
Boş nokta: a ring (Dot blank).
Eğik çizgi: a tick across the tip (Oblique).
Mimari çentik: a heavy tick (Architectural tick).
Dolu kare (Box filled).
Boş kare (Box blank).
Dayanak üçgeni: a filled triangle standing on the tip (Datum triangle filled).

through its vertices and, with a note, a landing from its last vertex
along the note's direction and the note past the landing's end; one
object. The arrowhead and the landing are measured by the note's height.

commands.title: Sabit bloğa çevir
commands.summary: Dinamik bir bloğun yerleştirmelerini çizdikleriyle aynı düz bloklara geçirir; tek geri alma adımı, adı Sabit bloğa çevir. Aynı blok ve aynı değerler tek yeni blok olur: nesneleri cad.blocks.proxy'ninkiler, taban noktası, birimi, öznitelik tanımları, açıklaması ve kartı kaynağınki, dinamik parçası yok. commands.title: Blok ekle
commands.summary: Bir bloğu kimliğiyle ya da adıyla at noktasına, layerId katmanına yerleştirir; tek geri alma adımı, adı Ekle. scale x ekseni boyunca, yScale y ekseni boyunca çarpandır (yScale verilmezse scale; eşit değilse daire elipse döner), rotation radyan saat yönünün tersine, mirror bloğun x ekseninde aynalar. Birimsiz blok çizimin birimini alır (1 birimi milimetre çizimde 1 mm); birimi olan blok gerçek boyutuyla yerleşir, birimi çizimin biriminden başkaysa söylenir (insert_units_differ). attributes öznitelik değerlerini etiketleriyle verir; verilmeyen öznitelik varsayılanını gösterir, blokta olmayan etiket reddedilir. Blok ekle aracı bu komutla yazar. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur. Yerel çizim izin istemez; bulut projesine değişiklik project.changes ile gider.

input.description:
Input of `cad.blocks.insert` v1 (docs/adr/0315 §4): an insert of a block, named by its id or its name, at `at`
on `layerId`. Everything it depends on is here (TODOS.md CMD-07): Blok ekle gives the active layer, the current
colour, its scale, turn and mirror, the values asked.

The insert's factors: `scale` (absent: 1) and `yScale` (absent: `scale`), times the unit's factor: a unitless
block takes the drawing's unit (a 1 of it is a millimetre in a millimetre drawing); a real-size block keeps
its size (factor 1) and, drawn in another unit than the drawing's, is said so (`block_units_differ`).

Attribute values are the given ones by tag (an attribute left out shows its default); a tag the block does
not have is refused. `attrs` are the insert's other data (an object template's, a GIS record's), not checked
against the block's tags; a value under a tag of both is the attribute's.

Refusals, in this order: `no_block` (neither `block` nor `name`), `not_finite` (`at`, then `rotation`),
`invalid_scale` (`scale`, `yScale`: positive and finite); `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict` (status
`conflict`); `unknown_block` (no such id or name, Turkish case folded); `unknown_tag`; `layer_not_found`,
`not_a_layer`, `layer_locked`; on the desktop `slots_exhausted`. Warnings: `layer_hidden`, `block_units_differ`.

commands.summary: Katman ağacına bir harita servisinden çizilen katman ekler (add: XYZ ve TMS, WMTS, WMS, OGC API Tiles, ArcGIS REST, Google'ın 2B karoları, vektör karolar), nesneleri bir servisten alınan katman ekler (addFeed: WFS, OGC API Features, ArcGIS katmanı, GeoJSON adresi; alanlarıyla), birini değiştirir (update: ad, servis ya da kaynak) ya da bir servis katmanını siler (remove); tek geri alma adımı, adı işlemin. parent katmanın gireceği grup (ya da yanına gireceği katman), index gruptaki yeri: ilki en üstte çizilir, verilmezse en sona, her şeyin altına girer. connections projenin bağlantılarına eklenir ya da aynı kimliklisinin yerini alır; bağlantı yalnız doğrulamanın türünü ve gizli olmayan adları taşır, gizli değerler çizime yazılmaz. Servis katmanı nesne tutmaz; servis ya da kaynak projenin bağlantılarından birini adlandırır. Nesneler servisten alındıktan sonra cad.entities.create ile yazılır; aynı işlem grubunda tek adım olur. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur. Yerel çizim izin istemez; bulut projesine değişiklik project.changes ile gider.

input.description:
Input of `cad.layers.service` v1: one change of the layer tree, as one
undo step named after the operation.

- `add`: `name`, `service`; `parent` and `index` place it;
- `addFeed`: `name`, `feed`, `fields` (absent: none); placed as `add`;
- `update`: `layer`, and any of `name`, `service` (a service layer's),
  `feed` (a feed layer's);
- `remove`: `layer` (a service layer).

`parent`: the group it goes into, or a layer whose group it goes into;
absent, the top. `index`: its place among the group's nodes, first on
top; absent or past the end, last: drawn first, under everything else.
`connections`: the project's connections it adds or replaces (by id), in
the same step.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `no_layer` (update
and remove without `layer`), `empty_name` (add, addFeed; update with a
name that is empty or only white space), `no_service` (add),
`no_feed` (addFeed), `service_and_feed` (both given), `invalid_service`,
`invalid_feed`, `invalid_fields`, `invalid_connection` (the project's
connections with these, by `connections_problem`); then
`invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict` (status `conflict`),
`layer_not_found`, `not_a_layer` (a group), `not_a_service_layer`
(update's service on a layer that has none, update's feed on a layer
without one, remove on a layer drawn from no service), `layer_has_objects`
(update giving a service to a layer with objects), `unknown_connection`
(a service or feed naming a connection the project does not have).

LayerCompose.description:
How a layer is composed into the drawing (Katman çizimi, docs/adr/0226 §3,
§4); absent, as it always was: opaque, normal, no mask.

LayerField.description: A field of a layer (docs/adr/0199 §1): its name is the attribute's key.

alias.description: The name the table and the form show.

default.description: The value a new object takes, in its canonical text.

domain.description:
The project's value list it links (docs/adr/0430): its `values` (or `min` and `max`) are that
list's copy, written anew whenever the list changes. None: its own.

id.description:
The field's stable id (docs/adr/0401 §2): what a form binds to. None: its name is its id; a
rename writes the old name here so a binding holds. Unique among the layer's fields' keys.

max.description: A number's greatest value, in its canonical text; included.

maxExclusive.description: `max` is not itself in the range; only with `max`; written only as `true`.

merge.description:
What the field's value becomes when objects are merged into one (Alan birleştir, Birleştir,
Parçaları birleştir; docs/adr/0419). None: the first object's.

min.description: A number's least value, in its canonical text; included.

minExclusive.description: `min` is not itself in the range (docs/adr/0438 §4); only with `min`; written only as `true`.

multiple.description:
A text field holds several values (docs/adr/0408 §1, 0409 §1): a listed one its codes in the
list's order, an unlisted one its values in their order (objects' persistent ids for a
many-to-many reference), joined with `; `; written only as `true`.

required.description: An object may not leave it empty; written only as `true`.

scale.description: A decimal's most fraction digits (0–15).

split.description:
What the field's value becomes in the pieces when its object is split (Alan böl, Parçala,
Kır, Parçalara ayır; docs/adr/0419). None: each piece keeps it.

unique.description:
No two objects of the layer hold the same value (empty ones aside; docs/adr/0438 §3): every
write is refused `not_unique` that would; written only as `true`.

unit.description:
The unit a number is in, shown after it (`m²`, `kg`; 1–16 characters; docs/adr/0438 §4); the value
stays the number.

values.description: The values a text or a number takes, when only some.

oneOf.description: A date and a time of day, local (docs/adr/0412 §1): `YYYY-AA-GGTSS:DD:SS`.
A time of day (docs/adr/0412 §1): `SS:DD:SS`.

LayerFilter.description:
A layer's filter (docs/adr/0211 §2): an object passes when the condition
holds for it and, when there is a list, the list names it.

expression.description:
The condition (İfadeyle seç's language, docs/adr/0100): an object
passes when it is true.

objects.description:
Only these objects, by their persistent ids (Seçimden süzgeç); an id
the drawing does not hold is not wrong.

LayerGeometry.description:
What a layer holds (docs/adr/0622 §5): GIS's layer type, a layer of points, lines, areas or annotation; absent,
any kind (Karışık, a CAD layer). A typed layer takes only the objects of its kind: a write that would put another
kind on it is refused (`layer_geometry_mismatch`) and the tools that draw another kind are off while it is active.

LayerLabels.description: How a layer is labelled (`LayerStyle.labels`, docs/adr/0212 §2).

classes.description: The rules' classes, in order; only with `rules`.

LayerMask.description: The mask a layer's labels and markers cut into other layers (docs/adr/0226 §3).

labels.description: Its placed labels' boxes.

size.description: How far the shapes grow, paper mm (0–10); their corners round as far.

targets.description: The layers it cuts into, by their ids.

LayerNode.description: A node of the layer tree: a group or a layer.

actions.description:
The addresses and files its objects open (docs/adr/0225 §4). Only a
layer holding objects has them, never a group or a layer drawn from a
service.

card.description:
What the Bilgi tool shows of its objects (docs/adr/0225 §5); absent:
the default card. Only on a layer holding objects.

contingents.description:
Değer bileşimleri (docs/adr/0423): the groups of fields whose values go together. Only a
layer holding objects has them.

feed.description:
Where the layer's objects were taken from, to take them again
(docs/adr/0208 §10). Only a layer has it, never a group.

fields.description:
A layer's fields (docs/adr/0199 §1): the schema of its objects'
attributes, in the order the table and the form show them; empty, no
schema (and nothing written). Only a layer has them, never a group.

filter.description:
The layer's filter (docs/adr/0211 §2): only the objects that pass it
are shown, picked and given to its tools. Only a layer has it, never a
group or a layer drawn from a service.

frozen.description:
Dondur (AutoCAD's freeze, DXF's 70 bit 1; docs/adr/0311 §1): absent,
thawed; `true`, frozen: neither drawn, picked, snapped to nor counted
in the drawing's extent, and Hepsini göster leaves it frozen; the
active layer is never frozen. A group's covers what it holds. Only
`true` is written.

geometry.description:
What the layer holds (docs/adr/0622 §5): points, lines, areas or annotation; absent, any kind. Only a layer
has it, never a group.

replaces.description: A scenario's layer: the base layer it stands for (docs/adr/0210 §9).

rules.description:
Kayıt kuralları (docs/adr/0438 §1): the constraints every write of the layer's records keeps.
Only a layer holding objects has them.

scenario.description: A group made a scenario (docs/adr/0210 §9). Only a group has it.

service.description:
A layer drawn from a map service (docs/adr/0208 §2): it holds no
objects. Only a layer has it, never a group.

snap.description:
A layer's own snapping (docs/adr/0163 §4): off, or only some kinds;
absent, the general kinds. Only a layer has it, never a group.

sourceCrs.description: The system its objects came from (docs/adr/0583 §1); absent: not known. Only a layer has it, never a group.

subtypes.description:
Alt türler (docs/adr/0422): the field that sorts the records and what each kind narrows.
Only a layer holding objects has them.

tableStyles.description:
Koşullu biçim (docs/adr/0413 §1): how the attribute table paints its rows and cells by
conditions; empty, plainly. Only a layer holding objects has them.

time.description:
A temporal layer's time setting (docs/adr/0210 §2): which attributes
hold its objects' start and end. Only a layer has it, never a group.

LayerRule.description: A record rule of a layer.

fields.description:
The fields' keys a form shows it on and a refusal points at, in order; none: the first field it
reads.

id.description: Its id, once in the layer: what a form or a refusal names it by (1–64 characters).

message.description: What a write breaking it is told (1–500 characters).

name.description: Its name as the interface shows it (1–64 characters).

rule.description:
The expression that must hold (the record's fields by name, `$alan` and the project's `@`
values).

warning.description: A soft rule: broken, it warns and the write goes in; written only as `true`.

LayerSnap.description:
A layer's own snapping (docs/adr/0163 §4): `{ "off": true }`, no
snapping to its objects; or `{ "kinds": [...] }`, only these kinds (as
far as the general kinds take them). Exactly one of the two, and a list
that is not empty: the readers refuse anything else ([`LayerSnap::problem`]).

off.description: No snapping to the layer's objects; written only as `true`.

LayerSourceCrs.description: The system a layer's objects came from.

area.description: Where the system is meant for, in the registry's words.

axisOrder.description: `en`, `ne` or `latlon`: EPSG's order of its axes (the drawing's are always east, north).

srid.description: Its EPSG code, when the registry knows it.

unit.description: `metre` or `degree`.

LayerStyle.description: A layer's look. `renderer` (the style engine, docs/STYLE.md) is opaque JSON in v1.

color.description: Hex colour or a theme token (fg, fg-dim, ink, paper).

labels.description:
How the layer is labelled (docs/adr/0212 §2): rule-based classes,
none, its objects as obstacles; absent, by `label` (one label).

linePattern.description: A project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1; `pattern` is a hatch's); absent: `line_type`.

lineType.description: Its built-in line type; with a `pattern`, the one nearest to it (what a reader without patterns draws).

lineWeight.description: Plot line weight in mm.

LayerSubtypes.description: A layer's subtypes: the field that sorts the records (its key) and the subtypes, in their order.

field.description: The subtype field's key (its id, else its name): a field with a value list, one value each.

LayerTime.description:
A layer's time setting (docs/adr/0210 §2): its objects' start (or
moment) and end are the values of these attributes.

cumulative.description: Birikimli: an object shows from its start on, whatever its end; written only as `true`.

end.description: The attribute holding the end; absent, the objects are moments.

key.description: The attribute naming an object across its versions (Zamanı karşılaştır's key).

recordedEnd.description: The attribute holding when the version was superseded (its system time's end); empty: still current.

recordedStart.description:
The attribute holding when the object's version was recorded (its system time's start, docs/adr/0537):
what was known on a day is the versions recorded by then and not yet superseded. `.kcad` schema 90.

start.description: The attribute holding the start (an instant layer's moment).

oneOf.description: Straight, along the line.
Letter by letter, following the line.
Level, on the line.
A contour's height: curved on the line, its top uphill.

MergePolicy.description: A field's value in the object merged from several (docs/adr/0419).

oneOf.description: The first object's value.
Empty.
The values' sum, exact to the field's last digit: integers and decimals with fraction digits.
The least value (numbers).
The greatest value (numbers).

ObstacleKind.description: What of an obstacle area a label avoids.

oneOf.description: Its inside: a label covering any of it.
Its outline: a label crossing an edge.
Around it, QGIS's cartographic order (top right first).
On it.

size.description: Diameter in CSS px.

ScenarioInfo.description:
A group made a scenario (docs/adr/0210 §9): its layers are an alternative
kept apart from the field state (Mevcut durum).

ServiceConnection.description:
A connection of the project (docs/adr/0208 §2): what proof requests to
its origin carry, without the secrets.

origin.description: `https://host[:port]`: proof goes to this origin only.

oneOf.description: Tiles by an address template, Web Mercator (TMS with `yFlip`).
OGC API Tiles' map tiles.
An ArcGIS REST MapServer or ImageServer: its cached tiles, else `export`.
Google's Map Tiles API, 2D tiles.
Vector tiles (MVT) by a MapLibre style, a TileJSON or a template.

ServiceLayer.description: A layer drawn from a service (docs/adr/0208 §2).

bbox.description:
The service's extent, WGS 84 degrees (west, south, east, north), as
its capabilities give it: what “Servisin kapsamına yakınlaştır” shows.

connection.description: The project's connection whose proof goes with the requests.

dynamic.description: WMS and `export`: one picture of the view instead of tiles.

format.description: The image's media type (`image/png`, …).

grid.description: WMTS's, OGC's and a cached ArcGIS service's matrices.

layers.description: WMS's layer names; WMTS's one layer; ArcGIS's layers shown.

preset.description: The ready basemap it came from.

srid.description: The system asked: WMS's `CRS`, ArcGIS's `imageSR`; a grid's own.

style.description: WMS's and WMTS's style; Google's map type.

template.description: WMTS REST's and OGC's tile template.

tileSize.description: XYZ's and the vector tiles' tile side, pixels; absent 256.

url.description:
XYZ: the template; WMS, WMTS, ArcGIS: the service's address; OGC
API Tiles: the tile set's; vector: the style's, the TileJSON's or the
template; Google: empty.

yFlip.description: TMS: rows counted from the bottom.

ServiceParam.description: A parameter sent with every request (`TIME`, `CQL_FILTER`, …): never a secret.

SplitPolicy.description: A field's value in the pieces of a split object (docs/adr/0419).

oneOf.description: Each piece keeps the value.
The pieces' values are emptied.
The pieces take the field's default (none: empty).

The value is shared by the pieces' areas (lines: lengths), the total kept to the field's last
digit: integers and decimals with fraction digits.

StackMode.description: When a label is cut into lines.

oneOf.description: Only when it does not fit on one line.

Subtype.description: One subtype: a code of the subtype field's list, its label, and what it narrows.

label.description: What it is called; empty: the subtype field's label of its code.

SubtypeField.description: What a subtype changes on one field; a field it does not name keeps the layer's rules.

default.description: The value a new record of this subtype starts with, in its field's canonical text.

field.description: The field's key.

required.description: A record of this subtype has a value (in addition to the field's own rule).

values.description: The codes of its value list this subtype offers (a field with a value list); none: all of them.

TableStyle.description: One rule of a layer's table (docs/adr/0413 §1).

color.description: The text's colour, `#RRGGBB`.

condition.description: When it holds: an expression over the record (`Kat > 3 ve Durum = 'kotu'`).

field.description: The field whose cell it paints, by name; absent: the whole row.

TileGrid.description: A service's tile grid as read: its system and its matrices, coarsest first.

TileMatrix.description:
One matrix of a tile grid (docs/adr/0208 §3): its pixel's size in the
grid system's units, its top left corner as east and north (longitude
and latitude), whatever order the service wrote them in, its tiles' and
its own size in tiles.

plan.description: What `cad.layers.service` would write (plan mode); nothing is written.

connections.description: The project's connections as execute would leave them.

node.description:
The layer as execute would leave it (`add`, `addFeed`: its id the one
it would be given); absent for `remove`.

revision.description: The document revision the plan was made against.

examples.title: Belediyenin WMS'i, anahtarı adreste giden bir bağlantıyla
WFS'ten alınacak parseller için veri katmanı

commands.title: Ağ tanımı
commands.summary: Projenin ağlarına bir ağ tanımı yazar (set: aynı kimlikli ağın yerini alır, yoksa sona eklenir) ya da birini siler (remove). Ağ, katmanlardan her analizde kurulan grafın tanımıdır: kenar katmanları (çizgi, çoklu çizgi ve yaylar; isteğe bağlı süzgeç ifadesi), düğüm katmanları (bağlantı, kaynak ya da vana; süzgeç ve kapalı ifadesi), bağlanma (ends: uçlarda, bir uç başka kenara değiyorsa orada; vertices: bütün köşelerde de) ve tolerans (m), yön (both, digitized ya da field: alanın ileri, geri ve kapalı değerleri), uzunluktan başka maliyetler (speed: hız alanından dakika, varsayılan hızla; field: kenarın bütününün maliyeti) ve kapalı kenarların ifadesi; ayrıca turns (dönüşler), levels (seviyeler), terminals (cihazların terminalleri: kenarların başlangıç ve bitiş terminal alanları, cihaz katmanı, terminalleri ve aralarındaki yollar) ve subnetworks (alt ağlar: ad alanı, yazılacak öznitelik, reach). Ağ proje ayarıdır: yazmak çizimi kirli yapar, geri alma adımı değildir. Çizimde olmayan katmanı adlandıran ağ yazılır, unknown_layer uyarısıyla. Analizler (en kısa yol, hizmet alanı, en yakın tesis, maliyet matrisi, şebeke izleme) çizimi değiştirmez; sonuçları cad.entities.create ile yazılır. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

DeviceTerminal.description: A terminal: its id (lower-case letters, digits and hyphens) and its name (what the tools say).

JunctionLayer.description: A junction layer: its points' role and, optionally, which of them it takes and which are closed.

closed.description: An expression: the junctions it holds for (a closed valve) are passed by no analysis.

oneOf.description: Bağlantı: splits the edges it lies on.
Kaynak: where the supply comes from (Yalıtım's beslemesiz kalan).
Vana: where Yalıtım stops.

NetworkClosures.description:
The edge fields of a closure's first and last day (docs/adr/0567 §2): `YYYY-MM-DD`, both days in; an empty first
day closes from always, an empty last day until ever. Its weekdays and hours (docs/adr/0568): an edge closed on
the days its weekday field names (`Pzt-Cum`, `Cmt, Paz`, `1-5`; empty: every day) and, when its hours field holds
any, only in those hours (`22:00-06:00`, `07:00-09:00, 17:00-19:00`; empty: the whole day). An edge whose four
values are all empty is not closed.

days.description: The edge field of the weekdays an edge is closed on (docs/adr/0568 §1).

hours.description: The edge field of the hours an edge is closed in (docs/adr/0568 §1).

oneOf.description: Uçlarda: at their ends, and an end on another edge splits it there.
Köşelerde: at every vertex too.

field.description: The attribute it reads: a speed in km/h, or the whole edge's cost.

periods.description:
A speed cost's time profile (docs/adr/0521 §4): its periods in the day's order; the rest of the day the
edges' own speeds. Read when a question gives a time.

speed.description: A speed cost's speed (km/h) where the field gives none it can read.

unit.description: A field cost's unit (“TL”, “dk”); a speed cost's is minutes and names none.

oneOf.description: Süre, minutes: the length over the speed.
The field's value for the whole edge, shared by its pieces by their lengths.

closed.description: An expression: the edges it holds for are out of service, travelled by nothing.

closures.description:
Tarihli kapanmalar (docs/adr/0567 §2): the edge fields of the first and the last day an edge is closed; a
question with a date passes none closed that day. None: no edge is closed by date.

costs.description: The costs besides the length, in the order the tools offer them.

edges.description: The line layers whose lines, paths and arcs are the edges, in this order.

id.description: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens; one of its kind in the project.

junctions.description: The point layers whose points are junctions, sources or valves.

levels.description:
Seviyeler (docs/adr/0521 §3): which ends and insides of the edges connect, by their level fields; none: every
one at one level.

name.description: Trimmed; one of its kind in the project.

profiles.description:
Araç profilleri (docs/adr/0567 §1): what a vehicle may travel (its weight, height, width against the edges'
limits; the edges its kind may not) and how fast; a question names one. None: every vehicle the same.

subnetworks.description:
Alt ağlar (docs/adr/0557 §2): the parts the sources feed, found by `cad.subnetworks.find` and written into an
attribute by `cad.subnetworks.update`. None: the network has no subnetworks.

terminals.description:
Terminaller (docs/adr/0557 §1): the ends of a device (a valve's in and out, a transformer's two sides) and which
of them connect through it; a trace goes through a device only along those paths. None: a device is a point.

tolerance.description: Metres, within [`NETWORK_TOLERANCES`].

turns.description: Dönüşler (docs/adr/0521 §2): forbidden turns, U-turns and turn delays; none: every turn free.

oneOf.description: The network replaces the project's of its id, or goes last.
The network of `id` goes.
Every edge both ways.
Every edge the way it is drawn (pipes drawn with the flow).

By an attribute's value: `forward` the way the edge is drawn only, `backward` against it only, `closed`
neither; any other value, and none, both ways.

NetworkKind.description: Yol ağı or Şebeke: what the tools offer first; the graph is the same.

NetworkLayer.description: An edge layer and, optionally, which of its objects are edges.

filter.description: An expression: only the objects it holds for; absent: all of them.

layer.description: The layer's id. A layer the project no longer has is said when the network is built.

NetworkLevels.description:
The level fields (docs/adr/0521 §3): an edge's level at its start, at its end and, when given, inside it (else
its ends' when they are one, none when they differ); a junction point's from `start` (empty: every level).

NetworkPeriod.description:
A period of a speed cost's day (docs/adr/0521 §4): from `from` to `to` (minutes of the day), the edges go at their
speed times `factor`, or at the speed `field` gives (km/h; 0 closed, empty or unreadable the edge's own speed).

NetworkProfile.description:
A vehicle profile (docs/adr/0567 §1): its name, its limits (an edge is closed to it where the edge's field is
below its value), what forbids an edge to it (a field's values), its top speed and whether it goes against one-way
edges (a pedestrian).

bothWays.description: Whether the vehicle goes both ways on one-way edges (closed edges stay closed).

name.description: Trimmed, at most 40 characters; one of its kind in the network, Turkish case aside.

topSpeed.description: The highest speed (km/h) the vehicle goes on any edge: a speed cost's edges slower; none: the edges' own.

NetworkSubnetworks.description:
A network's subnetworks (docs/adr/0557 §2): its sources are the subnetwork controllers; a subnetwork is what a
controller reaches (not past another controller, a closed junction or a closed edge).

attribute.description:
The attribute `cad.subnetworks.update` writes on every object of the network: its subnetworks' names, joined
with `; ` where it is in more than one; taken away where it is in none.

keepCurrent.description:
Güncel tut (docs/adr/0562 §3): a write that touches the network's layers also rewrites the attribute, in its
own step; when it cannot, the command says `subnetwork_dirty`.

name.description: The controller's attribute holding its subnetwork's name; none: its label, else its `Ad`, else `Kaynak <no>`.

NetworkTerminals.description:
The terminals of a network's devices (docs/adr/0557 §1): the edge fields naming the terminal an edge's start and
its end are attached to, and the devices.

devices.description: The devices: 1–16, each a junction layer of the network.

end.description: The same for its end.

start.description: The edge attribute whose value (a terminal's id or name) is the terminal its start is attached to.

NetworkTurns.description:
A network's turns (docs/adr/0521 §2): where a way may turn back, what a turn at a crossing of three or more
pieces costs by its angle (seconds, added to the speed costs), and the turn layers' lines, each a turn from the
edge at its start to the edge at its end through their common node: forbidden, or its own delay.

back.description: A U-turn, wherever it is made, seconds.

straight.description: Going straight on (within 30° of the way one came), seconds.

oneOf.description: Her yerde: at every node.
Yalnız çıkmazlarda: where one piece ends (a dead end).
Hiçbir yerde.

ProfileForbid.description: What forbids an edge to a profile: the edge field's values (Turkish case aside).

ProfileLimit.description:
A profile's limit: the vehicle's value (tonnes, metres …) against the edge field's: closed where the field reads
a number below it; an empty field, no limit.

SubnetworkReach.description: Which way a subnetwork reaches from its controller (docs/adr/0557 §2).

oneOf.description: Akış aşağı: the way the edges' directions lead.
Bağlı: along every connection, any way.

TerminalConfig.description:
A configuration of a device (docs/adr/0562 §2): the terminals and paths of the points whose `by` attribute holds
`value` (caseless).

TerminalDevice.description:
A device: every point of the junction layer `layer` has these terminals. An edge attached to one of its terminals
goes on through the device only to a terminal on a path with it; an edge that names none (or one the device does
not have) passes to every terminal and the trace is said to be unverified.

by.description:
The attribute of the device's points that names their configuration (docs/adr/0562 §2): a point whose value is
a configuration's has that configuration's terminals and paths; one with none, or an unknown value, has the
device's own (an unknown value is said). None: every point has the device's own.

configs.description: The configurations besides the device's own: 1–16 when `by` is named, none otherwise.

layer.description: A junction layer of the network (its id).

paths.description: 1–16 paths: each the ids of two or more terminals connected to one another through the device.

TurnLayer.description:
A turn layer: its lines are turns; `field`'s number is a turn's delay (seconds), its empty value a forbidden turn;
without a field every turn of the layer is forbidden.

input.description:
Input of `cad.network.define` v1.

- `set`: `network`, which replaces the project's network of its id or goes
  last;
- `remove`: `id`.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `no_network` (set
without `network`), `no_id` (remove without `id`), `invalid_network` (the
network, or the project's networks with it, by `networks_problem`); then
`invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict` (status `conflict`),
`unknown_network` (remove: the project has no network of the id). A
network naming a layer the drawing does not have is written, with the
warning `unknown_layer`.

expectedRevision.description: The document revision the input was prepared against, as decimal text.

unit.description: A field cost's unit (“TL”, “dk”); a speed cost's is minutes and names none.

closed.description: An expression: the edges it holds for are out of service, travelled by nothing.

closures.description:

costs.description: The costs besides the length, in the order the tools offer them.

edges.description: The line layers whose lines, paths and arcs are the edges, in this order.

id.description: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens; one of its kind in the project.

junctions.description: The point layers whose points are junctions, sources or valves.

levels.description:
