In two columns, filled a row at a time: Tab goes across, then down (docs/adr/0443 §6); else
down the first column, then the second. Written only as `true`.

collapsed.description: It opens closed (its title opens it); written only as `true`.

columns.description: 1 or 2; none: 1.

oneOf.description: A field of the layer.

calculate.description:
The field's value, worked out from the record at every write; the field is read-only. Not
with `default`, `defaultExpr` or `readOnlyWhen`.

checks.description: What the record must satisfy, in order.

choiceFilter.description:
Asked of each of the field's listed values: `@secenek` is its code, `@secenek_etiketi` its
label; a value it is not true for is not offered.

default.description:
The value an empty field shows when the form opens, in the field's canonical text; written
only when the record is saved.

defaultExpr.description:
The value of a new record's empty field: an expression over the record (its plain defaults
in), evaluated in the form's order. Not with `default`.

field.description: The layer field's key ([`LayerField::key`](crate::LayerField::key)): its stable id or its name.

id.description: The item's id, unique in the form.

label.description: The label; none: the field's alias or name.

lookup.description:
The field's values from another layer (docs/adr/0404 §1). Not with the field's own list or
`choiceFilter`.

minSearch.description:
A searched list searches once this many letters are typed (docs/adr/0439 §6); none: from the
first.

mirror.description:
A mirror (docs/adr/0437): the field's value shown again, read-only, where the form needs it; the
field's own item elsewhere writes it. Only its label, help, widget and visibility rule. Written
only as `true`.

overridable.description:
The calculation may be overridden (docs/adr/0417): it fills the field while the field is
empty, the field stays open to typing, and emptying it calculates it again. Only with
`calculate`; written only as `true`.

readOnly.description: Shown, never edited; written only as `true`.

readOnlyWhen.description: Locked when this expression is true.

redact.description:
Kept out of the recorder's examples (docs/adr/0443 §2): the field's values are written as
`‹gizli›` in the Python and replay a call is copied as. Written only as `true`.

required.description:
May not be left empty while shown; written only as `true`. The layer field's own `required`
holds as well.

requiredWhen.description: Required when this expression is true (and the field is shown).

reuseLast.description:
A new record's field opens with the value last written through the form in the session (the
form's interface keeps it); written only as `true`.

suggest.description:
The layer's values of the field offered while typing, the value staying free (docs/adr/0407
§3): text fields without a list; written only as `true`.

unique.description: No two objects of the layer have the same value (empty ones aside); written only as `true`.

visibleWhen.description: Shown only when this expression is true (the record's fields by name).

widget.description: How it is edited; none: the field kind's own.

oneOf.description:
A line of text: a hint for whoever fills the form. A `{…}` in it is an expression put in with
the record's value (docs/adr/0225 §6's templates; docs/adr/0402 §1).

The objects of another layer whose field holds this record's persistent id (docs/adr/0404 §4):
a list in the form, each opened by its own form.

columns.description: The table's columns: the other layer's fields' keys, at most 8; empty: its first four.

field.description: Its field's key that holds this record's id.

layer.description: The other layer's id.

max.description: The most (1–1000): 1 one to one.

min.description:
The fewest related objects (0–1000) the record holds while the item is shown: 1 a child it
must have (docs/adr/0444 §1).

view.description: How the objects are shown (docs/adr/0425): a list of their names, or a table of `columns`.

oneOf.description:
The record's photos and documents (docs/adr/0407 §1): the object's own attachments, added
and removed in the form; their count may be bounded.

accept.description: What counts and is added: every attachment, only photos or only documents and addresses.

max.description: The most (0–100).

min.description: The fewest (0–100) the record holds while the item is shown.

oneOf.description:
The record's place (docs/adr/0433): its shape on a small map, its centre's coordinates and its
area or length; nothing is written.
A divider (docs/adr/0441 §2): a line across the form, its title on it, that a rule may hide.

An action (docs/adr/0441 §6, 0442 §5): a button of a declared kind on the record: a registered
processing tool by its id, the form's calculations again, a workflow step by its label, or the
record shown on the drawing; no address, query or script.

kind.description: What it does; written unless `tool`.

runs.description: Where a `tool` action's tool runs (docs/adr/0442 §6); written unless `auto`.

step.description: A `step` action's workflow step, by its label.

tool.description:
A `tool` action's processing tool id (`attributes.calculate`): letters and digits in dotted
parts.

FormLookup.description: A field's list of values from another layer (docs/adr/0404 §1, docs/adr/0439 §1).

columns.description:
Its layer's fields shown beside a value's label in the list and under the chosen value
(docs/adr/0439 §2), in order; at most [`MOST_LOOKUP_COLUMNS`].

copy.description:
The chosen object's fields copied into the record's when the value is chosen (docs/adr/0439
§3): a copy, kept when the source changes.

duplicates.description: What a code held by more than one of the list's objects is (docs/adr/0439 §4).

filter.description: Asked of each of the list's objects (its fields by name, the project's `@` values).

key.description: Its field's key whose value is written; `$uid`: the object's persistent id (a reference).

label.description: Its field's key shown; none: the key's.

layer.description: The list's layer id.

limit.description:
How many values a page of the list holds (docs/adr/0439 §1): a form's state carries the
first ones and the count of the rest; searching reaches them all. None: every value.

matches.description: The list's object is offered when its field equals the record's (a chain: il, ilçe, mahalle).

sort.description: The list's order (docs/adr/0439 §1): by a field of its layer; none: the labels' natural order.

spatial.description: Only the list's objects standing so to the record's geometry are offered (docs/adr/0439 §5).

stamp.description:
A text field of the record that is told where the copy came from (docs/adr/0439 §3): the
layer, the code, the copied values' fingerprint and the day.

FormPackage.description:
A form package (docs/adr/0435): a form's body with the fields it reads and the value lists those
fields link, to take to another layer or project. No records, no connections, no rights.

domains.description: The project's value lists those fields link (docs/adr/0430).

fields.description: The fields the body binds or reads, as their layer defines them, in its order.

format.description: `kentos.form-package`.

name.description: The form's name.

FormTest.description:
A scenario of a form (docs/adr/0420): a record's typed values and what the form showed, required,
locked, wrote and said for them.

name.description: Unique in the form; trimmed, 1–64 characters.

new.description: A new record: the form's defaults fill it. Written only as `true`.

values.description: The values typed, by the layer fields' keys, onto an empty record.

attrs.description: The record after the form: its attributes by the fields' names.

issues.description: What the form said: each issue's code, `@` and its item when it has one (`form_required@not`).

shown.description: The items shown, required and read-only, by their ids in the form's order.

FormTranslation.description: A form's words in one language (docs/adr/0443 §5).

name.description: The form's name; none: its own.

oneOf.description: One line of text.
Several lines of text.
A number: integer or decimal fields.
A date (YYYY-AA-GG).
A check box: yes or no fields.
A switch: yes or no fields.
A drop-down list: fields with a value list.
Radio buttons: fields with a value list.
A segmented choice: fields with a short value list.
A slider between the field's least and most (docs/adr/0406 §2): number fields with both.
A colour, `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA` (docs/adr/0407 §2): text fields.
A check box for each listed value (docs/adr/0408 §2): multiple fields, and only they.
A list searched by typing (docs/adr/0431): single-valued fields with a long value list.
The codes held as chips, one added from a list (docs/adr/0431): multiple fields with a value list.

A tree of the list (docs/adr/0437): its labels' “Üst / Alt” parts as branches; single-valued
fields with a value list. The codes are the list's.

FormWorkflow.description:
A form's workflow (İş akışı, docs/adr/0428): a listed field holds each record's state; a step
(`cad.forms.transition`) takes a record from one state to another, the form valid when the step
says so and a reason written when it names one; a locked state's record is read-only until a step
takes it out.

drafts.description:
The draft states (docs/adr/0432): a record in one may be kept incomplete, the form's own
requirements warn; the layer's and the subtype's still refuse.

field.description: The state field's key: a single-valued field with a value list.

initial.description: The state a new record starts in: a code of its list.

locked.description: The states whose records are read-only.

log.description:
A text field's key each step appends a line to (docs/adr/0429): the moment, the person, the step,
the states and the reason; read-only in the form.

steps.description: The steps, in their order (the editor's buttons).

ItemWords.description:
An item's words in a language: its label (a tab's, group's, field's, list's or action's title, a
note's text) and its help line.

choices.description: A listed field's values' labels by their codes; the codes written are the list's own.

placeholder.description: A field's text shown in it while empty.

LayerField.description: A field of a layer (docs/adr/0199 §1): its name is the attribute's key.

alias.description: The name the table and the form show.

default.description: The value a new object takes, in its canonical text.

domain.description:
The project's value list it links (docs/adr/0430): its `values` (or `min` and `max`) are that
list's copy, written anew whenever the list changes. None: its own.

id.description:
The field's stable id (docs/adr/0401 §2): what a form binds to. None: its name is its id; a
rename writes the old name here so a binding holds. Unique among the layer's fields' keys.

max.description: A number's greatest value, in its canonical text; included.

maxExclusive.description: `max` is not itself in the range; only with `max`; written only as `true`.

merge.description:
What the field's value becomes when objects are merged into one (Alan birleştir, Birleştir,
Parçaları birleştir; docs/adr/0419). None: the first object's.

min.description: A number's least value, in its canonical text; included.

minExclusive.description: `min` is not itself in the range (docs/adr/0438 §4); only with `min`; written only as `true`.

multiple.description:
A text field holds several values (docs/adr/0408 §1, 0409 §1): a listed one its codes in the
list's order, an unlisted one its values in their order (objects' persistent ids for a
many-to-many reference), joined with `; `; written only as `true`.

required.description: An object may not leave it empty; written only as `true`.

scale.description: A decimal's most fraction digits (0–15).

split.description:
What the field's value becomes in the pieces when its object is split (Alan böl, Parçala,
Kır, Parçalara ayır; docs/adr/0419). None: each piece keeps it.

unique.description:
No two objects of the layer hold the same value (empty ones aside; docs/adr/0438 §3): every
write is refused `not_unique` that would; written only as `true`.

unit.description:
The unit a number is in, shown after it (`m²`, `kg`; 1–16 characters; docs/adr/0438 §4); the value
stays the number.

values.description: The values a text or a number takes, when only some.

oneOf.description: A date and a time of day, local (docs/adr/0412 §1): `YYYY-AA-GGTSS:DD:SS`.
A time of day (docs/adr/0412 §1): `SS:DD:SS`.

LookupCopy.description: A field of the chosen object copied into a field of the record.

from.description: The list's field's key.

LookupDuplicates.description: What a code held by more than one of the list's objects is (docs/adr/0439 §4).

oneOf.description: The first object's is taken and a record holding it is warned (`form_lookup_duplicate`).
The first object's is taken, as chosen.
A record may not hold it (`form_lookup_duplicate`, an error).

LookupMatch.description: A field of the list's layer that must equal a field of the record.

field.description: The list's field's key.

fold.description:
Compared without regard to case, Turkish letters folded (`İ` and `i`, `I` and `ı`), ends
trimmed (docs/adr/0439 §4); written only as `true`. Numbers are compared by their values.

LookupRelation.description: How a list's object stands to the record's geometry.

oneOf.description: The object holds the record (a building's parcel).
The record holds the object.
They have a point in common (within the tolerance).
The nearest object (within the tolerance, when given); ties by the list's order.

LookupSort.description: A list's order by a field of its layer.

descending.description: The greatest first; written only as `true`.

field.description: The field's key: numbers by value, dates as written, text in natural order; empty ones last.

LookupSpatial.description: The objects of the list a record's geometry takes (docs/adr/0439 §5).

tolerance.description: How far apart still counts, in the drawing's unit; none: 0 (nearest: any distance).

MergePolicy.description: A field's value in the object merged from several (docs/adr/0419).

oneOf.description: The first object's value.
Empty.
The values' sum, exact to the field's last digit: integers and decimals with fraction digits.
The least value (numbers).
The greatest value (numbers).

RelatedView.description: How a related item shows its objects (docs/adr/0425).

oneOf.description: Their names, one a line.
A table of the item's columns, the numbers totalled under them.
A card for each child: its columns' labels and values, as its form names them (docs/adr/0440 §6).

A bar for each value of its first column, as long as the children holding it are many
(docs/adr/0441 §3).

SplitPolicy.description: A field's value in the pieces of a split object (docs/adr/0419).

oneOf.description: Each piece keeps the value.
The pieces' values are emptied.
The pieces take the field's default (none: empty).

The value is shared by the pieces' areas (lines: lengths), the total kept to the field's last
digit: integers and decimals with fraction digits.

from.description: The states it is taken from; empty: any state.

label.description: The button's words, unique in the workflow: “Gönder”, “Onayla”, “Geri gönder”.

reason.description: A text field's key the step writes its reason to; it must be given.

valid.description: The record must be valid by the form (no error) to take it.

commands.title: İş akışı adımı
commands.summary: Kaydı formun iş akışında bir adım ilerletir: adım kaydın durumundan atılabilmeli; verilen değerler formun kurallarıyla yazılır (kilitli durumdaki kayıtta yalnız adımın gerekçesi), durum alanı adımın durumunu alır, kayıt yeniden tamamlanır; adım geçerli kayıt istiyorsa formun hatası olan kayıt, gerekçe istiyorsa boş gerekçe reddedilir. notes: alanların anahtarlarıyla inceleyenin notları, iş akışının not alanına yazılır (notsuz adım onu boşaltır; not alanı olmayan iş akışında ya da formda olmayan alanda form_invalid). Tek geri alma adımı “Form: <adım>”.

input.description:
Input of `cad.forms.transition` v1 (İş akışı adımı, docs/adr/0428): a record taken a step of its form's
workflow, one undo step (“Form: <adım>”): its state field set to the step's state, with the values
given (on a locked record only the step's reason); the form valid when the step asks so, its reason
written when it names one.

Refusals, in this order: `invalid_uid`, `invalid_moment`, `invalid_user`, `invalid_revision`,
`revision_conflict` (status `conflict`), `unknown_form`, `form_unpublished`, `form_preflight`,
`no_workflow`, `entity_not_found`, `form_layer_mismatch`, `layer_locked`, `unknown_step`,
`step_not_allowed`, `record_locked`, `form_invalid`, `reason_required`.

draft.description: Through its draft instead of its latest release.

expectedRevision.description: The document revision the input was prepared against, as decimal text.

moment.description: The moment the rules' `@tarih` and `@simdi` read (as `cad.forms.submit`'s).

notes.description:
Notes on the record's fields by their keys (docs/adr/0442 §4): written to the workflow's notes
field, shown under those fields; a step without them empties it.

step.description: The step's label.

uid.description: The record (lowercase UUID text with hyphens).

values.description: Values by the layer fields' keys written with the step (the reason among them).

Değişiklikler yeni sürümün sırasıyla, kaldırılanlar sonda.

commands.title: Kayıt ekle
commands.summary: Verilen katmana geometrisiz kayıtlar (tablo satırları) ekler; tek geri alma adımıdır. Kayıt çizilmez, seçilmez, kenetlenmez; öznitelikleri, etiketi ve ekleri vardır, Öznitelik tablosunda, formlarda, ilişkilerde ve sorgularda yer alır. Her satırın öznitelikleri katmanın alanlarıyla yazılır: değer tek biçimine çevrilir, kuralı bozan reddedilir, verilmeyen alana varsayılanı yazılır; katmana form uygulanmışsa form da aynı adımda tamamlar. En çok 10000 satır. Kilitli katmana yazılmaz, gizli katmana uyarıyla yazılır. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

RecordRow.description: One record: its attributes and its label.

attrs.description: Its attributes, by the layer's fields: canonical, a field's default where none is given. Absent: none.

label.description: Its label (`EntityBase.label`), shown in the table and the forms. Absent: none.

Input of `cad.records.create` v1: records on a named layer, written as one undo step (“Kayıt ekle”).

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `invalid_count` (`rows`: 1 to 10 000),
`invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict` (status `conflict`), `layer_not_found`, `not_a_layer`,
`layer_locked`, then each row's attributes by the layer's fields (`invalid_attribute`,
`attribute_required`, at `rows.<i>.attrs.<name>`); on the desktop also `slots_exhausted`. Warning:
`layer_hidden` (they are written all the same).

layerId.description: The layer they go on: a layer's id (`LayerNode.id`), not a group's.

rows.description: The records, in order: 1 to 10 000.

revision.description: The document's revision after the write, as decimal text.

breakSize.description: A break's width, times the value's height, over 0; absent: 1 (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK size).

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

commands.title: Kaydı çoğalt
commands.summary: Nesneleri yerlerinde, bütün özellikleri ve ekleriyle yeni kalıcı kimliklerle kopyalar; tek geri alma adımıdır. children açıkken (varsayılan) nesnenin bileşik (cascade) ilişkilerindeki alt kayıtlar da kopyalanır, alanları kopyanın kimliğini alır; alt kaydın kendi bileşik ilişkileri de izlenir, her nesne bir kez kopyalanır. Girdideki bir nesne başka bir girdinin alt kaydıysa yalnız onunla kopyalanır. Katmanın bir formunun tekil tuttuğu alan kopyada boş kalır (unique_cleared). Kilitli katmandaki nesne ve alt kayıt atlanır, uyarıda sayılır; hepsi kilitliyse reddedilir. En çok 1000 nesne. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

input.description:
Input of `cad.records.duplicate` v1: the objects to copy where they are, as one undo step
(“Kaydı çoğalt”).

Refusals, in this order: `no_entities`, `invalid_uid` (`uids[i]`), `invalid_count` (more than
1000), `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict` (status `conflict`), `entity_not_found`
(`uids[i]`), `layer_locked` (every object on a locked layer). Warnings: `layer_locked` (objects and
children on locked layers left out), `unique_cleared` (a field a form keeps unique left empty).

children.description:
The records the objects' composite relations hold are copied too, their field taking the
copy's id; written only as `false`.

expectedRevision.description: The document revision the input was prepared against, as decimal text.

uids.description: The objects' persistent ids; an object given twice is copied once.

commands.summary: Projenin ilişkilerini oluşturur (create), değiştirir (update) ve siler (remove). İlişki: alt katmanın field alanı üst katmanın nesnesinin kalıcı kimliğini tutar; onDelete üst nesne silinince alt kayıtlara ne olacağıdır: unlink (varsayılan, alan boşalır), cascade (alt kayıtlar da silinir), restrict (alt kaydı olan üst nesne silinmez), keep (bağ kalır). Proje ayarıdır, geri alma adımı değildir; silinen ilişkinin bağları kayıtlarda kalır. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

Ana katmanın kaydı birden çok kayıtla eşleşirse birden çok satırdır; satırın kimliği iki kaydın kalıcı kimliğidir (left/right, eşleşmeyende left/), her okuyuşta aynı. Sütunlar kaydın tarafını (left, right) ve alanını söyler; bir hücre cad.entities.set ile o kayda yazılır, yazılamayanın (anahtar, kilitli katman) nedeni sütundadır. report kayıtların nasıl eşleştiğini (eşleşen, eşleşmeyen, anahtarsız, kardinalite 1:1, 1:N, N:1, N:N), totals sayı sütunlarının toplamını (her kayıt bir kez) verir. commands.title: Formla toplu yaz
commands.summary: Aynı değerleri birden çok kayda formla yazar (formun toplu kipi): uids aynı katmandaki nesneler (yinelenen bir kez yazılır), values alan anahtarlarıyla. Her kayıt kendi değerleri ve şekliyle formun kurallarından ve hesaplarından geçer; biri geçmezse hiçbiri yazılmaz (form_invalid: ilk sorunlu kaydın ilk sorunu, path onu veren değer, uids o kayıt). Tekil alana birden çok kayıtta aynı değer yazılamaz. moment ve user cad.forms.submit'teki gibidir. Uyarı denetimi yazmayı durdurmaz (form_check_warning). Tek geri alma adımı: “Form: <ad> (n nesne)”; changed değişen kayıtlar. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

commands.title: Birimi değiştir
commands.summary: Yerel projenin çizim birimini from'dan to'ya değiştirir (mm, cm, m); from çizimin şimdiki birimi olmalıdır. geometry ne olacağını söyler: keep boyları korur, yalnız okuma ve yazma birimi değişir (4000 mm'lik duvar 4 m okunur, hiçbir nesne değişmez); scale sayıları korur, çizim iki birimin oranıyla 0,0'a göre ölçeklenir (4000 mm 4000 m okunur: ×1000; cm'den mm'ye ÷10). scale'de nesnelerin koordinatları, uzunlukları, yarıçapları, kotları, yazı, ölçü, kılavuz ve tablo yükseklikleri ve boyları, paragraf kutusu, eğri boyunca yazının eğrisi, tarama aralığı ve desen ölçeği, resim ve raster çerçeveleri, blok tanımları, ana görünüm ölçeklenir; açılar, oranlar, yerleştirmenin kendi ölçeği, kâğıt üstü boylar ve ölçüler (M) kalır. Nokta bulutlarının noktaları, pafta kitabı ve projenin toleransları değişmez; uyarı söyler. Telde geometri her durumda metredir. Birim ve ölçeklenen çizim tek geri alma adımıdır (“Birimi değiştir”). Koordinat sistemli projenin birimi sistemindir (unit_needs_local); scale'de kilitli katmanda nesne varsa hiçbir şey yazılmaz (layer_locked). expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

UnitGeometry.description: What becomes of the drawing when its unit changes.

oneOf.description:
The sizes stay: only the unit lengths are read and typed in changes
(4000 mm reads 4 m). Nothing of the drawing moves.

The numbers stay: the drawing is scaled by the ratio of the two
units about 0,0 (4000 mm reads 4000 m, a thousand times larger).

input.description:
Input of `cad.units.change` v1: the drawing unit goes from `from` to
`to`, with `geometry` saying what becomes of the drawing, as one undo
step “Birimi değiştir” (the unit and the scaled drawing undone together).

With `scale`, everything the drawing measures in its unit is scaled by
one whole factor (×1000 from mm to m, ÷10 from cm to mm): every object's
coordinates, lengths, radii, elevations, its text, dimension, leader and
table heights and sizes, a paragraph's box, a curved text's curve, a
hatch's spacing and pattern scale, a picture's and a raster's frame; the
block definitions (base point, objects, attribute definitions); the home
view and the drawing's anchor. Angles, ratios, an insert's own scale,
paper sizes and a route's measures stay. A point cloud's points are in
its files and stay (`point_clouds_kept`); the sheet book stays
(`sheets_kept`); the topology tolerance and the networks' tolerances are
the project's precision and stay (`tolerances_kept`).

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `same_unit`
(`from` is `to`), `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict` (status
`conflict`), `unit_needs_local` (the project has a coordinate system:
its unit is the system's), `unit_mismatch` (`from` is not the drawing's
unit, which the message names), `layer_locked` (with `scale`: objects on
a locked layer, whose `uids` the error lists, the first 100).

expectedRevision.description:
The document revision the input was prepared against, as decimal
text. When given and the document is no longer at it, nothing is
written and the answer is `conflict`.

from.description:
The drawing's unit now: said, not assumed, so a script written for
another drawing does not scale this one.

geometry.description: Whether the sizes or the numbers stay.

commands.title: GIS türevini denetle
commands.summary: path'teki, file.export.gis'in yazdığı GeoPackage'ın her satırını açık çizimde kaynağı olan nesneyle karşılaştırır; hiçbir şey yazmaz. Satırın kalıcı kimliği (kentos_uids, yoksa kentos_uid sütunu) çizimdeki nesneyi bulur. Nesnenin türev özeti (kentos_digest: bakışı dışında bütün alanlarının SHA-256'sı, blokta tanımın öznitelikleri de) satırınkinden başkaysa satır stale'dir: kaynak dışa aktarmadan sonra değişti, türev eski. Özet aynıysa satırın geometrisi ve öznitelik sütunları tablonun kaydındaki algoritma ve toleransla yeniden türetilen satırla karşılaştırılır (koordinatlar 1e-9 m içinde); farklıysa satır edited'dır: GIS'te değiştirilmiş, kaynak nesne değişmemiş; hangi alanların (geometry, öznitelik adları) farklı olduğu fields'tadır. Kimliği çizimde olmayan satır source_gone, tablonun katmanında olup satırı olmayan nesne not_exported'tur. Bir tablonun kaydındaki sapma kaydındaki toleransın üstündeyse over_tolerance sayılır. Cevap her tablonun sayılarını, toplamları, dosyanın kaydettiği kaynağı (proje, ad, sürüm) ve eşleşmeyen satırlar önce olmak üzere en çok limit satırı listeler. Türev, kaynağın yerine geçmez: stale ve edited satırlar çizimi değiştirmez ve GIS'teki değişiklik çizime geri yazılmaz.

commands.title: Kaynakları tanı
commands.summary: path verilirse o GeoPackage'ın obje ve öznitelik tablolarını söyler: satır sayısı, geometri türü, bildirdiği EPSG, sütunlar (dosyadaki bildirimi ve alan türü) ve neler yapılabildiği (okuma, ekleme, güncelleme, silme, tek işlem, Z, M, eğri). path verilmezse projenin bağlı katmanlarını söyler: bağ, dosya yerinde mi (found), dosya katman onunla son eşleştiğinden beri değişti mi (changed), katman değişti mi (edited) ve katmanın tablodan farkı: tabloda olmayan (added), ikisinde olup farklı (modified) ve katmanda olmayan (removed) nesne sayıları. Nesne ile satır kalıcı kimlikle eşlenir, satır olarak karşılaştırılır (koordinatlar 0,001 mm içinde). Hiçbir şey yazmaz. path bir PostGIS adresiyse (postgresql://kullanıcı@sunucu:5432/veritabanı; parolasız: invalid_address) veritabanının tek tam sayı anahtarlı tablolarını şema.tablo adlarıyla söyler; ulaşılamayan veritabanı source_unreachable, bağlı katmanında found false.

input.description:
Input of `cad.sources.describe` v1: a file's or a PostGIS database's tables (`path`), or the project's bound layers'
state (none). Refusals: `invalid_file_path`, `file_not_found`, `import_unreadable`, `invalid_address`,
`source_unreachable` (docs/adr/0505).

LabelPin.description:
A label moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (an object's
`labelPins`, docs/adr/0212 §3.7).

at.description: Where the label's middle is from the object's anchor, metres; absent, the engine places it.

class.description: The class's name; absent, the object's first label.

rotation.description: Degrees counter-clockwise from east; only with `at`.

oneOf.description: A date and a time of day, local (docs/adr/0412 §1): `YYYY-AA-GGTSS:DD:SS`.
A time of day (docs/adr/0412 §1): `SS:DD:SS`.

ParkedPin.description: The pins of a row outside the part (docs/adr/0578 §3).

key.description: The key's value of the row when the link has a key and the row had a value.

pins.description: The pins, as the object held them.

uid.description: The object's lasting id (the row's).

SourceCapabilities.description: What a source can do (docs/adr/0503 §1): each told apart, so a refusal says which.

transaction.description: Every write of a sync in one transaction.

SourceColumn.description: A column of a table and the field kind it reads as; none for one that is not read (a blob).

oneOf.description: A PostGIS table (docs/adr/0505): `path` is the database's address without a password.

SourceLink.description: A layer bound to a table of a file.

digest.description:
The layer's digest when it last matched the file (64 hex digits: the SHA-256 of its objects' kinds, geometries
and attributes by lasting id, `kentos_native_application::sources::layer_digest`): a reload compares with it to
tell the layer's own edits from the file's.

extent.description:
The area the working copy holds (minimum east, north, maximum east, north, in the project's system; docs/adr/0510):
only the table's rows whose box meets it are read, and a write leaves the rows outside as they are. None: the
whole table.

id.description: Its own id, `kaynak-N`.

key.description:
The attribute that names a row the same whatever its place in the table (docs/adr/0533 §1): its value is unique
among the rows and not empty. A reload follows a label pin to the row of the same value when the table was
written again with other row ids, and says the pins whose row is gone. None: a row is its row id, the rule
of every bound layer before.

layer.description: The drawing's layer that is its working copy.

parked.description:
The label pins of objects that left the part (docs/adr/0578 §3): the object's row is in the table but outside
`extent` (it was moved out, or the part was narrowed), so the layer holds no object for its pins. They are kept
here with the row's lasting id and its key's value, not drawn, and go back to the object when the row comes
into the part again; a row gone from the table takes its parked pins with it.

path.description: The file, an absolute path.

relative.description:
The file's path from the project file's folder, `/` between its parts (docs/adr/0506): written on saving when
the file lies on the same disk, so a project moved with its data (or packed with Paketle) finds it again; read
only when `path` is not there and the file it names has the same content. A database has none.

revision.description: The SHA-256 (64 hex digits) of the file when the layer last matched it: what a write or a reload compares with.

srid.description: The EPSG code the table declares, none for an undefined system.

table.description: The table in it.

writable.description: Whether the table can be written: a feature or attribute table of a file KentOS may write.

SourceNext.description: What a bound layer's state asks for next (docs/adr/0543): the one way out a user and a script take from it.

oneOf.description: The layer and the table hold the same.
Only the layer changed: `cad.sources.sync` with `write`.
Only the file changed (or it differs without either side's mark): `cad.sources.sync` with `read`.
Both changed: `cad.sources.reconcile`.

The file, its table or the database is not reached: `cad.sources.edit` `relink` (a file), the address again (a
database).

SourceRelation.description: A relation of a file's table (a row of `gpkgext_relations`).

base.description: The base table (for KentOS's: the child, which holds the references).

name.description: The relation's name as the file writes it (`kentos_references`, `media`, …).

related.description: The related table (for KentOS's: the parent).

rows.description: How many rows the mapping table holds.

why.description: Why a broken relation is (none otherwise).

SourceRelationKind.description: How a relation of a file is held (docs/adr/0532 §2).

oneOf.description: KentOS's representation (`kentos_references`): a mapping table of base and related rows.
A well-formed relation of another kind: read and listed, never rewritten.
A relation whose mapping table or tables are not as the profile says; `why` says how.

SourceState.description:
A bound layer's state: whether its file is there, whether the file changed since the layer last matched it, and
how the layer differs from it now (objects the layer has and the table lacks, both have but differ, the table has
and the layer lacks); how much of the table the layer holds and what to do next.

changed.description: The file changed since the layer last matched it.

edited.description: The layer changed since it last matched the file.

objects.description: The layer's objects, of any kind.

rows.description:
The table's rows the working copy covers (a part's: those whose box meets its area; docs/adr/0510) and the
layer can hold; none when the table is not reached.

total.description: The whole table's rows; none when the table is not reached.

extent.description:
The box the source declares for the table, in the table's system: min x, min y, max x, max y (docs/adr/0599
§2). A GeoPackage's `gpkg_contents`, PostGIS's `ST_EstimatedExtent`; declared, not counted, and none when
the source declares none.

geometry.description: The geometry column's type, none for an attribute table.

relations.description:
The relations of the file this table is a side of (GeoPackage related tables, docs/adr/0532 §2), each with
whether KentOS reads and writes its representation.

Vec2.description: A point in world units: x = east (Y, sağa), y = north (X, yukarı).

commands.title: Kaynağa bağla
commands.summary: Bir katmanı bir GeoPackage tablosunun çalışma kopyası yapar ya da bağı değiştirir. link: layer verilmezse tablonun satırları yeni bir katmana alınır (file.import.gpkg gibi, tek geri alma adımı; boş tablo boş katman); layer verilirse o katman tablonun nesnelerini olduğu gibi taşımalıdır (source_differs). Başka sistemdeki tablo yalnız reproject ile bağlanır (yoksa crs_mismatch): katmanın nesneleri projenin sisteminde, tablonunkiler kendi sisteminde kalır; eşitleme her seferinde çevirir, yazma tablonun sistemine geri çevirerek yazar, yaylı nesneler kesin çevrilemediği için bağlanmaz ve tabloda dokunulmadan kalır. Bağ dosyanın SHA-256'sını ve katmanın özetini tutar; projenin ayarıdır (.kcad şema 74), geri alma adımı değildir. extent [minX, minY, maxX, maxY] (projenin sisteminde) yeni katmana bağlamada yalnız kutusu o alana değen satırları alır: büyük tablonun bir parçasının çalışma kopyası; eşitleme alanın dışındaki satırları silinmiş saymaz, alanın dışına taşınan nesne kendi satırına yazılır; ters alan, var olan katman, geometrisiz tablo ve veritabanı invalid_extent. unlink bağı çözer, nesneler kalır. relink taşınan dosyanın yeni yerini verir; dosya aynı (aynı SHA-256) olmalıdır (source_changed). Bir tablo ve bir katman tek bağa (source_bound), en çok 1000 bağ. path bir PostGIS adresi de olabilir (postgresql://kullanıcı@sunucu:5432/veritabanı, table şema.tablo): parola adrese yazılmaz (invalid_address), PGPASSWORD ya da ~/.pgpass'tan okunur; tablo tek tam sayı birincil anahtarlı olmalıdır; ulaşılamayan veritabanı source_unreachable.

SourcesEditOp.description: An edit of the project's bound layers.

oneOf.description:
Binds a table: onto a new layer with its rows (one undo step, as `file.import.gpkg` takes it), or onto the
`layer` given, which must hold the table's objects as they are. A table in another coordinate system is bound
only with `reproject` (docs/adr/0504): the layer holds its objects in the project's system, the table keeps
its own, and every sync moves them across.

extent.description:
Onto a new layer from a file, only the rows whose box meets this area (minimum east, north, maximum east,
north, in the project's system; docs/adr/0510): the working copy of a part of a large table.

key.description:
The attribute that names a row whatever its place in the table (docs/adr/0533 §1): unique and not empty
among the rows taken in.

oneOf.description:
Sets or clears (`key` absent) a bound layer's key (docs/adr/0533 §1): the layer's objects must hold the
attribute with a value each, no two alike. Nothing else changes; the next reload follows the pins by it.

Changes the area a part's working copy holds (docs/adr/0533 §2), or takes the whole table (`extent`
absent): the table is read again in the new area as one undo step, the rows that left it removed from
the layer and the ones that came in added. The layer must match its table (no pending changes); the pins
of an object that left the area are said. Undoing brings the objects back; the binding's area, like any
setting, is not an undo step.
Unbinds a layer; its objects stay.
The file moved: binds the layer to the file at `path`, which must be the same file (the revision's).

input.description:
Input of `cad.sources.edit` v1. Refusals: `invalid_file_path`, `file_not_found`, `import_unreadable`,
`table_not_found`, `layer_not_found`, `not_a_layer`, `layer_locked`, `crs_mismatch`, `source_bound` (the layer or
the table is bound already), `source_differs` (the layer given does not hold the table's objects),
`source_not_found` (an id), `source_changed` (relink to another file), `too_many_sources`, `invalid_extent` (an area
that is not one, on a table without geometry, onto a layer given, or of a database), `invalid_key` (a key that is
not a column of the objects, is empty on one or repeats); conflicts: `pending_changes` (an area changed over the
layer's own edits). Warnings: `label_pins_lost`, `label_pins_moved`, `label_pins_parked`,
`label_pins_restored` (an area change that took objects with label pins out of the layer, or brought them in).

commands.summary: Bir katmanın nesnelerine öznitelik değerlerini tek geri alma adımında yazar. calculate (Alan hesapla): expression'ın (İfadeyle seç'in dili; geometri değerleri projenin çizim biriminde, $sıra nesnelerin sırası) her nesnedeki değeri field'a; uids boşsa katmanın bütün nesneleri; boş sonuçta değer kalır (empty: keep) ya da kalkar (clear). values (Yapıştır): her satırın değerleri kendi nesnesine, null değeri kaldırır. Her değer cad.entities.set'in kurallarıyla denetlenir: alanın türü ve kuralları (kanonik metne çevrilir), zorunlu alan, alt türler, değer bileşimleri, kayıt kuralları, tekil alanlar (yazılanlar birlikte). Alanı olan katmanda alanların adlarıyla yazılır (field_not_found). policy all (varsayılan): uymayan bir değer bütün yazmayı reddeder (invalid_values); policy valid: uyanlar yazılır, öbürleri values_skipped ile söylenir. Bir değeri gösteren etiket yeni değeri gösterir. plan yazmadan değişecekleri (nesne, alan, eski ve yeni değer; ilk 200) ve sorunları (nesne, alan, değer, kod, ileti) sayılarıyla verir; policy all'da da reddetmez, sorunları listeler. Adım “Alan hesapla: alan” ya da “Yapıştır”.

commands.title: İşlem aracını çalıştır
commands.summary: İşlemler'in bir aracını açık değerlerle çalıştırır; masaüstünün İşlemler penceresinin çalıştırıcısı, tek geri alma adımı (adı aracın adı). Verilmeyen parametre bu çizimdeki varsayılanını alır. Nesne girdisi { scope: all } (görünen katmanlar), { scope: layer, layerId }, { scope: uids, uids }, { scope: selection } (girdinin selection'ının adlandırdığı nesneler) ya da { scope: visible } (view kutusundakiler), isteğe bağlı kinds ile; nesne girdisinin varsayılanı seçimdir. Dosya parametresi { path } (tablo dosyası pencerenin okuduğu gibi okunur) ya da { name, rows }. Ekranın seçimi ve görünümü okunmaz: yalnız girdinin selection'ı ve view'u. Retler sırayla: tools_unavailable, unknown_tool, invalid_uid, entity_not_found, invalid_parameters (aracın olmayan parametresi, kuralına uymayan değer, okunmayan dosya, view'suz görünen alan; parametresiyle), tool_failed (araç çalıştı ve durdu: kilitli katman, girdi yok, aracın kendi reddi; çizim değişmez). Cevap aracın özeti, eklediği ve değiştirdiği nesneler (kalıcı kimlikleriyle), seçtikleri, açtığı katmanlar, çıktıları (nesne çıktıları kalıcı kimliklerle, sayılar, metinler, tablolar), notları ve adımın adı. plan aracı çizimin bir kopyasında çalıştırır: aynı algoritmayla ne yazılacağını söyler, yeni nesnelerin kimlikleri kopyanındır. Raster araçları başsız ortamda rasterin bağlı ya da gömülü GeoTIFF ve PNG dosyasını okur, sonucu COG olarak yazar; adresteki raster, JPEG, NetCDF ve nokta bulutu dosyaları yalnız masaüstünde, başsız ortamda tool_failed. sink { path, overwrite } sonucu çizim yerine yeni bir GeoPackage'a yazar: araç kopyada çalışır, yaptığı nesnelerin katmanları birer tablo (adı katmanın adı, alanları sütun, kimlikler kentos_uids'te), çizim değişmez; dosya geçici adla yazılıp tek adımla yerine konur, var olan dosya yalnız overwrite ile değişir; retler invalid_file_path, file_exists, file_unwritable, nothing_to_export, GeoPackage'ın tutmadığı nesneler export_losses; cevabın sink'i yolu, boyu, SHA-256'sı ve tabloları, inputs'u okunan katmanlar, içeriklerinin özeti ve bağlı katmanların kaynak sürümleri; her tablo soyunu GeoPackage'ın metadata uzantısında taşır (https://kentos.app/lineage/1: araç, istek, girdiler ve özetleri, motor, zaman). sink.mode: new (varsayılan: yeni dosya), addTables (var olan GeoPackage'a tablo ekler; aynı adlı tablo table_exists ile reddedilir, dosyanın başka tablosuna dokunulmaz) ya da replaceTables (aynı adlı nesne ya da öznitelik tablosunu yenisiyle değiştirir; başka tabloya dokunulmaz); mode new dışında dosya var olmalı (file_not_found), GeoPackage olarak okunmalı (import_unreadable), çizimin koordinat sistemini taşımalı (crs_mismatch), overwrite verilmez (invalid_input). Tablolar tek SQLite işleminde, beş bin satırlık parçalarla yazılır; hata ya da durdurma (iş olarak çalışırken) dosyayı olduğu gibi bırakır. sink.tables aracın tablo çıktılarını (özet, rapor) da birer öznitelik tablosu olarak yazar: adı çıktının etiketi, sütunları başlıkları (metin; hücreler aracın gösterdiği yazı), sinkReport'ta output adıyla görünür; yalnız tablo üreten araç yalnız onu yazar. Cevabın sinkReport'u kipi, her tablonun satırlarını, geometri türünü, Z ve M'ini, sütunlarının öznitelikleriyle eşlemesini, dosyanın dokunulmayan tablolarını ve parça sayısını söyler; satırların kalıcı kimlikleri kentos_uids tablosundadır. tool “model:” ve modelin kimliği de olabilir (model:builtin.parcelSheet; cad.processing.tools'un models'i listeler): modelin girdileri parametreleridir, adımları sırayla çalışır, hepsi tek geri alma adımıdır (adı modelin adı); bir adım çalışmazsa önceki adımların sonuçları geri alınır, hiçbir şey yazılmaz. Cevabın record'u koşunun kaydıdır (kentos.run-record 1): araç ya da model ve sürümü, aldığı değerler (varsayılanlar doldurulmuş, nesneler kalıcı kimliklerle: aynen verilince aynı işi yeniden çalıştırır), girdi katmanları ve içerik özetleri, çizimin sürümü, projenin koordinat sistemi, varsa tohum, motor ve ev sahibi, başlangıç zamanı ve süresi, her adımın girdi ve çıktı kayıt sayısı ve süresi, kesin toplam. Kayıt proje dosyasına yazılmaz (yazılsa kendisi bir düzenleme olurdu, çizimin sürümünü oynatırdı); requestId verilen çağrının cevabı, kaydıyla, proje dosyasının istek defterinde kalır (256 istek, her cevap 64 KB'a kadar) ve sink'e yazılan her tablo kaydı soyunun run alanında taşır. İş olarak çalışırken durdurma aracın kendi soru noktalarında da duyulur (iptal: çizim ve dosya olduğu gibi); aracın kendisi sormuyorsa araç bitince duyulur.

RunSink.description:
A run's result written to a GeoPackage or a PostGIS database instead of the drawing (docs/adr/0508 §4, 0549, 0592
§2): the tool runs on a copy,
the objects it made are written, each layer they are on a table (the layer's name, its fields as columns), and the
drawing does not change. A new file is written whole or not at all (one that is there is replaced only with
`overwrite`, and the old file stays until the new one is complete); into a file that is there the tables go in one
transaction, a batch of rows at a time, and a run that fails or is stopped leaves the file as it was.

mode.description: New file (the default), tables added to a file that is there, or tables added and same-named ones replaced.

path.description:
The GeoPackage's path (`.gpkg`), or a PostGIS database's address (`postgresql://…`, without a password; the
tables go in `schema`, docs/adr/0592 §2).

schema.description: The database schema the tables go in (`public` when none); a GeoPackage has none.

tables.description:
Also write the tool's table outputs (a summary, a report) as attribute tables, each named by its output's
label, beside the layers' tables (docs/adr/0551 §3). A tool whose result is only a table writes only that.

SinkMode.description: What a sink does with the file at its path (docs/adr/0508 §4, 0549 §1).

oneOf.description: A new file: one that is there is replaced only with `overwrite`.

The tables are added to a GeoPackage that is there; a table of the same name is refused (`table_exists`), no
table of the file is touched.

As `addTables`, but a feature or attribute table of the same name is replaced by the new one; no other table
of the file is touched.

input.description:
Input of `cad.processing.run` v1: the tool (its id) and the values of its parameters; a parameter not given takes
its default for the drawing. A features input is `{ "scope": "all" }` (the visible layers), `{ "scope": "layer",
"layerId": … }`, `{ "scope": "uids", "uids": [ … ] }`, `{ "scope": "selection" }` (the objects `selection` names)
or `{ "scope": "visible" }` (those in `view`), optionally with `kinds`, or `{ "scope": "source", "layer": … }` (a
bound layer's whole table, not the part the drawing holds) or `{ "scope": "source", "path": …, "table": … }` (a
GeoPackage's or a PostGIS database's table), each optionally with `filter` (an expression, its part the source can
check sent to it) and `bbox`: the records are read a part at a time and the run is made on a copy, so a source input
needs a `sink` (docs/adr/0592 §1); a features input's default is the
selection, so a run on chosen objects gives `selection`. A file parameter is `{ "path": … }` (a table file read
as the dialog reads it) or `{ "name": …, "rows": [[…]] }`. Refusals, in order: `tools_unavailable`,
`unknown_tool`, `invalid_uid`, `entity_not_found`, `invalid_parameters` (each named: a parameter the tool has
not, a value its rules refuse, a file unread, the visible scope without `view`, a source input without `sink`),
for a source input `layer_not_found`, `invalid_input` (the layer is not bound), `invalid_address`, `file_not_found`,
`import_unreadable`, `table_not_found`, `source_unreachable`, `invalid_expression`, `input_too_large` (more than
1 000 000 records), `crs_mismatch`; `tool_failed` (it ran and stopped: a locked layer, nothing to do, its own
refusal; nothing written). A bound layer read by its loaded part (`scope: layer`) is said (`partial_scope`).

drawing.description:
The open drawing's own file, an absolute path, when it has one: a raster's relative path is found from its
folder (then in the project's search paths), a result written beside it. The host gives it.

selection.description: The objects the run takes as chosen (persistent ids, in order): a features input's `selection` scope.

sink.description: Where the result goes instead of the drawing (docs/adr/0508 §4): a new GeoPackage.

view.description: The box taken as on screen (minimum east, north, maximum east, north): a features input's `visible` scope.

input.title: ProcessingRun

GpkgExported.description: What `file.export.gpkg` wrote, or with `plan` would write.

approximated.description: Curves (ellipses, splines, NURBS) written as chords within 0.1 mm.

left.description: Objects not written, by kind.

geometry.description: Its geometry column's type (`MULTIPOLYGON` …); none for an attribute table.

ProcessingRecord.description:
The record of a run (docs/adr/0529 §2), made when it ends and handed back with its answer: what ran (tool or model
and its version), with which explicit values and objects, on which state of the data (the revision, each input
layer's content digest, the project's CRS), the seed where a tool has one, the engine and the host, and what
flowed through each step and how long it took. It is not kept in the project file: a script keeps it as JSON
(`kentos.run-record` 1) and `kentos_processing::record::rerun_kind` says whether running it again meets the same
revision, the same data under another revision, or changed data.

definition.description: A model's definition as the SHA-256 of its JSON (the steps, their wiring and fixed values); none for a tool.

documentRevision.description: The drawing's revision when the run began.

failed.description: A batch run with `onError: continue`: the rows that stopped and were taken back, in order (docs/adr/0551 §1).

format.description: Always `kentos.run-record`.

grids.description:
The rasters a raster tool read and wrote, each with its grid (docs/adr/0535): the run again on the same
grids gives the same cells.

host.description: Where it ran: `desktop` or `headless` (Python, MCP, the agent's connection).

inputs.description: The layers the features inputs read, each with its content digest when it was read (docs/adr/0511).

kind.description: `tool`, `model` or `batch`.

ms.description: How long the whole took, milliseconds.

parameters.description:
The values the run took, defaults filled in, with objects as persistent ids (`scope: uids`) and a file as its
name and path, not its rows: giving them to `cad.processing.run` runs it again.

seed.description: The seed a tool with one took (its `seed` parameter).

sink.description:
Where the result was written, when it went to a file or a database (docs/adr/0593 §3): the place, its tables
and their rows, the file's size and SHA-256 after the write. Changing the file afterwards changes nothing here.

srid.description: The project's coordinate system (EPSG/SRID); none for a local project.

steps.description: The tool as one step, a model's steps in order, a batch's rows in order.

tool.description: The tool's id, the model's (`model:…`), or a batch's tool.

toolVersion.description:
The tool's version: bumped when what it computes from the same values changes (1 for every tool today); a
model's, the version of the tool-and-model contract.

total.description: What flowed through the whole, counted when it ended.

RecordFailure.description: A row of a batch that stopped and was taken back (docs/adr/0551 §1): which row, why.

code.description: The refusal's code (`tool_failed`, `invalid_parameters`, …) and its message.

id.description: `rows[i]`.

RecordGrid.description:
A raster a run read or wrote and its grid (docs/adr/0535): where its cells lie, their size and how many, the
band read, what counts as empty, the system; a source's `window` the cells the run worked out (an area's).

affine.description: `[x₀, a, b, y₀, c, d]`, GDAL's geotransform order: the cell (i, j)'s corner at x₀ + a·i + b·j, y₀ + c·i + d·j.

band.description: The band read (1 and up); none for a result.

file.description: The raster's file (its path as the object names it), or none for one embedded.

nodata.description: The value taken as empty; none: NaN only (or the file's own for a source read with its own).

srid.description: The raster's EPSG/SRID; none when it has none.

window.description: A source's cells worked out: first column, first row, columns, rows.

RecordSink.description: Where a run's result was written (docs/adr/0593 §3).

bytes.description: The file's size and SHA-256 once written; none for a database.

path.description: The GeoPackage's path, or the database's address (without a password).

schema.description: The database's schema; none for a file.

RecordSinkTable.description: A table a run wrote: its name, the layer or the output it holds, the batch row that made it, its rows.

of.description: The layer's id, or the table output's name.

row.description: The batch row that made it (`rows[i]`); none for a run's.

id.description: A model step's id, a batch row's `rows[i]`, a tool's own id.

label.description: A step's name (“1. adım (Köşe noktalarını numarala)”), a row's label.

recordsIn.description:
The objects its features inputs resolved to, and the distinct objects it made, changed or chose; counted when
the step ended, so exact.

RecordTotal.description:
What flowed through a run in all, counted when it ended (docs/adr/0529 §2): `records_in` adds the steps' (an object
several steps read counts once for each), `records_out` counts the distinct objects the run made, changed or chose.
The steps' own counts are exact too; a tool that reports only approximate progress while it runs
(`Feedback::progress`) has this last, exact total.

RunInput.description: A layer the run read: a bound layer gives its source and the revision it read (docs/adr/0503).

digest.description:
The layer's content when it was read: the SHA-256 of its objects' kinds, geometries and attributes by lasting id
(`sources::layer_digest`; docs/adr/0511), so a result tells which state of its input it came from.

path.description:
The file or the database address (without a password) it was read from (docs/adr/0593 §3): what running it
again reads, and where `revision`'s SHA-256 is compared.

table.description:
For an input read from its source (`scope: source`, docs/adr/0592 §1): the table (`path › table`, or the
bound layer's) and how many of its records were read.

SinkColumn.description: A column of a sink's table and the attribute it holds.

column.description:
The column's name; it differs from the attribute's when the name had to change (a column of the same name in
another case, `fid`, `geom`).

SinkDimension.description: Whether a geometry column holds Z (or M) in the rows of a sink's table.

oneOf.description: No row has it.
Every row has it.
Some rows have it, others do not (the column allows it).

SinkMode.description: What a sink does with the file at its path (docs/adr/0508 §4, 0549 §1).

oneOf.description: A new file: one that is there is replaced only with `overwrite`.

The tables are added to a GeoPackage that is there; a table of the same name is refused (`table_exists`), no
table of the file is touched.

As `addTables`, but a feature or attribute table of the same name is replaced by the new one; no other table
of the file is touched.

SinkReport.description:
What a sink did and how, in the answer (docs/adr/0549 §4): the policy of the write made visible. What was left out
or written as chords is in the answer's `sink` and its `export_losses` warning.

batches.description: The batches the rows went in, and how many rows a batch holds at most.

ids.description: The table of the file that keeps each row's lasting id (`kentos_uids`: the table, the row's fid, the id).

untouched.description: The tables the file already had that the write did not touch (a new file has none).

SinkTable.description: One table of a sink: what it holds and how it was made.

columns.description: The columns in order, each with its attribute.

geometry.description: The geometry column's type; none for a table of records.

layer.description: The layer of the copy the rows are the objects of; none for a table output.

output.description: The tool's output a table holds (`sink.tables`); none for a layer's table.

replaced.description: A table of the file taken out and written again (`replaceTables`).

ToolNote.description: A note the tool made while it ran.

output.description: What `cad.processing.run` did, or with `plan` would do (on a copy of the drawing).

added.description: The objects it made and changed (persistent ids).

inputs.description: The layers the features inputs read, in the inputs' order.

notes.description: Its notes (what resolving left out, what it skipped).

outputs.description: Its outputs by name (a features output as persistent ids, a number, a text, a table as its rows).

record.description: What the run was made of and how it went (docs/adr/0529 §2): the same record a script keeps to run it again.

selected.description: The objects it chose (a selecting tool's result; persistent ids).

sink.description: The GeoPackage the result went to (or with `plan` would go to), when the input gave a sink.

sinkReport.description: How the sink wrote it: mode, tables with their columns, Z and M, what the file kept (docs/adr/0549 §4).

step.description: The undo step's name; none when the drawing did not change.

summary.description: The tool's sentence of what it did.

output.title: ProcessingRan

GpkgExported.description: What `file.export.gpkg` wrote, or with `plan` would write.

approximated.description: Curves (ellipses, splines, NURBS) written as chords within 0.1 mm.

left.description: Objects not written, by kind.

geometry.description: Its geometry column's type (`MULTIPOLYGON` …); none for an attribute table.

ProcessingRecord.description:
The record of a run (docs/adr/0529 §2), made when it ends and handed back with its answer: what ran (tool or model

commands.summary: İşlemler'in bir aracını ya da modelini (tool, model: kimliğiyle) bir parametre tablosunun satırlarıyla sırayla çalıştırır: her satır cad.processing.run'ın aynı aracı, aynı çalıştırıcısı, aynı retleriyle koşar; parameters bütün satırların ortak değerleridir, rows[i].parameters satırın kendi değerleri onların üstüne gelir (örnek: aynı araç birkaç girdi katmanına ya da birkaç tampon uzaklığına); selection ve view her satıra aynen verilir. Satırlar sırayla çalışır, her biri kendinden öncekilerin yazdığını görür. Bütün toplu iş tek geri alma adımıdır (adı “Toplu: <araç>”) ve varsayılan onError: stop ile ya hep ya hiç yazılır: bir satır çalışıp dururlarsa ya da durdurulursa (iş olarak çalışırken: satırlar arasında ve çalışan aracın içinde) önceki satırların sonuçları geri alınır, hiçbir şey yazılmaz. onError: continue ile çalışırken duran satır tek başına geri alınır (modelin önceki adımlarını da), öteki satırlar yazılır, yine tek adımda; duran satırlar cevabın failed listesinde (index, label, code, message) ve kaydın failed'ında, batch_rows_failed uyarısıyla söylenir; bütün satırlar durursa hiçbir şey yazılmaz, adım yoktur. Durdurma (iptal) hiçbir kipte satır hatası değildir: bütün toplu iş geri alınır. En çok 500 satır. Retler sırayla: tools_unavailable, empty_batch, too_many_rows, sonra her satır için cad.processing.run'ın retleri (unknown_tool, invalid_uid, entity_not_found, invalid_parameters), yolu rows[i]. ile başlar; çalışırken batch_row_failed (onError: stop: satır çalıştı ve durdu ya da değerleri önceki satırların yazdıklarına artık uymuyor; ileti satırı söyler); çalıştırmadan önceki retler onError: continue ile de ret kalır. Cevap her satırın cad.processing.run cevabı (kendi kaydıyla), toplu işin özeti ve kaydı (kind batch, adımları satırlar) ve adımın adıdır. plan aynısını çizimin okuma kopyasında çalıştırır, çizim değişmez; sink bu komutta yoktur.

BatchOnError.description: What a batch does when a row stops at run time (docs/adr/0551 §1).

oneOf.description: The whole batch is taken back and nothing is written (`batch_row_failed`).

A run's result written to a GeoPackage or a PostGIS database instead of the drawing (docs/adr/0508 §4, 0549, 0592
§2): the tool runs on a copy,
the objects it made are written, each layer they are on a table (the layer's name, its fields as columns), and the
drawing does not change. A new file is written whole or not at all (one that is there is replaced only with
`overwrite`, and the old file stays until the new one is complete); into a file that is there the tables go in one
transaction, a batch of rows at a time, and a run that fails or is stopped leaves the file as it was.

path.description:

tables go in `schema`, docs/adr/0592 §2).

schema.description: The database schema the tables go in (`public` when none); a GeoPackage has none.

tables.description:
Also write the tool's table outputs (a summary, a report) as attribute tables, each named by its output's
label, beside the layers' tables (docs/adr/0551 §3). A tool whose result is only a table writes only that.

of the file is touched.

input.description:
Input of `cad.processing.batch` v1: one tool (or model, `model:…`) run over a table of rows of parameter values,
through the same descriptor and executor as `cad.processing.run`: each row is the run `tool` with `parameters`
and the row's own values over them, with the input's `selection` and `view`. The rows run in order, each seeing
what the rows before it wrote; the whole batch is one undo step named “Toplu: <tool>”, written all or not at all:
a row that stops (or a stop asked between rows) takes back what the earlier rows did. At most 500 rows. Refusals,
in order: `tools_unavailable`, `empty_batch`, `too_many_rows`, then each row's as `cad.processing.run` refuses
them (`unknown_tool`, `invalid_uid`, `entity_not_found`, `invalid_parameters`), the path prefixed `rows[i].`; at run
time `batch_row_failed` (the row ran and stopped, or its values no longer fit what the rows before it wrote:
nothing written).

As `cad.processing.run`'s: the open drawing's own file, an absolute path, when it has one: a raster's relative path is found from its
folder (then in the project's search paths), a result written beside it. The host gives it.

onError.description:
What happens when a row stops at run time: `stop` (the default) takes the whole batch back, `continue` takes
back only that row, writes the others and reports it in `failed` (docs/adr/0551 §1).

parameters.description: The values every row takes unless it gives its own.

sink.description:

one after another on a copy of the drawing and what they made is written in one write, a table for each layer
a row made. A row's or the batch's input read from its source (`scope: source`) needs it.

name and path, not its rows: giving them to `cad.processing.run` runs it again.

seed.description: The seed a tool with one took (its `seed` parameter).

sink.description:
Where the result was written, when it went to a file or a database (docs/adr/0593 §3): the place, its tables
and their rows, the file's size and SHA-256 after the write. Changing the file afterwards changes nothing here.

srid.description: The project's coordinate system (EPSG/SRID); none for a local project.

steps.description: The tool as one step, a model's steps in order, a batch's rows in order.

tool.description: The tool's id, the model's (`model:…`), or a batch's tool.

toolVersion.description:
The tool's version: bumped when what it computes from the same values changes (1 for every tool today); a
model's, the version of the tool-and-model contract.

total.description: What flowed through the whole, counted when it ended.

RecordFailure.description: A row of a batch that stopped and was taken back (docs/adr/0551 §1): which row, why.

code.description: The refusal's code (`tool_failed`, `invalid_parameters`, …) and its message.

id.description: `rows[i]`.

RecordGrid.description:
A raster a run read or wrote and its grid (docs/adr/0535): where its cells lie, their size and how many, the
band read, what counts as empty, the system; a source's `window` the cells the run worked out (an area's).

affine.description: `[x₀, a, b, y₀, c, d]`, GDAL's geotransform order: the cell (i, j)'s corner at x₀ + a·i + b·j, y₀ + c·i + d·j.

band.description: The band read (1 and up); none for a result.

file.description: The raster's file (its path as the object names it), or none for one embedded.

nodata.description: The value taken as empty; none: NaN only (or the file's own for a source read with its own).

srid.description: The raster's EPSG/SRID; none when it has none.

window.description: A source's cells worked out: first column, first row, columns, rows.

RecordSink.description: Where a run's result was written (docs/adr/0593 §3).

bytes.description: The file's size and SHA-256 once written; none for a database.

path.description: The GeoPackage's path, or the database's address (without a password).

schema.description: The database's schema; none for a file.

RecordSinkTable.description: A table a run wrote: its name, the layer or the output it holds, the batch row that made it, its rows.

of.description: The layer's id, or the table output's name.

row.description: The batch row that made it (`rows[i]`); none for a run's.

id.description: A model step's id, a batch row's `rows[i]`, a tool's own id.

label.description: A step's name (“1. adım (Köşe noktalarını numarala)”), a row's label.

recordsIn.description:
The objects its features inputs resolved to, and the distinct objects it made, changed or chose; counted when
the step ended, so exact.

RecordTotal.description:
What flowed through a run in all, counted when it ended (docs/adr/0529 §2): `records_in` adds the steps' (an object
several steps read counts once for each), `records_out` counts the distinct objects the run made, changed or chose.
The steps' own counts are exact too; a tool that reports only approximate progress while it runs
(`Feedback::progress`) has this last, exact total.

digest.description:
The layer's content when it was read: the SHA-256 of its objects' kinds, geometries and attributes by lasting id
(`sources::layer_digest`; docs/adr/0511), so a result tells which state of its input it came from.

path.description:
The file or the database address (without a password) it was read from (docs/adr/0593 §3): what running it
again reads, and where `revision`'s SHA-256 is compared.

table.description:
For an input read from its source (`scope: source`, docs/adr/0592 §1): the table (`path › table`, or the
bound layer's) and how many of its records were read.

column.description:
The column's name; it differs from the attribute's when the name had to change (a column of the same name in
another case, `fid`, `geom`).

SinkDimension.description: Whether a geometry column holds Z (or M) in the rows of a sink's table.

oneOf.description: No row has it.

Some rows have it, others do not (the column allows it).

SinkMode.description: What a sink does with the file at its path (docs/adr/0508 §4, 0549 §1).

oneOf.description: A new file: one that is there is replaced only with `overwrite`.

As `addTables`, but a feature or attribute table of the same name is replaced by the new one; no other table

batches.description: The batches the rows went in, and how many rows a batch holds at most.

ids.description: The table of the file that keeps each row's lasting id (`kentos_uids`: the table, the row's fid, the id).

untouched.description: The tables the file already had that the write did not touch (a new file has none).

columns.description: The columns in order, each with its attribute.

geometry.description: The geometry column's type; none for a table of records.

layer.description: The layer of the copy the rows are the objects of; none for a table output.

output.description: The tool's output a table holds (`sink.tables`); none for a layer's table.

replaced.description: A table of the file taken out and written again (`replaceTables`).

ToolNote.description: A note the tool made while it ran.

plan.description: What `cad.processing.batch` did, or with `plan` would do (on a copy of the drawing).

failed.description: With `onError: continue`, the rows that stopped and were taken back: which, why (docs/adr/0551 §1).

record.description: The batch's own record: its rows as steps.

rows.description: Every row that ran, in order, as it ran (with `onError: continue`, the rows that stopped are in `failed`).

sink.description:
With a sink: the file or database the rows' results went to (or with `plan` would go to), and how
(docs/adr/0593 §1). The drawing then does not change.

step.description: The undo step's name; none when the drawing did not change.

commands.summary: Bağlı katmanı tablosuyla eşitler. write: katmanın değişikliklerini tabloya yazar, tek SQLite işleminde: yeni nesneler kalıcı kimlikleriyle eklenir (kentos_uids), değişenler fid'leriyle güncellenir, silinenler silinir, katmanın tabloda olmayan alanları sütun olarak eklenir; mekânsal dizin kendi tetikleyicileriyle izler, tanımadığı tablolara dokunulmaz. Dosya katman onunla son eşleştiğinden beri değiştiyse yazılmaz (source_changed, conflict); geometrisi tablonun sütununa uymayan nesne geometry_mismatch (Z ve M de: Z'yi yasaklayan sütuna kotlu, isteyene kotsuz, hiçbirine kısmen kotlu nesne yazılmaz; M için de aynı, docs/adr/0584 §2); tablonun tutmadığı nesneler (yazı, ölçü) ve alanı olmayan öznitelikler çizimde kalır (export_losses). Yazma geri alma adımı değildir: dosya yazılır. read: tablonun satırlarını katmana alır, tek geri alma adımı (“Kaynaktan oku: tablo”): değişen nesnelerin görünüşü kalır, yeni satırlar eklenir, tabloda olmayanlar silinir. Katman son eşleşmeden beri değiştiyse discard olmadan okunmaz (pending_changes, conflict). PostGIS tablosu da aynı kurallarla, tek veritabanı işleminde yazılır: tablo yazarlara kilitlenir, sürümü yeniden denetlenir, kalıcı kimlikler şemanın kentos_uids tablosunda; ulaşılamayan veritabanı source_unreachable. with (yalnız write) başka bağlı katmanları aynı işlemde yazar: üst kayıt ile alt kayıtları ya hep birlikte ya hiç (docs/adr/0532): her katman önce denetlenir, biri reddedilirse (source_readonly, geometry_mismatch, source_changed, relation_dangling) hiçbiri yazılmaz; katmanlar tek GeoPackage dosyasında ya da tek PostGIS veritabanında olmalıdır (docs/adr/0584 §1: veritabanında tablolar adlarının sırasıyla kilitlenir, her birinin satırları tabanına karşı denetlenir; iki kaynağa birden tek işlem olmaz, transaction_split); cevabın layers'ı her katmanın payı, relations'ı eşli ilişkilerin eşleme satırlarıdır. cad.sources.relate ile eşlenen çoktan çoğa ilişki katmanlarıyla birlikte yazılır: eşleme tablosunun satırları alt katmanın çok değerli alanını izler, alan metin sütunu olarak yazılmaz; eşlenmemiş çoktan çoğa başvuru “; ” ile birleşmiş metin olarak kalır ve relation_unmapped ile söylenir, dosyanın tanınmayan temsilli ilişkisi metne çevrilmez. read eşli ilişkinin alanını eşleme satırlarından doldurur. plan dosyayı okur, hiçbir şey yazmaz ve sayıları söyler.

oneOf.description: The layer's changes into its table.
The table's rows into the layer.

SyncTopology.description:
How a write takes the table's rows outside a part's area (docs/adr/0531, 0585): those sharing a corner or an edge
the written objects changed follow them, in the same transaction. A row is read by the changes' box from the file
or the database; a database's row is checked again under the table's lock (`source_changed` when someone changed it
since, `rows_denied` when the account may see but not change it: both profiles write nothing then).

oneOf.description:
All or nothing: a row that would be left invalid (too few vertices, or newly invalid: a ring crossing itself, of
no area, a hole out of its ring) refuses the whole write (`outside_neighbour_invalid`).
The rows that can follow do; one that would be left invalid keeps its shape and is said (`neighbours_left`).

input.description:
Input of `cad.sources.sync` v1. Refusals: `source_not_found` (the layer is not bound), `layer_not_found`,
`source_gone` (the file is gone), `source_readonly`, `geometry_mismatch`, `file_unwritable`, `rows_denied` (a
database's rows the account may not change: privilege or row security, docs/adr/0585 §2); conflicts:
`source_changed` (writing, and the file changed since the layer last matched it), `pending_changes` (reading, and
the layer differs from the table, without `discard`). Warnings: `export_losses` (objects a table has no geometry
for stay in the drawing only), `label_pins_lost` (a read that took objects with label pins out, or could not keep
their pins), `label_pins_moved` (pins that followed their key, or without a key their geometry or nearest feature
of the same kind within 0,05 m, to another row; docs/adr/0578 §2), `label_pins_parked` (pins of objects whose row
is outside the part's area now, kept in the link; docs/adr/0578 §3), `label_pins_restored` (parked pins given
back to their row that came into the part), `key_not_unique` (a read whose table repeats the layer's key: the
pins of those rows are not followed).

`with` (docs/adr/0532 §1) writes more bound layers in the same transaction: a parent and its children go in
together or not at all. Every layer is checked first; one refused (`source_readonly`, `geometry_mismatch`,
`source_changed`, `relation_dangling` …) and nothing is written. The layers must lie in one GeoPackage file
(`transaction_split`: another file, or a database, which writes one table a transaction), must not repeat, and
`with` is for writing (`invalid_input` with `read`). A relation KentOS maps (`cad.sources.relate`) is written with
its layers: its mapping rows follow the child's field (`relation_dangling`: a reference to an object the table
does not hold, not even after this write; `relation_unmapped`, a warning: a multi-valued reference that stays text).

discard.description: Reading: take the table's rows though the layer differs (one undo step brings the layer back).

layer.description: The bound layer, by id.

topology.description:
Writing a part's working copy (docs/adr/0531, 0585): the table's rows outside the area that share the changed
corners and edges follow in the same transaction, a GeoPackage's or a PostGIS table's. Reading refuses it
(`topology_on_read`).

with.description:
Writing: more bound layers (by id) written in the same transaction: of the same GeoPackage file or the same
PostGIS database (docs/adr/0532 §1, 0584 §1); layers of two sources are `transaction_split`.

commands.summary: Hem katmanı hem tablosu son eşleşmeden beri değişen bağlı katmanı uzlaştırır. Bağın tabanı (son eşleşmede her nesnenin katmandaki ve tablodaki özeti, docs/adr/0538) ile karşılaştırılır: yalnız katmanın değiştirdiği nesne tabloya yazılır, yalnız tablonun değiştirdiği (QGIS'te, başka bir KentOS'ta) katmana alınır, ikisinin aynı biçimde değiştirdiği uyuşur. İkisinin de değiştirdiği nesne tabana karşı alan alan birleştirilir (docs/adr/0553): yalnız bir yanın değiştirdiği öznitelik ve geometri o yanınkini alır, iki yan birden farklı değiştirdiği öznitelik ya da geometri çatışmadır (iki yanın değerleriyle); nesne, tabanın alan kaydı yoksa bütün olarak çatışır (field_base_missing). Birinin silip öbürünün değiştirdiği nesne de çatışmadır. Birlikte değişen nesneler bir gruptur ve birlikte, tek yanla çözülür: ortak köşesini iki yanın da taşıdığı komşular ve bir yanın sildiği üst kayıtla öbür yanın eklediği ya da değiştirdiği alt kayıt (ilişki). Son yazan kazanmaz: take (nesne ya da grup için) ve rest (kalanlar) ile bir yan seçilir; bir grubun nesneleri farklı yanlara seçilemez (group_split). with ile aynı GeoPackage dosyasının başka bağlı katmanları aynı çağrıda ve tek SQLite işleminde uzlaştırılır (başka dosyadaki katman transaction_split). plan dosyayı okur, hiçbir şey yazmaz ve hepsini söyler. Yürütme bütün çatışmalar çözülmeden yapılmaz (unresolved_conflicts, conflict); çözülünce tablonun yanı katmana alınır, katmanın yanı tabloya yazılır: tek geri alma adımı (“Uzlaştır: tablo”) ve tek işlem, dosyanın yazılamaması ikisini de geri alır. Tabanı olmayan bağ (bu sürümden önce bağlanan, MAX_BASE_ROWS'tan çok nesneli katman) uzlaştırılamaz (no_source_base): önce yazın ya da okuyun. Alan sınırlı çalışma kopyasında yalnız alandaki satırlar karşılaştırılır.

base for its revision and digest: bound before this version, or a layer of more than `MAX_BASE_ROWS` objects),
`not_a_conflict` (a `take` for an object that is not one), `invalid_input` (an object taken twice),
`geometry_mismatch` (a layer's object the table's column cannot hold), `transaction_split` (a layer of `with` in
another file), `group_split` (the objects of one group taken to different sides); conflict: `unresolved_conflicts`
