commands.title: İlişkiyi dosyaya eşle
commands.summary: Projenin bir ilişkisinin (cad.relations.edit) çok değerli alanı (alt kayıt birden çok üstün kimliğini “; ” ile tutar, docs/adr/0409) bağlı GeoPackage'da nasıl tutuluyor: iki katman da aynı dosyanın tablolarına bağlıysa metin sütunu (text), KentOS'un ilişki temsili (mapped), dosyanın başka bir temsilli ilişkisi (foreign) ya da profile uymayan ilişkisi (broken); bağlı olmayan (unbound), ayrı kaynaklardaki (split) ve tek kimlikli (single) ilişki. check hiçbir şey yazmaz, durumu ve nedenini söyler. map GeoPackage ilişki profilinde (OGC 18-000, gpkgext_relations) “kentos_references” ilişkisini ve eşleme tablosunu (base_id: alt kaydın fid'i, related_id: üstün fid'i) tek SQLite işleminde yazar; satırlar katmanların alandaki başvurularından kurulur. Eşlenen alan sütun olarak yazılmaz ve okunmaz, eşleme tablosu tek temsildir; cad.sources.sync eşleme satırlarını katmanlarla birlikte yazar ve okur. Dosyanın başka bir temsilli ilişkisi ya da eşleme tablosu olmayan bir tablo üzerine yazılmaz (relation_unsupported), noktalı virgüllü metne de çevrilmez. unmap ilişkiyi ve eşleme tablosunu dosyadan kaldırır; başvurular katmanda kalır ve sonraki yazmada metin sütunu olur (relation_unmapped uyarısıyla). Dosya katmanlar onunla son eşleştiğinden beri değiştiyse yazılmaz (source_changed, conflict). Bağ ve dosya revizyonları güncellenir; geri alma adımı değildir (dosya yazılır). plan yazmadan söyler.

input.description:

Refusals, checked in this order: `unknown_relation`; `source_gone` (the file is not there). `check` answers for what it
finds (`unbound`, `split`, `single`, `text`, `mapped`, `foreign`, `broken`); `map` and `unmap` refuse them:
`relation_unbound` (a layer of the relation is not bound), `transaction_split` (the layers are not in one GeoPackage
file: the mapping needs both in one transaction), `relation_not_multiple` (`map`) and `relation_not_mapped` (`unmap`) for a
field that holds one id, `source_readonly`, `source_changed` (status `conflict`: the file changed since the layers last
matched it); then for `map`: `relation_mapped` (already mapped), `relation_unsupported` (the file relates the two tables
another way, or its mapping table is not one), `invalid_mapping` (the table's name is not a name, or the file has a table
of it), `relation_dangling` (a reference to an object the table does not hold); for `unmap`: `relation_not_mapped`.
`file_unwritable` when the file cannot be written (nothing is).

Katman bir kaynağa bağlıysa source kaynağın sürümünü söyler: id, tablo, revision (katman kaynakla son eşleştiğinde dosyanın SHA-256'sı) ve edited (katmanda kaynağın bilmediği değişiklik var: sayfa çalışma kopyasının, kaynağın değil). expectedRevision ve expectedSource ilk sayfanın söylediklerini geri verir: çizim ya da kaynak değiştiyse sonraki sayfa okunmaz (revision_conflict, source_changed; conflict), böylece sayfalar aynı verinin sayfalarıdır. commands.title: Kaynağı sorgula
commands.summary: Bir veri kümesini bulunduğu yerde sorgular: path ve table ile bir GeoPackage dosyasının ya da bir PostGIS adresinin (postgresql://…, parolasız) tablosunu, layer ile çizimin bir katmanını (scope loaded: çizimin nesneleri, bağlı katmanda çalışma kopyası; scope source: bağlı katmanın kaynağının bütün tablosu). bbox (projenin sisteminde; kaynağın sistemi başkaysa ona çevrilir) kutusu değen kayıtları, near (at, tolerance) yere tolerans içindeki kayıtları (tanımlama), filter İfadeyle seç'in dilinde koşulu tutan kayıtları verir. fields döndürülecek alanları, geometry kaydın geometrisini projenin sisteminde ISO WKT olarak seçer. Kayıtlar anahtar sırasıyla sayfa sayfadır (limit 0–10 000, varsayılan 100; cursor önceki sayfanın next'i); anahtar sırası ekleme ve silmede kararlıdır. count sorunun tuttuğu bütün kayıtları sayar; statistics alanların istatistiğini (kentos.statistics/1: okunan, atlanan, toplam, ortalama, en az, en çok, standart sapma; kesin ondalık metinler) sayfadan değil bütün kayıtlardan verir. Kutu, sütunlar ve süzgecin kaynağın denetleyebildiği kısmı kaynağa gider: koşul ifadenin tuttuğu her kaydı tutar, kaynaktan gelen her kayıt ifadeyle burada yeniden sınanır; sonuç kaynağın kurallarından bağımsızdır. plan ne yapıldığını söyler: kutu (index, geometry, local), okunan sütunlar, kaynağa giden koşul değerleriyle ve tam olup olmadığı, burada yapılanlar, sıra. Kayıtların kalıcı kimliği (uid) aynı kaynağı açan her pencerede ve bağlı katmanın çalışma kopyasında aynıdır. Parçası bağlı katmanın çalışma kopyası tam veri kümesi değildir: partial ve partial_scope uyarısı. Çizimi değiştirmez.

The attribute holding when the object's version was recorded (its system time's start, docs/adr/0537):

start.description: The attribute holding the start (an instant layer's moment).

tolerance.description: How far from it a record's geometry may be.

QueryOrder.description:
The order of a question's records other than the key's (docs/adr/0591): a field and which way. Records without a
value come after every one with; equal ones by key (the drawing's: by lasting id).

QueryScope.description: What a layer's question is asked of.

A bound layer's source, the whole table.

QueryTime.description:
A question's time (docs/adr/0595 §1): the valid time at an instant (`at`) or over a period [`from`, `to`), the day
known (`knownAt`); the moments as `cad.time.query` reads them. A layer with time settings gives its fields; a table
(or a layer without them) names them in `fields`.

Input of `cad.sources.query` v1: `layer`, or `path` and `table`.

Refusals, checked in this order: `invalid_input` (neither or both of `layer` and `path`, `table` without `path`,
`path` without `table`, `scope` without `layer`), `invalid_count` (`limit` past 10 000), `invalid_extent` (a box that
is reversed or not finite), `invalid_tolerance`, `invalid_cursor` (not a cursor of this question), `invalid_expression`
(the filter does not compile, reads `$sıra` or `$ölçek`, or looks at another layer), `layer_not_found`, `invalid_input`
(`scope: source` on a layer that is not bound), `file_not_found`, `import_unreadable`, `table_not_found`,
`field_not_found` (in `fields`, `statistics` or `order`), `source_changed` (a conflict: the file is not the one
`expectedStamp` names), `order_too_large` (more than 200 000 records to order here), `source_unreachable`. A job
stopped answers `cancelled`.

a condition that keeps at least them, each record is checked here by the layer time's rules.

commands.title: PDF içe aktar
commands.summary: path'teki PDF'in bir sayfasının (page, varsayılan 1) çizgilerini, dolgularını ve yazılarını açık çizimin kendi nesneleri olarak alır: çizgi çizgi ya da çoklu çizgi (renk, kâğıttaki kalınlık, kesik), dolgu alan (beyaz dolgu kâğıt sayılır, alınmaz), yazı yazı (yer, yükseklik, dönüş, renk). strokes, fills, texts hangilerinin alınacağını seçer. Kâğıt ölçüsü scale ile çizime büyür (1:scale; kâğıdın bir metresi çizimin scale metresi), sayfanın sol alt köşesi at'e gelir. region (sayfanın sol alt köşesinden milimetre) yalnız bütün noktaları içinde kalan parçaları ve başı içinde kalan yazıları alır. Eğriler curves polyline ile tolerance (kâğıtta mm, varsayılan 0,01) içinde çoklu çizgi, nurbs ile kesin üçüncü dereceden NURBS eğrisi olur (aradaki düz kenarlar çizgi). Sayfanın isteğe bağlı içerik grupları katmandır (hiçbirinde olmayan “PDF”); skipLayers onları dışarıda bırakır, layers var olan katmana yönlendirir, yoksa aynı adlı katmana, o da yoksa dosyanın adındaki gruba yeni katman. PDF yazdırılanı taşır, çizimi değil: ölçü, kılavuz ve tablo çizgileri ve yazılarıyla gelir; resimler, gölgelemeler ve okunamayan harfler alınmaz (import_losses). Bütün alınanlar tek geri alma adımıdır (“PDF: ad.pdf”); plan dosyayı okur, kutuyu, katmanları ve kayıpları verir, hiçbir şey yazmaz.

oneOf.description: Points within the tolerance, as polylines.
Each run of curves exactly, as a cubic NURBS curve; the straight runs between them as lines and polylines.

PdfRegion.description: A rectangle on the page, millimetres from its lower left corner as it shows.

Vec2.description: A point in world units: x = east (Y, sağa), y = north (X, yukarı).

input.description:
Input of `file.import.pdf` v1. Refusals (`CommandError.code`), in order: `invalid_file_path`, `invalid_scale`,
`invalid_tolerance`, `invalid_pdf_region`, `file_not_found`, `import_unreadable` (not a PDF, encrypted or broken),
`pdf_page_not_found`, `layer_not_found` and `not_a_layer` (a target of `layers`), `layer_locked`,
`nothing_to_import`. Warnings: `import_losses` (pictures, shadings, letters that read as no character, white fills
taken for the paper, a page cut short).

at.description: Where the page's lower left corner goes in the drawing (metres on the wire). Absent: the origin.

curves.description: What the curves become; absent: polylines.

expectedRevision.description: The drawing's revision the input was prepared against.

group.description:
The group at the top of the tree the new layers go into, found by its name or made. Absent: one named after
the file; empty: the top of the tree.

layers.description:
A page's layer → the drawing's layer (its id) its objects go onto. A layer not named here goes onto the
drawing's layer of the same name (case and Turkish marks aside), else onto a new layer.

page.description: The page, from 1. Absent: the first.

path.description: The file to read, an absolute path.

region.description:
Only what lies inside this rectangle of the page: a part of a path whose every point is in it, a text whose
start is in it. Absent: the whole page.

scale.description:

commands.title: GeoPackage içe aktar
commands.summary: path'teki GeoPackage'ın (.gpkg) obje ve öznitelik tablolarını açık çizime alır: her tablo çizimde aynı adlı katmana, yoksa tablonun sütunlarını alan olarak taşıyan yeni bir katmana gider; yeni katmanlar dosyanın adındaki gruba girer. tables yalnız adı verilen tabloları alır, layers bir tabloyu var olan bir katmana yönlendirir. Nokta ve çok nokta nokta nesnesi, çizgi ve eğri (dairesel yay, birleşik eğri) çoklu çizgi (yaylar bulge olarak kesin), alan ve eğri alan delikleriyle alan, çok parçalılar parçalarıyla gelir; Z köşelerin kotu, M çoklu çizginin ölçüsüdür. Geometrisi olmayan ya da boş satır geometrisiz kayıttır. NULL değer özniteliğin yokluğu, boş metin boş metindir; 2⁵³'ten büyük tam sayılar metin alanına her basamağıyla gelir; UTC tarih ve saat yerel tarih-saat alanına diliminsiz gelir (import_losses söyler). Her satırın kalıcı kimliği dosyanın kentos_uids'i ya da tablo ve fid'den türetilmiş kimliktir: aynı dosya ikinci kez alınmaz (entity_exists). Dosyanın koordinat sistemi projeninkinden başkaysa reproject ile projenin sistemine çevrilir (projenin datum seçimleriyle), yoksa crs_mismatch; sistem bildirmeyen dosya olduğu gibi alınır (crs_undeclared). Telde geometri metredir. Bütün alınanlar tek geri alma adımıdır (“GeoPackage: ad.gpkg”); plan dosyayı okur, hiçbir şey yazmaz.

`reproject` was not asked), `entity_exists` (a row's lasting id is an object of the drawing already),
`nothing_to_import`. Warnings: `crs_undeclared`, `import_losses`.

commands.title: Şablondan pafta oluştur
commands.summary: Sistem şablonundan (source.type=system, id) ya da tam özel şablondan (custom, template) yeni pafta oluşturur. Sistem şablonları ve tam kitap cad.sheets.set(details=true) ile okunur. options: sayfa, ad, metre cinsinden center, ölçek paydası scale ve değişken values cevapları. Yeni id paftanın kimliğidir; öğe ve ana sayfa kimlikleri bu id’den türetilir. Resimler otomatik gömülür; index varsa paftayı o sıraya koyar. Tasarımcıyla aynı oluşturma işlemleri; hata halinde hiçbir şey yazılmaz. Model geometri değişmez. Bağımsız çağrı kâğıt geçmişinde, açık betik grubunda modelle birlikte tek undo/redo adımıdır; inverse ve inversePictures geri alır. expectedRevision korunur.

commands.title: Görünüm penceresini nesnelere sığdır
commands.summary: Sabit haritayı item kimliğiyle nesneye sığdırır. uids verilirse kalıcı kimlikli model nesneleri, bounds verilirse metre cinsinden [minX,minY,maxX,maxY], ikisi de yoksa bütün model kullanılır. uids ve bounds birlikte verilmez; boş seçim reddedilir. Döndürme korunur, iç boşluk ve yazı bandından kalan alan kullanılır; marginPct her yanda kutu boyunun yüzdesidir (varsayılan %5). standardScales=false en küçük sığan tam paydayı, true standart paydayı seçer. Tek nokta mevcut ölçeği korur. Kaynak nesneler ve modelin 1:1 boyu değişmez; yalnız görünüm merkez ve ölçeği değişir. Kilitli öğe ve atlas haritası reddedilir. Pafta tasarımcısı ile aynı çekirdek; inverse geri alır, açık betik grubunda modelle tek adımdır.

commands.title: Pafta kitabı
commands.summary: Projenin pafta kitabını pafta çekirdeğinin kendi işlemleriyle değiştirir (kentos.sheet/1; pafta tasarımcısının yaptıkları): ops sırayla ve tek değişiklik olarak uygulanır. Her işlem op ile adlanan bir nesnedir: addSheet (sayfası, öğeleriyle bir pafta), removeSheet, renameSheet, setPage, addItems (harita, antet, ölçek çubuğu, kuzey oku, yazı …), setItemProps, removeItems, applyTemplate, saveVariables ve ötekiler. Kâğıt üstündeki uzunluklar mikrometre (A3 yatay 420000 × 297000), açılar derecenin binde biridir; haritanın görünümü projenin koordinatlarında merkez ve ölçek paydasıyla verilir. Tek başına çağrı kâğıdın geçmişindedir; açık Python/belge grubu ve changeset kitabı ve resimleri modelle tek undo/redo adımına alır. Sonuçtaki inverse işlemleri geri alır. pictures, addAssets bilgisindeki SHA-256 ve byte boyuyla eşleşen base64 resim baytlarıdır; applyTemplate içindeki resim baytları otomatik gömülür. inversePictures gelirse ters işlemlerle birlikte pictures olarak ve replacePictures=true ile verilir. Sonuç kitabın paftalarını boyları ve haritalarının ölçekleriyle sayar. Çekirdeğin okumadığı ya da reddettiği işlem hiçbir şey yazdırmaz; ret çekirdeğin kodu ve ops[i] yoluyla döner. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

input.description:
Input of `cad.sheets.edit` v1: the sheet core's operations applied to the
project's book in order, as one change. Lengths on the paper are
micrometres, angles thousandths of a degree, as the core writes them. A
project without a book starts from an empty one; a book left empty is no
book. The book is the paper's (docs/adr/0251 §3): the change makes the
drawing dirty and is no undo step of it; `inverse` in the answer takes it
back. Inside an explicit group/changeset the book and its pictures are part of the model undo step (ADR 0590).

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `no_operations`
(none given), `invalid_operation` (one the core does not read, at
`ops[i]`), `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict` (status `conflict`),
`book_unreadable` (the project's book is one the core cannot read: it is
kept as it is), then the core's own refusal of an operation with its code
(`unknown_sheet`, `duplicate_id`, `unknown_item` …), at `ops[i]` and the
core's path.

expectedRevision.description:
The document revision the input was prepared against, as decimal
text. When given and the document is no longer at it, nothing is
written and the answer is `conflict`.

ops.description:
The operations, at least one, each an object tagged by `op`
(`kentos.sheet/1`).

pictures.description:
Embedded picture bytes, keyed by SHA-256. Metadata is supplied by addAssets or applyTemplate.
Each picture must match the book's metadata (digest and byte length). Existing bytes are retained.

replacePictures.description: Replace the entire picture byte set instead of merging it; use with the answer's inversePictures for undo.

commands.title: Değişiklik kümesi
commands.summary: Birden çok komutu tek iş olarak yazar: steps sırayla, aynı adımın içinde çalışır; biri reddederse hepsi geri alınır, proje ayarları, stil kitaplığı ve pafta kitabı da. Sonraki adım önceki bir adımın çıktısını tam değer olan bir metinle adlar: "$ad" o adımın uid'i, "$ad[2]" created[2]'si, "$ad.layer" layer'ı (ad, adımın as'i). Bağlı yazılar, taramalar ve ölçüler son adımdan sonra bir kez izler, çizimin bütünlüğü o zaman denetlenir. Nesneler, katmanlar, bloklar ve pafta kitabı label adlı tek geri alma adımıdır; ayarlar ve stil kitaplığı ayrı politikalarını korur, özet hangisinin değiştiğini söyler. İsteğe bağlı modelScope={sheet,item}, paftaya ait sabit ve yerleştirilmiş model görünümünü açıkça doğrular; model koordinatları yine metredir. Bu kapsamda pafta, görünüm, proje ayarı ve history komutları reddedilir. İç içe küme ve dosyaya yazan komut girmez. expectedRevision verilmişse ve çizim o sürümde değilse hiçbir şey yazılmaz, sonuç conflict olur.

ChangesetStep.description: A step of a change set.

as.description:
The name later steps refer to its output by: a letter or `_`, then
letters, digits and `_`; each once.

input.description: Its input, its catalog's schema, with references to earlier steps.

input.description:
Input of `cad.changeset.apply` v1: the steps, in order, each a command of
this host with its input as its catalog says. A later step names an
earlier one's output by a text that is the whole value: `"$ad"` its
`uid`, `"$ad[2]"` its `created[2]`, `"$ad.layer"` its `layer`,
`"$ad.created[0]"` the same as `"$ad[0]"`, where `ad` is the earlier
step's `as`. A text that names a step not before it is refused
(`unknown_reference`); any other text is the text.

Every step runs in the one change: a step refused refuses the set (its
code, at `steps[i].input.…`), and nothing of any step is written. The
linked texts, hatches and dimensions follow once, after the last step;
the document's integrity is checked then. Objects, layers and blocks are
one undo step named `label`, with the sheet book and its pictures (ADR 0590).
A later independent paper edit blocks the whole undo/redo instead of being
overwritten. Project preferences and the style library keep their separate
policy; the summary says which parts are outside undo.

Refusals, in this order: `no_steps`; per step, in order, `nested_changeset`
(a change set inside), `side_effect_in_changeset` (a `file.*` command),
`unknown_command`, `unknown_version`; `invalid_revision`,
`revision_conflict`; then the steps' own, and `unknown_reference`.

expectedRevision.description:
The document revision the input was prepared against, as decimal
text. When given and the document is no longer at it, nothing is
written and the answer is `conflict`.

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

commands.summary: Verilen katmana bir dikdörtgen alan ekler; köşeleri komut hesaplar. Çerçeve iki köşe (corners), köşe ile boy ve en (size), köşe ile alan ve bir kenar (area) ya da kenar ve en (edge); rotation kenarların doğrultusu (radyan), corners keskin, yuvarlak (fillet, yarıçap) ya da pah (chamfer, uzaklık). Halka paylaşılan çekirdekle hesaplanır ve cad.polygon.create gibi yazılır: tek geri alma adımı, kilitli katmana yazılmaz, gizli katmana uyarıyla. Dikdörtgen ve Döndürülmüş dikdörtgen araçları, Python ve ajan aynı girdiye aynı dikdörtgeni alır.

AreaRules.description:
The rules a new area is written by (docs/adr/0162, 0622 §9), the tools' Çakışma and Topoloji made explicit: the
command reads no session state.

- `avoid`: the layers whose shown areas it must not overlap (Çakışma: its own layer, or the chosen ones); what
  overlaps them is cut away and the rest written as one object, its parts and holes as they are; one wholly
  covered is refused (`area_covered`), one cut warned of (`area_clipped`). Empty: Serbest.
- `topology`: joined with the shown lines, paths and areas it touches corner by corner, within 1 µm: its corners
  on their edges go to them, theirs on its edges to it, the neighbours in the same undo step (`corners_joined`);
  a locked layer's neighbour takes none (`neighbours_locked`). `points`: points too (Noktalar da).

RectangleCorners.description: A rectangle's corners: sharp, rounded or cut, every one alike.

oneOf.description: Köşe yuvarla: an arc of this radius at every corner.
Pah: every corner cut this far along both its sides.

RectangleFrame.description: Where a rectangle lies. Its sides run along `rotation` and across it, but for `edge`, whose edge gives them.

oneOf.description: Two opposite corners (AutoCAD RECTANG's two points).

A corner, the side along the rotation (`length`) and across it (`width`), opening toward `toward`'s quarter
(RECTANG's Dimensions).
A corner, the area and the side along the rotation; the other side is the area over it (RECTANG's Area).
An edge from `a` to `b` and the width to its left (a minus sign: to its right): Döndürülmüş dikdörtgen.

Vec2.description: A point in world units: x = east (Y, sağa), y = north (X, yukarı).

input.description:
Input of `cad.rectangle.create` v1. The ring is the shared core's (`rect_from_corners`, `rect_from_size`,
`rect_from_edge`, `corners_of_ring`); it is written as `cad.polygon.create` writes, its checks after the
rectangle's own.

Refusals (`CommandError.code`), checked in this order: `not_finite` (a point, a size, the rotation, a corner
size), `invalid_distance` (a size, an area, a width, a radius or a chamfer not above zero: none of them may be
zero but a sharp rectangle's), `degenerate_shape` (a side of no length: two corners on a line along the
rotation, an edge of no length), `invalid_corners` (the radius or the chamfer does not fit the sides), then
`cad.polygon.create`'s: `invalid_line_weight`, `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict`, `layer_not_found`,
`not_a_layer`, `layer_locked`.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).

Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their

drawn from these (`geom::wall` of the shared core), at the detail the drawing's scale asks.

AreaRules.description:
The rules a new area is written by (docs/adr/0162, 0622 §9), the tools' Çakışma and Topoloji made explicit: the
command reads no session state.

- `avoid`: the layers whose shown areas it must not overlap (Çakışma: its own layer, or the chosen ones); what
  overlaps them is cut away and the rest written as one object, its parts and holes as they are; one wholly
  covered is refused (`area_covered`), one cut warned of (`area_clipped`). Empty: Serbest.
- `topology`: joined with the shown lines, paths and areas it touches corner by corner, within 1 µm: its corners
  on their edges go to them, theirs on its edges to it, the neighbours in the same undo step (`corners_joined`);
  a locked layer's neighbour takes none (`neighbours_locked`). `points`: points too (Noktalar da).

oneOf.description: Çember içinde: the centre and the first corner (AutoCAD POLYGON's Inscribed).
Çember dışında: the centre and the first edge's middle (POLYGON's Circumscribed).
Kenardan: an edge from `a` to `b`, the polygon to its left, counter-clockwise (POLYGON's Edge).

input.description:

it is written as `cad.polygon.create` writes.

two points meet), then `cad.polygon.create`'s.

commands.title: Daire dilimi oluştur
commands.summary: Verilen katmana kapalı bir daire dilimi alan ekler: merkez (c), yarıçap (r) ve yayın doğudan saat yönünün tersine a0'dan a1'e süpürüldüğü açılar (radyan). Halkayı komut hesaplar: merkez, yayın başı ve sonu, ortadaki kenar kesin yay; alan cad.polygon.create gibi yazılır. Süpürmesi sıfır ya da tam tur olan dilim degenerate_shape, sıfırdan büyük olmayan yarıçap invalid_distance ile reddedilir. Daire dilimi aracı, Python ve ajan aynı girdiye aynı dilimi alır; tek geri alma adımı.

AreaRules.description:
The rules a new area is written by (docs/adr/0162, 0622 §9), the tools' Çakışma and Topoloji made explicit: the
command reads no session state.

- `avoid`: the layers whose shown areas it must not overlap (Çakışma: its own layer, or the chosen ones); what
  overlaps them is cut away and the rest written as one object, its parts and holes as they are; one wholly
  covered is refused (`area_covered`), one cut warned of (`area_clipped`). Empty: Serbest.
- `topology`: joined with the shown lines, paths and areas it touches corner by corner, within 1 µm: its corners
  on their edges go to them, theirs on its edges to it, the neighbours in the same undo step (`corners_joined`);
  a locked layer's neighbour takes none (`neighbours_locked`). `points`: points too (Noktalar da).

Vec2.description: A point in world units: x = east (Y, sağa), y = north (X, yukarı).

input.description:
`cad.sector.create`'s input (Daire dilimi): a closed pie slice by its centre, radius and the arc swept
counter-clockwise from `a0` to `a1`. The command makes the ring (the centre, the arc's start and end, the arc as the
middle edge) and writes it as `cad.polygon.create` writes an area; a sweep of nothing or of a whole turn, or a radius
not above zero, is refused (`degenerate_shape`, `invalid_distance`). No active layer, unit or remembered tool option
is read.

a0.description: Where the arc starts: radians counter-clockwise from east (a geometry angle, not a bearing).

a1.description: Where it ends: the slice is swept counter-clockwise from `a0` to `a1`.

c.description: The centre: x east (Y), y north (X), in the project's units (m).

rules.description: Çakışma and Topoloji, as `cad.polygon.create`'s (docs/adr/0622 §9). Absent: written as made.

input.title: SectorCreate

output.description: Output of `cad.polygon.create` v1: the object written.

id.description: Its slot in the open document (`Entity.id`); it means nothing once the document is closed.

revision.description:
The document's revision after the write, as decimal text. Inside an
open transaction or group the write joins it, and the revision
changes when that ends.

uid.description: Its persistent id (UUIDv7, docs/adr/0014): the name files, the cloud, Python and AI use.

breakSize.description: A break's width, times the value's height, over 0; absent: 1 (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK size).

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

commands.summary: Verilen katmana kapalı bir revizyon bulutu alan ekler. Çerçeve doğu ve kuzey boyunca bir dikdörtgenin iki köşesi (rectangle), bir çokgenin köşeleri (polygon) ya da kapalı bir nesnenin kalıcı kimliğidir (object: alan, kapalı çoklu çizgi, daire, kapalı eğri, tam elips; nesne kalır). Halkanın her kenarı yaklaşık arc uzunluğunda eşit kirişlere bölünür, her kiriş dışa doğru 0,5 bükümlü bir yaydır; alan cad.polygon.create gibi yazılır. 10 000'den çok yay too_many_points ile reddedilir. Revizyon bulutu aracı yay boyunu kâğıt milimetresinden çizimin ölçeğiyle çevirip aynı girdiyi verir; Python ve ajan aynı bulutu alır; tek geri alma adımı.

AreaRules.description:
The rules a new area is written by (docs/adr/0162, 0622 §9), the tools' Çakışma and Topoloji made explicit: the
command reads no session state.

- `avoid`: the layers whose shown areas it must not overlap (Çakışma: its own layer, or the chosen ones); what
  overlaps them is cut away and the rest written as one object, its parts and holes as they are; one wholly
  covered is refused (`area_covered`), one cut warned of (`area_clipped`). Empty: Serbest.
- `topology`: joined with the shown lines, paths and areas it touches corner by corner, within 1 µm: its corners
  on their edges go to them, theirs on its edges to it, the neighbours in the same undo step (`corners_joined`);
  a locked layer's neighbour takes none (`neighbours_locked`). `points`: points too (Noktalar da).

the first) is dropped.

The outer outline of a closed object (an area, a closed polyline, a circle, a closed curve, a full ellipse) by
its persistent id; its curves at 64 chords a turn. The object stays.

input.description:
`cad.revcloud.create`'s input (Revizyon bulutu): the ring of `frame`, counter-clockwise, each side divided into
chords of about `arc` (`max(1, round(side / arc))` of them, equal), every chord an outward arc of bulge 0.5; written
as `cad.polygon.create` writes an area, one undo step. No active layer, plot scale or remembered tool option is
read: the tool turns its paper millimetres into `arc`.

Refusals, checked in this order: `not_finite` (a corner, `arc`), `invalid_distance` (`arc` not above zero),
`degenerate_shape` (a rectangle of no width or height, corners with no area), `too_few_corners` (fewer than three
corners), `entity_not_found` (the object), `not_closed` (an open object), `too_many_points` (more than 10 000
arcs), then `cad.polygon.create`'s.

rules.description: Çakışma and Topoloji, as `cad.polygon.create`'s (docs/adr/0622 §9). Absent: written as made.

commands.summary: Yalnız yeni sınır verilir: komşu bir alanın içinden ya da sınırından başka birine giden açık bir yol (pts, kenar başına bulges). Yolun neighbours katmanlarının (yoksa layerId'nin) görünen alanlarıyla kapattığı bölge yeni alandır; komşuların sınırı onun sınırı olur, parçaları ve delikleri olduğu gibi tek nesne olarak cad.polygon.create gibi yazılır, rules ile Çakışma ve Topoloji. within komşuları bir kutuya değenlerle sınırlar (aracın görünümü). Kapanmayan yol no_region ile reddedilir. Bitişik alan aracı, Python ve ajan aynı girdiye aynı alanı alır; tek geri alma adımı “Bitişik alan”.

AdjoinWindow.description: A box on the drawing: its south-west and north-east corners.

AreaRules.description:
The rules a new area is written by (docs/adr/0162, 0622 §9), the tools' Çakışma and Topoloji made explicit: the
command reads no session state.

- `avoid`: the layers whose shown areas it must not overlap (Çakışma: its own layer, or the chosen ones); what
  overlaps them is cut away and the rest written as one object, its parts and holes as they are; one wholly
  covered is refused (`area_covered`), one cut warned of (`area_clipped`). Empty: Serbest.
- `topology`: joined with the shown lines, paths and areas it touches corner by corner, within 1 µm: its corners
  on their edges go to them, theirs on its edges to it, the neighbours in the same undo step (`corners_joined`);
  a locked layer's neighbour takes none (`neighbours_locked`). `points`: points too (Noktalar da).

Vec2.description: A point in world units: x = east (Y, sağa), y = north (X, yukarı).

input.description:
`cad.entities.adjoin`'s input (Bitişik alan): only the new boundary is given, an open path from inside or on a
neighbouring area to another; the region it closes with the shown areas of `neighbours` (their boundaries taken
as its own) is the new area, written as `cad.polygon.create` writes one, its parts and holes as they are, one undo
step “Bitişik alan”. `within` keeps the neighbours to those touching a box (the tool's view); absent, every shown
area of the layers.

Refusals, in this order: `too_few_points` (fewer than two), `not_finite` (a point, a bulge, the box),
`bulge_count` (not one a segment), `layer_not_found` and `not_a_layer` (a neighbours' layer), `no_region` (the
path closes nothing), then `cad.polygon.create`'s (its layer, revision, line weight, attributes and `rules`).

bulges.description: One bulge a segment (DXF's: tan of a quarter of the arc's angle); absent: every segment straight.

neighbours.description: The layers whose shown areas close the region; empty: `layerId`'s own.

pts.description: The new boundary's points, at least two.

rules.description: Çakışma (beyond the neighbours) and Topoloji, as `cad.polygon.create`'s.

DatasetDim.description:
One of a dataset's slice dimensions (docs/adr/0243 §6): its name, the
index shown, its values (coordinates; moments in milliseconds since 1970
when `time`) and units.

time.description: The values are a CF time axis's moments.

DimensionArrow.description:
A dimension's arrowheads other than the oblique tick, which is no value but
the field's absence (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: A filled triangle, its tip on the dimension line's end (Dolu ok).
The triangle's two sides (Açık ok).
A filled circle about the end (Nokta).
Nothing at the ends (Yok).

DimensionBreak.description:
A gap in one of a dimension's lines where another object crosses it (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK), at the fraction `t` of
the line; its width the options' `breakSize`.

DimensionEntity.description:
Fields every object has. `id` is the object's local id inside a v1 file.
v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

angle.description: Linear: measured direction in degrees (0 = ΔY, 90 = ΔX).

annotative.description:
Its scales: drawn at the paper height it was given at every scale it takes part in, hidden
at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

arrowSize.description:
The arrowhead's (or tick's) length; absent: `DEFAULT_TICK` for ticks,
`DEFAULT_ARROW` for the others.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

breaks.description: The gaps in its lines where other objects cross them (docs/adr/0321 §1).

the line starts from (docs/adr/0147).

decimals.description:
A length's, a coordinate's or a slope's decimals; absent: the
project's length decimals (a slope's 2). Angles keep the project's.

dimLineColor.description:
The dimension line's and its arrowheads' colour, `#RRGGBB`; absent:
the object's (docs/adr/0205 §6).

dimLineType.description: The dimension line's type; absent: continuous.

dimLineWeight.description: The dimension line's weight, paper mm as an object's; absent: a hairline.

dimStyle.description: The project's dimension style it follows, by its id; absent: Standart.

extBeyond.description: How far the extension lines pass the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_BEYOND`.

extLineType.description: The extension lines' type; absent: continuous.

extOffset.description: The extension lines' gap from the measured points; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_OFFSET`.

extWeight.description: The extension lines' weight, paper mm; absent: a hairline.

font.description: The value's typeface; absent: the project's.

options.description: Where the value goes when it does not fit and how it is written (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2).

their value when the style changes. Empty: each field follows while it holds the style's old value.

prefix.description: Written before the value (and its kind's own prefix).

refs.description: The objects its points follow (docs/adr/0249): an associative dimension; none, free points.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

textColor.description: The value's colour; absent: the object's.

textGap.description: The value's baseline over the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_TEXT_GAP`.

textPlace.description: Where the value stands; absent: over the line.

textShift.description: Its value moved from its place (docs/adr/0321 §1).

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

unit.description: The unit lengths and coordinates are written in; absent: the project's.

za.description: Slope: the two points' elevations, metres (docs/adr/0147).

DimensionFit.description:
Where the value goes when it does not fit between the extension lines (AutoCAD's DIMATFIT and DIMTIX): absent,
always between them.

oneOf.description: Beyond the second extension line when the value and the two arrowheads are longer than the line between them.
Always beyond the second extension line, the arrowheads outside.

DimensionOptions.description: A dimension's options (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2): all absent, the dimension as it always was.

breakSize.description: A break's width, times the value's height, over 0; absent: 1 (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK size).

lengthStyle.description:
Feet and inches in an inch or foot unit (AutoCAD's DIMLUNIT, docs/adr/0262 §2); absent: the project's, unless
the dimension names its own unit.

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

DrawingFont.description:
The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

EllipseEntity.description: DXF ELLIPSE: centre, major axis vector, minor/major ratio, parameters t0 → t1.

oneOf.description: A general NURBS curve: degree, control points, weights and knots (docs/adr/0259).
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144).
An arrow with a note (docs/adr/0146).
Rows and columns of cells (docs/adr/0184).
A picture (docs/adr/0192).
An orthophoto, a scanned sheet or an elevation model (docs/adr/0204).
A point cloud: LAS, LAZ, COPC or text files (docs/adr/0207).
A wall (docs/adr/0339): its path, width, justification and components; its faces drawn from them.

A door, a window or a bare opening in a wall (docs/adr/0341): its wall's id, its place along it and its
jambs' points.
A grid (docs/adr/0343): its line, label and bubbles.
A column (docs/adr/0343): its centre, outline and the grids it stands on.
A stair (docs/adr/0343): its walking line and its risers, treads and landings.
A ramp (docs/adr/0343): its centre line, width, rise and landings.
A tag (docs/adr/0344): its object, its words and frame.
A view mark (docs/adr/0345): a section, elevation or detail mark pointing at a view.

A record without a geometry (docs/adr/0410): a table's row, with the base's attributes,
attachments and label; not drawn, picked or snapped to.

FieldBroken.description: Why a field's value cannot be read.

oneOf.description: The object is gone.

comma.description: A decimal comma (`24,35`) instead of a point.

decimals.description: Absent: the project's length or area decimals.

unit.description: Absent: the drawing unit for a length or a place, the project's area unit for an area.

GeorefMethod.description: A transform from the source's pixels to the drawing (docs/adr/0204 §6).

GeorefOutput.description: A resampled raster's grid: north-up, its corner on a multiple of its pixel (docs/adr/0204 §6).

digest.description: The written file's SHA-256 when it was written.

GeorefPoint.description:
A control or check point: a pixel of the source (column, row; pixel corners, 0, 0 the upper left corner of the
upper left pixel, as GDAL's GCPs) and where it is (`target`, in the record's `srid`).

check.description: A check point: kept out of the fit; its error says how good the fit is where no control point is.

name.description: What the user calls it (a mark on the sheet, a survey point's name).

off.description: Left out (Kullan off): neither fits nor checks; its residual is still shown.

target.description: Its east and north (a geographic system's longitude and latitude, degrees).

GeorefSource.description: The raster the points' pixels are of: what it read and its size.

asset.description: The project library's raster it was (embedded).

digest.description: Its bytes' SHA-256 (64 lowercase hex digits) when they were read: the revision the points belong to.

file.description: The file it was (linked), as kept.

url.description: The address it was read from.

oneOf.description: From one side of the hatch to the other along `angle`.

bounds.description: The objects whose line work closes its face (docs/adr/0328 §3).

gap.description: A face's tie: the gaps its line work was closed across, metres (docs/adr/0329 §3); absent: none.

HatchCurve.description: A boundary edge that is no line or circular arc (docs/adr/0328 §1).

oneOf.description:
An ellipse's arc: centre `c`, major semi-axis `major` (from `c`), minor to major `ratio`, from parameter `t0`
to `t1` (radians): counter-clockwise when `t1` is past `t0`, clockwise when before it; a whole ellipse
`t1 = t0 ± 2π`.
A NURBS curve run whole, from its first knot to its last.

assoc.description: The objects its region follows (docs/adr/0186 §6); none: it stays as drawn.

left, centre or right; vertically on its baseline, at its bottom (0.2 of
its height under the baseline), its middle (half its height over it) or
its top (its height over it). The left of the baseline, where a text
always stood, is no value but the field's absence: a text has one
spelling.

TextColumns.description:

v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in

align.description: Where `p` is on the text; absent: the left of the baseline (docs/adr/0145).

annotative.description:

commands.title: Parsel oluştur
commands.summary: Etkin katman ne olursa olsun parsel katmanına (parsel) kapalı bir alan ekler ve numarasını komut verir: number verilirse o (başka parselde de varsa parcel_number_taken uyarısıyla), verilmezse parsellerin Parsel değerlerinin başındaki en büyük tam sayının bir fazlası. Öznitelikleri Ada, Parsel, Mahalle, Nitelik “Arsa”, Tapu alanı (m²), Pafta; attrs onların üstüne, etiketi numara; tapu alanı boş kalır (tapunundur). Çizimde parsel katmanı yoksa yeni projedeki gibi aynı adımda açılır. Alan cad.polygon.create gibi, rules ile Çakışma ve Topoloji. Parsel oluştur aracı, Python ve ajan aynı girdiye aynı parseli alır; tek geri alma adımı.

AreaRules.description:
The rules a new area is written by (docs/adr/0162, 0622 §9), the tools' Çakışma and Topoloji made explicit: the
command reads no session state.

- `avoid`: the layers whose shown areas it must not overlap (Çakışma: its own layer, or the chosen ones); what
  overlaps them is cut away and the rest written as one object, its parts and holes as they are; one wholly
  covered is refused (`area_covered`), one cut warned of (`area_clipped`). Empty: Serbest.
- `topology`: joined with the shown lines, paths and areas it touches corner by corner, within 1 µm: its corners
  on their edges go to them, theirs on its edges to it, the neighbours in the same undo step (`corners_joined`);
  a locked layer's neighbour takes none (`neighbours_locked`). `points`: points too (Noktalar da).

Vec2.description: A point in world units: x = east (Y, sağa), y = north (X, yukarı).

input.description:
`cad.parcels.create`'s input (Parsel oluştur): a closed area on the `parsel` layer, whatever layer is active,
numbered by the command: `number` when given (its spaces trimmed; one another parcel has is warned of,
`parcel_number_taken`), else one above the greatest whole number the parcels' Parsel values start with. Its
attributes are Ada, Parsel, Mahalle, Nitelik “Arsa”, Tapu alanı (m²) and Pafta, the given ones over them, Parsel
the number; its label the number. The deed area stays empty: it is the title deed's, not the drawing's. A drawing
without the layer gets it in the parcel's undo step. Written as `cad.polygon.create` writes an area, `rules`
included.

Refusals, in this order: `invalid_parcel_number` (an empty number), `layer_locked` (the parcel layer), then
`cad.polygon.create`'s.

pts.description: Its corners, at least three.

rules.description: Çakışma and Topoloji, as `cad.polygon.create`'s.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.

Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

InsertEntity.description:
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144): its definition drawn

definition's x axis when `mirror`, then scaled and turned about `p`. The
transform is a similarity, shapes keeping their kind, unless the insert
has a y factor of its own (docs/adr/0315 §3): then an affine, a circle
becoming the exact ellipse of its image. The insert's own attributes
carry the values of the definition's attribute definitions.

commands.summary: Nesnelerin biçimini kalıcı kimlikleriyle değiştirir; geometriyi komut ortak çekirdekle hesaplar: Biçim değiştir (reshape: alanı ya da çizgiyi çizilen hatla keser ya da büyütür; çizgi çoklu çizgi olur), Sürdür (continue: çizgiyi ya da çoklu çizgiyi ucundan ya da başından noktalarla ve bükümlerle uzatır, köşeler kotlarını korur), Paralel kaydır (edgeShift: at'a en yakın düz kenarı distance kadar ya da area m²'lik alana ulaşana dek kaydırır; alanda dışarı, çoklu çizgide yürüme yönünün sağı artı), Sadeleştir (simplify: toleranstaki köşeleri atar), Kot ver (elevation: Sabit, Artır, Sıfırla) ve Okunur yap (readable: baş aşağı okunan yazıları yarım tur döndürür) ve Parçala (split: çizgi, açık çoklu çizgi, yay ve daireyi kesişimlerinden, eşit parçalara ya da uzunluktan ayrı nesnelere böler; ilk parça nesnenin yerini ve kimliğini korur, yeniler created'da). Cevap ölçüleri (önce ve sonra alan ya da uzunluk, eklenen ya da atılan köşe, kaydırma, parça) verir. Tek geri alma adımı, aracın adıyla.

ShapeElevation.description: Kot ver's elevation: one value for every vertex, a change to the ones there, or none.

oneOf.description: Sabit: every vertex at `z`.
Artır: every elevation there raised by `by` (lowered when negative); vertices without one stay without.
Sıfırla: the elevations gone.

ShapeWork.description: The edit, with what it works on.

oneOf.description:
Biçim değiştir: an area cut or grown, or a path's stretch redrawn, by the straight line through `line`'s
points; a line becomes a polyline in its place.

Sürdür: a line or a polyline continued from its start (`fromStart`) or its end through `pts`, each drawn segment
with its bulge (`bulges`, 0 straight); its own vertices keep their elevations.

Paralel kaydır: the straight edge nearest `at` moved parallel to itself by `distance` (along its outward
normal; an area's outward is away from the area), or until the area is `area` square metres; its neighbours
lengthen or shorten to meet it.
Sadeleştir: the paths' vertices within `tolerance` of their outline dropped.
Kot ver: the objects' vertices given elevations (lines, polylines, areas and points take them).
Okunur yap: the texts that read upside down turned half round about their box's middle.

Parçala (docs/adr/0140): lines, open polylines, arcs and circles cut into separate objects, by `method`: where
the given objects cross, into `parts` equal pieces (2 to 10 000), or into pieces `length` long from the start
(`fromEnd`: from the end; a circle from its east point). The first piece keeps the object's place and id.
Kesişimlerden: where the given objects cross one another.
Eşit parçalara: into `parts` pieces of equal length.
Uzunluktan: into pieces `length` long, the last one what remains.

input.description:
`cad.shapes.edit`'s input.

`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

DatasetDim.description:
One of a dataset's slice dimensions (docs/adr/0243 §6): its name, the
index shown, its values (coordinates; moments in milliseconds since 1970
when `time`) and units.

time.description: The values are a CF time axis's moments.

DimensionArrow.description:
A dimension's arrowheads other than the oblique tick, which is no value but
the field's absence (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: A filled triangle, its tip on the dimension line's end (Dolu ok).
The triangle's two sides (Açık ok).
A filled circle about the end (Nokta).
Nothing at the ends (Yok).

DimensionBreak.description:
A gap in one of a dimension's lines where another object crosses it (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK), at the fraction `t` of
the line; its width the options' `breakSize`.

DimensionEntity.description:
Fields every object has. `id` is the object's local id inside a v1 file.
v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

angle.description: Linear: measured direction in degrees (0 = ΔY, 90 = ΔX).

annotative.description:
Its scales: drawn at the paper height it was given at every scale it takes part in, hidden
at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

arrowSize.description:
The arrowhead's (or tick's) length; absent: `DEFAULT_TICK` for ticks,
`DEFAULT_ARROW` for the others.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

breaks.description: The gaps in its lines where other objects cross them (docs/adr/0321 §1).

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

c.description:
Angular: the vertex. Arc length: the arc's centre. Jogged: the centre
the line starts from (docs/adr/0147).

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

decimals.description:
A length's, a coordinate's or a slope's decimals; absent: the
project's length decimals (a slope's 2). Angles keep the project's.

dimLineColor.description:
The dimension line's and its arrowheads' colour, `#RRGGBB`; absent:
the object's (docs/adr/0205 §6).

dimLineType.description: The dimension line's type; absent: continuous.

dimLineWeight.description: The dimension line's weight, paper mm as an object's; absent: a hairline.

dimStyle.description: The project's dimension style it follows, by its id; absent: Standart.

extBeyond.description: How far the extension lines pass the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_BEYOND`.

extColor.description: The extension lines' colour; absent: the object's.

extLineType.description: The extension lines' type; absent: continuous.

extOffset.description: The extension lines' gap from the measured points; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_OFFSET`.

extWeight.description: The extension lines' weight, paper mm; absent: a hairline.

font.description: The value's typeface; absent: the project's.

labelPins.description:

§3.7), one a class at most.

mask.description:

options.description: Where the value goes when it does not fit and how it is written (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2).

order.description:

overrides.description:

their value when the style changes. Empty: each field follows while it holds the style's old value.

prefix.description: Written before the value (and its kind's own prefix).

refs.description: The objects its points follow (docs/adr/0249): an associative dimension; none, free points.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

textColor.description: The value's colour; absent: the object's.

textGap.description: The value's baseline over the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_TEXT_GAP`.

textPlace.description: Where the value stands; absent: over the line.

textShift.description: Its value moved from its place (docs/adr/0321 §1).

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

unit.description: The unit lengths and coordinates are written in; absent: the project's.

wipeout.description:

za.description: Slope: the two points' elevations, metres (docs/adr/0147).

DimensionFit.description:
Where the value goes when it does not fit between the extension lines (AutoCAD's DIMATFIT and DIMTIX): absent,
always between them.

oneOf.description: Beyond the second extension line when the value and the two arrowheads are longer than the line between them.
Always beyond the second extension line, the arrowheads outside.

DimensionOptions.description: A dimension's options (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2): all absent, the dimension as it always was.

breakSize.description: A break's width, times the value's height, over 0; absent: 1 (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK size).

lengthStyle.description:
Feet and inches in an inch or foot unit (AutoCAD's DIMLUNIT, docs/adr/0262 §2); absent: the project's, unless
the dimension names its own unit.

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

DrawingFont.description:
The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

EllipseEntity.description: DXF ELLIPSE: centre, major axis vector, minor/major ratio, parameters t0 → t1.

off.description: Left out (Kullan off): neither fits nor checks; its residual is still shown.

commands.summary: Kalıcı kimlikleriyle verilen nesnelerden yeni nesneler türetip verilen katmana ekler; hesabı komut ortak çekirdekle yapar: Köşelere nokta (vertexPoints: çizgi, çoklu çizgi ve alanların köşelerine adlı, kodlu, kotlu nokta; paylaşılan ve noktası olan köşe atlanır), Orta hat (centerline: iki kenarın ekseni, kenar bir nesne ya da uç uca birleşen zincir; eşleşen kenarlarda kesin, öbürlerinde step aralıkla) ve Toplu alan (polygonize: çizgilerin kapattığı her bölge bir alan, içindeki tek etiket attribute özniteliği). Cevap yeni nesneleri, atlananları ve sıradaki adı verir. Tek geri alma adımı, aracın adıyla.

oneOf.description:
Köşelere nokta (docs/adr/0152 §5): a point at every vertex of the lines, polylines and areas, past the places
two vertices share and those points already hold; named from `name` on (Yazı's Artır), each with the code
`code` and the vertex's elevation.

Orta hat (docs/adr/0190): the axis between two sides, each one object or a chain of lines, arcs and polylines
meeting end to end within `tolerance`; exact between matched sides, else sampled every `step`.

Toplu alan (docs/adr/0151): every region the line work `lines` closes, an area with the one label (a text, a
named point) of `labels` inside it as the attribute `attribute`; with `islands` the regions inside others too.

input.description:
`cad.objects.derive`'s input: the work, the layer and the look of what it writes.

Refusals, in this order: `not_finite`, `invalid_uid`, `entity_not_found`, then the work's own (`not_a_path`,
`invalid_distance`, `no_route`, `not_joined`, `nothing_derived` …), then `cad.entities.create`'s.

matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

Yazının kâğıt yüksekliği mm, çizimde ölçekle çarpılır. Tek geri alma adımı, aracın adıyla.

oneOf.description:
Koordinat yaz and Köşelere koordinat yaz (docs/adr/0185): a label at each place `at`, its elevation and name the
visible objects' there, or at every vertex of the objects `ids`; `template`'s lines (`{Y}`, `{X}`, `{Z}`,
`{ad}`; the project type's first when none), `decimals` (the project's when none), a leader (`leader`) and
the way it leans (`lean`).

Km yaz (docs/adr/0189): the route `id`'s stations at the multiples of `interval` of its km (from `start` at
its first point, or its last with `reverse`; its measures with `measures` when it has them), its ends too with
`ends`; at each the km text on `text`'s side, a tick (`tick`), a cross-section of half width `section` and a
point `point` off the way (the right positive), each as asked.

Eğri boyunca yazı (docs/adr/0196 §4): `text` on the curve `id` (a line, an arc, a circle, a polyline's part, an
area's ring or hole, an ellipse, a spline: the path nearest `at`), on the piece its letters take, `at` being
what `align`'s share along says of it (its start, middle or end) and its share up where the letters stand
(over, on or under the curve; bottom centre when none); the piece turned so that the text reads.

DrawingFont.description:
The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

oneOf.description: Away from the middle of its object's box; north-east without one.

StationText.description: The side the km text goes on (Yazı), or none.

TextAlign.description:
Which point of a text its `p` is (docs/adr/0145 §1): horizontally its
left, centre or right; vertically on its baseline, at its bottom (0.2 of
its height under the baseline), its middle (half its height over it) or
its top (its height over it). The left of the baseline, where a text
always stood, is no value but the field's absence: a text has one
spelling.

TextFace.description:
A text's look from its style (docs/adr/0183 §2): the style it follows and
the face it is drawn in. With a typeface the text is drawn upright at 400
(600 bold, its italic face when italic), its letters leaning `oblique`
degrees; without one it is drawn as texts always were, in the project's
typeface (docs/adr/0055), and has no bold, italic or slant.

font.description: Its typeface; absent: the project's, in the look of docs/adr/0055.

oblique.description:
How far its letters lean, degrees, positive with their tops to the
right; within ±`MAX_OBLIQUE`, never 0 (upright is the field's absence).

overrides.description: The fields set apart from its style by hand (docs/adr/0322 §5), by name (`TEXT_OVERRIDES`), as a dimension's.

textStyle.description: The project's text style it follows, by its id; absent: Standart.

Vec2.description: A point in world units: x = east (Y, sağa), y = north (X, yukarı).

Refusals, in this order: `not_finite`, `invalid_uid`, `entity_not_found`, then the work's own (`invalid_input`,
`not_a_path`, `no_route`, `invalid_distance`, `nothing_derived` …), then `cad.entities.create`'s.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

commands.title: Alan işlemleri
commands.summary: Alan işlemlerini kalıcı kimlikleriyle verilen nesnelerde yapar; geometriyi komut ortak çekirdeğin kesin alan cebiriyle hesaplar (yaylar yay kalır, köşeler koordinatlarını korur): Alan birleştir (union; single ile değmeyenler tek çok parçalı alan), Alan kesiştir (intersect; erase ile kaynaklar silinir), Alan çıkar (subtract: from'dan cut çıkar; içteki alan delik bırakır), Alan böl (split: line noktaları ya da cutter nesnesiyle; ilk parça alanın kendisi), Alana çevir (toArea: kapalı nesneler yerinde, çizgilerin kapattığı bölgeler yeni alan), Çizgiye çevir (toPolyline), Parçaları birleştir ve Parçalara ayır (partsJoin, partsSplit: alan, çizgi ya da nokta), Delik ekle (holeAdd: halka), Deliği sil ve Deliği doldur (holeRemove, holeFill: delikteki nokta). Cevap yazılanları, sonucun nesnelerini (result) ve ölçülerini (alan m², parça sayısı) verir. Tek geri alma adımı, aracın adıyla.

AreaWork.description: The operation, with what it works on.

oneOf.description:
Alan birleştir: the areas go, their union comes from the first (its layer, colour and data); areas that do not
touch stay apart, or with `single` make one multi-part area. A multi-part area takes part whole.

Alan kesiştir: the areas' common part, a new blank area; with `erase` the areas go and it takes the first one's
data.

Alan çıkar: the areas `cut` taken out of the areas `from`, each piece left with its source's data; one wholly
inside leaves a hole; with `erase` the cutters go too (but not those on a locked layer).

Alan böl: the areas split along a cut line through `line`'s points, or along the object `cutter` (Çizgiyle
kes); the first piece is the area itself, the others new with its data.

Alana çevir: closed objects become areas in their places; the regions the line work among them closes become
new blank areas on the first line's layer (the lines stay).
Çizgiye çevir: each area's outer ring becomes a closed polyline in its place; its holes new blank polylines.
Parçaları birleştir: areas, lines or points (one kind) become one multi-part object in the first one's place.
Parçalara ayır: multi-part objects come apart, the first part keeping the place, the others new with its data.
Delik ekle: the ring cut from the area as a hole; one touching a hole merges with it.
Deliği sil: the area's hole around `at` removed.
Deliği doldur: the area's hole around `at` filled with a new area from it, the hole kept.

Vec2.description: A point in world units: x = east (Y, sağa), y = north (X, yukarı).

input.description:
`cad.areas.edit`'s input.

Refusals, in this order: `not_finite`, `entity_not_found`, `too_few_objects` (fewer areas than the operation needs),
`not_an_area` (an object that encloses no area where one must), `no_overlap` (nothing in common, nothing cut),
`degenerate_shape` (a cut line or a ring of too few points), `no_hole` (no hole at the point), `invalid_hole` (the
ring not inside the area), then `cad.entities.edit`'s (`layer_locked` …).

Feet and inches in an inch or foot unit (AutoCAD's DIMLUNIT, docs/adr/0262 §2); absent: the project's, unless
the dimension names its own unit.

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

decimals.description: Its decimals; absent: the value's.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

DrawingFont.description:
The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

drawn from these (`geom::wall` of the shared core), at the detail the drawing's scale asks.

commands.summary: Yapım araçlarının nesnelerini verilen katmana ekler; geometriyi komut hesaplar: Paralel çizgi (eksenin iki yanı, isteğe bağlı eksen ya da koridor alanı), Dik in (noktalardan çizgiye ya da daireye dikler), Dik çık (dik ayak ve dik boyla), İki daireye teğet (tıklamalara en yakın ortak teğet), Dördüncü köşe (nokta ya da paralelkenar alanı), Menzil halkaları (aralık, sayı, ışın), Ara nokta (eşit parçalar, uzaklıklar ya da oranlar), Kesişim noktası (iki uzaklık, iki doğrultu ya da iki doğru), yardımcı çizginin Açıortay'ı ve Paralel'i. Uzaklıklar çizim biriminde, doğrultular kuzeyden saat yönünde radyan. Teğeti ya da kesişimi olmayan yapım no_intersection, çakışan ya da aynı doğrudaki noktalar degenerate_shape ile reddedilir. Araç, Python ve ajan aynı girdiye aynı nesneleri alır; tek geri alma adımı, aracın adıyla.

oneOf.description:
Paralel çizgi: the sides of an axis at `left` and `right` (miter joins), as lines or (`area`) as the corridor
between them; with `withAxis` the axis too. A closed axis makes closed sides.
Dik in: from each point a line to its foot on the reference.
Dik çık: on the line from `a` to `b`, a line from each station's foot square to it.
İki daireye teğet: the common tangent of two circles or arcs nearest the two points.
Dördüncü köşe: the parallelogram's corner opposite `b`, a point, or (`area`) the parallelogram.

Menzil halkaları: `count` rings at `spacing` round `centre`, and `rays` from it to the outer one, the first due
north.

Ara nokta: points on the line from `a` to `b`: in `parts` equal parts, at `distances` from `a`, or at `ratios`
of the way (one of them).
Kesişim noktası: one point.

Yardımcı çizgi, Açıortay: the construction line through `vertex` halving the angle between the arms to `p1` and
`p2` (square to opposite arms).

Yardımcı çizgi, Paralel: the construction line parallel to the edge `a`→`b`, `distance` from it on `side`'s
side, or through `side` without a distance.

ConstructionRound.description: A circle, or an arc of it (`a0` to `a1`, radians counter-clockwise from east).

Meeting.description: How Kesişim noktası finds its point.

oneOf.description: İki uzaklık: `da` from `a` and `db` from `b`; of two points the one nearest `near`, else the one right of a→b.

İki doğrultu: from `a` along the survey bearing `ta` and from `b` along `tb` (radians from grid north,
clockwise); the meeting ahead of both.
İki doğru: the line through `a` and `b` and the one through `c` and `d`, wherever they extend to.

PerpendicularReference.description:
What a perpendicular is dropped onto (Dik in): a straight edge from `a` (its start) to `b`, taken as its whole
line, or a circle, the perpendicular then running through its centre.

PerpendicularStation.description: Dik çık's foot along the line (dik ayak, from its start) and the length square to it (dik boy, right plus).

Vec2.description: A point in world units: x = east (Y, sağa), y = north (X, yukarı).

input.description:
`cad.constructions.create`'s input: the construction, the layer and the look its objects take.

Refusals, in this order: `not_finite` (a point or a number), `invalid_distance` (a side, a radius, a spacing not
above zero where one is needed), `invalid_count` (parts, rings or rays out of range), `degenerate_shape` (points
that fall together or lie on a line where they must not, a reference of no length, a centre given as the point),
`no_intersection` (no tangent, no meeting), then `cad.entities.create`'s.
